verses.sa: स्वादिष्ठया मदिष्ठया पवस्व सोम धारया । इन्द्राय पातवे सुतः॥
verses.tr: svādiṣṭhayā madiṣṭhayā pavasva soma dhārayā indrāya pātave sutaḥ
verses.en: In sweetest and most gladdening stream flow pure, O Soma, on thy way, Pressed out for Indra, for his drink.

verses.sa: रक्षोहा विश्वचर्षणिरभि योनिमयोहतम् । द्रुणा सधस्थमासदत्॥
verses.tr: rakṣohā viśvacarṣaṇirabhi yonimayohatam druṇā sadhasthamāsadat
verses.en: Fiend-queller, Friend of all men, he hath with the wood attained unto His place, his iron-fashioned home.

verses.sa: वरिवोधातमो भव मंहिष्ठो वृत्रहन्तमः । पर्षि राधो मघोनाम्॥
verses.tr: varivodhātamo bhava maṃhiṣṭho vṛtrahantamaḥ parṣi rādho maghonām
verses.en: Be thou best Vrtra-slayer, best granter of bliss, most liberal: Promote our wealthy princes' gifts.

verses.sa: अभ्यर्ष महानां देवानां वीतिमन्धसा । अभि वाजमुत श्रवः॥
verses.tr: abhyarṣa mahānāṃ devānāṃ vītimandhasā abhi vājamuta śravaḥ
verses.en: Flow onward with thy juice unto the banquet of the Mighty Gods: Flow hither for our strength and fame.

verses.sa: त्वामच्छा चरामसि तदिदर्थं दिवेदिवे । इन्दो त्वे न आशसः॥
verses.tr: tvāmacchā carāmasi tadidarthaṃ divedive indo tve na āśasaḥ
verses.en: O Indu, we draw nigh to thee, with this one object day by day: To thee alone our prayers are said

verses.sa: पुनाति ते परिस्रुतं सोमं सूर्यस्य दुहिता । वारेण शश्वता तना॥
verses.tr: punāti te parisrutaṃ somaṃ sūryasya duhitā vāreṇa śaśvatā tanā
verses.en: By means of this eternal fleece may Surya's Daughter purify Thy Soma that is foaming forth.

verses.sa: तमीमण्वीः समर्य आ गृभ्णन्ति योषणो दश । स्वसारः पार्ये दिवि॥
verses.tr: tamīmaṇvīḥ samarya ā gṛbhṇanti yoṣaṇo daśa svasāraḥ pārye divi
verses.en: Ten sister maids of slender form seize him within the press and hold Him firmly on the final day.

verses.sa: तमीं हिन्वन्त्यग्रुवो धमन्ति बाकुरं दृतिम् । त्रिधातु वारणं मधु॥
verses.tr: tamīṃ hinvantyagruvo dhamanti bākuraṃ dṛtim tridhātu vāraṇaṃ madhu
verses.en: The virgins send him forth: they blow the the skin musician-like and fuse The triple foe-repelling meath.

verses.sa: अभी३ममघ्न्या उत श्रीणन्ति धेनवः शिशुम् । सोममिन्द्राय पातवे॥
verses.tr: abhī3mamaghnyā uta śrīṇanti dhenavaḥ śiśum somamindrāya pātave
verses.en: Inviolable milch-kine round about him blend for Indra's drink, The fresh young Soma with their milk.

verses.sa: अस्येदिन्द्रो मदेष्वा विश्वा वृत्राणि जिघ्नते । शूरो मघा च मंहते॥
verses.tr: asyedindro madeṣvā viśvā vṛtrāṇi jighnate śūro maghā ca maṃhate
verses.en: In the wild raptures of this draught, Indra slays all the Vrtras: he, The Hero, pours his wealth on us.

verses.sa: पवस्व देववीरति पवित्रं सोम रंह्या । इन्द्रमिन्दो वृषा विश॥
verses.tr: pavasva devavīrati pavitraṃ soma raṃhyā indramindo vṛṣā viśa
verses.en: Soma, flow on, inviting Gods, speed to the purifying cloth: Pass into Indra, as a Bull.

verses.sa: आ वच्यस्व महि प्सरो वृषेन्दो द्युम्नवत्तमः । आ योनिं धर्णसिः सदः॥
verses.tr: ā vacyasva mahi psaro vṛṣendo dyumnavattamaḥ ā yoniṃ dharṇasiḥ sadaḥ
verses.en: As mighty food speed hitherward, Indu, as a most splendid Steer: Sit in thy place as one with strength.

verses.sa: अधुक्षत प्रियं मधु धारा सुतस्य वेधसः । अपो वसिष्ट सुक्रतुः॥
verses.tr: adhukṣata priyaṃ madhu dhārā sutasya vedhasaḥ apo vasiṣṭa sukratuḥ
verses.en: The well-loved meath was made to flow, the stream of the creative juice ne Sage drew waters to himself.

verses.sa: महान्तं त्वा महीरन्वापो अर्षन्ति सिन्धवः । यद्गोभिर्वासयिष्यसे॥
verses.tr: mahāntaṃ tvā mahīranvāpo arṣanti sindhavaḥ yadgobhirvāsayiṣyase
verses.en: The mighty waters, yea, the floods accompany thee Mighty One, When thou wilt clothe thee with the milk.

verses.sa: समुद्रो अप्सु मामृजे विष्टम्भो धरुणो दिवः । सोमः पवित्रे अस्मयुः॥
verses.tr: samudro apsu māmṛje viṣṭambho dharuṇo divaḥ somaḥ pavitre asmayuḥ
verses.en: The lake is brightened in the floods. Soma, our Friend, heaven's prop and stay, Falls on the purifying cloth.

verses.sa: अचिक्रदद्वृषा हरिर्महान्मित्रो न दर्शतः । सं सूर्येण रोचते॥
verses.tr: acikradadvṛṣā harirmahānmitro na darśataḥ saṃ sūryeṇa rocate
verses.en: The tawny Bull hath bellowed, fair as mighty Mitra to behold: He shines together with the Sun.

verses.sa: गिरस्त इन्द ओजसा मर्मृज्यन्ते अपस्युवः । याभिर्मदाय शुम्भसे॥
verses.tr: girasta inda ojasā marmṛjyante apasyuvaḥ yābhirmadāya śumbhase
verses.en: Songs, Indu, active in their might are beautified for thee, wherewith Thou deckest thee for our delight.

verses.sa: तं त्वा मदाय घृष्वय उ लोककृत्नुमीमहे । तव प्रशस्तयो महीः॥
verses.tr: taṃ tvā madāya ghṛṣvaya u lokakṛtnumīmahe tava praśastayo mahīḥ
verses.en: To thee who givest ample room we pray, to win the joyous draught: Great are the praise due to thee.

verses.sa: अस्मभ्यमिन्दविन्द्रयुर्मध्वः पवस्व धारया । पर्जन्यो वृष्टिमाँ इव॥
verses.tr: asmabhyamindavindrayurmadhvaḥ pavasva dhārayā parjanyo vṛṣṭimāṃ iva
verses.en: Indu as, Indra's Friend, on us pour with a stream of sweetness, like Parjanya sender of the rain.

verses.sa: गोषा इन्दो नृषा अस्यश्वसा वाजसा उत । आत्मा यज्ञस्य पूर्व्यः॥
verses.tr: goṣā indo nṛṣā asyaśvasā vājasā uta ātmā yajñasya pūrvyaḥ
verses.en: Winner of kine, Indu, art thou, winner of heroes, steeds, and strength Primeval Soul of sacrifice.

verses.sa: एष देवो अमर्त्यः पर्णवीरिव दीयति । अभि द्रोणान्यासदम्॥
verses.tr: eṣa devo amartyaḥ parṇavīriva dīyati abhi droṇānyāsadam
verses.en: Here present this Immortal God flies, like a bird upon her wings, To settle in the vats of wood.

verses.sa: एष देवो विपा कृतोऽति ह्वरांसि धावति । पवमानो अदाभ्यः॥
verses.tr: eṣa devo vipā kṛto'ti hvarāṃsi dhāvati pavamāno adābhyaḥ
verses.en: This God, made ready with the hymn, runs swiftly through the winding ways, Inviolable as he flows.

verses.sa: एष देवो विपन्युभिः पवमान ऋतायुभिः । हरिर्वाजाय मृज्यते॥
verses.tr: eṣa devo vipanyubhiḥ pavamāna ṛtāyubhiḥ harirvājāya mṛjyate
verses.en: This God while flowing is adorned, like a bay steed for war, by men Devout and skilled in holy songs.

verses.sa: एष विश्वानि वार्या शूरो यन्निव सत्वभिः । पवमानः सिषासति॥
verses.tr: eṣa viśvāni vāryā śūro yanniva satvabhiḥ pavamānaḥ siṣāsati
verses.en: He, like a warrior going forth with heroes, as he flows along Is fain to win all precious boons.

verses.sa: एष देवो रथर्यति पवमानो दशस्यति । आविष्कृणोति वग्वनुम्॥
verses.tr: eṣa devo ratharyati pavamāno daśasyati āviṣkṛṇoti vagvanum
verses.en: This God, as he is flowing on, speeds like a car and gives his gifts: He lets his voice be heard of all

verses.sa: एष विप्रैरभिष्टुतोऽपो देवो वि गाहते । दधद्रत्नानि दाशुषे॥
verses.tr: eṣa viprairabhiṣṭuto'po devo vi gāhate dadhadratnāni dāśuṣe
verses.en: Praised by the sacred bards, this God dives into waters, and bestows Rich gifts upon the worshipper.

verses.sa: एष दिवं वि धावति तिरो रजांसि धारया । पवमानः कनिक्रदत्॥
verses.tr: eṣa divaṃ vi dhāvati tiro rajāṃsi dhārayā pavamānaḥ kanikradat
verses.en: Away he rushes with his stream, across the regions, into heaven, And roars as he is flowing on.

verses.sa: एष दिवं व्यासरत्तिरो रजांस्यस्पृतः । पवमानः स्वध्वरः॥
verses.tr: eṣa divaṃ vyāsarattiro rajāṃsyaspṛtaḥ pavamānaḥ svadhvaraḥ
verses.en: While flowing, meet for sacrifice, he hath gone up to heaven across The regions, irresistible.

verses.sa: एष प्रत्नेन जन्मना देवो देवेभ्यः सुतः । हरिः पवित्रे अर्षति॥
verses.tr: eṣa pratnena janmanā devo devebhyaḥ sutaḥ hariḥ pavitre arṣati
verses.en: After the 'way of ancient time, this God, pressed out for Deities, Flows tawny to the straining-cloth.

verses.sa: एष उ स्य पुरुव्रतो जज्ञानो जनयन्निषः । धारया पवते सुतः॥
verses.tr: eṣa u sya puruvrato jajñāno janayanniṣaḥ dhārayā pavate sutaḥ
verses.en: This Lord of many Holy Laws, even at his birth engendering strength, Effused, flows onward in a stream.

verses.sa: सना च सोम जेषि च पवमान महि श्रवः । अथा नो वस्यसस्कृधि॥
verses.tr: sanā ca soma jeṣi ca pavamāna mahi śravaḥ athā no vasyasaskṛdhi
verses.en: O Soma flowing on thy way, win thou and conquer high renown; And make us better than we are.

verses.sa: सना ज्योतिः सना स्व१र्विश्वा च सोम सौभगा । अथा नो वस्यसस्कृधि॥
verses.tr: sanā jyotiḥ sanā sva1rviśvā ca soma saubhagā athā no vasyasaskṛdhi
verses.en: Win thou the light, win heavenly light, and, Soma, all felicities; And make us better than we are.

verses.sa: सना दक्षमुत क्रतुमप सोम मृधो जहि । अथा नो वस्यसस्कृधि॥
verses.tr: sanā dakṣamuta kratumapa soma mṛdho jahi athā no vasyasaskṛdhi
verses.en: Win skillful strength and mental power. O Soma, drive away our foes; And make us better than we are.

verses.sa: पवीतारः पुनीतन सोममिन्द्राय पातवे । अथा नो वस्यसस्कृधि॥
verses.tr: pavītāraḥ punītana somamindrāya pātave athā no vasyasaskṛdhi
verses.en: Ye purifiers, purify Soma for Indra, for his drink: Make thou us better than we are.

verses.sa: त्वं सूर्ये न आ भज तव क्रत्वा तवोतिभिः । अथा नो वस्यसस्कृधि॥
verses.tr: tvaṃ sūrye na ā bhaja tava kratvā tavotibhiḥ athā no vasyasaskṛdhi
verses.en: Give us our portion in the Sun through thine own mental power and aids; And make us better than we are.

verses.sa: तव क्रत्वा तवोतिभिर्ज्योक्पश्येम सूर्यम् । अथा नो वस्यसस्कृधि॥
verses.tr: tava kratvā tavotibhirjyokpaśyema sūryam athā no vasyasaskṛdhi
verses.en: Through thine own mental power and aid long may we look upon the Sun; Make thou us better than we are.

verses.sa: अभ्यर्ष स्वायुध सोम द्विबर्हसं रयिम् । अथा नो वस्यसस्कृधि॥
verses.tr: abhyarṣa svāyudha soma dvibarhasaṃ rayim athā no vasyasaskṛdhi
verses.en: Well-weaponed Soma, pour to us a stream of riches doubly great; And make us better than we are.

verses.sa: अभ्य१र्षानपच्युतो रयिं समत्सु सासहिः । अथा नो वस्यसस्कृधि॥
verses.tr: abhya1rṣānapacyuto rayiṃ samatsu sāsahiḥ athā no vasyasaskṛdhi
verses.en: As one victorious unsubdued in battle pour forth wealth to us; And make us better than we are.

verses.sa: त्वां यज्ञैरवीवृधन्पवमान विधर्मणि । अथा नो वस्यसस्कृधि॥
verses.tr: tvāṃ yajñairavīvṛdhanpavamāna vidharmaṇi athā no vasyasaskṛdhi
verses.en: By worship, Pavamana! men have strengthened thee to prop the Law: Make thou us better than we are.

verses.sa: रयिं नश्चित्रमश्विनमिन्दो विश्वायुमा भर । अथा नो वस्यसस्कृधि॥
verses.tr: rayiṃ naścitramaśvinamindo viśvāyumā bhara athā no vasyasaskṛdhi
verses.en: O Indu, bring us wealth in steeds, manifold. quickening all life; And mate us better than we are.

verses.sa: समिद्धो विश्वतस्पतिः पवमानो वि राजति । प्रीणन्वृषा कनिक्रदत्॥
verses.tr: samiddho viśvataspatiḥ pavamāno vi rājati prīṇanvṛṣā kanikradat
verses.en: Enkindled, Pavamana, Lord, sends forth his light on, every side In friendly show, the bellowing Bull.

verses.sa: तनूनपात्पवमानः शृङ्गे शिशानो अर्षति । अन्तरिक्षेण रारजत्॥
verses.tr: tanūnapātpavamānaḥ śṛṅge śiśāno arṣati antarikṣeṇa rārajat
verses.en: He, Pavamana, Self-produced, speeds onward sharpening his horns: He glitters through the firmament.

verses.sa: ईळेन्यः पवमानो रयिर्वि राजति द्युमान् । मधोर्धाराभिरोजसा॥
verses.tr: īḻenyaḥ pavamāno rayirvi rājati dyumān madhordhārābhirojasā
verses.en: Brilliant like wealth, adorable, with splendour Pavamana shines, Mightily with the streams of meath.

verses.sa: बर्हिः प्राचीनमोजसा पवमानः स्तृणन्हरिः । देवेषु देव ईयते॥
verses.tr: barhiḥ prācīnamojasā pavamānaḥ stṛṇanhariḥ deveṣu deva īyate
verses.en: The tawny Pavamana, who strews from of old the grass with might, Is worshipped, God amid the Gods.

verses.sa: उदातैर्जिहते बृहद्द्वारो देवीर्हिरण्ययीः । पवमानेन सुष्टुताः॥
verses.tr: udātairjihate bṛhaddvāro devīrhiraṇyayīḥ pavamānena suṣṭutāḥ
verses.en: The golden, the Celestial Doors are lifted with their frames on high, By Pavamana glorified.

verses.sa: सुशिल्पे बृहती मही पवमानो वृषण्यति । नक्तोषासा न दर्शते॥
verses.tr: suśilpe bṛhatī mahī pavamāno vṛṣaṇyati naktoṣāsā na darśate
verses.en: With passion Pavamana longs for the great lofty pair, well-formed Like beauteous maidens, Night and Dawn

verses.sa: उभा देवा नृचक्षसा होतारा दैव्या हुवे । पवमान इन्द्रो वृषा॥
verses.tr: ubhā devā nṛcakṣasā hotārā daivyā huve pavamāna indro vṛṣā
verses.en: Both Gods who look on men I call, Celestial Heralds: Indra's Self Is Pavamana, yea, the Bull.

verses.sa: भारती पवमानस्य सरस्वतीळा मही । इमं नो यज्ञमा गमन्तिस्रो देवीः सुपेशसः॥
verses.tr: bhāratī pavamānasya sarasvatīḻā mahī imaṃ no yajñamā gamantisro devīḥ supeśasaḥ
verses.en: This, Pavamana's sacrifice, shall the three beauteous Goddesses, Sarasvati and Bharati and Ila, Mighty One, attend.

verses.sa: त्वष्टारमग्रजां गोपां पुरोयावानमा हुवे । इन्दुरिन्द्रो वृषा हरिः पवमानः प्रजापतिः॥
verses.tr: tvaṣṭāramagrajāṃ gopāṃ puroyāvānamā huve indurindro vṛṣā hariḥ pavamānaḥ prajāpatiḥ
verses.en: 1 summon Tvastar hither, our protector, champion, earliest-born, Indu is Indra, tawny Steer; Pavamana is Prajapati.

verses.sa: वनस्पतिं पवमान मध्वा समङ्ग्धि धारया । सहस्रवल्शं हरितं भ्राजमानं हिरण्ययम्॥
verses.tr: vanaspatiṃ pavamāna madhvā samaṅgdhi dhārayā sahasravalśaṃ haritaṃ bhrājamānaṃ hiraṇyayam
verses.en: O Pavamana, with the meath in streams anoint Vanaspati, The ever-green. the golden-hued, refulgent, with a thousand boughs.

verses.sa: विश्वे देवाः स्वाहाकृतिं पवमानस्या गत । वायुर्बृहस्पतिः सूर्योऽग्निरिन्द्रः सजोषसः॥
verses.tr: viśve devāḥ svāhākṛtiṃ pavamānasyā gata vāyurbṛhaspatiḥ sūryo'gnirindraḥ sajoṣasaḥ
verses.en: Come to the consecrating rite of Pavamana, all ye Gods,- Vayu, Surya, Brhaspati, Indra, and Agni, in accord.

verses.sa: मन्द्रया सोम धारया वृषा पवस्व देवयुः । अव्यो वारेष्वस्मयुः॥
verses.tr: mandrayā soma dhārayā vṛṣā pavasva devayuḥ avyo vāreṣvasmayuḥ
verses.en: Soma, flow on with pleasant stream, a Bull devoted to the Gods, Our Friend, unto the woolen sieve.

verses.sa: अभि त्यं मद्यं मदमिन्दविन्द्र इति क्षर । अभि वाजिनो अर्वतः॥
verses.tr: abhi tyaṃ madyaṃ madamindavindra iti kṣara abhi vājino arvataḥ
verses.en: Pour hitherward, as Indra's Self, Indu, that gladdening stream of thine, And send us coursers full of strength.

verses.sa: अभि त्यं पूर्व्यं मदं सुवानो अर्ष पवित्र आ । अभि वाजमुत श्रवः॥
verses.tr: abhi tyaṃ pūrvyaṃ madaṃ suvāno arṣa pavitra ā abhi vājamuta śravaḥ
verses.en: Flow to the filter hitherward, pouring that ancient gladdening juice, Streaming forth power and high renown.

verses.sa: अनु द्रप्सास इन्दव आपो न प्रवतासरन् । पुनाना इन्द्रमाशत॥
verses.tr: anu drapsāsa indava āpo na pravatāsaran punānā indramāśata
verses.en: Hither the sparkling drops have flowed, like waters down a steep descent They have reached Indra purified.

verses.sa: यमत्यमिव वाजिनं मृजन्ति योषणो दश । वने क्रीळन्तमत्यविम्॥
verses.tr: yamatyamiva vājinaṃ mṛjanti yoṣaṇo daśa vane krīḻantamatyavim
verses.en: Whom, having passed the filter, ten dames cleanse, as 'twere a vigorous steed, While he disports him in the wood,-

verses.sa: तं गोभिर्वृषणं रसं मदाय देववीतये । सुतं भराय सं सृज॥
verses.tr: taṃ gobhirvṛṣaṇaṃ rasaṃ madāya devavītaye sutaṃ bharāya saṃ sṛja
verses.en: The steer-strong juice with milk pour forth, for feast and service of the Gods, To him who bears away the draught.

verses.sa: देवो देवाय धारयेन्द्राय पवते सुतः । पयो यदस्य पीपयत्॥
verses.tr: devo devāya dhārayendrāya pavate sutaḥ payo yadasya pīpayat
verses.en: Effused, the God flows onward with his stream to Indra, to the God, So that his milk may strengthen him.

verses.sa: आत्मा यज्ञस्य रंह्या सुष्वाणः पवते सुतः । प्रत्नं नि पाति काव्यम्॥
verses.tr: ātmā yajñasya raṃhyā suṣvāṇaḥ pavate sutaḥ pratnaṃ ni pāti kāvyam
verses.en: Soul of the sacrifice, the juice effused flows quickly on: he keeps His ancient wisdom of a Sage.

verses.sa: एवा पुनान इन्द्रयुर्मदं मदिष्ठ वीतये । गुहा चिद्दधिषे गिरः॥
verses.tr: evā punāna indrayurmadaṃ madiṣṭha vītaye guhā ciddadhiṣe giraḥ
verses.en: So pouring forth, as Indra's Friend, strong drink, best Gladdener! for the feast, Thou, even in secret, storest hymns.

verses.sa: असृग्रमिन्दवः पथा धर्मन्नृतस्य सुश्रियः । विदाना अस्य योजनम्॥
verses.tr: asṛgramindavaḥ pathā dharmannṛtasya suśriyaḥ vidānā asya yojanam
verses.en: Forth on their way the glorious drops have flowed for maintenance of Law, Knowing this sacrifice's course.

verses.sa: प्र धारा मध्वो अग्रियो महीरपो वि गाहते । हविर्हविष्षु वन्द्यः॥
verses.tr: pra dhārā madhvo agriyo mahīrapo vi gāhate havirhaviṣṣu vandyaḥ
verses.en: Down in the mighty waters sinks the stream of meath, most excellent, Oblation best of all in worth.

verses.sa: प्र युजो वाचो अग्रियो वृषाव चक्रदद्वने । सद्माभि सत्यो अध्वरः॥
verses.tr: pra yujo vāco agriyo vṛṣāva cakradadvane sadmābhi satyo adhvaraḥ
verses.en: About the holy place, the Steer true, guileless, noblest, hath sent forth Continuous voices in the wood.

verses.sa: परि यत्काव्या कविर्नृम्णा वसानो अर्षति । स्वर्वाजी सिषासति॥
verses.tr: pari yatkāvyā kavirnṛmṇā vasāno arṣati svarvājī siṣāsati
verses.en: When, clothed in manly strength, the Sage flows in celestial wisdom round, The Strong would win the light of heaven.

verses.sa: पवमानो अभि स्पृधो विशो राजेव सीदति । यदीमृण्वन्ति वेधसः॥
verses.tr: pavamāno abhi spṛdho viśo rājeva sīdati yadīmṛṇvanti vedhasaḥ
verses.en: When purified, he sits as King above the hosts, among his folk, What time the sages bring him nigh.

verses.sa: अव्यो वारे परि प्रियो हरिर्वनेषु सीदति । रेभो वनुष्यते मती॥
verses.tr: avyo vāre pari priyo harirvaneṣu sīdati rebho vanuṣyate matī
verses.en: Dear, golden-coloured, in the fleece he sinks and settles in the wood: The Singer shows his zeal in hymns.

verses.sa: स वायुमिन्द्रमश्विना साकं मदेन गच्छति । रणा यो अस्य धर्मभिः॥
verses.tr: sa vāyumindramaśvinā sākaṃ madena gacchati raṇā yo asya dharmabhiḥ
verses.en: He goes to Indra, Vayu, to the Asvins, as his custom is, With gladdening juice which gives them joy.

verses.sa: आ मित्रावरुणा भगं मध्वः पवन्त ऊर्मयः । विदाना अस्य शक्मभिः॥
verses.tr: ā mitrāvaruṇā bhagaṃ madhvaḥ pavanta ūrmayaḥ vidānā asya śakmabhiḥ
verses.en: Tle streams of pleasant Soma flow to Bhaga, Mitra-Varuna,- Well-knowing through his mighty powers.

verses.sa: अस्मभ्यं रोदसी रयिं मध्वो वाजस्य सातये । श्रवो वसूनि सं जितम्॥
verses.tr: asmabhyaṃ rodasī rayiṃ madhvo vājasya sātaye śravo vasūni saṃ jitam
verses.en: Heaven and Earth, riches of meath to win us wealth: Gain for us treasures and renown.

verses.sa: एते सोमा अभि प्रियमिन्द्रस्य काममक्षरन् । वर्धन्तो अस्य वीर्यम्॥
verses.tr: ete somā abhi priyamindrasya kāmamakṣaran vardhanto asya vīryam
verses.en: Obeying Indra's dear desire these Soma juices have flowed forth, Increasing his heroic might.

verses.sa: पुनानासश्चमूषदो गच्छन्तो वायुमश्विना । ते नो धान्तु सुवीर्यम्॥
verses.tr: punānāsaścamūṣado gacchanto vāyumaśvinā te no dhāntu suvīryam
verses.en: Laid in the bowl, pure-flowing on to Vayu and the Asvins, may These give us great heroic strength.

verses.sa: इन्द्रस्य सोम राधसे पुनानो हार्दि चोदय । ऋतस्य योनिमासदम्॥
verses.tr: indrasya soma rādhase punāno hārdi codaya ṛtasya yonimāsadam
verses.en: Soma, as thou art purified, incite to bounty Indra's heart, To sit in place of sacrifice.

verses.sa: मृजन्ति त्वा दश क्षिपो हिन्वन्ति सप्त धीतयः । अनु विप्रा अमादिषुः॥
verses.tr: mṛjanti tvā daśa kṣipo hinvanti sapta dhītayaḥ anu viprā amādiṣuḥ
verses.en: The ten swift fingers deck thee forth, seven ministers impel thee on: The sages have rejoiced in thee.

verses.sa: देवेभ्यस्त्वा मदाय कं सृजानमति मेष्यः । सं गोभिर्वासयामसि॥
verses.tr: devebhyastvā madāya kaṃ sṛjānamati meṣyaḥ saṃ gobhirvāsayāmasi
verses.en: When through the filter thou art poured, we clothe thee with a robe of milk To be a gladdening draught for Gods.

verses.sa: पुनानः कलशेष्वा वस्त्राण्यरुषो हरिः । परि गव्यान्यव्यत॥
verses.tr: punānaḥ kalaśeṣvā vastrāṇyaruṣo hariḥ pari gavyānyavyata
verses.en: When purified within the jars, Soma, bright red and golden-hued, Hath clothed him with a robe of milk.

verses.sa: मघोन आ पवस्व नो जहि विश्वा अप द्विषः । इन्दो सखायमा विश॥
verses.tr: maghona ā pavasva no jahi viśvā apa dviṣaḥ indo sakhāyamā viśa
verses.en: Flow on to us and make us rich. Drive all our enemies away. O Indu, flow into thy Friend.

verses.sa: वृष्टिं दिवः परि स्रव द्युम्नं पृथिव्या अधि । सहो नः सोम पृत्सु धाः॥
verses.tr: vṛṣṭiṃ divaḥ pari srava dyumnaṃ pṛthivyā adhi saho naḥ soma pṛtsu dhāḥ
verses.en: Send down the rain from heaven, a stream of opulence from earth. Give us, O Soma, victory in war.

verses.sa: नृचक्षसं त्वा वयमिन्द्रपीतं स्वर्विदम् । भक्षीमहि प्रजामिषम्॥
verses.tr: nṛcakṣasaṃ tvā vayamindrapītaṃ svarvidam bhakṣīmahi prajāmiṣam
verses.en: May we obtain thee, Indra's drink, who viewest men and findest light, Gain thee, and progeny and food.

verses.sa: परि प्रिया दिवः कविर्वयांसि नप्त्योर्हितः । सुवानो याति कविक्रतुः॥
verses.tr: pari priyā divaḥ kavirvayāṃsi naptyorhitaḥ suvāno yāti kavikratuḥ
verses.en: The Sage of Heaven whose heart is wise, when laid between both hands and pressed, Sends us delightful powers of life.

verses.sa: प्रप्र क्षयाय पन्यसे जनाय जुष्टो अद्रुहे । वीत्यर्ष चनिष्ठया॥
verses.tr: prapra kṣayāya panyase janāya juṣṭo adruhe vītyarṣa caniṣṭhayā
verses.en: On, onward to a glorious home; dear to the people void of guile, With excellent enjoyment, flow.

verses.sa: स सूनुर्मातरा शुचिर्जातो जाते अरोचयत् । महान्मही ऋतावृधा॥
verses.tr: sa sūnurmātarā śucirjāto jāte arocayat mahānmahī ṛtāvṛdhā
verses.en: He, the bright Son, when born illumed his Parents who had sprung to life, Great Son great Strengtheners of Law.

verses.sa: स सप्त धीतिभिर्हितो नद्यो अजिन्वदद्रुहः । या एकमक्षि वावृधुः॥
verses.tr: sa sapta dhītibhirhito nadyo ajinvadadruhaḥ yā ekamakṣi vāvṛdhuḥ
verses.en: Urged by the seven devotions he hath stirred the guileless rivers which Have magnified the Single Eye.

verses.sa: ता अभि सन्तमस्तृतं महे युवानमा दधुः । इन्दुमिन्द्र तव व्रते॥
verses.tr: tā abhi santamastṛtaṃ mahe yuvānamā dadhuḥ indumindra tava vrate
verses.en: These helped to might the Youthful One, high over all, invincible, Even Indu, Indra! in thy law.

verses.sa: अभि वह्निरमर्त्यः सप्त पश्यति वावहिः । क्रिविर्देवीरतर्पयत्॥
verses.tr: abhi vahniramartyaḥ sapta paśyati vāvahiḥ krivirdevīratarpayat
verses.en: The immortal Courser, good to draw, looks down upon the Seven: the fount Hath satisfied the Goddesses

verses.sa: अवा कल्पेषु नः पुमस्तमांसि सोम योध्या । तानि पुनान जङ्घनः॥
verses.tr: avā kalpeṣu naḥ pumastamāṃsi soma yodhyā tāni punāna jaṅghanaḥ
verses.en: Aid us in holy rites, O Man: O Pavamana, drive away Dark shades that must be met in fight.

verses.sa: नू नव्यसे नवीयसे सूक्ताय साधया पथः । प्रत्नवद्रोचया रुचः॥
verses.tr: nū navyase navīyase sūktāya sādhayā pathaḥ pratnavadrocayā rucaḥ
verses.en: Make the paths ready for a hymn newer and newer evermore: Make the lights shine as erst they shone.

verses.sa: पवमान महि श्रवो गामश्वं रासि वीरवत् । सना मेधां सना स्वः॥
verses.tr: pavamāna mahi śravo gāmaśvaṃ rāsi vīravat sanā medhāṃ sanā svaḥ
verses.en: Give, Pavamana, high renown, give kine and steeds and hero sons: Win for us wisdom, win the light.

verses.sa: प्र स्वानासो रथा इवाऽर्वन्तो न श्रवस्यवः । सोमासो राये अक्रमुः॥
verses.tr: pra svānāso rathā ivā'rvanto na śravasyavaḥ somāso rāye akramuḥ
verses.en: Like cars that thunder on their way, like coursers eager for renown, Have Soma-drops flowed forth for wealth.

verses.sa: हिन्वानासो रथा इव दधन्विरे गभस्त्योः । भरासः कारिणामिव॥
verses.tr: hinvānāso rathā iva dadhanvire gabhastyoḥ bharāsaḥ kāriṇāmiva
verses.en: Forth have they rushed from holding hands, like chariots that are urged to speed, Like joyful songs of singing-men.

verses.sa: राजानो न प्रशस्तिभिः सोमासो गोभिरञ्जते । यज्ञो न सप्त धातृभिः॥
verses.tr: rājāno na praśastibhiḥ somāso gobhirañjate yajño na sapta dhātṛbhiḥ
verses.en: The Somas deck themselves with milk, as Kings are graced with eulogies, And, with seven priests, the sacrifice.

verses.sa: परि सुवानास इन्दवो मदाय बर्हणा गिरा । सुता अर्षन्ति धारया॥
verses.tr: pari suvānāsa indavo madāya barhaṇā girā sutā arṣanti dhārayā
verses.en: Pressed for the gladdening draught, the drops flow forth abundantly with song, The Soma juices in a stream.

verses.sa: आपानासो विवस्वतो जनन्त उषसो भगम् । सूरा अण्वं वि तन्वते॥
verses.tr: āpānāso vivasvato jananta uṣaso bhagam sūrā aṇvaṃ vi tanvate
verses.en: Winning Vivasvan's glory and producing Morning's light, the Suns Pass through the openings of the cloth.

verses.sa: अप द्वारा मतीनां प्रत्ना ऋण्वन्ति कारवः । वृष्णो हरस आयवः॥
verses.tr: apa dvārā matīnāṃ pratnā ṛṇvanti kāravaḥ vṛṣṇo harasa āyavaḥ
verses.en: The singing-men of ancient time open the doors of sacred songs,- Men, for the mighty to accept.

verses.sa: समीचीनास आसते होतारः सप्तजामयः । पदमेकस्य पिप्रतः॥
verses.tr: samīcīnāsa āsate hotāraḥ saptajāmayaḥ padamekasya piprataḥ
verses.en: Combined in close society sit the seven priests, the brother-hood, Filling the station of the One.

verses.sa: नाभा नाभिं न आ ददे चक्षुश्चित्सूर्ये सचा । कवेरपत्यमा दुहे॥
verses.tr: nābhā nābhiṃ na ā dade cakṣuścitsūrye sacā kaverapatyamā duhe
verses.en: He gives us kinship with the Gods, and with the Sun unites our eye: The Sage's offspring hath appeared.

verses.sa: अभि प्रिया दिवस्पदमध्वर्युभिर्गुहा हितम् । सूरः पश्यति चक्षसा॥
verses.tr: abhi priyā divaspadamadhvaryubhirguhā hitam sūraḥ paśyati cakṣasā
verses.en: The Sun with his dear eye beholds that quarter of the heavens which priests Have placed within the sacred cell.

verses.sa: उपास्मै गायता नरः पवमानायेन्दवे । अभि देवाँ इयक्षते॥
verses.tr: upāsmai gāyatā naraḥ pavamānāyendave abhi devāṃ iyakṣate
verses.en: Sing forth to Indu, O ye men, to him who is purified, Fain to pay worship to the Gods.

verses.sa: अभि ते मधुना पयोऽथर्वाणो अशिश्रयुः । देवं देवाय देवयु॥
verses.tr: abhi te madhunā payo'tharvāṇo aśiśrayuḥ devaṃ devāya devayu
verses.en: Together with thy pleasant juice the Atharvans have commingled milk, Divine, devoted to the God.

verses.sa: स नः पवस्व शं गवे शं जनाय शमर्वते । शं राजन्नोषधीभ्यः॥
verses.tr: sa naḥ pavasva śaṃ gave śaṃ janāya śamarvate śaṃ rājannoṣadhībhyaḥ
verses.en: Bring, by thy flowing, weal to kine, weal to the people, weal to steeds. Weal, O thou King, to growing plants

verses.sa: बभ्रवे नु स्वतवसेऽरुणाय दिविस्पृशे । सोमाय गाथमर्चत॥
verses.tr: babhrave nu svatavase'ruṇāya divispṛśe somāya gāthamarcata
verses.en: Sing a praise-song to Soma brown of hue, of independent might. The Red, who reaches up to heaven.

verses.sa: हस्तच्युतेभिरद्रिभिः सुतं सोमं पुनीतन । मधावा धावता मधु॥
verses.tr: hastacyutebhiradribhiḥ sutaṃ somaṃ punītana madhāvā dhāvatā madhu
verses.en: Purify Soma when effused with stones which bands move rapidly, And pour the sweet milk in the meath.

verses.sa: नमसेदुप सीदत दध्नेदभि श्रीणीतन । इन्दुमिन्द्रे दधातन॥
verses.tr: namasedupa sīdata dadhnedabhi śrīṇītana indumindre dadhātana
verses.en: With humble homage draw ye nigh; blend the libation with the curds: To Indra offer Indu up.

verses.sa: अमित्रहा विचर्षणिः पवस्व सोम शं गवे । देवेभ्यो अनुकामकृत्॥
verses.tr: amitrahā vicarṣaṇiḥ pavasva soma śaṃ gave devebhyo anukāmakṛt
verses.en: Soma, foe-que chief o'er men, doing the will of pour forth Prosperity upon our kine.

verses.sa: इन्द्राय सोम पातवे मदाय परि षिच्यसे । मनश्चिन्मनसस्पतिः॥
verses.tr: indrāya soma pātave madāya pari ṣicyase manaścinmanasaspatiḥ
verses.en: Heart-knower, Sovran of the heart, thou art effused, O Soma, that Indra may drink thee and rejoice.

verses.sa: पवमान सुवीर्यं रयिं सोम रिरीहि नः । इन्दविन्द्रेण नो युजा॥
verses.tr: pavamāna suvīryaṃ rayiṃ soma rirīhi naḥ indavindreṇa no yujā
verses.en: O Soma Pavamana, give us riches and heroic strength,- Indu! with. Indra for ally.

verses.sa: सोमा असृग्रमिन्दवः सुता ऋतस्य सादने । इन्द्राय मधुमत्तमाः॥
verses.tr: somā asṛgramindavaḥ sutā ṛtasya sādane indrāya madhumattamāḥ
verses.en: To Indra have the Soma drops, exceeding rich in sweets, been poured, Shed in the seat of sacrifice.

verses.sa: अभि विप्रा अनूषत गावो वत्सं न मातरः । इन्द्रं सोमस्य पीतये॥
verses.tr: abhi viprā anūṣata gāvo vatsaṃ na mātaraḥ indraṃ somasya pītaye
verses.en: As mother kine low to their calves, to Indra have the sages called, Called him to drink the Soma juice.

verses.sa: मदच्युत्क्षेति सादने सिन्धोरूर्मा विपश्चित् । सोमो गौरी अधि श्रितः॥
verses.tr: madacyutkṣeti sādane sindhorūrmā vipaścit somo gaurī adhi śritaḥ
verses.en: In the stream's wave wise Soma dwells, distilling rapture, in his seat, Resting upon a wiId-cow's hide.

verses.sa: दिवो नाभा विचक्षणोऽव्यो वारे महीयते । सोमो यः सुक्रतुः कविः॥
verses.tr: divo nābhā vicakṣaṇo'vyo vāre mahīyate somo yaḥ sukratuḥ kaviḥ
verses.en: Far-sighted Soma, Sage and Seer, is worshipped in the central point Of heaven, the straining-cloth of wool.

verses.sa: यः सोमः कलशेष्वाँ अन्तः पवित्र आहितः । तमिन्दुः परि षस्वजे॥
verses.tr: yaḥ somaḥ kalaśeṣvāṃ antaḥ pavitra āhitaḥ taminduḥ pari ṣasvaje
verses.en: In close embraces Indu holds Soma when poured within the jars. And on the. purifying sieve.

verses.sa: प्र वाचमिन्दुरिष्यति समुद्रस्याधि विष्टपि । जिन्वन्कोशं मधुश्चुतम्॥
verses.tr: pra vācaminduriṣyati samudrasyādhi viṣṭapi jinvankośaṃ madhuścutam
verses.en: Indu sends forth a voice on high to regions of the sea of air, Shaking the vase that drops with meath.

verses.sa: नित्यस्तोत्रो वनस्पतिर्धीनामन्तः सबर्दुघः । हिन्वानो मानुषा युगा॥
verses.tr: nityastotro vanaspatirdhīnāmantaḥ sabardughaḥ hinvāno mānuṣā yugā
verses.en: The Tree whose praises never fail yields heavenly milk among our hymns, Urging men's generations on.

verses.sa: अभि प्रिया दिवस्पदा सोमो हिन्वानो अर्षति । विप्रस्य धारया कविः॥
verses.tr: abhi priyā divaspadā somo hinvāno arṣati viprasya dhārayā kaviḥ
verses.en: The Wise One, with the Sage's stream, the Soma urged to speed, flows on To the dear places of the sky.

verses.sa: आ पवमान धारय रयिं सहस्रवर्चसम् । अस्मे इन्दो स्वाभुवम्॥
verses.tr: ā pavamāna dhāraya rayiṃ sahasravarcasam asme indo svābhuvam
verses.en: O Pavamana, bring us wealth bright with a thousand splendours. Yea. O Indu, give us ready help.

verses.sa: सोमः पुनानो अर्षति सहस्रधारो अत्यविः । वायोरिन्द्रस्य निष्कृतम्॥
verses.tr: somaḥ punāno arṣati sahasradhāro atyaviḥ vāyorindrasya niṣkṛtam
verses.en: Passed through, the fleece in thousand streams the Soma, purified, flows on To Indra's, Viyu's special place.

verses.sa: पवमानमवस्यवो विप्रमभि प्र गायत । सुष्वाणं देववीतये॥
verses.tr: pavamānamavasyavo vipramabhi pra gāyata suṣvāṇaṃ devavītaye
verses.en: Sing forth, ye men who long for help, to Pavamana, to the Sage, Effused to entertain the Gods.

verses.sa: पवन्ते वाजसातये सोमाः सहस्रपाजसः । गृणाना देववीतये॥
verses.tr: pavante vājasātaye somāḥ sahasrapājasaḥ gṛṇānā devavītaye
verses.en: The Soma-drops with thousand powers are purified for victory, Hymned to become the feast of Gods.

verses.sa: उत नो वाजसातये पवस्व बृहतीरिषः । द्युमदिन्दो सुवीर्यम्॥
verses.tr: uta no vājasātaye pavasva bṛhatīriṣaḥ dyumadindo suvīryam
verses.en: Yea, as thou flowest bring great store of food that we may win the spoil Indu, bring splendid manly might.

verses.sa: ते नः सहस्रिणं रयिं पवन्तामा सुवीर्यम् । सुवाना देवास इन्दवः॥
verses.tr: te naḥ sahasriṇaṃ rayiṃ pavantāmā suvīryam suvānā devāsa indavaḥ
verses.en: May they in flowing give us wealth in thousands, and heroic power,- These Godlike Soma-drops effused.

verses.sa: अत्या हियाना न हेतृभिरसृग्रं वाजसातये । वि वारमव्यमाशवः॥
verses.tr: atyā hiyānā na hetṛbhirasṛgraṃ vājasātaye vi vāramavyamāśavaḥ
verses.en: Like coursers by their drivers urged, they were poured forth, for victory, Swift through the woollen straining-cloth.

verses.sa: वाश्रा अर्षन्तीन्दवोऽभि वत्सं न धेनवः । दधन्विरे गभस्त्योः॥
verses.tr: vāśrā arṣantīndavo'bhi vatsaṃ na dhenavaḥ dadhanvire gabhastyoḥ
verses.en: Noisily flow the Soma-drops, like milch-kine lowing to their calves: They have run forth from both the hands.

verses.sa: जुष्ट इन्द्राय मत्सरः पवमान कनिक्रदत् । विश्वा अप द्विषो जहि॥
verses.tr: juṣṭa indrāya matsaraḥ pavamāna kanikradat viśvā apa dviṣo jahi
verses.en: As Gladdener whom Indra loves, O Pavamana, with a roar Drive all our enemies away.

verses.sa: अपघ्नन्तो अराव्णः पवमानाः स्वर्दृशः । योनावृतस्य सीदत॥
verses.tr: apaghnanto arāvṇaḥ pavamānāḥ svardṛśaḥ yonāvṛtasya sīdata
verses.en: O Pavamamas, driving off the godless, looking on the light, Sit in the place of sacrifice.

verses.sa: परि प्रासिष्यदत्कविः सिन्धोरूर्मावधि श्रितः । कारं बिभ्रत्पुरुस्पृहम्॥
verses.tr: pari prāsiṣyadatkaviḥ sindhorūrmāvadhi śritaḥ kāraṃ bibhratpuruspṛham
verses.en: Reposing on the river's wave the Sage hath widely flowed around, Bearing the hymn which many love.

verses.sa: गिरा यदी सबन्धवः पञ्च व्राता अपस्यवः । परिष्कृण्वन्ति धर्णसिम्॥
verses.tr: girā yadī sabandhavaḥ pañca vrātā apasyavaḥ pariṣkṛṇvanti dharṇasim
verses.en: When the Five kindred Companies, active in duty, with the song Establish him, the Powerful,

verses.sa: आदस्य शुष्मिणो रसे विश्वे देवा अमत्सत । यदी गोभिर्वसायते॥
verses.tr: ādasya śuṣmiṇo rase viśve devā amatsata yadī gobhirvasāyate
verses.en: Then in his juice whose strength is great, have all the Gods rejoiced themselves, When he hath clothed him in the milk.

verses.sa: निरिणानो वि धावति जहच्छर्याणि तान्वा । अत्रा सं जिघ्नते युजा॥
verses.tr: niriṇāno vi dhāvati jahaccharyāṇi tānvā atrā saṃ jighnate yujā
verses.en: Freeing himself he flows away, leaving his body's severed limbs, And meets his own Companion here.

verses.sa: नप्तीभिर्यो विवस्वतः शुभ्रो न मामृजे युवा । गाः कृण्वानो न निर्णिजम्॥
verses.tr: naptībhiryo vivasvataḥ śubhro na māmṛje yuvā gāḥ kṛṇvāno na nirṇijam
verses.en: He by the daughters of the priest, like a fair youth, hath been adorned, Making the milk, as 'twere, his robe.

verses.sa: अति श्रिती तिरश्चता गव्या जिगात्यण्व्या । वग्नुमियर्ति यं विदे॥
verses.tr: ati śritī tiraścatā gavyā jigātyaṇvyā vagnumiyarti yaṃ vide
verses.en: O'er the fine fingers, through desire of milk, in winding course he goes, And utters voice which he hath found.

verses.sa: अभि क्षिपः समग्मत मर्जयन्तीरिषस्पतिम् । पृष्ठा गृभ्णत वाजिनः॥
verses.tr: abhi kṣipaḥ samagmata marjayantīriṣaspatim pṛṣṭhā gṛbhṇata vājinaḥ
verses.en: The nimble fingers have approached, adorning him the Lord of Strength: They grasp the vigorous Courser's back.

verses.sa: परि दिव्यानि मर्मृशद्विश्वानि सोम पार्थिवा । वसूनि याह्यस्मयुः॥
verses.tr: pari divyāni marmṛśadviśvāni soma pārthivā vasūni yāhyasmayuḥ
verses.en: Comprising all the treasures that are in the heavens and on the earth, Come, Soma, as our faithful Friend.

verses.sa: एष धिया यात्यण्व्या शूरो रथेभिराशुभिः । गच्छन्निन्द्रस्य निष्कृतम्॥
verses.tr: eṣa dhiyā yātyaṇvyā śūro rathebhirāśubhiḥ gacchannindrasya niṣkṛtam
verses.en: Through the fine fingers, with the song, this Hero comes with rapid ears, Going to Indra's special place.

verses.sa: एष पुरू धियायते बृहते देवतातये । यत्रामृतास आसते॥
verses.tr: eṣa purū dhiyāyate bṛhate devatātaye yatrāmṛtāsa āsate
verses.en: In holy thought he ponders much for the great worship of the Gods. Where the Immortals have their seat.

verses.sa: एष हितो वि नीयतेऽन्तः शुभ्रावता पथा । यदी तुञ्जन्ति भूर्णयः॥
verses.tr: eṣa hito vi nīyate'ntaḥ śubhrāvatā pathā yadī tuñjanti bhūrṇayaḥ
verses.en: Like a good horse is he led out, when on the path that shines with light The mettled steeds exert their strength.

verses.sa: एष शृङ्गाणि दोधुवच्छिशीते यूथ्यो३ वृषा । नृम्णा दधान ओजसा॥
verses.tr: eṣa śṛṅgāṇi dodhuvacchiśīte yūthyo3 vṛṣā nṛmṇā dadhāna ojasā
verses.en: He brandishes his horns on high, and whets them Bull who leads the herd, Doing with might heroic deeds.

verses.sa: एष रुक्मिभिरीयते वाजी शुभ्रेभिरंशुभिः । पतिः सिन्धूनां भवन्॥
verses.tr: eṣa rukmibhirīyate vājī śubhrebhiraṃśubhiḥ patiḥ sindhūnāṃ bhavan
verses.en: He moves, a vigorous Steed, adorned with beauteous rays of shining gold, Becoming Sovran of the streams.

verses.sa: एष वसूनि पिब्दना परुषा ययिवाँ अति । अव शादेषु गच्छति॥
verses.tr: eṣa vasūni pibdanā paruṣā yayivāṃ ati ava śādeṣu gacchati
verses.en: He, over places rough to pass, bringing rich treasures closely packed. Descends into the reservoirs.

verses.sa: एतं मृजन्ति मर्ज्यमुप द्रोणेष्वायवः । प्रचक्राणं महीरिषः॥
verses.tr: etaṃ mṛjanti marjyamupa droṇeṣvāyavaḥ pracakrāṇaṃ mahīriṣaḥ
verses.en: Men beautify him in the vats, him worthy to be beautified, Him who brings forth abundant food.

verses.sa: एतमु त्यं दश क्षिपो मृजन्ति सप्त धीतयः । स्वायुधं मदिन्तमम्॥
verses.tr: etamu tyaṃ daśa kṣipo mṛjanti sapta dhītayaḥ svāyudhaṃ madintamam
verses.en: Him, even him, the fingers ten and the seven songs make beautiful, Well-weaponed, best of gladdeners.

verses.sa: प्र ते सोतार ओण्यो३ रसं मदाय घृष्वये । सर्गो न तक्त्येतशः॥
verses.tr: pra te sotāra oṇyo3 rasaṃ madāya ghṛṣvaye sargo na taktyetaśaḥ
verses.en: The pressers from the Soma-press send forth thy juice for rapturous joy The speckled sap runs like a flood.

verses.sa: क्रत्वा दक्षस्य रथ्यमपो वसानमन्धसा । गोषामण्वेषु सश्चिम॥
verses.tr: kratvā dakṣasya rathyamapo vasānamandhasā goṣāmaṇveṣu saścima
verses.en: With strength we follow through the sieve him who brings might and wins the kine, Enrobed in water with his juice.

verses.sa: अनप्तमप्सु दुष्टरं सोमं पवित्र आ सृज । पुनीहीन्द्राय पातवे॥
verses.tr: anaptamapsu duṣṭaraṃ somaṃ pavitra ā sṛja punīhīndrāya pātave
verses.en: Pour on the sieve the Soma, ne'er subdued in waters, waterless, And make it pure for Indra's drink.

verses.sa: प्र पुनानस्य चेतसा सोमः पवित्रे अर्षति । क्रत्वा सधस्थमासदत्॥
verses.tr: pra punānasya cetasā somaḥ pavitre arṣati kratvā sadhasthamāsadat
verses.en: Moved by the purifier's thought, the Soma flows into the sieve: By wisdom it hath gained its home.

verses.sa: प्र त्वा नमोभिरिन्दव इन्द्र सोमा असृक्षत । महे भराय कारिणः॥
verses.tr: pra tvā namobhirindava indra somā asṛkṣata mahe bharāya kāriṇaḥ
verses.en: With humble homage, Indra, have the Soma-drops flowed forth to thee, Contending for the glorious prize.

verses.sa: पुनानो रूपे अव्यये विश्वा अर्षन्नभि श्रियः । शूरो न गोषु तिष्ठति॥
verses.tr: punāno rūpe avyaye viśvā arṣannabhi śriyaḥ śūro na goṣu tiṣṭhati
verses.en: Purified in his fleecy garb, attaining every beauty, he Stands, hero-like, amid the kine.

verses.sa: दिवो न सानु पिप्युषी धारा सुतस्य वेधसः । वृथा पवित्रे अर्षति॥
verses.tr: divo na sānu pipyuṣī dhārā sutasya vedhasaḥ vṛthā pavitre arṣati
verses.en: Swelling, as 'twere, to heights of heaven, the stream of the creative juice Falls lightly on the cleansing sieve.

verses.sa: त्वं सोम विपश्चितं तना पुनान आयुषु । अव्यो वारं वि धावसि॥
verses.tr: tvaṃ soma vipaścitaṃ tanā punāna āyuṣu avyo vāraṃ vi dhāvasi
verses.en: Thus, Soma, purifying him who knoweth song mid living men, Thou wanderest through the cloth of wool.

verses.sa: प्र निम्नेनेव सिन्धवो घ्नन्तो वृत्राणि भूर्णयः । सोमा असृग्रमाशवः॥
verses.tr: pra nimneneva sindhavo ghnanto vṛtrāṇi bhūrṇayaḥ somā asṛgramāśavaḥ
verses.en: Like rivers down a steep descent, slaying the Vrtras, full of zeal, The rapid Soma-streams have flowed.

verses.sa: अभि सुवानास इन्दवो वृष्टयः पृथिवीमिव । इन्द्रं सोमासो अक्षरन्॥
verses.tr: abhi suvānāsa indavo vṛṣṭayaḥ pṛthivīmiva indraṃ somāso akṣaran
verses.en: The drops of Soma juice effused fall like the rain upon the earth: To Indra flow the Soma-streams.

verses.sa: अत्यूर्मिर्मत्सरो मदः सोमः पवित्रे अर्षति । विघ्नन्रक्षांसि देवयुः॥
verses.tr: atyūrmirmatsaro madaḥ somaḥ pavitre arṣati vighnanrakṣāṃsi devayuḥ
verses.en: With swelling wave the gladdening drink, the Soma, flows into the sieve, Loving the Gods and slaying fiends.

verses.sa: आ कलशेषु धावति पवित्रे परि षिच्यते । उक्थैर्यज्ञेषु वर्धते॥
verses.tr: ā kalaśeṣu dhāvati pavitre pari ṣicyate ukthairyajñeṣu vardhate
verses.en: It hastens to the pitchers, poured upon the sieve it waxes strong At sacrifices through the lauds.

verses.sa: अति त्री सोम रोचना रोहन्न भ्राजसे दिवम् । इष्णन्त्सूर्यं न चोदयः॥
verses.tr: ati trī soma rocanā rohanna bhrājase divam iṣṇantsūryaṃ na codayaḥ
verses.en: Soma, thou shinest mounting heaven as 'twere above light's triple realm, And moving secm'st to speed the Sun.

verses.sa: अभि विप्रा अनूषत मूर्धन्यज्ञस्य कारवः । दधानाश्चक्षसि प्रियम्॥
verses.tr: abhi viprā anūṣata mūrdhanyajñasya kāravaḥ dadhānāścakṣasi priyam
verses.en: To him, the head of sacrifice, singers and bards have sung their songs, Offering what he loves to see.

verses.sa: तमु त्वा वाजिनं नरो धीभिर्विप्रा अवस्यवः । मृजन्ति देवतातये॥
verses.tr: tamu tvā vājinaṃ naro dhībhirviprā avasyavaḥ mṛjanti devatātaye
verses.en: The men, the sages with their hymns, eager for help, deck thee strong steed, Deck thee for service of the Gods.

verses.sa: मधोर्धारामनु क्षर तीव्रः सधस्थमासदः । चारुॠताय पीतये॥
verses.tr: madhordhārāmanu kṣara tīvraḥ sadhasthamāsadaḥ cāruṝtāya pītaye
verses.en: Flow onward to the stream of meath rest efficacious in thy home, Fair, to be drunk at sacrifice.

verses.sa: परि सुवानो गिरिष्ठाः पवित्रे सोमो अक्षाः । मदेषु सर्वधा असि॥
verses.tr: pari suvāno giriṣṭhāḥ pavitre somo akṣāḥ madeṣu sarvadhā asi
verses.en: Thou, Soma, dweller on the hills, effused, hast flowed into the sieve,: All-bounteous art thou in carouse.

verses.sa: त्वं विप्रस्त्वं कविर्मधु प्र जातमन्धसः । मदेषु सर्वधा असि॥
verses.tr: tvaṃ viprastvaṃ kavirmadhu pra jātamandhasaḥ madeṣu sarvadhā asi
verses.en: Thou art a sacred Bard, a Sage; the meath is offspring of thy sap: All-bounteous art thou in carouse.

verses.sa: तव विश्वे सजोषसो देवासः पीतिमाशत । मदेषु सर्वधा असि॥
verses.tr: tava viśve sajoṣaso devāsaḥ pītimāśata madeṣu sarvadhā asi
verses.en: All Deities of one accord have come that they may drink of thee: All-bounteous art thou in carouse.

verses.sa: आ यो विश्वानि वार्या वसूनि हस्तयोर्दधे । मदेषु सर्वधा असि॥
verses.tr: ā yo viśvāni vāryā vasūni hastayordadhe madeṣu sarvadhā asi
verses.en: He who containeth in his hands all treasures much to be desired: All-bounteous art thou in carouse.

verses.sa: य इमे रोदसी मही सं मातरेव दोहते । मदेषु सर्वधा असि॥
verses.tr: ya ime rodasī mahī saṃ mātareva dohate madeṣu sarvadhā asi
verses.en: Who milketh out this mighty Pair, the Earth and Heaven, like mother kine All-bounteous art thou in carouse.

verses.sa: परि यो रोदसी उभे सद्यो वाजेभिरर्षति । मदेषु सर्वधा असि॥
verses.tr: pari yo rodasī ubhe sadyo vājebhirarṣati madeṣu sarvadhā asi
verses.en: Who in a moment mightily floweth around these two world-halves: All-bounteous art thou in carouse.

verses.sa: स शुष्मी कलशेष्वा पुनानो अचिक्रदत् । मदेषु सर्वधा असि॥
verses.tr: sa śuṣmī kalaśeṣvā punāno acikradat madeṣu sarvadhā asi
verses.en: The Strong One, being purified, hath in the pitchers cried aloud: All-bounteous art thou in carouse.

verses.sa: यत्सोम चित्रमुक्थ्यं दिव्यं पार्थिवं वसु । तन्नः पुनान आ भर॥
verses.tr: yatsoma citramukthyaṃ divyaṃ pārthivaṃ vasu tannaḥ punāna ā bhara
verses.en: O SOMA, being purified bring us the wondrous treasure, meet For lauds, that is in earth and heaven.

verses.sa: युवं हि स्थः स्वर्पती इन्द्रश्च सोम गोपती । ईशाना पिप्यतं धियः॥
verses.tr: yuvaṃ hi sthaḥ svarpatī indraśca soma gopatī īśānā pipyataṃ dhiyaḥ
verses.en: For ye Twain, Indra, Soma, are Lords of the light, Lords of the kine: Great Rulers, prosper ye our songs.

verses.sa: वृषा पुनान आयुषु स्तनयन्नधि बर्हिषि । हरिः सन्योनिमासदत्॥
verses.tr: vṛṣā punāna āyuṣu stanayannadhi barhiṣi hariḥ sanyonimāsadat
verses.en: The tawny Steer, while cleansed among the living, bellowing on the grass, Hath sunk and settled in his home.

verses.sa: अवावशन्त धीतयो वृषभस्याधि रेतसि । सूनोर्वत्सस्य मातरः॥
verses.tr: avāvaśanta dhītayo vṛṣabhasyādhi retasi sūnorvatsasya mātaraḥ
verses.en: Over the Steer's productive flow the sacred songs were resonant, The mothers of the darling Son.

verses.sa: कुविद्वृषण्यन्तीभ्यः पुनानो गर्भमादधत् । याः शुक्रं दुहते पयः॥
verses.tr: kuvidvṛṣaṇyantībhyaḥ punāno garbhamādadhat yāḥ śukraṃ duhate payaḥ
verses.en: Hath he not, purified, impregned the kine who long to meet their Lord, The kine who yield the shining milk?

verses.sa: उप शिक्षापतस्थुषो भियसमा धेहि शत्रुषु । पवमान विदा रयिम्॥
verses.tr: upa śikṣāpatasthuṣo bhiyasamā dhehi śatruṣu pavamāna vidā rayim
verses.en: Bring near us those who stand aloof strike fear into our enemies: O Pavamana, find us wealth.

verses.sa: नि शत्रोः सोम वृष्ण्यं नि शुष्मं नि वयस्तिर । दूरे वा सतो अन्ति वा॥
verses.tr: ni śatroḥ soma vṛṣṇyaṃ ni śuṣmaṃ ni vayastira dūre vā sato anti vā
verses.en: Soma, bring down the foeman's might, his vigorous strength and vital powe'r, Whether he be afar or near.

verses.sa: प्र कविर्देववीतयेऽव्यो वारेभिरर्षति । साह्वान्विश्वा अभि स्पृधः॥
verses.tr: pra kavirdevavītaye'vyo vārebhirarṣati sāhvānviśvā abhi spṛdhaḥ
verses.en: Forth through the straining-cloth the Sage flows to the banquet of the Gods, Subduing all our enemies.

verses.sa: स हि ष्मा जरितृभ्य आ वाजं गोमन्तमिन्वति । पवमानः सहस्रिणम्॥
verses.tr: sa hi ṣmā jaritṛbhya ā vājaṃ gomantaminvati pavamānaḥ sahasriṇam
verses.en: For he, as Pavamana, sends thousand fold treasure in the shape Of cattle to the singing-men.

verses.sa: परि विश्वानि चेतसा मृशसे पवसे मती । स नः सोम श्रवो विदः॥
verses.tr: pari viśvāni cetasā mṛśase pavase matī sa naḥ soma śravo vidaḥ
verses.en: Thou graspest all things with thy mind, and purifiest thee with thoughts As such, O Soma, find us fame.

verses.sa: अभ्यर्ष बृहद्यशो मघवद्भ्यो ध्रुवं रयिम् । इषं स्तोतृभ्य आ भर॥
verses.tr: abhyarṣa bṛhadyaśo maghavadbhyo dhruvaṃ rayim iṣaṃ stotṛbhya ā bhara
verses.en: Pour lofty glory on us, send sure riches to our liberal lords, Bring food to those who sing thy praise.

verses.sa: त्वं राजेव सुव्रतो गिरः सोमा विवेशिथ । पुनानो वह्ने अद्भुत॥
verses.tr: tvaṃ rājeva suvrato giraḥ somā viveśitha punāno vahne adbhuta
verses.en: As thou art cleansed, O Wondrous Steed, O Soma, thou hast entered, like A pious King, into the songs.

verses.sa: स वह्निरप्सु दुष्टरो मृज्यमानो गभस्त्योः । सोमश्चमूषु सीदति॥
verses.tr: sa vahnirapsu duṣṭaro mṛjyamāno gabhastyoḥ somaścamūṣu sīdati
verses.en: He, Soma, like a courser in the floods invincible, made clean With hands, is resting in the jars.

verses.sa: क्रीळुर्मखो न मंहयुः पवित्रं सोम गच्छसि । दधत्स्तोत्रे सुवीर्यम्॥
verses.tr: krīḻurmakho na maṃhayuḥ pavitraṃ soma gacchasi dadhatstotre suvīryam
verses.en: Disporting, like a liberal chief, thou goest, Soma, to the sieve, Lending the laud a Hero's strength.

verses.sa: एते धावन्तीन्दवः सोमा इन्द्राय घृष्वयः । मत्सरासः स्वर्विदः॥
verses.tr: ete dhāvantīndavaḥ somā indrāya ghṛṣvayaḥ matsarāsaḥ svarvidaḥ
verses.en: To Indra flow these running drops, these Somas frolicsome in mood. Exhilarating, finding light;

verses.sa: प्रवृण्वन्तो अभियुजः सुष्वये वरिवोविदः । स्वयं स्तोत्रे वयस्कृतः॥
verses.tr: pravṛṇvanto abhiyujaḥ suṣvaye varivovidaḥ svayaṃ stotre vayaskṛtaḥ
verses.en: Driving off foes, bestowing room upon the presser, willingly Bringing their praiser vital force.

verses.sa: वृथा क्रीळन्त इन्दवः सधस्थमभ्येकमित् । सिन्धोरूर्मा व्यक्षरन्॥
verses.tr: vṛthā krīḻanta indavaḥ sadhasthamabhyekamit sindhorūrmā vyakṣaran
verses.en: Lightly disporting them, the drops flow to one common reservoir, And fall into the river's wave.

verses.sa: एते विश्वानि वार्या पवमानास आशत । हिता न सप्तयो रथे॥
verses.tr: ete viśvāni vāryā pavamānāsa āśata hitā na saptayo rathe
verses.en: These Pavamanas have obtained all blessings much to be desired, Like coursers harnessed to a car.

verses.sa: आस्मिन्पिशङ्गमिन्दवो दधाता वेनमादिशे । यो अस्मभ्यमरावा॥
verses.tr: āsminpiśaṅgamindavo dadhātā venamādiśe yo asmabhyamarāvā
verses.en: With view to us, O Soma-drops, bestow his manifold desire On him who yet hath given us naught.

verses.sa: ऋभुर्न रथ्यं नवं दधाता केतमादिशे । शुक्राः पवध्वमर्णसा॥
verses.tr: ṛbhurna rathyaṃ navaṃ dadhātā ketamādiśe śukrāḥ pavadhvamarṇasā
verses.en: Bring us our wish with this design, as a wright brings his new-wrought wheel: Flow pure and shining with the stream.

verses.sa: एत उ त्ये अवीवशन्काष्ठां वाजिनो अक्रत । सतः प्रासाविषुर्मतिम्॥
verses.tr: eta u tye avīvaśankāṣṭhāṃ vājino akrata sataḥ prāsāviṣurmatim
verses.en: These drops have cried with resonant voice: like swift steeds they have run the course, And roused the good man's hymn to life.

verses.sa: एते सोमास आशवो रथा इव प्र वाजिनः । सर्गाः सृष्टा अहेषत॥
verses.tr: ete somāsa āśavo rathā iva pra vājinaḥ sargāḥ sṛṣṭā aheṣata
verses.en: These rapid Soma-streams have stirred themselves to motion like strong steeds, Like cars, like armies hurried forth.

verses.sa: एते वाता इवोरवः पर्जन्यस्येव वृष्टयः । अग्नेरिव भ्रमा वृथा॥
verses.tr: ete vātā ivoravaḥ parjanyasyeva vṛṣṭayaḥ agneriva bhramā vṛthā
verses.en: Swift as wide winds they lightly move, like rain-storms of Parjanya, like The flickering flames of burning fire.

verses.sa: एते पूता विपश्चितः सोमासो दध्याशिरः । विपा व्यानशुर्धियः॥
verses.tr: ete pūtā vipaścitaḥ somāso dadhyāśiraḥ vipā vyānaśurdhiyaḥ
verses.en: These Soma juices, blent with curds, purified, skilled in sacred hymns, Have gained by song their hearts' desire.

verses.sa: एते मृष्टा अमर्त्याः ससृवांसो न शश्रमुः । इयक्षन्तः पथो रजः॥
verses.tr: ete mṛṣṭā amartyāḥ sasṛvāṃso na śaśramuḥ iyakṣantaḥ patho rajaḥ
verses.en: Immortal, cleansed, these drops, since first they flowed, have never wearied, fain To reach the regions and their paths.

verses.sa: एते पृष्ठानि रोदसोर्विप्रयन्तो व्यानशुः । उतेदमुत्तमं रजः॥
verses.tr: ete pṛṣṭhāni rodasorviprayanto vyānaśuḥ utedamuttamaṃ rajaḥ
verses.en: Advancing they have travelled o'er the ridges of the earth and heaven, And this the highest realm of all.

verses.sa: तन्तुं तन्वानमुत्तममनु प्रवत आशत । उतेदमुत्तमाय्यम्॥
verses.tr: tantuṃ tanvānamuttamamanu pravata āśata utedamuttamāyyam
verses.en: Over the heights have they attained the highest thread that is spun out, And this which must be deemed most high.

verses.sa: त्वं सोम पणिभ्य आ वसु गव्यानि धारयः । ततं तन्तुमचिक्रदः॥
verses.tr: tvaṃ soma paṇibhya ā vasu gavyāni dhārayaḥ tataṃ tantumacikradaḥ
verses.en: Thou, Soma, boldest wealth in kine which thou hast seized from niggard churls: Thou calledst forth the out spun thread.

verses.sa: सोमा असृग्रमाशवो मधोर्मदस्य धारया । अभि विश्वानि काव्या॥
verses.tr: somā asṛgramāśavo madhormadasya dhārayā abhi viśvāni kāvyā
verses.en: Swift Soma drops have been effused in streams of meath, the gladdening drink, For sacred lore of every kind.

verses.sa: अनु प्रत्नास आयवः पदं नवीयो अक्रमुः । रुचे जनन्त सूर्यम्॥
verses.tr: anu pratnāsa āyavaḥ padaṃ navīyo akramuḥ ruce jananta sūryam
verses.en: Hither to newer. resting-place the ancient Living Ones are come. They made the Sun that he might shine.

verses.sa: आ पवमान नो भराऽर्यो अदाशुषो गयम् । कृधि प्रजावतीरिषः॥
verses.tr: ā pavamāna no bharā'ryo adāśuṣo gayam kṛdhi prajāvatīriṣaḥ
verses.en: O Pavamana, bring to us the unsacrificing foeman's wealth, And give us food with progeny.

verses.sa: अभि सोमास आयवः पवन्ते मद्यं मदम् । अभि कोशं मधुश्चुतम्॥
verses.tr: abhi somāsa āyavaḥ pavante madyaṃ madam abhi kośaṃ madhuścutam
verses.en: The living Somas being cleansed diffuse exhilarating drink, Turned to the vat which drips with meath.

verses.sa: सोमो अर्षति धर्णसिर्दधान इन्द्रियं रसम् । सुवीरो अभिशस्तिपाः॥
verses.tr: somo arṣati dharṇasirdadhāna indriyaṃ rasam suvīro abhiśastipāḥ
verses.en: Soma grows on intelligent, possessing sap and mighty strength, Brave Hero who repels the curse.

verses.sa: इन्द्राय सोम पवसे देवेभ्यः सधमाद्यः । इन्दो वाजं सिषाससि॥
verses.tr: indrāya soma pavase devebhyaḥ sadhamādyaḥ indo vājaṃ siṣāsasi
verses.en: For Indra, Soma! thou art cleansed, a feast-companion for the Gods: Indu, thou fain wilt win us strength

verses.sa: अस्य पीत्वा मदानामिन्द्रो वृत्राण्यप्रति । जघान जघनच्च नु॥
verses.tr: asya pītvā madānāmindro vṛtrāṇyaprati jaghāna jaghanacca nu
verses.en: When he had drunken draughts of this, Indra smote down resistless foes: Yea, smote them, and shall smite them still.

verses.sa: प्र सोमासो अधन्विषुः पवमानास इन्दवः । श्रीणाना अप्सु मृञ्जत॥
verses.tr: pra somāso adhanviṣuḥ pavamānāsa indavaḥ śrīṇānā apsu mṛñjata
verses.en: Hitherward have the Soma streamed, the drops while they are purified: When blent, in waters they are rinsed.

verses.sa: अभि गावो अधन्विषुरापो न प्रवता यतीः । पुनाना इन्द्रमाशत॥
verses.tr: abhi gāvo adhanviṣurāpo na pravatā yatīḥ punānā indramāśata
verses.en: The milk hath run to meet them like floods rushing down a precipice: They come to Indra, being cleansed.

verses.sa: प्र पवमान धन्वसि सोमेन्द्राय पातवे । नृभिर्यतो वि नीयसे॥
verses.tr: pra pavamāna dhanvasi somendrāya pātave nṛbhiryato vi nīyase
verses.en: O Soma Pavamana, thou art flowing to be Indra's drink: The men have seized and lead thee forth.

verses.sa: त्वं सोम नृमादनः पवस्व चर्षणीसहे । सस्निर्यो अनुमाद्यः॥
verses.tr: tvaṃ soma nṛmādanaḥ pavasva carṣaṇīsahe sasniryo anumādyaḥ
verses.en: Victorious, to be hailed with joy, O Soma, flow, delighting men, To him who ruleth o'er mankind.

verses.sa: इन्दो यदद्रिभिः सुतः पवित्रं परिधावसि । अरमिन्द्रस्य धाम्ने॥
verses.tr: indo yadadribhiḥ sutaḥ pavitraṃ paridhāvasi aramindrasya dhāmne
verses.en: Thou, Indu, when, effused by stones, thou runnest to the filter, art, Ready for Indra's high decree.

verses.sa: पवस्व वृत्रहन्तमोक्थेभिरनुमाद्यः । शुचिः पावको अद्भुतः॥
verses.tr: pavasva vṛtrahantamokthebhiranumādyaḥ śuciḥ pāvako adbhutaḥ
verses.en: Flow on, best Vrtra-slayer; flow meet to be hailed with joyful lauds. Pure, purifying, wonderful.

verses.sa: शुचिः पावक उच्यते सोमः सुतस्य मध्वः । देवावीरघशंसहा॥
verses.tr: śuciḥ pāvaka ucyate somaḥ sutasya madhvaḥ devāvīraghaśaṃsahā
verses.en: Pure, purifying is he called the Soma of the meath effused, Slayer of sinners, dear to Gods.

verses.sa: पवस्व दक्षसाधनो देवेभ्यः पीतये हरे । मरुद्भ्यो वायवे मदः॥
verses.tr: pavasva dakṣasādhano devebhyaḥ pītaye hare marudbhyo vāyave madaḥ
verses.en: Green-HUED! as one who giveth strength flow on for Gods to drink, a draught For Vayu and the Marut host.

verses.sa: पवमान धिया हितो३ऽभि योनिं कनिक्रदत् । धर्मणा वायुमा विश॥
verses.tr: pavamāna dhiyā hito3'bhi yoniṃ kanikradat dharmaṇā vāyumā viśa
verses.en: O Pavamana, sent by song, roaring about thy dwelling-place, Pass into Vayu as Law bids.

verses.sa: सं देवैः शोभते वृषा कविर्योनावधि प्रियः । वृत्रहा देववीतमः॥
verses.tr: saṃ devaiḥ śobhate vṛṣā kaviryonāvadhi priyaḥ vṛtrahā devavītamaḥ
verses.en: The Steer shines with the Deities, dear Sage in his appointed home, Foe-Slayer, most beloved by Gods.

verses.sa: विश्वा रूपाण्याविशन्पुनानो याति हर्यतः । यत्रामृतास आसते॥
verses.tr: viśvā rūpāṇyāviśanpunāno yāti haryataḥ yatrāmṛtāsa āsate
verses.en: Taking each beauteous form, he goes, desirable, while purified, Thither where the Immortals sit.

verses.sa: अरुषो जनयन्गिरः सोमः पवत आयुषक् । इन्द्रं गच्छन्कविक्रतुः॥
verses.tr: aruṣo janayangiraḥ somaḥ pavata āyuṣak indraṃ gacchankavikratuḥ
verses.en: To Indra Soma flows, the Red, engendering song, exceeding wise, The visitor of living men.

verses.sa: आ पवस्व मदिन्तम पवित्रं धारया कवे । अर्कस्य योनिमासदम्॥
verses.tr: ā pavasva madintama pavitraṃ dhārayā kave arkasya yonimāsadam
verses.en: Flow, best exhilarator, Sage, flow to the filter in a stream To seat thee in the place of song.

verses.sa: तममृक्षन्त वाजिनमुपस्थे अदितेरधि । विप्रासो अण्व्या धिया॥
verses.tr: tamamṛkṣanta vājinamupasthe aditeradhi viprāso aṇvyā dhiyā
verses.en: The sages with the fingers' art have dressed and decked that vigorous Steed Upon the lap of Aditi,

verses.sa: तं गावो अभ्यनूषत सहस्रधारमक्षितम् । इन्दुं धर्तारमा दिवः॥
verses.tr: taṃ gāvo abhyanūṣata sahasradhāramakṣitam induṃ dhartāramā divaḥ
verses.en: The kine have called aloud to him exhaustless with a thousand streams, To Indu who supporteth heaven.

verses.sa: तं वेधां मेधयाह्यन्पवमानमधि द्यवि । धर्णसिं भूरिधायसम्॥
verses.tr: taṃ vedhāṃ medhayāhyanpavamānamadhi dyavi dharṇasiṃ bhūridhāyasam
verses.en: Him, nourisher of many, Sage, creative Pavamana, they Have sent, by wisdom, to the sky.

verses.sa: तमह्यन्भुरिजोर्धिया संवसानं विवस्वतः । पतिं वाचो अदाभ्यम्॥
verses.tr: tamahyanbhurijordhiyā saṃvasānaṃ vivasvataḥ patiṃ vāco adābhyam
verses.en: Him, dweller with Vivasvan, they with use of both arms have sent forth, The Lord of Speech infallible.

verses.sa: तं सानावधि जामयो हरिं हिन्वन्त्यद्रिभिः । हर्यतं भूरिचक्षसम्॥
verses.tr: taṃ sānāvadhi jāmayo hariṃ hinvantyadribhiḥ haryataṃ bhūricakṣasam
verses.en: Him, green, beloved, many eyed, the Sisters with prosing stones Send down to ridges of the sieve.

verses.sa: तं त्वा हिन्वन्ति वेधसः पवमान गिरावृधम् । इन्दविन्द्राय मत्सरम्॥
verses.tr: taṃ tvā hinvanti vedhasaḥ pavamāna girāvṛdham indavindrāya matsaram
verses.en: O Pavamana, Indu, priests hurry thee on to Indra, thee Who aidest song and cheerest him.

verses.sa: एष कविरभिष्टुतः पवित्रे अधि तोशते । पुनानो घ्नन्नप स्रिधः॥
verses.tr: eṣa kavirabhiṣṭutaḥ pavitre adhi tośate punāno ghnannapa sridhaḥ
verses.en: This Sage, exalted by our lauds, flows to the purifying cloth, Scattering foes as he is cleansed.

verses.sa: एष इन्द्राय वायवे स्वर्जित्परि षिच्यते । पवित्रे दक्षसाधनः॥
verses.tr: eṣa indrāya vāyave svarjitpari ṣicyate pavitre dakṣasādhanaḥ
verses.en: As giving power and winning light, for Indra and for Vayu he Is poured upon the filtering-cloth.

verses.sa: एष नृभिर्वि नीयते दिवो मूर्धा वृषा सुतः । सोमो वनेषु विश्ववित्॥
verses.tr: eṣa nṛbhirvi nīyate divo mūrdhā vṛṣā sutaḥ somo vaneṣu viśvavit
verses.en: The men conduct him, Soma, Steer, Omniscient, and the Head of Heaven, Effused into the vats of wood.

verses.sa: एष गव्युरचिक्रदत्पवमानो हिरण्ययुः । इन्दुः सत्राजिदस्तृतः॥
verses.tr: eṣa gavyuracikradatpavamāno hiraṇyayuḥ induḥ satrājidastṛtaḥ
verses.en: Longing for kine, longing for gold hath Indu Pavamana lowed, Still Conqueror, never overcome.

verses.sa: एष सूर्येण हासते पवमानो अधि द्यवि । पवित्रे मत्सरो मदः॥
verses.tr: eṣa sūryeṇa hāsate pavamāno adhi dyavi pavitre matsaro madaḥ
verses.en: This Pavamana, gladdening draught, drops on the filtering cloth, and then Mounts up with Surya to the sky.

verses.sa: एष शुष्म्यसिष्यददन्तरिक्षे वृषा हरिः । पुनान इन्दुरिन्द्रमा॥
verses.tr: eṣa śuṣmyasiṣyadadantarikṣe vṛṣā hariḥ punāna indurindramā
verses.en: To Indra in the firmament this mighty tawny Steer hath flowed, This Indu, being purified.

verses.sa: एष वाजी हितो नृभिर्विश्वविन्मनसस्पतिः । अव्यो वारं वि धावति॥
verses.tr: eṣa vājī hito nṛbhirviśvavinmanasaspatiḥ avyo vāraṃ vi dhāvati
verses.en: Urged by the men, this vigorous Steed, Lord of the mind, Omniscient, Runs to the woolen straining-cloth.

verses.sa: एष पवित्रे अक्षरत्सोमो देवेभ्यः सुतः । विश्वा धामान्याविशन्॥
verses.tr: eṣa pavitre akṣaratsomo devebhyaḥ sutaḥ viśvā dhāmānyāviśan
verses.en: Within the filter hath he flowed, this Soma for the Gods effused, Entering all their essences.

verses.sa: एष देवः शुभायतेऽधि योनावमर्त्यः । वृत्रहा देववीतमः॥
verses.tr: eṣa devaḥ śubhāyate'dhi yonāvamartyaḥ vṛtrahā devavītamaḥ
verses.en: He shines in beauty there, this God Immortal in his dwelling-place, Foe-slayer, dearest to the Gods.

verses.sa: एष वृषा कनिक्रदद्दशभिर्जामिभिर्यतः । अभि द्रोणानि धावति॥
verses.tr: eṣa vṛṣā kanikradaddaśabhirjāmibhiryataḥ abhi droṇāni dhāvati
verses.en: Directed by the Sisters ten, bellowing on his way this Steer Runs onward to the wooden vats.

verses.sa: एष सूर्यमरोचयत्पवमानो विचर्षणिः । विश्वा धामानि विश्ववित्॥
verses.tr: eṣa sūryamarocayatpavamāno vicarṣaṇiḥ viśvā dhāmāni viśvavit
verses.en: This Pavamana, swift and strong, Omniscient, gave splendour to The Sun and all his forms of light.

verses.sa: एष शुष्म्यदाभ्यः सोमः पुनानो अर्षति । देवावीरघशंसहा॥
verses.tr: eṣa śuṣmyadābhyaḥ somaḥ punāno arṣati devāvīraghaśaṃsahā
verses.en: This Soma being purified, flows mighty and infallible, Slayer of sinners, dear to Gods.

verses.sa: प्रास्य धारा अक्षरन्वृष्णः सुतस्यौजसा । देवाँ अनु प्रभूषतः॥
verses.tr: prāsya dhārā akṣaranvṛṣṇaḥ sutasyaujasā devāṃ anu prabhūṣataḥ
verses.en: Forward with mighty force have flowed the currents of this Steer effused, Of him who sets him by the Gods.

verses.sa: सप्तिं मृजन्ति वेधसो गृणन्तः कारवो गिरा । ज्योतिर्जज्ञानमुक्थ्यम्॥
verses.tr: saptiṃ mṛjanti vedhaso gṛṇantaḥ kāravo girā jyotirjajñānamukthyam
verses.en: The singers praise him with their song, and learned priests adorn the Steed, Brought forth as light that merits laud.

verses.sa: सुषहा सोम तानि ते पुनानाय प्रभूवसो । वर्धा समुद्रमुक्थ्यम्॥
verses.tr: suṣahā soma tāni te punānāya prabhūvaso vardhā samudramukthyam
verses.en: These things thou winnest lightly while purified, Soma, Lord of wealth: Fill full the sea that claims our praise.

verses.sa: विश्वा वसूनि संजयन्पवस्व सोम धारया । इनु द्वेषांसि सध्र्यक्॥
verses.tr: viśvā vasūni saṃjayanpavasva soma dhārayā inu dveṣāṃsi sadhryak
verses.en: Winning all precious things at once, flow on, O Soma, with thy stream Drive to one place our enemies.

verses.sa: रक्षा सु नो अररुषः स्वनात्समस्य कस्य चित् । निदो यत्र मुमुच्महे॥
verses.tr: rakṣā su no araruṣaḥ svanātsamasya kasya cit nido yatra mumucmahe
verses.en: Preserve us from the godless, from ill-omened voice of one and all, That so we may be freed from blame.

verses.sa: एन्दो पार्थिवं रयिं दिव्यं पवस्व धारया । द्युमन्तं शुष्ममा भर॥
verses.tr: endo pārthivaṃ rayiṃ divyaṃ pavasva dhārayā dyumantaṃ śuṣmamā bhara
verses.en: O Indu, as thou flowest on bring us the wealth of earth and heaven, And splendid vigour, in thy stream.

verses.sa: प्र धारा अस्य शुष्मिणो वृथा पवित्रे अक्षरन् । पुनानो वाचमिष्यति॥
verses.tr: pra dhārā asya śuṣmiṇo vṛthā pavitre akṣaran punāno vācamiṣyati
verses.en: Streams of this Potent One have flowed easily to the straining-cloth: While he is cleansed he lifts his voice.

verses.sa: इन्दुर्हियानः सोतृभिर्मृज्यमानः कनिक्रदत् । इयर्ति वग्नुमिन्द्रियम्॥
verses.tr: indurhiyānaḥ sotṛbhirmṛjyamānaḥ kanikradat iyarti vagnumindriyam
verses.en: Indu, by pressers urged to speed, bellowing out while beautified. Sends forth a very mighty sound.

verses.sa: आ नः शुष्मं नृषाह्यं वीरवन्तं पुरुस्पृहम् । पवस्व सोम धारया॥
verses.tr: ā naḥ śuṣmaṃ nṛṣāhyaṃ vīravantaṃ puruspṛham pavasva soma dhārayā
verses.en: Pour on us, Soma, with thy stream man conquering might which many crave, Accompanied with hero sons.

verses.sa: प्र सोमो अति धारया पवमानो असिष्यदत् । अभि द्रोणान्यासदम्॥
verses.tr: pra somo ati dhārayā pavamāno asiṣyadat abhi droṇānyāsadam
verses.en: Hither hath Pavamana flowed, Soma flowed hither in a stream, To settle in the vats of wood.

verses.sa: अप्सु त्वा मधुमत्तमं हरिं हिन्वन्त्यद्रिभिः । इन्दविन्द्राय पीतये॥
verses.tr: apsu tvā madhumattamaṃ hariṃ hinvantyadribhiḥ indavindrāya pītaye
verses.en: To waters with the stones they drive thee tawny-hued, most rich in sweets, O Indu, to be Indra's drink.

verses.sa: सुनोता मधुमत्तमं सोममिन्द्राय वज्रिणे । चारुं शर्धाय मत्सरम्॥
verses.tr: sunotā madhumattamaṃ somamindrāya vajriṇe cāruṃ śardhāya matsaram
verses.en: For Indra, for the Thunderer press the Soma very rich in sweets, Lovely, inspiriting, for strength.

verses.sa: प्र सोमासः स्वाध्य१ः पवमानासो अक्रमुः । रयिं कृण्वन्ति चेतनम्॥
verses.tr: pra somāsaḥ svādhya1ḥ pavamānāso akramuḥ rayiṃ kṛṇvanti cetanam
verses.en: The, Soma-drops, benevolent, come forth as they are purified, Bestowing wealth which all may see.

verses.sa: दिवस्पृथिव्या अधि भवेन्दो द्युम्नवर्धनः । भवा वाजानां पतिः॥
verses.tr: divaspṛthivyā adhi bhavendo dyumnavardhanaḥ bhavā vājānāṃ patiḥ
verses.en: O Indu, high o'er heaven and earth be thou, increaser of our might: The Master of all strength be thou.

verses.sa: तुभ्यं वाता अभिप्रियस्तुभ्यमर्षन्ति सिन्धवः । सोम वर्धन्ति ते महः॥
verses.tr: tubhyaṃ vātā abhipriyastubhyamarṣanti sindhavaḥ soma vardhanti te mahaḥ
verses.en: The winds are gracious in their love to thee, the rivers flow to thee Soma, they multiply thy power.

verses.sa: आ प्यायस्व समेतु ते विश्वतः सोम वृष्ण्यम् । भवा वाजस्य संगथे॥
verses.tr: ā pyāyasva sametu te viśvataḥ soma vṛṣṇyam bhavā vājasya saṃgathe
verses.en: Soma, wax great. From every side may vigorous powers unite in thee: Be in the gathering-Place of strength.

verses.sa: तुभ्यं गावो घृतं पयो बभ्रो दुदुह्रे अक्षितम् । वर्षिष्ठे अधि सानवि॥
verses.tr: tubhyaṃ gāvo ghṛtaṃ payo babhro duduhre akṣitam varṣiṣṭhe adhi sānavi
verses.en: For thee, brown-hued! the kine have poured imperishable oil and milk. Aloft on the sublimest height.

verses.sa: स्वायुधस्य ते सतो भुवनस्य पते वयम् । इन्दो सखित्वमुश्मसि॥
verses.tr: svāyudhasya te sato bhuvanasya pate vayam indo sakhitvamuśmasi
verses.en: Friendship, O Indu, we desire with thee who bearest noble arms, With thee, O Lord of all that is.

verses.sa: प्र सोमासो मदच्युतः श्रवसे नो मघोनः । सुता विदथे अक्रमुः॥
verses.tr: pra somāso madacyutaḥ śravase no maghonaḥ sutā vidathe akramuḥ
verses.en: The rapture-shedding Soma-drops, effused in our assembly, have Flowed forth to glorify our prince.

verses.sa: आदीं त्रितस्य योषणो हरिं हिन्वन्त्यद्रिभिः । इन्दुमिन्द्राय पीतये॥
verses.tr: ādīṃ tritasya yoṣaṇo hariṃ hinvantyadribhiḥ indumindrāya pītaye
verses.en: Then Trita's Maidens onward urge the Tawny-coloured with the stones, Indu for Indra, for his drink.

verses.sa: आदीं हंसो यथा गणं विश्वस्यावीवशन्मतिम् । अत्यो न गोभिरज्यते॥
verses.tr: ādīṃ haṃso yathā gaṇaṃ viśvasyāvīvaśanmatim atyo na gobhirajyate
verses.en: Now like a swan he maketh all the company sing each his hymn: He, like a steed, is bathed in milk.

verses.sa: उभे सोमावचाकशन्मृगो न तक्तो अर्षसि । सीदन्नृतस्य योनिमा॥
verses.tr: ubhe somāvacākaśanmṛgo na takto arṣasi sīdannṛtasya yonimā
verses.en: O Soma, viewing heaven and earth, thou runnest like a darting deer Set in the place of sacrifice.

verses.sa: अभि गावो अनूषत योषा जारमिव प्रियम् । अगन्नाजिं यथा हितम्॥
verses.tr: abhi gāvo anūṣata yoṣā jāramiva priyam agannājiṃ yathā hitam
verses.en: The cows have sung with joy to him, even as a woman to her love He came as to a settled race.

verses.sa: अस्मे धेहि द्युमद्यशो मघवद्भ्यश्च मह्यं च । सनिं मेधामुत श्रवः॥
verses.tr: asme dhehi dyumadyaśo maghavadbhyaśca mahyaṃ ca saniṃ medhāmuta śravaḥ
verses.en: Bestow illustrious fame on us, both on our liberal lords and me, Glory, intelligence, and wealth.

verses.sa: प्र सोमासो विपश्चितोऽपां न यन्त्यूर्मयः । वनानि महिषा इव॥
verses.tr: pra somāso vipaścito'pāṃ na yantyūrmayaḥ vanāni mahiṣā iva
verses.en: Like waves of waters, skilled in song the juices of the Soma speed Onward, as buffaloes to woods.

verses.sa: अभि द्रोणानि बभ्रवः शुक्रा ऋतस्य धारया । वाजं गोमन्तमक्षरन्॥
verses.tr: abhi droṇāni babhravaḥ śukrā ṛtasya dhārayā vājaṃ gomantamakṣaran
verses.en: With stream of sacrifice the brown bright drops have flowed with strength in store Of kine into the wooden vats.

verses.sa: सुता इन्द्राय वायवे वरुणाय मरुद्भ्यः । सोमा अर्षन्ति विष्णवे॥
verses.tr: sutā indrāya vāyave varuṇāya marudbhyaḥ somā arṣanti viṣṇave
verses.en: To Indra, Vayu, Varuna, to Visnu, and the Maruts, flow The drops of Soma juice effused.

verses.sa: तिस्रो वाच उदीरते गावो मिमन्ति धेनवः । हरिरेति कनिक्रदत्॥
verses.tr: tisro vāca udīrate gāvo mimanti dhenavaḥ harireti kanikradat
verses.en: Three several words are uttered: kine are ]owing, cows who give their milk: The Tawny-hued goes bellowing on.

verses.sa: अभि ब्रह्मीरनूषत यह्वीॠतस्य मातरः । मर्मृज्यन्ते दिवः शिशुम्॥
verses.tr: abhi brahmīranūṣata yahvīṝtasya mātaraḥ marmṛjyante divaḥ śiśum
verses.en: The young and sacred mothers of the holy rite have uttered praise: They decorate the Child of Heaven.

verses.sa: रायः समुद्राँश्चतुरोऽस्मभ्यं सोम विश्वतः । आ पवस्व सहस्रिणः॥
verses.tr: rāyaḥ samudrāṃścaturo'smabhyaṃ soma viśvataḥ ā pavasva sahasriṇaḥ
verses.en: From every side, O Soma, for our profit, pour thou forth four seas Filled full of riches thousand fold.

verses.sa: प्र सुवानो धारया तनेन्दुर्हिन्वानो अर्षति । रुजद्दृळ्हा व्योजसा॥
verses.tr: pra suvāno dhārayā tanendurhinvāno arṣati rujaddṛḻhā vyojasā
verses.en: The drop of Soma juice effused flows onward with this stream impelled. Rending strong places with its might.

verses.sa: सुत इन्द्राय वायवे वरुणाय मरुद्भ्यः । सोमो अर्षति विष्णवे॥
verses.tr: suta indrāya vāyave varuṇāya marudbhyaḥ somo arṣati viṣṇave
verses.en: Poured forth to Indra, Varuna, to Vayu and the Marut hosts, To Visnu, flows the Soma juice.

verses.sa: वृषाणं वृषभिर्यतं सुन्वन्ति सोममद्रिभिः । दुहन्ति शक्मना पयः॥
verses.tr: vṛṣāṇaṃ vṛṣabhiryataṃ sunvanti somamadribhiḥ duhanti śakmanā payaḥ
verses.en: With stones they press the Soma forth, the Strong conducted by the strong: They milk the liquor out with skill.

verses.sa: भुवत्त्रितस्य मर्ज्यो भुवदिन्द्राय मत्सरः । सं रूपैरज्यते हरिः॥
verses.tr: bhuvattritasya marjyo bhuvadindrāya matsaraḥ saṃ rūpairajyate hariḥ
verses.en: 'Tis he whom Trita must refine, 'tis he who shall make Indra glad: The Tawny One is decked with tints.

verses.sa: अभीमृतस्य विष्टपं दुहते पृश्निमातरः । चारु प्रियतमं हविः॥
verses.tr: abhīmṛtasya viṣṭapaṃ duhate pṛśnimātaraḥ cāru priyatamaṃ haviḥ
verses.en: Him do the Sons of Prsni milk, the dwelling-place of sacrifice, Oblation lovely and most dear.

verses.sa: समेनमह्रुता इमा गिरो अर्षन्ति सस्रुतः । धेनूर्वाश्रो अवीवशत्॥
verses.tr: samenamahrutā imā giro arṣanti sasrutaḥ dhenūrvāśro avīvaśat
verses.en: To him in one united stream these songs flow on straight forward. he, Loud voiced, hath made the milch-kine low.

verses.sa: आ नः पवस्व धारया पवमान रयिं पृथुम् । यया ज्योतिर्विदासि नः॥
verses.tr: ā naḥ pavasva dhārayā pavamāna rayiṃ pṛthum yayā jyotirvidāsi naḥ
verses.en: Pour forth on us abundant wealth, O Pavamana, with thy stream. Wherewith thou mayest find us light

verses.sa: इन्दो समुद्रमीङ्खय पवस्व विश्वमेजय । रायो धर्ता न ओजसा॥
verses.tr: indo samudramīṅkhaya pavasva viśvamejaya rāyo dhartā na ojasā
verses.en: O Indu, swayer of the sea, shaker of all things, flow thou on, Bearer of wealth to us with might.

verses.sa: त्वया वीरेण वीरवोऽभि ष्याम पृतन्यतः । क्षरा णो अभि वार्यम्॥
verses.tr: tvayā vīreṇa vīravo'bhi ṣyāma pṛtanyataḥ kṣarā ṇo abhi vāryam
verses.en: With thee for Hero, Valiant One! may we subdue our enemies: Let what is precious flow to us.

verses.sa: प्र वाजमिन्दुरिष्यति सिषासन्वाजसा ऋषिः । व्रता विदान आयुधा॥
verses.tr: pra vājaminduriṣyati siṣāsanvājasā ṛṣiḥ vratā vidāna āyudhā
verses.en: Indu arouses strength the Sage who strives for victory, winning power, Discovering holy works and means.

verses.sa: तं गीर्भिर्वाचमीङ्खयं पुनानं वासयामसि । सोम  जनस्य गोपतिम्॥
verses.tr: taṃ gīrbhirvācamīṅkhayaṃ punānaṃ vāsayāmasi soma janasya gopatim
verses.en: Mover of speech, we robe him with our songs as he is purified Soma, the Guardian of the folk;

verses.sa: विश्वो यस्य व्रते जनो दाधार धर्मणस्पतेः । पुनानस्य प्रभूवसोः॥
verses.tr: viśvo yasya vrate jano dādhāra dharmaṇaspateḥ punānasya prabhūvasoḥ
verses.en: On whose way, Lord of Holy Law, most rich as he is purified. The people all have set their hearts.

verses.sa: असर्जि रथ्यो यथा पवित्रे चम्वोः सुतः । कार्ष्मन्वाजी न्यक्रमीत्॥
verses.tr: asarji rathyo yathā pavitre camvoḥ sutaḥ kārṣmanvājī nyakramīt
verses.en: Forth from the mortar is the juice sent, like a car-horse, to the sieve: The Steed steps forward to the goal.

verses.sa: स वह्निः सोम जागृविः पवस्व देववीरति । अभि कोशं मधुश्चुतम्॥
verses.tr: sa vahniḥ soma jāgṛviḥ pavasva devavīrati abhi kośaṃ madhuścutam
verses.en: Thus, Soma, watchful, bearing well, cheering the Gods, flow past the sieve, Turned to the vat that drops with meath.

verses.sa: स नो ज्योतींषि पूर्व्य पवमान वि रोचय । क्रत्वे दक्षाय नो हिनु॥
verses.tr: sa no jyotīṃṣi pūrvya pavamāna vi rocaya kratve dakṣāya no hinu
verses.en: Excellent Pavamana, make the lights shine brightly out for us. Speed us to mental power and skill.

verses.sa: शुम्भमान ऋतायुभिर्मृज्यमानो गभस्त्योः । पवते वारे अव्यये॥
verses.tr: śumbhamāna ṛtāyubhirmṛjyamāno gabhastyoḥ pavate vāre avyaye
verses.en: He, beautified by pious men, and coming from their hands adorned, Flows through the fleecy straining-cloth.

verses.sa: स विश्वा दाशुषे वसु सोमो दिव्यानि पार्थिवा । पवतामान्तरिक्ष्या॥
verses.tr: sa viśvā dāśuṣe vasu somo divyāni pārthivā pavatāmāntarikṣyā
verses.en: May Soma pour all treasures of the heavens, the earth, the firmament Upon the liberal worshipper.

verses.sa: आ दिवस्पृष्ठमश्वयुर्गव्ययुः सोम रोहसि । वीरयुः शवसस्पते॥
verses.tr: ā divaspṛṣṭhamaśvayurgavyayuḥ soma rohasi vīrayuḥ śavasaspate
verses.en: Thou mountest to the height of heaven, O Soma, seeking steeds and kine, And seeking heroes, Lord of Strength!

verses.sa: स सुतः पीतये वृषा सोमः पवित्रे अर्षति । विघ्नन्रक्षांसि देवयुः॥
verses.tr: sa sutaḥ pītaye vṛṣā somaḥ pavitre arṣati vighnanrakṣāṃsi devayuḥ
verses.en: Soma, the Steer, effused for draught, flows to the purifying sieve, Slaying the fiends, loving the Gods.

verses.sa: स पवित्रे विचक्षणो हरिरर्षति धर्णसिः । अभि योनिं कनिक्रदत्॥
verses.tr: sa pavitre vicakṣaṇo harirarṣati dharṇasiḥ abhi yoniṃ kanikradat
verses.en: Far-sighted, tawny-coloured, he flows to the sieve, intelligent, Bellowing, to his place of rest.

verses.sa: स वाजी रोचना दिवः पवमानो वि धावति । रक्षोहा वारमव्ययम्॥
verses.tr: sa vājī rocanā divaḥ pavamāno vi dhāvati rakṣohā vāramavyayam
verses.en: This vigorous Pavamana runs forth to the luminous realm of heaven, Fiend-slayer, through the fleecy sieve.

verses.sa: स त्रितस्याधि सानवि पवमानो अरोचयत् । जामिभिः सूर्यं सह॥
verses.tr: sa tritasyādhi sānavi pavamāno arocayat jāmibhiḥ sūryaṃ saha
verses.en: This Payamana up above Trita's high ridge hath made the Sun, Together with the Sisters, shine.

verses.sa: स वृत्रहा वृषा सुतो वरिवोविददाभ्यः । सोमो वाजमिवासरत्॥
verses.tr: sa vṛtrahā vṛṣā suto varivovidadābhyaḥ somo vājamivāsarat
verses.en: This Vrtra-slaying Steer, effused, Soma room-giver, ne'er deceived, Hath gone, as 'twere, to win the spoil.

verses.sa: स देवः कविनेषितो३ऽभि द्रोणानि धावति । इन्दुरिन्द्राय मंहना॥
verses.tr: sa devaḥ kavineṣito3'bhi droṇāni dhāvati indurindrāya maṃhanā
verses.en: Urged onward by the sage, the God speeds forward to the casks of wood, Indu to Indra willingly.

verses.sa: एष उ स्य वृषा रथोऽव्यो वारेभिरर्षति । गच्छन्वाजं सहस्रिणम्॥
verses.tr: eṣa u sya vṛṣā ratho'vyo vārebhirarṣati gacchanvājaṃ sahasriṇam
verses.en: This Steer, this Chariot, rushes through the woolen filter, as he goes To war that wins a thousand spoils.

verses.sa: एतं त्रितस्य योषणो हरिं हिन्वन्त्यद्रिभिः । इन्दुमिन्द्राय पीतये॥
verses.tr: etaṃ tritasya yoṣaṇo hariṃ hinvantyadribhiḥ indumindrāya pītaye
verses.en: The Dames of Trita with the stones onward impel this Tawny One Indu to Indra for his drink.

verses.sa: एतं त्यं हरितो दश मर्मृज्यन्ते अपस्युवः । याभिर्मदाय शुम्भते॥
verses.tr: etaṃ tyaṃ harito daśa marmṛjyante apasyuvaḥ yābhirmadāya śumbhate
verses.en: Ten active fingers carefully adorn him here; they make him bright And beauteous for the gladdening draught.

verses.sa: एष स्य मानुषीष्वा श्येनो न विक्षु सीदति । गच्छञ्जारो न योषितम्॥
verses.tr: eṣa sya mānuṣīṣvā śyeno na vikṣu sīdati gacchañjāro na yoṣitam
verses.en: He like a falcon settles down amid the families of men. Speeding like lover to his love.

verses.sa: एष स्य मद्यो रसोऽव चष्टे दिवः शिशुः । य इन्दुर्वारमाविशत्॥
verses.tr: eṣa sya madyo raso'va caṣṭe divaḥ śiśuḥ ya indurvāramāviśat
verses.en: This young exhilarating juice looks downward from its place in heaven, This Soma-drop that pierced the sieve.

verses.sa: एष स्य पीतये सुतो हरिरर्षति धर्णसिः । क्रन्दन्योनिमभि प्रियम्॥
verses.tr: eṣa sya pītaye suto harirarṣati dharṇasiḥ krandanyonimabhi priyam
verses.en: Poured for the draught, this tawny juice flows forth, intelligent, crying out, Unto the well-beloved place.

verses.sa: आशुरर्ष बृहन्मते परि प्रियेण धाम्ना । यत्र देवा इति ब्रवन्॥
verses.tr: āśurarṣa bṛhanmate pari priyeṇa dhāmnā yatra devā iti bravan
verses.en: Flow On, O thou of lofty thought, flow swift in thy beloved form, Saying, I go where dwell the Gods.

verses.sa: परिष्कृण्वन्ननिष्कृतं जनाय यातयन्निषः । वृष्टिं दिवः परि स्रव॥
verses.tr: pariṣkṛṇvannaniṣkṛtaṃ janāya yātayanniṣaḥ vṛṣṭiṃ divaḥ pari srava
verses.en: Preparing what is unprepared, and bringing store of food to man, Make thou the rain descend from heaven.

verses.sa: सुत एति पवित्र आ त्विषिं दधान ओजसा । विचक्षाणो विरोचयन्॥
verses.tr: suta eti pavitra ā tviṣiṃ dadhāna ojasā vicakṣāṇo virocayan
verses.en: With might, bestowing power, the juice enters the purifying sieve, Far-seeing, sending forth its light.

verses.sa: अयं स यो दिवस्परि रघुयामा पवित्र आ । सिन्धोरूर्मा व्यक्षरत्॥
verses.tr: ayaṃ sa yo divaspari raghuyāmā pavitra ā sindhorūrmā vyakṣarat
verses.en: This is it which in rapid course hath with the river's wave flowed down From heaven upon the straining cloth.

verses.sa: आविवासन्परावतो अथो अर्वावतः सुतः । इन्द्राय सिच्यते मधु॥
verses.tr: āvivāsanparāvato atho arvāvataḥ sutaḥ indrāya sicyate madhu
verses.en: Inviting him from far away, and even from near at hand, the juice For Indra is poured forth as meath.

verses.sa: समीचीना अनूषत हरिं हिन्वन्त्यद्रिभिः । योनावृतस्य सीदत॥
verses.tr: samīcīnā anūṣata hariṃ hinvantyadribhiḥ yonāvṛtasya sīdata
verses.en: In union they have sung the hymn: with stones they urge the Tawny One. Sit in the place of sacrifice.

verses.sa: पुनानो अक्रमीदभि विश्वा मृधो विचर्षणिः । शुम्भन्ति विप्रं धीतिभिः॥
verses.tr: punāno akramīdabhi viśvā mṛdho vicarṣaṇiḥ śumbhanti vipraṃ dhītibhiḥ
verses.en: The Very Active hath assailed, while purified, all enemies: They deck the Sage with holy songs.

verses.sa: आ योनिमरुणो रुहद्गमदिन्द्रं वृषा सुतः । ध्रुवे सदसि सीदति॥
verses.tr: ā yonimaruṇo ruhadgamadindraṃ vṛṣā sutaḥ dhruve sadasi sīdati
verses.en: The Red hath mounted to his place; to India, goes the mighty juice: He settles in his firm abode.

verses.sa: नू नो रयिं महामिन्दोऽस्मभ्यं सोम विश्वतः । आ पवस्व सहस्रिणम्॥
verses.tr: nū no rayiṃ mahāmindo'smabhyaṃ soma viśvataḥ ā pavasva sahasriṇam
verses.en: O Indu, Soma, send us now great opulence from every side, Pour on us treasures thousand fold.

verses.sa: विश्वा सोम पवमान द्युम्नानीन्दवा भर । विदाः सहस्रिणीरिषः॥
verses.tr: viśvā soma pavamāna dyumnānīndavā bhara vidāḥ sahasriṇīriṣaḥ
verses.en: O Soma Pavamana, bring, Indu, all splendours hitherward: Find for us food in boundless store.

verses.sa: स नः पुनान आ भर रयिं स्तोत्रे सुवीर्यम् । जरितुर्वर्धया गिरः॥
verses.tr: sa naḥ punāna ā bhara rayiṃ stotre suvīryam jariturvardhayā giraḥ
verses.en: As thou art cleansed, bring hero strength and riches to thy worshipper, And prosper thou the singer's hymns.

verses.sa: पुनान इन्दवा भर सोम द्विबर्हसं रयिम् । वृषन्निन्दो न उक्थ्यम्॥
verses.tr: punāna indavā bhara soma dvibarhasaṃ rayim vṛṣannindo na ukthyam
verses.en: O Indu, Soma, being cleansed, bring hither riches doubly piled, Wealth, mighty Indu, meet for lauds.

verses.sa: प्र ये गावो न भूर्णयस्त्वेषा अयासो अक्रमुः । घ्नन्तः कृष्णामप त्वचम्॥
verses.tr: pra ye gāvo na bhūrṇayastveṣā ayāso akramuḥ ghnantaḥ kṛṣṇāmapa tvacam
verses.en: Active and bright have they come forth, impetuous in speed like bulls, Driving the black skin far away.

verses.sa: सुवितस्य मनामहेऽति सेतुं दुराव्यम् । साह्वांसो दस्युमव्रतम्॥
verses.tr: suvitasya manāmahe'ti setuṃ durāvyam sāhvāṃso dasyumavratam
verses.en: Quelling the riteless Dasyu, may we think upon the bridge of bliss, Leaving the bridge of woe behind.

verses.sa: शृण्वे वृष्टेरिव स्वनः पवमानस्य शुष्मिणः । चरन्ति विद्युतो दिवि॥
verses.tr: śṛṇve vṛṣṭeriva svanaḥ pavamānasya śuṣmiṇaḥ caranti vidyuto divi
verses.en: The mighty Pavamana's roar is heard as 'twere the rush of rain Lightnings are flashing to the sky.

verses.sa: आ पवस्व महीमिषं गोमदिन्दो हिरण्यवत् । अश्वावद्वाजवत्सुतः॥
verses.tr: ā pavasva mahīmiṣaṃ gomadindo hiraṇyavat aśvāvadvājavatsutaḥ
verses.en: Pour out on us abundant food, when thou art pressed, O Indu wealth In kine and gold and steeds and spoil.

verses.sa: स पवस्व विचर्षण आ मही रोदसी पृण । उषाः सूर्यो न रश्मिभिः॥
verses.tr: sa pavasva vicarṣaṇa ā mahī rodasī pṛṇa uṣāḥ sūryo na raśmibhiḥ
verses.en: Flow on thy way, Most Active, thou. fill full the mighty heavens and earth, As Dawn, as Surya with his beams.

verses.sa: परि णः शर्मयन्त्या धारया सोम विश्वतः । सरा रसेव विष्टपम्॥
verses.tr: pari ṇaḥ śarmayantyā dhārayā soma viśvataḥ sarā raseva viṣṭapam
verses.en: On every side, O Soma, flow round us with thy protecting stream, As Rasa flows around the world.

verses.sa: जनयन्रोचना दिवो जनयन्नप्सु सूर्यम् । वसानो गा अपो हरिः॥
verses.tr: janayanrocanā divo janayannapsu sūryam vasāno gā apo hariḥ
verses.en: Engendering the Sun in floods, engendering heaven's lights, green-hued, Robed in the waters and the milk,

verses.sa: एष प्रत्नेन मन्मना देवो देवेभ्यस्परि । धारया पवते सुतः॥
verses.tr: eṣa pratnena manmanā devo devebhyaspari dhārayā pavate sutaḥ
verses.en: According to primeval plan this Soma, with his stream, effused Flows purely on, a God for Gods.
