verses.sa: वावृधानाय तूर्वये पवन्ते वाजसातये । सोमाः सहस्रपाजसः॥
verses.tr: vāvṛdhānāya tūrvaye pavante vājasātaye somāḥ sahasrapājasaḥ
verses.en: For him victorious, waxen great, the juices with a thousand powers Are purified for winning spoil.

verses.sa: दुहानः प्रत्नमित्पयः पवित्रे परि षिच्यते । क्रन्दन्देवाँ अजीजनत्॥
verses.tr: duhānaḥ pratnamitpayaḥ pavitre pari ṣicyate krandandevāṃ ajījanat
verses.en: Shedding the ancient fluid he is poured into the cleansing sieve: He, thundering, hath produced the Gods.

verses.sa: अभि विश्वानि वार्याभि देवाँ ऋतावृधः । सोमः पुनानो अर्षति॥
verses.tr: abhi viśvāni vāryābhi devāṃ ṛtāvṛdhaḥ somaḥ punāno arṣati
verses.en: Soma, while purifying, sends hither all things to be desired, He sends the Gods who strengthen Law.

verses.sa: गोमन्नः सोम वीरवदश्वावद्वाजवत्सुतः । पवस्व बृहतीरिषः॥
verses.tr: gomannaḥ soma vīravadaśvāvadvājavatsutaḥ pavasva bṛhatīriṣaḥ
verses.en: Soma, effused, pour on us wealth in kine, in heroes, steeds, and spoil, Send us abundant store of food.

verses.sa: यो अत्य इव मृज्यते गोभिर्मदाय हर्यतः । तं गीर्भिर्वासयामसि॥
verses.tr: yo atya iva mṛjyate gobhirmadāya haryataḥ taṃ gīrbhirvāsayāmasi
verses.en: We will enrobe with sacred song the Lovely One who, as a Steed, Is decked with milk for rapturous joy.

verses.sa: तं नो विश्वा अवस्युवो गिरः शुम्भन्ति पूर्वथा । इन्दुमिन्द्राय पीतये॥
verses.tr: taṃ no viśvā avasyuvo giraḥ śumbhanti pūrvathā indumindrāya pītaye
verses.en: All songs of ours desiring grace adorn him in the ancient way, Indu for Indra, for his drink.

verses.sa: पुनानो याति हर्यतः सोमो गीर्भिः परिष्कृतः । विप्रस्य मेध्यातिथेः॥
verses.tr: punāno yāti haryataḥ somo gīrbhiḥ pariṣkṛtaḥ viprasya medhyātitheḥ
verses.en: Soma flows on when purified, beloved and adorned with songs, Songs of the sage Medhyatithi.

verses.sa: पवमान विदा रयिमस्मभ्यं सोम सुश्रियम् । इन्दो सहस्रवर्चसम्॥
verses.tr: pavamāna vidā rayimasmabhyaṃ soma suśriyam indo sahasravarcasam
verses.en: O Soma Pavamana, find exceeding glorious wealth for us, Wealth, Indu, fraught with boundless might.

verses.sa: इन्दुरत्यो न वाजसृत्कनिक्रन्ति पवित्र आ । यदक्षारति देवयुः॥
verses.tr: induratyo na vājasṛtkanikranti pavitra ā yadakṣārati devayuḥ
verses.en: Like courser racing to the prize Indu, the lover of the Gods, Roars, as he passes, in the sieve.

verses.sa: पवस्व वाजसातये विप्रस्य गृणतो वृधे । सोम रास्व सुवीर्यम्॥
verses.tr: pavasva vājasātaye viprasya gṛṇato vṛdhe soma rāsva suvīryam
verses.en: Flow on thy way to win us strength, to speed the sage who praises thee: Soma, bestow heroic power.

verses.sa: प्र ण इन्दो महे तन ऊर्मिं न बिभ्रदर्षसि । अभि देवाँ अयास्यः॥
verses.tr: pra ṇa indo mahe tana ūrmiṃ na bibhradarṣasi abhi devāṃ ayāsyaḥ
verses.en: Indu, to us for this great rite, bearing as 'twere thy wave to Gods, Unwearied, thou art flowing forth.

verses.sa: मती जुष्टो धिया हितः सोमो हिन्वे परावति । विप्रस्य धारया कविः॥
verses.tr: matī juṣṭo dhiyā hitaḥ somo hinve parāvati viprasya dhārayā kaviḥ
verses.en: Pleased with the hymn, impelled by prayer, Soma is hurried far away, The Wise One in the Singer's stream.,

verses.sa: अयं देवेषु जागृविः सुत एति पवित्र आ । सोमो याति विचर्षणिः॥
verses.tr: ayaṃ deveṣu jāgṛviḥ suta eti pavitra ā somo yāti vicarṣaṇiḥ
verses.en: Watchful among the. gods, this juice advances to the cleansing sieve Soma, most active, travels on.

verses.sa: स नः पवस्व वाजयुश्चक्राणश्चारुमध्वरम् । बर्हिष्माँ आ विवासति॥
verses.tr: sa naḥ pavasva vājayuścakrāṇaścārumadhvaram barhiṣmāṃ ā vivāsati
verses.en: Flow onward, seeking strength for us, embellishing the sacrifice: The priest with trimmed grass calleth thee.

verses.sa: स नो भगाय वायवे विप्रवीरः सदावृधः । सोमो देवेष्वा यमत्॥
verses.tr: sa no bhagāya vāyave vipravīraḥ sadāvṛdhaḥ somo deveṣvā yamat
verses.en: May Soma, ever bringing power to Bhaga and to Vayu, Sage And Hero, lead us to the Gods.

verses.sa: स नो अद्य वसुत्तये क्रतुविद्गातुवित्तमः । वाजं जेषि श्रवो बृहत्॥
verses.tr: sa no adya vasuttaye kratuvidgātuvittamaḥ vājaṃ jeṣi śravo bṛhat
verses.en: So, to increase our wealth to-day, Inspirer, best of Furtherers, Win for us strength and high renown.

verses.sa: स पवस्व मदाय कं नृचक्षा देववीतये । इन्दविन्द्राय पीतये॥
verses.tr: sa pavasva madāya kaṃ nṛcakṣā devavītaye indavindrāya pītaye
verses.en: Flow, thou who viewest men, to give delight, to entertain the Gods, Indu, to Indra for his drink.

verses.sa: स नो अर्षाभि दूत्यं१ त्वमिन्द्राय तोशसे । देवान्त्सखिभ्य आ वरम्॥
verses.tr: sa no arṣābhi dūtyaṃ1 tvamindrāya tośase devāntsakhibhya ā varam
verses.en: Stream to thine embassy for us: thou hastenest, for Indra, to The Gods, O better than our friends.

verses.sa: उत त्वामरुणं वयं गोभिरञ्ज्मो मदाय कम् । वि नो राये दुरो वृधि॥
verses.tr: uta tvāmaruṇaṃ vayaṃ gobhirañjmo madāya kam vi no rāye duro vṛdhi
verses.en: We balm thee, red of hue, with milk to fit thee for the rapturous joy: Unbar for us the doors of wealth.

verses.sa: अत्यू पवित्रमक्रमीद्वाजी धुरं न यामनि । इन्दुर्देवेषु पत्यते॥
verses.tr: atyū pavitramakramīdvājī dhuraṃ na yāmani indurdeveṣu patyate
verses.en: He through the sieve hath passed, as comes a courser to the pole, to run Indu belongs unto the Gods.

verses.sa: समी सखायो अस्वरन्वने क्रीळन्तमत्यविम् । इन्दुं नावा अनूषत॥
verses.tr: samī sakhāyo asvaranvane krīḻantamatyavim induṃ nāvā anūṣata
verses.en: All friends have lauded him as he sports in the wood, beyond the fleece: Singers have chanted Indu's praise.

verses.sa: तया पवस्व धारया यया पीतो विचक्षसे । इन्दो स्तोत्रे सुवीर्यम्॥
verses.tr: tayā pavasva dhārayā yayā pīto vicakṣase indo stotre suvīryam
verses.en: Flow, Indu, with that stream wherein steeped thou announcest to the man Who worships thee heroic strength.

verses.sa: असृग्रन्देववीतयेऽत्यासः कृत्व्या इव । क्षरन्तः पर्वतावृधः॥
verses.tr: asṛgrandevavītaye'tyāsaḥ kṛtvyā iva kṣarantaḥ parvatāvṛdhaḥ
verses.en: Like able coursers they have been sent forth to be the feast of Gods, joying in mountains, flowing on.

verses.sa: परिष्कृतास इन्दवो योषेव पित्र्यावती । वायुं सोमा असृक्षत॥
verses.tr: pariṣkṛtāsa indavo yoṣeva pitryāvatī vāyuṃ somā asṛkṣata
verses.en: To Vayu flow the Soma-streams, the drops of juice made beautiful Like a bride dowered by her sire.

verses.sa: एते सोमास इन्दवः प्रयस्वन्तश्चमू सुताः । इन्द्रं वर्धन्ति कर्मभिः॥
verses.tr: ete somāsa indavaḥ prayasvantaścamū sutāḥ indraṃ vardhanti karmabhiḥ
verses.en: Pressed in the mortar, these, the drops of juice, the Somas rich in food, Give strength to Indra with their work.

verses.sa: आ धावता सुहस्त्यः शुक्रा गृभ्णीत मन्थिना । गोभिः श्रीणीत मत्सरम्॥
verses.tr: ā dhāvatā suhastyaḥ śukrā gṛbhṇīta manthinā gobhiḥ śrīṇīta matsaram
verses.en: Deft-handed men, run hither, seize the brilliant juices blent with meal, And cook with milk the gladdening draught.

verses.sa: स पवस्व धनंजय प्रयन्ता राधसो महः । अस्मभ्यं सोम गातुवित्॥
verses.tr: sa pavasva dhanaṃjaya prayantā rādhaso mahaḥ asmabhyaṃ soma gātuvit
verses.en: Thus, Soma, Conqueror of wealth! flow, finding furtherance for us, Giver of ample opulence.

verses.sa: एतं मृजन्ति मर्ज्यं पवमानं दश क्षिपः । इन्द्राय मत्सरं मदम्॥
verses.tr: etaṃ mṛjanti marjyaṃ pavamānaṃ daśa kṣipaḥ indrāya matsaraṃ madam
verses.en: This Pavamana, meet to be adorned, the fingers ten adorn, The draught that shall make Indra glad.

verses.sa: अया सोमः सुकृत्यया महश्चिदभ्यवर्धत । मन्दान उद्वृषायते॥
verses.tr: ayā somaḥ sukṛtyayā mahaścidabhyavardhata mandāna udvṛṣāyate
verses.en: Great as he was, Soma hath gained strength by this high solemnity: joyous he riseth like a bull.

verses.sa: कृतानीदस्य कर्त्वा चेतन्ते दस्युतर्हणा । ऋणा च धृष्णुश्चयते॥
verses.tr: kṛtānīdasya kartvā cetante dasyutarhaṇā ṛṇā ca dhṛṣṇuścayate
verses.en: His task is done: his crushings of the Dasyus are made manifest: He sternly reckoneth their debts.

verses.sa: आत्सोम इन्द्रियो रसो वज्रः सहस्रसा भुवत् । उक्थं यदस्य जायते॥
verses.tr: ātsoma indriyo raso vajraḥ sahasrasā bhuvat ukthaṃ yadasya jāyate
verses.en: Soon as his song of praise is born, the Soma, Indra's juice, becomes A thousand-winning thunderbolt.

verses.sa: स्वयं कविर्विधर्तरि विप्राय रत्नमिच्छति । यदी मर्मृज्यते धियः॥
verses.tr: svayaṃ kavirvidhartari viprāya ratnamicchati yadī marmṛjyate dhiyaḥ
verses.en: Seer and Sustainer, he himself desireth riches for the sage When he embellisheth his songs.

verses.sa: सिषासतू रयीणां वाजेष्वर्वतामिव । भरेषु जिग्युषामसि॥
verses.tr: siṣāsatū rayīṇāṃ vājeṣvarvatāmiva bhareṣu jigyuṣāmasi
verses.en: Fain would they both win riches as in races of the steeds. In war Thou art upon the conquerors' side.

verses.sa: तं त्वा नृम्णानि बिभ्रतं सधस्थेषु महो दिवः । चारुं सुकृत्ययेमहे॥
verses.tr: taṃ tvā nṛmṇāni bibhrataṃ sadhastheṣu maho divaḥ cāruṃ sukṛtyayemahe
verses.en: With sacrifice we seek to thee kind Cherisher of manly might In mansions of the lofty heavens;

verses.sa: संवृक्तधृष्णुमुक्थ्यं महामहिव्रतं मदम् । शतं पुरो रुरुक्षणिम्॥
verses.tr: saṃvṛktadhṛṣṇumukthyaṃ mahāmahivrataṃ madam śataṃ puro rurukṣaṇim
verses.en: Gladdening crusher of the bold, ruling with very mighty sway, Destroyer of a hundred forts.

verses.sa: अतस्त्वा रयिमभि राजानं सुक्रतो दिवः । सुपर्णो अव्यथिर्भरत्॥
verses.tr: atastvā rayimabhi rājānaṃ sukrato divaḥ suparṇo avyathirbharat
verses.en: Hence, Sapient One! the Falcon, strong of wing, unwearied, brought thee down, Lord over riches, from the sky.

verses.sa: विश्वस्मा इत्स्वर्दृशे साधारणं रजस्तुरम् । गोपामृतस्य विर्भरत्॥
verses.tr: viśvasmā itsvardṛśe sādhāraṇaṃ rajasturam gopāmṛtasya virbharat
verses.en: That each may see the light, the Bird brought us the guard of Law, the Friend Of all, the speeder through the air.

verses.sa: अधा हिन्वान इन्द्रियं ज्यायो महित्वमानशे । अभिष्टिकृद्विचर्षणिः॥
verses.tr: adhā hinvāna indriyaṃ jyāyo mahitvamānaśe abhiṣṭikṛdvicarṣaṇiḥ
verses.en: And now, sent forth, it hath attained to mighty power and majesty, Most active, ready to assist.

verses.sa: पवस्व वृष्टिमा सु नोऽपामूर्मिं दिवस्परि । अयक्ष्मा बृहतीरिषः॥
verses.tr: pavasva vṛṣṭimā su no'pāmūrmiṃ divaspari ayakṣmā bṛhatīriṣaḥ
verses.en: Pour down the rain upon us, pour a wave of waters from the sky, And plenteous store of wholesome food.

verses.sa: तया पवस्व धारया यया गाव इहागमन् । जन्यास उप नो गृहम्॥
verses.tr: tayā pavasva dhārayā yayā gāva ihāgaman janyāsa upa no gṛham
verses.en: Flow onward with that stream of thine, whereby the cows have come to us, The kine of strangers to our home.

verses.sa: घृतं पवस्व धारया यज्ञेषु देववीतमः । अस्मभ्यं वृष्टिमा पव॥
verses.tr: ghṛtaṃ pavasva dhārayā yajñeṣu devavītamaḥ asmabhyaṃ vṛṣṭimā pava
verses.en: Chief Friend of Gods in sacred rites, pour on us fatness with thy stream, Pour down on us a flood of rain.

verses.sa: स न ऊर्जे व्य१व्ययं पवित्रं धाव धारया । देवासः शृणवन्हि कम्॥
verses.tr: sa na ūrje vya1vyayaṃ pavitraṃ dhāva dhārayā devāsaḥ śṛṇavanhi kam
verses.en: To give us vigour, with thy stream run through the fleecy straining-cloth For verily the Gods will bear.

verses.sa: पवमानो असिष्यदद्रक्षांस्यपजङ्घनत् । प्रत्नवद्रोचयन्रुचः॥
verses.tr: pavamāno asiṣyadadrakṣāṃsyapajaṅghanat pratnavadrocayanrucaḥ
verses.en: Onward hath Pavamana flowed and beaten off the Raksasas, Flashing out splendour as of old.

verses.sa: उत्ते शुष्मास ईरते सिन्धोरूर्मेरिव स्वनः । वाणस्य चोदया पविम्॥
verses.tr: utte śuṣmāsa īrate sindhorūrmeriva svanaḥ vāṇasya codayā pavim
verses.en: Loud as a river's roaring wave thy powers have lifted up themselves: Urge on thine arrow's sharpened point.

verses.sa: प्रसवे त उदीरते तिस्रो वाचो मखस्युवः । यदव्य एषि सानवि॥
verses.tr: prasave ta udīrate tisro vāco makhasyuvaḥ yadavya eṣi sānavi
verses.en: At thine effusion upward rise three voices full of joy, when thou Flowest upon the fleecy ridge.

verses.sa: अव्यो वारे परि प्रियं हरिं हिन्वन्त्यद्रिभिः । पवमानं मधुश्चुतम्॥
verses.tr: avyo vāre pari priyaṃ hariṃ hinvantyadribhiḥ pavamānaṃ madhuścutam
verses.en: On to the fleece they urge with stone the tawny well-beloved One, Even Pavamana, dropping meath.

verses.sa: आ पवस्व मदिन्तम पवित्रं धारया कवे । अर्कस्य योनिमासदम्॥
verses.tr: ā pavasva madintama pavitraṃ dhārayā kave arkasya yonimāsadam
verses.en: Flow with thy current to the sieve, O Sage most powerful to cheer, To seat thee in the place of song.

verses.sa: स पवस्व मदिन्तम गोभिरञ्जानो अक्तुभिः । इन्दविन्द्राय पीतये॥
verses.tr: sa pavasva madintama gobhirañjāno aktubhiḥ indavindrāya pītaye
verses.en: Flow, Most Exhilarating! flow anointed with the milk for balm, Indu, for Indra, for his drink.

verses.sa: अध्वर्यो अद्रिभिः सुतं सोमं पवित्र आ सृज । पुनीहीन्द्राय पातवे॥
verses.tr: adhvaryo adribhiḥ sutaṃ somaṃ pavitra ā sṛja punīhīndrāya pātave
verses.en: Adhvaryu, on the filter pour the Soma juice expressed with stones, And make it pure for Indra's drink.

verses.sa: दिवः पीयूषमुत्तमं सोममिन्द्राय वज्रिणे । सुनोता मधुमत्तमम्॥
verses.tr: divaḥ pīyūṣamuttamaṃ somamindrāya vajriṇe sunotā madhumattamam
verses.en: Pour out for Indra, Thunder-armed, the milk of heaven,, the Soma's juice, Most excellent, most rich in sweets.

verses.sa: तव त्य इन्दो अन्धसो देवा मधोर्व्यश्नते । पवमानस्य मरुतः॥
verses.tr: tava tya indo andhaso devā madhorvyaśnate pavamānasya marutaḥ
verses.en: These Gods and all the Marut host, Indu enjoy this juice of thine, This Pavamana's flowing meath.

verses.sa: त्वं हि सोम वर्धयन्त्सुतो मदाय भूर्णये । वृषन्त्स्तोतारमूतये॥
verses.tr: tvaṃ hi soma vardhayantsuto madāya bhūrṇaye vṛṣantstotāramūtaye
verses.en: For, Soma, thou hast been effused, strengthening for the wild carouse, O Steer, the singer, for our help.

verses.sa: अभ्यर्ष विचक्षण पवित्रं धारया सुतः । अभि वाजमुत श्रवः॥
verses.tr: abhyarṣa vicakṣaṇa pavitraṃ dhārayā sutaḥ abhi vājamuta śravaḥ
verses.en: Flow with thy stream, Far-sighted One, effused, into the cleansing sieve: Flow on to give us strength and fame.

verses.sa: परि द्युक्षः सनद्रयिर्भरद्वाजं नो अन्धसा । सुवानो अर्ष पवित्र आ॥
verses.tr: pari dyukṣaḥ sanadrayirbharadvājaṃ no andhasā suvāno arṣa pavitra ā
verses.en: Wealth-WINNER, dwelling in the sky, bringing us vigour with the juice, Flow to the filter when effused.

verses.sa: तव प्रत्नेभिरध्वभिरव्यो वारे परि प्रियः । सहस्रधारो यात्तना॥
verses.tr: tava pratnebhiradhvabhiravyo vāre pari priyaḥ sahasradhāro yāttanā
verses.en: So, in thine ancient ways, may he, beloved, with a thousand streams Run o'er the fleecy straining-cloth.

verses.sa: चरुर्न यस्तमीङ्खयेन्दो न दानमीङ्खय । वधैर्वधस्नवीङ्खय॥
verses.tr: carurna yastamīṅkhayendo na dānamīṅkhaya vadhairvadhasnavīṅkhaya
verses.en: Him who is like a caldron shake: O Indu, shake thy gift to us Shake it, armed Warrior! with thine arms.

verses.sa: नि शुष्ममिन्दवेषां पुरुहूत जनानाम् । यो अस्माँ आदिदेशति॥
verses.tr: ni śuṣmamindaveṣāṃ puruhūta janānām yo asmāṃ ādideśati
verses.en: Indu, invoked with many a prayer, bring down the vigour of these men, Of him who threatens us with war.

verses.sa: शतं न इन्द ऊतिभिः सहस्रं वा शुचीनाम् । पवस्व मंहयद्रयिः॥
verses.tr: śataṃ na inda ūtibhiḥ sahasraṃ vā śucīnām pavasva maṃhayadrayiḥ
verses.en: Indu, Wealth-giver, with thine help pour out for us a hundred, yea, A thousand of thy pure bright streams.

verses.sa: उत्ते शुष्मासो अस्थू रक्षो भिन्दन्तो अद्रिवः । नुदस्व याः परिस्पृधः॥
verses.tr: utte śuṣmāso asthū rakṣo bhindanto adrivaḥ nudasva yāḥ parispṛdhaḥ
verses.en: O THOU with stones for arms, thy powers, crushing the fiends, have raised themselves: Chase thou the foes who compass us.

verses.sa: अया निजघ्निरोजसा रथसंगे धने हिते । स्तवा अबिभ्युषा हृदा॥
verses.tr: ayā nijaghnirojasā rathasaṃge dhane hite stavā abibhyuṣā hṛdā
verses.en: Thou conquerest thus with might when car meets car, and when the prize is staked: With fearless heart will I sing praise.

verses.sa: अस्य व्रतानि नाधृषे पवमानस्य दूढ्या । रुज यस्त्वा पृतन्यति॥
verses.tr: asya vratāni nādhṛṣe pavamānasya dūḍhyā ruja yastvā pṛtanyati
verses.en: No one with evil thought assails this Pavamana's holy laws: Crush him who fain would fight with thee.

verses.sa: तं हिन्वन्ति मदच्युतं हरिं नदीषु वाजिनम् । इन्दुमिन्द्राय मत्सरम्॥
verses.tr: taṃ hinvanti madacyutaṃ hariṃ nadīṣu vājinam indumindrāya matsaram
verses.en: For Indra to the streams they drive the tawny rapture-dropping Steed, Indu the bringer of delight.

verses.sa: अस्य प्रत्नामनु द्युतं शुक्रं दुदुह्रे अह्रयः । पयः सहस्रसामृषिम्॥
verses.tr: asya pratnāmanu dyutaṃ śukraṃ duduhre ahrayaḥ payaḥ sahasrasāmṛṣim
verses.en: After his ancient splendour, they, the bold, have drawn the bright milk from The Sage who wins a thousand gifts.

verses.sa: अयं सूर्य इवोपदृगयं सरांसि धावति । सप्त प्रवत आ दिवम्॥
verses.tr: ayaṃ sūrya ivopadṛgayaṃ sarāṃsi dhāvati sapta pravata ā divam
verses.en: In aspect he is like the Sun; he runneth forward to the lakes, Seven currents flowing through the sky.

verses.sa: अयं विश्वानि तिष्ठति पुनानो भुवनोपरि । सोमो देवो न सूर्यः॥
verses.tr: ayaṃ viśvāni tiṣṭhati punāno bhuvanopari somo devo na sūryaḥ
verses.en: He, shining in his splendour, stands high over all things that exist- Soma, a God as Surya is.

verses.sa: परि णो देववीतये वाजाँ अर्षसि गोमतः । पुनान इन्दविन्द्रयुः॥
verses.tr: pari ṇo devavītaye vājāṃ arṣasi gomataḥ punāna indavindrayuḥ
verses.en: Thou, Indu, in thy brilliancy, pourest on us, as Indra's Friend, Wealth from the kine to feast the Gods.

verses.sa: यवंयवं नो अन्धसा पुष्टम्पुष्टं परि स्रव । सोम विश्वा च सौभगा॥
verses.tr: yavaṃyavaṃ no andhasā puṣṭampuṣṭaṃ pari srava soma viśvā ca saubhagā
verses.en: Pour on us with thy juice all kinds of corn, each sort of nourishment, And, Soma, all felicities.

verses.sa: इन्दो यथा तव स्तवो यथा ते जातमन्धसः । नि बर्हिषि प्रिये सदः॥
verses.tr: indo yathā tava stavo yathā te jātamandhasaḥ ni barhiṣi priye sadaḥ
verses.en: As thine, O Indu, is the praise, and thine what springeth from the juice, Seat thee on the dear sacred grass.

verses.sa: उत नो गोविदश्ववित्पवस्व सोमान्धसा । मक्षूतमेभिरहभिः॥
verses.tr: uta no govidaśvavitpavasva somāndhasā makṣūtamebhirahabhiḥ
verses.en: And, finding for us kine and steeds, O Soma, with thy juice flow on Through days that fly most rapidly.

verses.sa: यो जिनाति न जीयते हन्ति शत्रुमभीत्य । स पवस्व सहस्रजित्॥
verses.tr: yo jināti na jīyate hanti śatrumabhītya sa pavasva sahasrajit
verses.en: As one who conquers, ne'er subdued, attacks and stays the enemy, Thus, Vanquisher of thousands! flow.

verses.sa: परि सोम ऋतं बृहदाशुः पवित्रे अर्षति । विघ्नन्रक्षांसि देवयुः॥
verses.tr: pari soma ṛtaṃ bṛhadāśuḥ pavitre arṣati vighnanrakṣāṃsi devayuḥ
verses.en: Swift to the purifying sieve flows Soma as exalted Law, Slaying the fiends, loving the Gods.

verses.sa: यत्सोमो वाजमर्षति शतं धारा अपस्युवः । इन्द्रस्य सख्यमाविशन्॥
verses.tr: yatsomo vājamarṣati śataṃ dhārā apasyuvaḥ indrasya sakhyamāviśan
verses.en: When Soma pours the strengthening food a hundred ever-active streams To Indra's friendship win their way.

verses.sa: अभि त्वा योषणो दश जारं न कन्यानूषत । मृज्यसे सोम सातये॥
verses.tr: abhi tvā yoṣaṇo daśa jāraṃ na kanyānūṣata mṛjyase soma sātaye
verses.en: Ten Dames have sung to welcome thee, even as a maiden greets her love: O Soma, thou art decked to win.

verses.sa: त्वमिन्द्राय विष्णवे स्वादुरिन्दो परि स्रव । नॄन्त्स्तोतॄन्पाह्यंहसः॥
verses.tr: tvamindrāya viṣṇave svādurindo pari srava nṝntstotṝnpāhyaṃhasaḥ
verses.en: Flow hitherward, O Indu, sweet to Indra and to Visnu: guard The men, the singers, from distress.

verses.sa: प्र ते धारा असश्चतो दिवो न यन्ति वृष्टयः । अच्छा वाजं सहस्रिणम्॥
verses.tr: pra te dhārā asaścato divo na yanti vṛṣṭayaḥ acchā vājaṃ sahasriṇam
verses.en: Thy streams that never fail or waste flow forth like showers of rain from heaven, To bring a thousand stores of strength.

verses.sa: अभि प्रियाणि काव्या विश्वा चक्षाणो अर्षति । हरिस्तुञ्जान आयुधा॥
verses.tr: abhi priyāṇi kāvyā viśvā cakṣāṇo arṣati haristuñjāna āyudhā
verses.en: He flows beholding on his way all well beloved sacred lore, Green-tinted, brandishing his, arms.

verses.sa: स मर्मृजान आयुभिरिभो राजेव सुव्रतः । श्येनो न वंसु षीदति॥
verses.tr: sa marmṛjāna āyubhiribho rājeva suvrataḥ śyeno na vaṃsu ṣīdati
verses.en: He, when the people deck him like a docile king of elephants. Sits as a falcon in the, wood.

verses.sa: स नो विश्वा दिवो वसूतो पृथिव्या अधि । पुनान इन्दवा भर॥
verses.tr: sa no viśvā divo vasūto pṛthivyā adhi punāna indavā bhara
verses.en: So bring thou hitherward to us, Indu, while thou art purified, All treasures both of heaven and earth.

verses.sa: तरत्स मन्दी धावति धारा सुतस्यान्धसः । तरत्स मन्दी धावति॥
verses.tr: taratsa mandī dhāvati dhārā sutasyāndhasaḥ taratsa mandī dhāvati
verses.en: Swift runs this giver of delight, even the stream of flowing juice: Swift runs this giver of delight.

verses.sa: उस्रा वेद वसूनां मर्तस्य देव्यवसः । तरत्स मन्दी धावति॥
verses.tr: usrā veda vasūnāṃ martasya devyavasaḥ taratsa mandī dhāvati
verses.en: The Morning knows all precious things, the Goddess knows her grace to man: Swift runs this giver of delight.

verses.sa: ध्वस्रयोः पुरुषन्त्योरा सहस्राणि दद्महे । तरत्स मन्दी धावति॥
verses.tr: dhvasrayoḥ puruṣantyorā sahasrāṇi dadmahe taratsa mandī dhāvati
verses.en: We have accepted thousands from Dhvasra's and Purusanti's hands: Swift runs this giver of delight.

verses.sa: आ ययोस्त्रिंशतं तना सहस्राणि च दद्महे । तरत्स मन्दी धावति॥
verses.tr: ā yayostriṃśataṃ tanā sahasrāṇi ca dadmahe taratsa mandī dhāvati
verses.en: From whom we have accepted thus thousands and three times ten beside: Swift runs this giver of delight.

verses.sa: पवस्व गोजिदश्वजिद्विश्वजित्सोम रण्यजित् । प्रजावद्रत्नमा भर॥
verses.tr: pavasva gojidaśvajidviśvajitsoma raṇyajit prajāvadratnamā bhara
verses.en: Flow onward, Soma, winning kine, and steeds, and all that gives delight: Bring hither wealth with progeny.

verses.sa: पवस्वाद्भ्यो अदाभ्यः पवस्वौषधीभ्यः । पवस्व धिषणाभ्यः॥
verses.tr: pavasvādbhyo adābhyaḥ pavasvauṣadhībhyaḥ pavasva dhiṣaṇābhyaḥ
verses.en: Flow onward from the waters, flow, inviolable, from the plants: Flow onward from the pressing-boards.

verses.sa: त्वं सोम पवमानो विश्वानि दुरिता तर । कविः सीद नि बर्हिषि॥
verses.tr: tvaṃ soma pavamāno viśvāni duritā tara kaviḥ sīda ni barhiṣi
verses.en: Soma, as Pavamana, pass over all trouble and distress: Sit on the sacred grass, a Sage.

verses.sa: पवमान स्वर्विदो जायमानोऽभवो महान् । इन्दो विश्वाँ अभीदसि॥
verses.tr: pavamāna svarvido jāyamāno'bhavo mahān indo viśvāṃ abhīdasi
verses.en: Thou, Pavamana, foundest light; thou at thy birth becamest great: O Indu, thou art over all.

verses.sa: प्र गायत्रेण गायत पवमानं विचर्षणिम् । इन्दुं सहस्रचक्षसम्॥
verses.tr: pra gāyatreṇa gāyata pavamānaṃ vicarṣaṇim induṃ sahasracakṣasam
verses.en: Sing forth and laud with sacred song most active Pavamana, laud Indu who sees with thousand eyes.

verses.sa: तं त्वा सहस्रचक्षसमथो सहस्रभर्णसम् । अति वारमपाविषुः॥
verses.tr: taṃ tvā sahasracakṣasamatho sahasrabharṇasam ati vāramapāviṣuḥ
verses.en: Thee who hast thousand eyes to see, bearer of thousand burthens, they Have filtered through the fleecy cloth.

verses.sa: अति वारान्पवमानो असिष्यदत्कलशाँ अभि धावति । इन्द्रस्य हार्द्याविशन्॥
verses.tr: ati vārānpavamāno asiṣyadatkalaśāṃ abhi dhāvati indrasya hārdyāviśan
verses.en: He, Pavamana, hath streamed through the fleece then: he runs into the jars, Finding his way to Indra's heart.

verses.sa: इन्द्रस्य सोम राधसे शं पवस्व विचर्षणे । प्रजावद्रेत आ भर॥
verses.tr: indrasya soma rādhase śaṃ pavasva vicarṣaṇe prajāvadreta ā bhara
verses.en: That Indra may be bounteous, flow, most active Soma, for our weal: Bring genial seed with progeny.

verses.sa: अया वीती परि स्रव यस्त इन्दो मदेष्वा । अवाहन्नवतीर्नव॥
verses.tr: ayā vītī pari srava yasta indo madeṣvā avāhannavatīrnava
verses.en: Flow onward, Indu, with this food for him who in thy wild delight Battered the nine-and-ninety down,

verses.sa: पुरः सद्य इत्थाधिये दिवोदासाय शम्बरम् । अध त्यं तुर्वशं यदुम्॥
verses.tr: puraḥ sadya itthādhiye divodāsāya śambaram adha tyaṃ turvaśaṃ yadum
verses.en: Smote swiftly forts, and Sambara, then Yadu and that Turvaga, For pious Divodasa's sake.

verses.sa: परि णो अश्वमश्वविद्गोमदिन्दो हिरण्यवत् । क्षरा सहस्रिणीरिषः॥
verses.tr: pari ṇo aśvamaśvavidgomadindo hiraṇyavat kṣarā sahasriṇīriṣaḥ
verses.en: Finder of horses, pour on us horses and wealth in kine and gold, And, Indu, food in boundless store.

verses.sa: पवमानस्य ते वयं पवित्रमभ्युन्दतः । सखित्वमा वृणीमहे॥
verses.tr: pavamānasya te vayaṃ pavitramabhyundataḥ sakhitvamā vṛṇīmahe
verses.en: We seek to win thy friendly love, even Pavamana's flowing o'er The limit of the cleansing sieve.

verses.sa: ये ते पवित्रमूर्मयोऽभिक्षरन्ति धारया । तेभिर्नः सोम मृळय॥
verses.tr: ye te pavitramūrmayo'bhikṣaranti dhārayā tebhirnaḥ soma mṛḻaya
verses.en: With those same waves which in their stream oyerflow the purifying sieve, Soma; be gracious unto us.

verses.sa: स नः पुनान आ भर रयिं वीरवतीमिषम् । ईशानः सोम विश्वतः॥
verses.tr: sa naḥ punāna ā bhara rayiṃ vīravatīmiṣam īśānaḥ soma viśvataḥ
verses.en: O Soma, being purified, bring us from all sides, for thou canst, Riches and food with hero sons.

verses.sa: एतमु त्यं दश क्षिपो मृजन्ति सिन्धुमातरम् । समादित्येभिरख्यत॥
verses.tr: etamu tyaṃ daśa kṣipo mṛjanti sindhumātaram samādityebhirakhyata
verses.en: Him here, the Child whom streams have borne, the ten swift fingers beautify With the Adityas is he seen.

verses.sa: समिन्द्रेणोत वायुना सुत एति पवित्र आ । सं सूर्यस्य रश्मिभिः॥
verses.tr: samindreṇota vāyunā suta eti pavitra ā saṃ sūryasya raśmibhiḥ
verses.en: With Indra and with Vayu he, effused, flows onward with, the beams Of Surya to the cleansing sieve.

verses.sa: स नो भगाय वायवे पूष्णे पवस्व मधुमान् । चारुर्मित्रे वरुणे च॥
verses.tr: sa no bhagāya vāyave pūṣṇe pavasva madhumān cārurmitre varuṇe ca
verses.en: Flow rich in sweets and lovely for our Bhaga, Vayu, Pusan flow For Mitra and for Varuna.

verses.sa: उच्चा ते जातमन्धसो दिवि षद्भूम्या ददे । उग्रं शर्म महि श्रवः॥
verses.tr: uccā te jātamandhaso divi ṣadbhūmyā dade ugraṃ śarma mahi śravaḥ
verses.en: High is thy juice's birth: though set in heaven, on earth it hath obtained Strong sheltering power and great renown.

verses.sa: एना विश्वान्यर्य आ द्युम्नानि मानुषाणाम् । सिषासन्तो वनामहे॥
verses.tr: enā viśvānyarya ā dyumnāni mānuṣāṇām siṣāsanto vanāmahe
verses.en: Striving to win, with him we gain all wealth from the ungodly man, Yea, all the glories of mankind.

verses.sa: स न इन्द्राय यज्यवे वरुणाय मरुद्भ्यः । वरिवोवित्परि स्रव॥
verses.tr: sa na indrāya yajyave varuṇāya marudbhyaḥ varivovitpari srava
verses.en: Finder of room and freedom, flow for Indra whom we must adore, For Varuna and the Marut host.

verses.sa: उपो षु जातमप्तुरं गोभिर्भङ्गं परिष्कृतम् । इन्दुं देवा अयासिषुः॥
verses.tr: upo ṣu jātamapturaṃ gobhirbhaṅgaṃ pariṣkṛtam induṃ devā ayāsiṣuḥ
verses.en: The Gods have come to Indu well-descended, beautified with milk, The active crusher of the foe.

verses.sa: तमिद्वर्धन्तु नो गिरो वत्सं संशिश्वरीरिव । य इन्द्रस्य हृदंसनिः॥
verses.tr: tamidvardhantu no giro vatsaṃ saṃśiśvarīriva ya indrasya hṛdaṃsaniḥ
verses.en: Even as mother cows their calf, so let our praise-songs strengthen him, Yea, him who winneth Indra's heart.

verses.sa: अर्षा णः सोम शं गवे धुक्षस्व पिप्युषीमिषम् । वर्धा समुद्रमुक्थ्यम्॥
verses.tr: arṣā ṇaḥ soma śaṃ gave dhukṣasva pipyuṣīmiṣam vardhā samudramukthyam
verses.en: Soma, pour blessings on our kine, pour forth the food that streams with milk Increase the sea that merits laud.

verses.sa: पवमानो अजीजनद्दिवश्चित्रं न तन्यतुम् । ज्योतिर्वैश्वानरं बृहत्॥
verses.tr: pavamāno ajījanaddivaścitraṃ na tanyatum jyotirvaiśvānaraṃ bṛhat
verses.en: From heaven hath Pavamana made, as 'twere, the marvellous thunder, and The lofty light of all mankind.

verses.sa: पवमानस्य ते रसो मदो राजन्नदुच्छुनः । वि वारमव्यमर्षति॥
verses.tr: pavamānasya te raso mado rājannaducchunaḥ vi vāramavyamarṣati
verses.en: The gladdening and auspicious juice of thee, of Pavamana, King! Flows o'er the woollen straining-cloth.

verses.sa: पवमान रसस्तव दक्षो वि राजति द्युमान् । ज्योतिर्विश्वं स्वर्दृशे॥
verses.tr: pavamāna rasastava dakṣo vi rājati dyumān jyotirviśvaṃ svardṛśe
verses.en: Thy juice, O Pavamana, sends its rays abroad like splendid skill, Like lustre, all heaven's light, to see.

verses.sa: यस्ते मदो वरेण्यस्तेना पवस्वान्धसा । देवावीरघशंसहा॥
verses.tr: yaste mado vareṇyastenā pavasvāndhasā devāvīraghaśaṃsahā
verses.en: Flow onward with that juice of thine most excellent, that brings delight, Slaying the wicked, dear to Gods.

verses.sa: जघ्निर्वृत्रममित्रियं सस्निर्वाजं दिवेदिवे । गोषा उ अश्वसा असि॥
verses.tr: jaghnirvṛtramamitriyaṃ sasnirvājaṃ divedive goṣā u aśvasā asi
verses.en: Killing the foeman and his hate, and winning booty every day, Gainer art thou of steeds and kine.

verses.sa: सम्मिश्लो अरुषो भव सूपस्थाभिर्न धेनुभिः । सीदञ्छ्येनो न योनिमा॥
verses.tr: sammiślo aruṣo bhava sūpasthābhirna dhenubhiḥ sīdañchyeno na yonimā
verses.en: Red-hued, be blended with the milk that seems to yield its lovely breast, Falcon-like resting in thine home.

verses.sa: स पवस्व य आविथेन्द्रं वृत्राय हन्तवे । वव्रिवांसं महीरपः॥
verses.tr: sa pavasva ya āvithendraṃ vṛtrāya hantave vavrivāṃsaṃ mahīrapaḥ
verses.en: Flow onward thou who strengthenedst Indra to slaughter Vrtra who Compassed and stayed the mighty floods.

verses.sa: सुवीरासो वयं धना जयेम सोम मीढ्वः । पुनानो वर्ध नो गिरः॥
verses.tr: suvīrāso vayaṃ dhanā jayema soma mīḍhvaḥ punāno vardha no giraḥ
verses.en: Soma who rainest gifts, may we win riches with our hero sons: Strengthen, as thou art cleansed, our hymns.

verses.sa: त्वोतासस्तवावसा स्याम वन्वन्त आमुरः । सोम व्रतेषु जागृहि॥
verses.tr: tvotāsastavāvasā syāma vanvanta āmuraḥ soma vrateṣu jāgṛhi
verses.en: Aided by thee, and through thy grace, may we be slayers when we war: Watch, Soma, at our solemn rites.

verses.sa: अपघ्नन्पवते मृधोऽप सोमो अराव्णः । गच्छन्निन्द्रस्य निष्कृतम्॥
verses.tr: apaghnanpavate mṛdho'pa somo arāvṇaḥ gacchannindrasya niṣkṛtam
verses.en: Chasing our foemen, driving off the godless, Soma floweth on, Going to Indra's special place.

verses.sa: महो नो राय आ भर पवमान जही मृधः । रास्वेन्दो वीरवद्यशः॥
verses.tr: maho no rāya ā bhara pavamāna jahī mṛdhaḥ rāsvendo vīravadyaśaḥ
verses.en: O Pavamana, hither bring great riches, and destroy our foes: O Indu, grant heroic fame.

verses.sa: न त्वा शतं चन ह्रुतो राधो दित्सन्तमा मिनन् । यत्पुनानो मखस्यसे॥
verses.tr: na tvā śataṃ cana hruto rādho ditsantamā minan yatpunāno makhasyase
verses.en: A hundred obstacles have ne'er checked thee when fain to give thy boons, When, being cleansed, thou combatest.

verses.sa: पवस्वेन्दो वृषा सुतः कृधी नो यशसो जने । विश्वा अप द्विषो जहि॥
verses.tr: pavasvendo vṛṣā sutaḥ kṛdhī no yaśaso jane viśvā apa dviṣo jahi
verses.en: Indu, flow on, a mighty juice; glorify us among the folk: Drive all our enemies away.

verses.sa: अस्य ते सख्ये वयं तवेन्दो द्युम्न उत्तमे । सासह्याम पृतन्यतः॥
verses.tr: asya te sakhye vayaṃ tavendo dyumna uttame sāsahyāma pṛtanyataḥ
verses.en: Indu, in this thy friendship most lofty and glorious may we Subdue all those who war with us.

verses.sa: या ते भीमान्यायुधा तिग्मानि सन्ति धूर्वणे । रक्षा समस्य नो निदः॥
verses.tr: yā te bhīmānyāyudhā tigmāni santi dhūrvaṇe rakṣā samasya no nidaḥ
verses.en: Those awful weapons that thou hast, sharpened at point to strike men down- Guard us therewith from every foe.

verses.sa: एते असृग्रमिन्दवस्तिरः पवित्रमाशवः । विश्वान्यभि सौभगा॥
verses.tr: ete asṛgramindavastiraḥ pavitramāśavaḥ viśvānyabhi saubhagā
verses.en: These rapid Soma-drops have been poured through the purifying sieve To bring us all felicities.

verses.sa: विघ्नन्तो दुरिता पुरु सुगा तोकाय वाजिनः । तना कृण्वन्तो अर्वते॥
verses.tr: vighnanto duritā puru sugā tokāya vājinaḥ tanā kṛṇvanto arvate
verses.en: Dispelling manifold mishap, giving the courser's progeny, Yea, and the warrior steed, success.

verses.sa: कृण्वन्तो वरिवो गवेऽभ्यर्षन्ति सुष्टुतिम् । इळामस्मभ्यं संयतम्॥
verses.tr: kṛṇvanto varivo gave'bhyarṣanti suṣṭutim iḻāmasmabhyaṃ saṃyatam
verses.en: Bringing prosperity to kine, they make perpetual Ila flow To us for noble eulogy.

verses.sa: असाव्यंशुर्मदायाऽप्सु दक्षो गिरिष्ठाः । श्येनो न योनिमासदत्॥
verses.tr: asāvyaṃśurmadāyā'psu dakṣo giriṣṭhāḥ śyeno na yonimāsadat
verses.en: Strong, mountain-born, the stalk hath been pressed in the streams for rapturous joy: Hawk-like he settles in his home.

verses.sa: शुभ्रमन्धो देववातमप्सु धूतो नृभिः सुतः । स्वदन्ति गावः पयोभिः॥
verses.tr: śubhramandho devavātamapsu dhūto nṛbhiḥ sutaḥ svadanti gāvaḥ payobhiḥ
verses.en: Fair is the God-loved juice; the plant is washed in waters, pressed by men The milch-kine sweeten it with milk.

verses.sa: आदीमश्वं न हेतारोऽशूशुभन्नमृताय । मध्वो रसं सधमादे॥
verses.tr: ādīmaśvaṃ na hetāro'śūśubhannamṛtāya madhvo rasaṃ sadhamāde
verses.en: As drivers deck a courser, so have they adorned the meath's juice for Ambrosia, for the festival.

verses.sa: यास्ते धारा मधुश्चुतोऽसृग्रमिन्द ऊतये । ताभिः पवित्रमासदः॥
verses.tr: yāste dhārā madhuścuto'sṛgraminda ūtaye tābhiḥ pavitramāsadaḥ
verses.en: Thou, Indu, with thy streams that drop sweet juices, which were poured for help, Hast settled in the cleansing sieve.

verses.sa: सो अर्षेन्द्राय पीतये तिरो रोमाण्यव्यया । सीदन्योना वनेष्वा॥
verses.tr: so arṣendrāya pītaye tiro romāṇyavyayā sīdanyonā vaneṣvā
verses.en: So flow thou onward through the fleece, for Indra flow, to be his drink, Finding thine home in vats of wood.

verses.sa: त्वमिन्दो परि स्रव स्वादिष्ठो अङ्गिरोभ्यः । वरिवोविद्घृतं पयः॥
verses.tr: tvamindo pari srava svādiṣṭho aṅgirobhyaḥ varivovidghṛtaṃ payaḥ
verses.en: As giving room and freedom, as most sweet, pour butter forth and milk, O Indu, for the Angirases.

verses.sa: अयं विचर्षणिर्हितः पवमानः स चेतति । हिन्वान आप्यं बृहत्॥
verses.tr: ayaṃ vicarṣaṇirhitaḥ pavamānaḥ sa cetati hinvāna āpyaṃ bṛhat
verses.en: Most active and benevolent, this Pavamana, sent to us For lofty friendship, meditates.

verses.sa: एष वृषा वृषव्रतः पवमानो अशस्तिहा । करद्वसूनि दाशुषे॥
verses.tr: eṣa vṛṣā vṛṣavrataḥ pavamāno aśastihā karadvasūni dāśuṣe
verses.en: Queller of curses, mighty, with strong sway, this Pavamana shall Bring treasures to the worshipper.

verses.sa: आ पवस्व सहस्रिणं रयिं गोमन्तमश्विनम् । पुरुश्चन्द्रं पुरुस्पृहम्॥
verses.tr: ā pavasva sahasriṇaṃ rayiṃ gomantamaśvinam puruścandraṃ puruspṛham
verses.en: Pour thou upon us thousand fold possessions, both of kine and steeds, Exceeding glorious, much-desired.

verses.sa: एष स्य परि षिच्यते मर्मृज्यमान आयुभिः । उरुगायः कविक्रतुः॥
verses.tr: eṣa sya pari ṣicyate marmṛjyamāna āyubhiḥ urugāyaḥ kavikratuḥ
verses.en: Wandering far, with wise designs, the juice here present is effused, Made beautiful by living men.

verses.sa: सहस्रोतिः शतामघो विमानो रजसः कविः । इन्द्राय पवते मदः॥
verses.tr: sahasrotiḥ śatāmagho vimāno rajasaḥ kaviḥ indrāya pavate madaḥ
verses.en: For Indra flows the gladdening drink, the measurer of the region, Sage, With countless wealth and endless help.

verses.sa: गिरा जात इह स्तुत इन्दुरिन्द्राय धीयते । विर्योना वसताविव॥
verses.tr: girā jāta iha stuta indurindrāya dhīyate viryonā vasatāviva
verses.en: Born on the mountain, lauded here, Indu for Indra is set down, As in her sheltering nest a bird.

verses.sa: पवमानः सुतो नृभिः सोमो वाजमिवासरत् । चमूषु शक्मनासदम्॥
verses.tr: pavamānaḥ suto nṛbhiḥ somo vājamivāsarat camūṣu śakmanāsadam
verses.en: Pressed by the men, as 'twere to war hath Soma Pavamana sped, To test with might within the vats.

verses.sa: तं त्रिपृष्ठे त्रिवन्धुरे रथे युञ्जन्ति यातवे । ऋषीणां सप्त धीतिभिः॥
verses.tr: taṃ tripṛṣṭhe trivandhure rathe yuñjanti yātave ṛṣīṇāṃ sapta dhītibhiḥ
verses.en: That he may move, they yoke him to the three-backed triple-seated car By the Seven Rsis' holy songs.

verses.sa: तं सोतारो धनस्पृतमाशुं वाजाय यातवे । हरिं हिनोत वाजिनम्॥
verses.tr: taṃ sotāro dhanaspṛtamāśuṃ vājāya yātave hariṃ hinota vājinam
verses.en: Drive ye that Tawny Courser, O ye pressers, on his way to war, Swift Steed who carries off the spoil.

verses.sa: आविशन्कलशं सुतो विश्वा अर्षन्नभि श्रियः । शूरो न गोषु तिष्ठति॥
verses.tr: āviśankalaśaṃ suto viśvā arṣannabhi śriyaḥ śūro na goṣu tiṣṭhati
verses.en: Pouring all glories hither, he, effused and entering the jar, Stands like a hero mid the kine.

verses.sa: आ त इन्दो मदाय कं पयो दुहन्त्यायवः । देवा देवेभ्यो मधु॥
verses.tr: ā ta indo madāya kaṃ payo duhantyāyavaḥ devā devebhyo madhu
verses.en: Indu, the living men milk out the juice to make the rapturous draught: Gods for the Gods milk out the meath.

verses.sa: आ नः सोमं पवित्र आ सृजता मधुमत्तमम् । देवेभ्यो देवश्रुत्तमम्॥
verses.tr: ā naḥ somaṃ pavitra ā sṛjatā madhumattamam devebhyo devaśruttamam
verses.en: Pour for the Gods into the sieve our Soma very rich in sweets, Him whom the Gods most gladly hear.

verses.sa: एते सोमा असृक्षत गृणानाः श्रवसे महे । मदिन्तमस्य धारया॥
verses.tr: ete somā asṛkṣata gṛṇānāḥ śravase mahe madintamasya dhārayā
verses.en: Into his stream who gladdens best these Soma juices have been poured, Lauded with songs for lofty fame.

verses.sa: अभि गव्यानि वीतये नृम्णा पुनानो अर्षसि । सनद्वाजः परि स्रव॥
verses.tr: abhi gavyāni vītaye nṛmṇā punāno arṣasi sanadvājaḥ pari srava
verses.en: Thou flowest to enjoy the milk, and bringest valour, being cleansed: Winning the spoil flow hitherward.

verses.sa: उत नो गोमतीरिषो विश्वा अर्ष परिष्टुभः । गृणानो जमदग्निना॥
verses.tr: uta no gomatīriṣo viśvā arṣa pariṣṭubhaḥ gṛṇāno jamadagninā
verses.en: And, hymned by Jamadagnis, let all nourishment that kine supply, And general praises, flow to us.

verses.sa: पवस्व वाचो अग्रियः सोम चित्राभिरूतिभिः । अभि विश्वानि काव्या॥
verses.tr: pavasva vāco agriyaḥ soma citrābhirūtibhiḥ abhi viśvāni kāvyā
verses.en: Soma, as leader of the song flow onward with thy wondrous aids, For holy lore of every kind.

verses.sa: त्वं समुद्रिया अपोऽग्रियो वाच ईरयन् । पवस्व विश्वमेजय॥
verses.tr: tvaṃ samudriyā apo'griyo vāca īrayan pavasva viśvamejaya
verses.en: Do thou as leader of the song, stirring the waters of the sea, Flow onward, thou who movest all.

verses.sa: तुभ्येमा भुवना कवे महिम्ने सोम तस्थिरे । तुभ्यमर्षन्ति सिन्धवः॥
verses.tr: tubhyemā bhuvanā kave mahimne soma tasthire tubhyamarṣanti sindhavaḥ
verses.en: O Soma, O thou Sage, these worlds stand ready to attest thy might: For thy behoof the rivers flow.

verses.sa: प्र ते दिवो न वृष्टयो धारा यन्त्यसश्चतः । अभि शुक्रामुपस्तिरम्॥
verses.tr: pra te divo na vṛṣṭayo dhārā yantyasaścataḥ abhi śukrāmupastiram
verses.en: Like showers of rain that fall from heaven thy streams perpetually flow To the bright fleece spread under them.

verses.sa: इन्द्रायेन्दुं पुनीतनोग्रं दक्षाय साधनम् । ईशानं वीतिराधसम्॥
verses.tr: indrāyenduṃ punītanograṃ dakṣāya sādhanam īśānaṃ vītirādhasam
verses.en: For potent Indra purify Indu effectual and strong, Enjoyment-giver, Mighty Lord.

verses.sa: पवमान ऋतः कविः सोमः पवित्रमासदत् । दधत्स्तोत्रे सुवीर्यम्॥
verses.tr: pavamāna ṛtaḥ kaviḥ somaḥ pavitramāsadat dadhatstotre suvīryam
verses.en: Soma, true, Pavamana, Sage, is seated in the cleansing sieve, Giving his praiser hero strength.

verses.sa: आ पवस्व सहस्रिणं रयिं सोम सुवीर्यम् । अस्मे श्रवांसि धारय॥
verses.tr: ā pavasva sahasriṇaṃ rayiṃ soma suvīryam asme śravāṃsi dhāraya
verses.en: Pour hitherward, O Soma, wealth in thousands and heroic strength, And keep renown secure for us.

verses.sa: इषमूर्जं च पिन्वस इन्द्राय मत्सरिन्तमः । चमूष्वा नि षीदसि॥
verses.tr: iṣamūrjaṃ ca pinvasa indrāya matsarintamaḥ camūṣvā ni ṣīdasi
verses.en: Thou makest food and vigour swell for Indra, best of gladdeners! Within the cups thou seatest thee.

verses.sa: सुत इन्द्राय विष्णवे सोमः कलशे अक्षरत् । मधुमाँ अस्तु वायवे॥
verses.tr: suta indrāya viṣṇave somaḥ kalaśe akṣarat madhumāṃ astu vāyave
verses.en: For Indra and for Visnu poured, Soma hath flowed into the jar: May Vayu find it rich in sweets.

verses.sa: एते असृग्रमाशवोऽति ह्वरांसि बभ्रवः । सोमा ऋतस्य धारया॥
verses.tr: ete asṛgramāśavo'ti hvarāṃsi babhravaḥ somā ṛtasya dhārayā
verses.en: These Somas swift and brown of hue, in stream of solemn sacrifice Have flowed through twisted obstacles,

verses.sa: इन्द्रं वर्धन्तो अप्तुरः कृण्वन्तो विश्वमार्यम् । अपघ्नन्तो अराव्णः॥
verses.tr: indraṃ vardhanto apturaḥ kṛṇvanto viśvamāryam apaghnanto arāvṇaḥ
verses.en: Performing every noble work, active, augmenting Indra's strength, Driving away the godless ones.

verses.sa: सुता अनु स्वमा रजोऽभ्यर्षन्ति बभ्रवः । इन्द्रं गच्छन्त इन्दवः॥
verses.tr: sutā anu svamā rajo'bhyarṣanti babhravaḥ indraṃ gacchanta indavaḥ
verses.en: Brown Soma-drops, effused that seek Indra, to their appropriate place Flow through the region hitherward.

verses.sa: अया पवस्व धारया यया सूर्यमरोचयः । हिन्वानो मानुषीरपः॥
verses.tr: ayā pavasva dhārayā yayā sūryamarocayaḥ hinvāno mānuṣīrapaḥ
verses.en: Flow onward with that stream of thine wherewith thou gavest Surya light, Urging on waters good to men.

verses.sa: अयुक्त सूर एतशं पवमानो मनावधि । अन्तरिक्षेण यातवे॥
verses.tr: ayukta sūra etaśaṃ pavamāno manāvadhi antarikṣeṇa yātave
verses.en: He, Pavamana, high o'er man yoked the Sun's courser Etasa To travel through the realm of air.

verses.sa: उत त्या हरितो दश सूरो अयुक्त यातवे । इन्दुरिन्द्र इति ब्रुवन्॥
verses.tr: uta tyā harito daśa sūro ayukta yātave indurindra iti bruvan
verses.en: And those ten Coursers, tawny-hued, he harnessed that the Sun might come Indu, he said, is Indra's self.

verses.sa: परीतो वायवे सुतं गिर इन्द्राय मत्सरम् । अव्यो वारेषु सिञ्चत॥
verses.tr: parīto vāyave sutaṃ gira indrāya matsaram avyo vāreṣu siñcata
verses.en: Hence, singers, pour the gladdening juice to Vayu and to Indra, pour The drops upon the fleecy cloth.

verses.sa: पवमान विदा रयिमस्मभ्यं सोम दुष्टरम् । यो दूणाशो वनुष्यता॥
verses.tr: pavamāna vidā rayimasmabhyaṃ soma duṣṭaram yo dūṇāśo vanuṣyatā
verses.en: O Soma Pavamana, find wealth for us not to be assailed, Wealth which the foeman may not win.

verses.sa: अभ्यर्ष सहस्रिणं रयिं गोमन्तमश्विनम् । अभि वाजमुत श्रवः॥
verses.tr: abhyarṣa sahasriṇaṃ rayiṃ gomantamaśvinam abhi vājamuta śravaḥ
verses.en: Send riches hither with thy stream in thousands, both of steeds and kine, Send spoil of war and high renown.

verses.sa: सोमो देवो न सूर्योऽद्रिभिः पवते सुतः । दधानः कलशे रसम्॥
verses.tr: somo devo na sūryo'dribhiḥ pavate sutaḥ dadhānaḥ kalaśe rasam
verses.en: Soma the God, expressed with stones, like Surya, floweth on his way, Pouring the juice within the jar.

verses.sa: एते धामान्यार्या शुक्रा ऋतस्य धारया । वाजं गोमन्तमक्षरन्॥
verses.tr: ete dhāmānyāryā śukrā ṛtasya dhārayā vājaṃ gomantamakṣaran
verses.en: These brilliant drops have poured for us, in stream of solemn sacrifice, Worshipful laws and strength in kine.

verses.sa: सुता इन्द्राय वज्रिणे सोमासो दध्याशिरः । पवित्रमत्यक्षरन्॥
verses.tr: sutā indrāya vajriṇe somāso dadhyāśiraḥ pavitramatyakṣaran
verses.en: Over the cleansing sieve have flowed the Somas, blent with curdled milk, Effused for Indra Thunder-armed.

verses.sa: प्र सोम मधुमत्तमो राये अर्ष पवित्र आ । मदो यो देववीतमः॥
verses.tr: pra soma madhumattamo rāye arṣa pavitra ā mado yo devavītamaḥ
verses.en: Soma, do thou most rich in sweets, a gladdening drink most dear to Gods, Flow to the sieve to bring us wealth.

verses.sa: तमी मृजन्त्यायवो हरिं नदीषु वाजिनम् । इन्दुमिन्द्राय मत्सरम्॥
verses.tr: tamī mṛjantyāyavo hariṃ nadīṣu vājinam indumindrāya matsaram
verses.en: For Indra, living men adorn the Tawny Courser in the streams, Indu, the giver of delight.

verses.sa: आ पवस्व हिरण्यवदश्वावत्सोम वीरवत् । वाजं गोमन्तमा भर॥
verses.tr: ā pavasva hiraṇyavadaśvāvatsoma vīravat vājaṃ gomantamā bhara
verses.en: Pour for us, Soma, wealth in gold, in horses and heroic sons, Bring hither strength in herds of kine.

verses.sa: परि वाजे न वाजयुमव्यो वारेषु सिञ्चत । इन्द्राय मधुमत्तमम्॥
verses.tr: pari vāje na vājayumavyo vāreṣu siñcata indrāya madhumattamam
verses.en: For Indra pour ye on the fleece him very sweet to taste, who longs. For battle as it were in war.

verses.sa: कविं मृजन्ति मर्ज्यं धीभिर्विप्रा अवस्यवः । वृषा कनिक्रदर्षति॥
verses.tr: kaviṃ mṛjanti marjyaṃ dhībhirviprā avasyavaḥ vṛṣā kanikradarṣati
verses.en: The singers, seeking help, adorn the Sage who must be decked with songs: Loud bellowing the Steer comes on,

verses.sa: वृषणं धीभिरप्तुरं सोममृतस्य धारया । मती विप्राः समस्वरन्॥
verses.tr: vṛṣaṇaṃ dhībhirapturaṃ somamṛtasya dhārayā matī viprāḥ samasvaran
verses.en: The singers with their thoughts and hymns have, in the stream of sacrifice, Caused Soma, active Steer, to roar.

verses.sa: पवस्व देवायुषगिन्द्रं गच्छतु ते मदः । वायुमा रोह धर्मणा॥
verses.tr: pavasva devāyuṣagindraṃ gacchatu te madaḥ vāyumā roha dharmaṇā
verses.en: God, working with mankind, flow on; to Indra go thy gladdening juice: To Vayu mount as Law commands

verses.sa: पवमान नि तोशसे रयिं सोम श्रवाय्यम् । प्रियः समुद्रमा विश॥
verses.tr: pavamāna ni tośase rayiṃ soma śravāyyam priyaḥ samudramā viśa
verses.en: O Soma, Pavamana, thou pourest out wealth that brings renown: Enter the lake, as one we love.

verses.sa: अपघ्नन्पवसे मृधः क्रतुवित्सोम मत्सरः । नुदस्वादेवयुं जनम्॥
verses.tr: apaghnanpavase mṛdhaḥ kratuvitsoma matsaraḥ nudasvādevayuṃ janam
verses.en: Soma thou flowest chasing foes and bringing wisdom and delight: Drive off the folk who love not Gods.

verses.sa: पवमाना असृक्षत सोमाः शुक्रास इन्दवः । अभि विश्वानि काव्या॥
verses.tr: pavamānā asṛkṣata somāḥ śukrāsa indavaḥ abhi viśvāni kāvyā
verses.en: The Pavamanas have been poured, the brilliant drops of Soma juice, For holy lore of every kind.

verses.sa: पवमानास आशवः शुभ्रा असृग्रमिन्दवः । घ्नन्तो विश्वा अप द्विषः॥
verses.tr: pavamānāsa āśavaḥ śubhrā asṛgramindavaḥ ghnanto viśvā apa dviṣaḥ
verses.en: The Pavamanas have been shed, the beautiful swift Soma-drops, Driving all enemies afar.

verses.sa: पवमाना दिवस्पर्यन्तरिक्षादसृक्षत । पृथिव्या अधि सानवि॥
verses.tr: pavamānā divasparyantarikṣādasṛkṣata pṛthivyā adhi sānavi
verses.en: From, heaven, from out the firmament, hath Pavamana been effused Upon the summit of the earth.

verses.sa: पुनानः सोम धारयेन्दो विश्वा अप स्रिधः । जहि रक्षांसि सुक्रतो॥
verses.tr: punānaḥ soma dhārayendo viśvā apa sridhaḥ jahi rakṣāṃsi sukrato
verses.en: O Soma, Indu, very wise, drive, being purified, with thy stream All foes, all Raksasas away.

verses.sa: अपघ्नन्त्सोम रक्षसोऽभ्यर्ष कनिक्रदत् । द्युमन्तं शुष्ममुत्तमम्॥
verses.tr: apaghnantsoma rakṣaso'bhyarṣa kanikradat dyumantaṃ śuṣmamuttamam
verses.en: Driving the Raksasas afar, O Soma, bellowing, pour for us Most excellent and splendid strength.

verses.sa: अस्मे वसूनि धारय सोम दिव्यानि पार्थिवा । इन्दो विश्वानि वार्या॥
verses.tr: asme vasūni dhāraya soma divyāni pārthivā indo viśvāni vāryā
verses.en: Soma, do thou secure for us the treasures of the earth and heaven, Indu, all boons to be desired.

verses.sa: वृषा सोम द्युमाँ असि वृषा देव वृषव्रतः । वृषा धर्माणि दधिषे॥
verses.tr: vṛṣā soma dyumāṃ asi vṛṣā deva vṛṣavrataḥ vṛṣā dharmāṇi dadhiṣe
verses.en: Soma, thou art a splendid Steer, a Steer, O God, with steer like sway: Thou as a Steer ordainest laws.

verses.sa: वृष्णस्ते वृष्ण्यं शवो वृषा वनं वृषा मदः । सत्यं वृषन्वृषेदसि॥
verses.tr: vṛṣṇaste vṛṣṇyaṃ śavo vṛṣā vanaṃ vṛṣā madaḥ satyaṃ vṛṣanvṛṣedasi
verses.en: Steer-strong thy might is as a steer's, steer strong thy wood, steer-like thy drink A Steer indeed, O Steer, art thou.

verses.sa: अश्वो न चक्रदो वृषा सं गा इन्दो समर्वतः । वि नो राये दुरो वृधि॥
verses.tr: aśvo na cakrado vṛṣā saṃ gā indo samarvataḥ vi no rāye duro vṛdhi
verses.en: Thou, Indu, as a vigorous horse, hast neighed together steeds and kine: Unbar for us the doors to wealth.

verses.sa: असृक्षत प्र वाजिनो गव्या सोमासो अश्वया । शुक्रासो वीरयाशवः॥
verses.tr: asṛkṣata pra vājino gavyā somāso aśvayā śukrāso vīrayāśavaḥ
verses.en: Out of desire of cows and steeds and horses. potent Soma-drops, Brilliant and swift, have been effused.

verses.sa: शुम्भमाना ऋतायुभिर्मृज्यमाना गभस्त्योः । पवन्ते वारे अव्यये॥
verses.tr: śumbhamānā ṛtāyubhirmṛjyamānā gabhastyoḥ pavante vāre avyaye
verses.en: They purified in both the hands, made beautiful by holy men, Flow onward to the fleecy cloth.

verses.sa: ते विश्वा दाशुषे वसु सोमा दिव्यानि पार्थिवा । पवन्तामान्तरिक्ष्या॥
verses.tr: te viśvā dāśuṣe vasu somā divyāni pārthivā pavantāmāntarikṣyā
verses.en: These Soma juices shall pour forth all treasures for the worshipper From heaven and earth and firmament.

verses.sa: पवमानस्य विश्ववित्प्र ते सर्गा असृक्षत । सूर्यस्येव न रश्मयः॥
verses.tr: pavamānasya viśvavitpra te sargā asṛkṣata sūryasyeva na raśmayaḥ
verses.en: The streams of Pavamana, thine, Finder of all, have been effused, Even as Surya's rays of light.

verses.sa: केतुं कृण्वन्दिवस्परि विश्वा रूपाभ्यर्षसि । समुद्रः सोम पिन्वसे॥
verses.tr: ketuṃ kṛṇvandivaspari viśvā rūpābhyarṣasi samudraḥ soma pinvase
verses.en: Making the light that shines from heaven thou flowest on to every form Soma, thou swellest like a sea.

verses.sa: हिन्वानो वाचमिष्यसि पवमान विधर्मणि । अक्रान्देवो न सूर्यः॥
verses.tr: hinvāno vācamiṣyasi pavamāna vidharmaṇi akrāndevo na sūryaḥ
verses.en: Urged on thou sendest out thy voice, O Pavamana; thou hast moved, Like the God Surya, to the sieve.

verses.sa: इन्दुः पविष्ट चेतनः प्रियः कवीनां मती । सृजदश्वं रथीरिव॥
verses.tr: induḥ paviṣṭa cetanaḥ priyaḥ kavīnāṃ matī sṛjadaśvaṃ rathīriva
verses.en: Indu, Enlightener, Friend, hath been purified by the sages' hymns: So starts the charioteer his steed-

verses.sa: ऊर्मिर्यस्ते पवित्र आ देवावीः पर्यक्षरत् । सीदन्नृतस्य योनिमा॥
verses.tr: ūrmiryaste pavitra ā devāvīḥ paryakṣarat sīdannṛtasya yonimā
verses.en: Thy God-delighting wave which hath flowed to purifying seive, Alighting in the home of Law.

verses.sa: स नो अर्ष पवित्र आ मदो यो देववीतमः । इन्दविन्द्राय पीतये॥
verses.tr: sa no arṣa pavitra ā mado yo devavītamaḥ indavindrāya pītaye
verses.en: Flow to our sieve, a gladdening draught that hath most intercourse with Gods, Indu, to Indra for his drink.

verses.sa: इषे पवस्व धारया मृज्यमानो मनीषिभिः । इन्दो रुचाभि गा इहि॥
verses.tr: iṣe pavasva dhārayā mṛjyamāno manīṣibhiḥ indo rucābhi gā ihi
verses.en: Flow onward with a stream for food, made beautiful by sapient men: Indu with sheen approach the milk.

verses.sa: पुनानो वरिवस्कृध्यूर्जं जनाय गिर्वणः । हरे सृजान आशिरम्॥
verses.tr: punāno varivaskṛdhyūrjaṃ janāya girvaṇaḥ hare sṛjāna āśiram
verses.en: While thou art cleansed, Song-Lover, bring comfort and vigour to the folk, Poured, Tawny One! on milk and curds.

verses.sa: पुनानो देववीतय इन्द्रस्य याहि निष्कृतम् । द्युतानो वाजिभिर्यतः॥
verses.tr: punāno devavītaya indrasya yāhi niṣkṛtam dyutāno vājibhiryataḥ
verses.en: Purified for the feast of Gods, go thou to Indra's special place, Resplendent, guided by the strong.

verses.sa: प्र हिन्वानास इन्दवोऽच्छा समुद्रमाशवः । धिया जूता असृक्षत॥
verses.tr: pra hinvānāsa indavo'cchā samudramāśavaḥ dhiyā jūtā asṛkṣata
verses.en: Accelerated by the hymn, the rapid drops of Soma juice Have flowed, urged onward, to the lake.

verses.sa: मर्मृजानास आयवो वृथा समुद्रमिन्दवः । अग्मन्नृतस्य योनिमा॥
verses.tr: marmṛjānāsa āyavo vṛthā samudramindavaḥ agmannṛtasya yonimā
verses.en: Easily have the living drops, made beautiful, approached the lake, Yea, to the place of sacrifice.

verses.sa: परि णो याह्यस्मयुर्विश्वा वसून्योजसा । पाहि नः शर्म वीरवत्॥
verses.tr: pari ṇo yāhyasmayurviśvā vasūnyojasā pāhi naḥ śarma vīravat
verses.en: Compass about, our faithful Friend, all our possessions with thy might: Guard, hero like, our sheltering home.

verses.sa: मिमाति वह्निरेतशः पदं युजान ऋक्वभिः । प्र यत्समुद्र आहितः॥
verses.tr: mimāti vahniretaśaḥ padaṃ yujāna ṛkvabhiḥ pra yatsamudra āhitaḥ
verses.en: Loud neighs the Courser Etasa, with singers, harnessed for the place, Guided for travel to the lake.

verses.sa: आ यद्योनिं हिरण्ययमाशुॠतस्य सीदति । जहात्यप्रचेतसः॥
verses.tr: ā yadyoniṃ hiraṇyayamāśuṝtasya sīdati jahātyapracetasaḥ
verses.en: What time the Swift One resteth in the golden place of sacrifice, He leaves the foolish far away.

verses.sa: अभि वेना अनूषतेयक्षन्ति प्रचेतसः । मज्जन्त्यविचेतसः॥
verses.tr: abhi venā anūṣateyakṣanti pracetasaḥ majjantyavicetasaḥ
verses.en: The friends have sung in unison, the prudent wish to sacrifice: Down sink the unintelligent.

verses.sa: इन्द्रायेन्दो मरुत्वते पवस्व मधुमत्तमः । ऋतस्य योनिमासदम्॥
verses.tr: indrāyendo marutvate pavasva madhumattamaḥ ṛtasya yonimāsadam
verses.en: For Indra girt by Maruts, flow, thou Indu, very rich in sweets, To sit in place of sacrifice.

verses.sa: तं त्वा विप्रा वचोविदः परि ष्कृण्वन्ति वेधसः । सं त्वा मृजन्त्यायवः॥
verses.tr: taṃ tvā viprā vacovidaḥ pari ṣkṛṇvanti vedhasaḥ saṃ tvā mṛjantyāyavaḥ
verses.en: Controlling priests and sages skilled in holy song adorn thee well: The living make thee beautiful.

verses.sa: रसं ते मित्रो अर्यमा पिबन्ति वरुणः कवे । पवमानस्य मरुतः॥
verses.tr: rasaṃ te mitro aryamā pibanti varuṇaḥ kave pavamānasya marutaḥ
verses.en: Aryaman, Mitra, Varuna drink Pavamana's juice, yea, thine: O Sage, the Maruts drink thereof.

verses.sa: त्वं सोम विपश्चितं पुनानो वाचमिष्यसि । इन्दो सहस्रभर्णसम्॥
verses.tr: tvaṃ soma vipaścitaṃ punāno vācamiṣyasi indo sahasrabharṇasam
verses.en: O Soma, Indu, thou while thou art purified urgest onward speech. Thousand fold, with the lore of hymns.

verses.sa: उतो सहस्रभर्णसं वाचं सोम मखस्युवम् । पुनान इन्दवा भर॥
verses.tr: uto sahasrabharṇasaṃ vācaṃ soma makhasyuvam punāna indavā bhara
verses.en: Yea, Soma, Indu, while thou art purified do thou bring to us Speech thousand fold that longs for war.

verses.sa: पुनान इन्दवेषां पुरुहूत जनानाम् । प्रियः समुद्रमा विश॥
verses.tr: punāna indaveṣāṃ puruhūta janānām priyaḥ samudramā viśa
verses.en: O Indu, Much-invoked, while thou art purifying, as the Friend. Of these men enter thou the lake.

verses.sa: दविद्युतत्या रुचा परिष्टोभन्त्या कृपा । सोमाः शुक्रा गवाशिरः॥
verses.tr: davidyutatyā rucā pariṣṭobhantyā kṛpā somāḥ śukrā gavāśiraḥ
verses.en: Bright are these Somas blent with milk, with light that flashes brilliantly. And form that utters loud acclaim.

verses.sa: हिन्वानो हेतृभिर्यत आ वाजं वाज्यक्रमीत् । सीदन्तो वनुषो यथा॥
verses.tr: hinvāno hetṛbhiryata ā vājaṃ vājyakramīt sīdanto vanuṣo yathā
verses.en: Led by his drivers, and sent forth, the Strong Steed hath come nigh for spoil, Like warriors when they stand arrayed.

verses.sa: ऋधक्सोम स्वस्तये संजग्मानो दिवः कविः । पवस्व सूर्यो दृशे॥
verses.tr: ṛdhaksoma svastaye saṃjagmāno divaḥ kaviḥ pavasva sūryo dṛśe
verses.en: Specially, Soma, coming as a Sage from heaven to prosper us, Flow like the Sun for us to see.

verses.sa: हिन्वन्ति सूरमुस्रयः स्वसारो जामयस्पतिम् । महामिन्दुं महीयुवः॥
verses.tr: hinvanti sūramusrayaḥ svasāro jāmayaspatim mahāminduṃ mahīyuvaḥ
verses.en: The, glittering maids send Sura forth, the glorious sisters, close-allied, Send Indu forth, their mighty Lord.

verses.sa: पवमान रुचारुचा देवो देवेभ्यस्परि । विश्वा वसून्या विश॥
verses.tr: pavamāna rucārucā devo devebhyaspari viśvā vasūnyā viśa
verses.en: Pervade, O Pavamana, all our treasures with repeated light, God, coming hither from the Gods.

verses.sa: आ पवमान सुष्टुतिं वृष्टिं देवेभ्यो दुवः । इषे पवस्व संयतम्॥
verses.tr: ā pavamāna suṣṭutiṃ vṛṣṭiṃ devebhyo duvaḥ iṣe pavasva saṃyatam
verses.en: Pour on us, Pavamana, rain, as service and rain praise for Gods: Pour all to be our nourishment.

verses.sa: वृषा ह्यसि भानुना द्युमन्तं त्वा हवामहे । पवमान स्वाध्यः॥
verses.tr: vṛṣā hyasi bhānunā dyumantaṃ tvā havāmahe pavamāna svādhyaḥ
verses.en: Thou art a Steer by lustre: we, O Pavamana, faithfully Call upon thee the Splendid One.

verses.sa: आ पवस्व सुवीर्यं मन्दमानः स्वायुध । इहो ष्विन्दवा गहि॥
verses.tr: ā pavasva suvīryaṃ mandamānaḥ svāyudha iho ṣvindavā gahi
verses.en: Do thou, rejoicing, nobly-armed! pour upon us heroic strength: O Indu, come thou bitherward.

verses.sa: यदद्भिः परिषिच्यसे मृज्यमानो गभस्त्योः । द्रुणा सधस्थमश्नुषे॥
verses.tr: yadadbhiḥ pariṣicyase mṛjyamāno gabhastyoḥ druṇā sadhasthamaśnuṣe
verses.en: When thou art cleansed with both the hands and dipped in waters, with the wood. Thou comest to the gathering-place.

verses.sa: प्र सोमाय व्यश्ववत्पवमानाय गायत । महे सहस्रचक्षसे॥
verses.tr: pra somāya vyaśvavatpavamānāya gāyata mahe sahasracakṣase
verses.en: Sing forth your songs, as Vyasva sang, to Soma Pavamana, to, The Mighty One with thousand eyes;

verses.sa: यस्य वर्णं मधुश्चुतं हरिं हिन्वन्त्यद्रिभिः । इन्दुमिन्द्राय पीतये॥
verses.tr: yasya varṇaṃ madhuścutaṃ hariṃ hinvantyadribhiḥ indumindrāya pītaye
verses.en: Whose coloured sap they drive with stones, the yellow meath-distilling juice, Indu for Indra, for his drink.

verses.sa: तस्य ते वाजिनो वयं विश्वा धनानि जिग्युषः । सखित्वमा वृणीमहे॥
verses.tr: tasya te vājino vayaṃ viśvā dhanāni jigyuṣaḥ sakhitvamā vṛṇīmahe
verses.en: We seek to gain the friendly love of thee that Strong and Mighty One, Of thee the winner of all wealth.

verses.sa: वृषा पवस्व धारया मरुत्वते च मत्सरः । विश्वा दधान ओजसा॥
verses.tr: vṛṣā pavasva dhārayā marutvate ca matsaraḥ viśvā dadhāna ojasā
verses.en: Flow onward with thy stream, a Steer, inspiriting the Maruts' Lord, Winning all riches by thy might.

verses.sa: तं त्वा धर्तारमोण्यो३ः पवमान स्वर्दृशम् । हिन्वे वाजेषु वाजिनम्॥
verses.tr: taṃ tvā dhartāramoṇyo3ḥ pavamāna svardṛśam hinve vājeṣu vājinam
verses.en: I send thee forth to battle from the press, O Pavamana, Strong, Sustainer, looker on the light.

verses.sa: अया चित्तो विपानया हरिः पवस्व धारया । युजं वाजेषु चोदय॥
verses.tr: ayā citto vipānayā hariḥ pavasva dhārayā yujaṃ vājeṣu codaya
verses.en: Acknowledged by this song of mine, flow, tawny-coloured, with thy stream Incite to battle thine ally.

verses.sa: आ न इन्दो महीमिषं पवस्व विश्वदर्शतः । अस्मभ्यं सोम गातुवित्॥
verses.tr: ā na indo mahīmiṣaṃ pavasva viśvadarśataḥ asmabhyaṃ soma gātuvit
verses.en: O Indu, visible to all pour out for us abundant food: Soma, be thou our prosperer.

verses.sa: आ कलशा अनूषतेन्दो धाराभिरोजसा । एन्द्रस्य पीतये विश॥
verses.tr: ā kalaśā anūṣatendo dhārābhirojasā endrasya pītaye viśa
verses.en: The pitchers, Indu, with thy streams have sung aloud in vigorous might Enter them, and let Indra drink.

verses.sa: यस्य ते मद्यं रसं तीव्रं दुहन्त्यद्रिभिः । स पवस्वाभिमातिहा॥
verses.tr: yasya te madyaṃ rasaṃ tīvraṃ duhantyadribhiḥ sa pavasvābhimātihā
verses.en: O thou whose potent gladdening juice they milk out with the stones, flow on, Destroyer of our enemies.

verses.sa: राजा मेधाभिरीयते पवमानो मनावधि । अन्तरिक्षेण यातवे॥
verses.tr: rājā medhābhirīyate pavamāno manāvadhi antarikṣeṇa yātave
verses.en: King Pavamana is implored with holy songs, on man's behalf, To travel through the firmament.

verses.sa: आ न इन्दो शतग्विनं गवां पोषं स्वश्व्यम् । वहा भगत्तिमूतये॥
verses.tr: ā na indo śatagvinaṃ gavāṃ poṣaṃ svaśvyam vahā bhagattimūtaye
verses.en: Bring us, O Indu, hundredfold increase of kine, and noble steeds, The gift of fortune for our help.

verses.sa: आ नः सोम सहो जुवो रूपं न वर्चसे भर । सुष्वाणो देववीतये॥
verses.tr: ā naḥ soma saho juvo rūpaṃ na varcase bhara suṣvāṇo devavītaye
verses.en: Pressed for the banquet of the Gods, O Soma, bring us might, and speed, Like beauty for a brilliant show.

verses.sa: अर्षा सोम द्युमत्तमोऽभि द्रोणानि रोरुवत् । सीदञ्छ्येनो न योनिमा॥
verses.tr: arṣā soma dyumattamo'bhi droṇāni roruvat sīdañchyeno na yonimā
verses.en: Soma, flow on exceeding bright with loud roar to the wooden vats, Falcon-like resting in thine home.

verses.sa: अप्सा इन्द्राय वायवे वरुणाय मरुद्भ्यः । सोमो अर्षति विष्णवे॥
verses.tr: apsā indrāya vāyave varuṇāya marudbhyaḥ somo arṣati viṣṇave
verses.en: Soma, the Water-winner flows to Indra, Vayu, Varuna, To Visnu and the Marut host.

verses.sa: इषं तोकाय नो दधदस्मभ्यं सोम विश्वतः । आ पवस्व सहस्रिणम्॥
verses.tr: iṣaṃ tokāya no dadhadasmabhyaṃ soma viśvataḥ ā pavasva sahasriṇam
verses.en: Soma, bestowing food upon our progeny, from every sides, Pour on us riches thousand fold

verses.sa: ये सोमासः परावति ये अर्वावति सुन्विरे । ये वादः शर्यणावति॥
verses.tr: ye somāsaḥ parāvati ye arvāvati sunvire ye vādaḥ śaryaṇāvati
verses.en: The Soma juices which have been expressed afar or near at hand, Or there on Saryanavan's bank,

verses.sa: य आर्जीकेषु कृत्वसु ये मध्ये पस्त्यानाम् । ये वा जनेषु पञ्चसु॥
verses.tr: ya ārjīkeṣu kṛtvasu ye madhye pastyānām ye vā janeṣu pañcasu
verses.en: Those pressed among Arjikas, pressed among the active, in men's homes, Or pressed among the Races Five-

verses.sa: ते नो वृष्टिं दिवस्परि पवन्तामा सुवीर्यम् । सुवाना देवास इन्दवः॥
verses.tr: te no vṛṣṭiṃ divaspari pavantāmā suvīryam suvānā devāsa indavaḥ
verses.en: May these celestial drops, expressed, pour forth upon us, as they flow, Rain from the heavens apd hero strength.

verses.sa: पवते हर्यतो हरिर्गृणानो जमदग्निना । हिन्वानो गोरधि त्वचि॥
verses.tr: pavate haryato harirgṛṇāno jamadagninā hinvāno goradhi tvaci
verses.en: Urged forward o'er the ox-hide flows the Lovely One of tawny hue, Lauded by Jamadagni's song.

verses.sa: प्र शुक्रासो वयोजुवो हिन्वानासो न सप्तयः । श्रीणाना अप्सु मृञ्जत॥
verses.tr: pra śukrāso vayojuvo hinvānāso na saptayaḥ śrīṇānā apsu mṛñjata
verses.en: Like horses urged to speed, the drops, bright, stirring vital power, when blent With milk, are beautified in streams.

verses.sa: तं त्वा सुतेष्वाभुवो हिन्विरे देवतातये । स पवस्वानया रुचा॥
verses.tr: taṃ tvā suteṣvābhuvo hinvire devatātaye sa pavasvānayā rucā
verses.en: So they who toil with juices send thee forward for the Gods' repast: So with this splendour flow thou on.

verses.sa: आ ते दक्षं मयोभुवं वह्निमद्या वृणीमहे । पान्तमा पुरुस्पृहम्॥
verses.tr: ā te dakṣaṃ mayobhuvaṃ vahnimadyā vṛṇīmahe pāntamā puruspṛham
verses.en: We choose to-day that chariot-steed of thine, the Strong, that brings us bliss, The Guardian, the desire of all,

verses.sa: आ मन्द्रमा वरेण्यमा विप्रमा मनीषिणम् । पान्तमा पुरुस्पृहम्॥
verses.tr: ā mandramā vareṇyamā vipramā manīṣiṇam pāntamā puruspṛham
verses.en: The Excellent, the Gladdener, the Sage with heart that understands, The Guardian, the desire of all;

verses.sa: आ रयिमा सुचेतुनमा सुक्रतो तनूष्वा । पान्तमा पुरुस्पृहम्॥
verses.tr: ā rayimā sucetunamā sukrato tanūṣvā pāntamā puruspṛham
verses.en: Who for ourselves, O thou Most Wise, is wealth and fair intelligence, The Guardian, the desire of all.

verses.sa: पवस्व विश्वचर्षणेऽभि विश्वानि काव्या । सखा सखिभ्य ईड्यः॥
verses.tr: pavasva viśvacarṣaṇe'bhi viśvāni kāvyā sakhā sakhibhya īḍyaḥ
verses.en: For holy lore of every sort, flow onward thou whom all men love. A Friend to be besought by friends.

verses.sa: ताभ्यां विश्वस्य राजसि ये पवमान धामनी । प्रतीची सोम तस्थतुः॥
verses.tr: tābhyāṃ viśvasya rājasi ye pavamāna dhāmanī pratīcī soma tasthatuḥ
verses.en: O'er all thou rulest with these Two which, Soma Pavamana, stand, Turned, as thy stations, hitherward.

verses.sa: परि धामानि यानि ते त्वं सोमासि विश्वतः । पवमान ऋतुभिः कवे॥
verses.tr: pari dhāmāni yāni te tvaṃ somāsi viśvataḥ pavamāna ṛtubhiḥ kave
verses.en: Wise Soma Pavamana, thou encompassest on every side Thy stations as the seasons come.

verses.sa: पवस्व जनयन्निषोऽभि विश्वानि वार्या । सखा सखिभ्य ऊतये॥
verses.tr: pavasva janayanniṣo'bhi viśvāni vāryā sakhā sakhibhya ūtaye
verses.en: Flow onward, generating food, for precious boons of every kind, A Friend for friends, to be our help.

verses.sa: तव शुक्रासो अर्चयो दिवस्पृष्ठे वि तन्वते । पवित्रं सोम धामभिः॥
verses.tr: tava śukrāso arcayo divaspṛṣṭhe vi tanvate pavitraṃ soma dhāmabhiḥ
verses.en: Upon the lofty ridge of heaven thy bright rays with their essences, Soma, spread purifying power.

verses.sa: तवेमे सप्त सिन्धवः प्रशिषं सोम सिस्रते । तुभ्यं धावन्ति धेनवः॥
verses.tr: taveme sapta sindhavaḥ praśiṣaṃ soma sisrate tubhyaṃ dhāvanti dhenavaḥ
verses.en: O Soma, these Seven Rivers flow, as being thine, to give command: The Streams of milk run forth to thee.

verses.sa: प्र सोम याहि धारया सुत इन्द्राय मत्सरः । दधानो अक्षिति श्रवः॥
verses.tr: pra soma yāhi dhārayā suta indrāya matsaraḥ dadhāno akṣiti śravaḥ
verses.en: Flow onward, Soma in a stream, effused to gladden Indra's heart, Bringing imperishable fame.

verses.sa: समु त्वा धीभिरस्वरन्हिन्वतीः सप्त जामयः । विप्रमाजा विवस्वतः॥
verses.tr: samu tvā dhībhirasvaranhinvatīḥ sapta jāmayaḥ vipramājā vivasvataḥ
verses.en: Driving thee in Vivasvan's course, the Seven Sisters with their hymns Made melody round thee the Sage.

verses.sa: मृजन्ति त्वा समग्रुवोऽव्ये जीरावधि ष्वणि । रेभो यदज्यसे वने॥
verses.tr: mṛjanti tvā samagruvo'vye jīrāvadhi ṣvaṇi rebho yadajyase vane
verses.en: The virgins deck thee o'er fresh streams to drive thee to the sieve when thou, A singer, bathest in the wood.

verses.sa: पवमानस्य ते कवे वाजिन्त्सर्गा असृक्षत । अर्वन्तो न श्रवस्यवः॥
verses.tr: pavamānasya te kave vājintsargā asṛkṣata arvanto na śravasyavaḥ
verses.en: The streams of Pavamana, thine, Sage, Mighty One, have pouredthem forth. Like coursers eager for renown.

verses.sa: अच्छा कोशं मधुश्चुतमसृग्रं वारे अव्यये । अवावशन्त धीतयः॥
verses.tr: acchā kośaṃ madhuścutamasṛgraṃ vāre avyaye avāvaśanta dhītayaḥ
verses.en: They have been poured upon the fleece towards the meath-distilling vat: The holy songs have sounded forth.

verses.sa: अच्छा समुद्रमिन्दवोऽस्तं गावो न धेनवः । अग्मन्नृतस्य योनिमा॥
verses.tr: acchā samudramindavo'staṃ gāvo na dhenavaḥ agmannṛtasya yonimā
verses.en: Like milch-kine coming home, the drops of Soma juice have reached the lake, Have reached the place of sacrifice.

verses.sa: प्र ण इन्दो महे रण आपो अर्षन्ति सिन्धवः । यद्गोभिर्वासयिष्यसे॥
verses.tr: pra ṇa indo mahe raṇa āpo arṣanti sindhavaḥ yadgobhirvāsayiṣyase
verses.en: O Indu, to our great delight the running waters flow to us, When thou wilt robe thyself in milk.

verses.sa: अस्य ते सख्ये वयमियक्षन्तस्त्वोतयः । इन्दो सखित्वमुश्मसि॥
verses.tr: asya te sakhye vayamiyakṣantastvotayaḥ indo sakhitvamuśmasi
verses.en: In this thy friendship, and with thee to help us, fain to sacrifice, Indu, we crave thy friendly love.

verses.sa: आ पवस्व गविष्टये महे सोम नृचक्षसे । एन्द्रस्य जठरे विश॥
verses.tr: ā pavasva gaviṣṭaye mahe soma nṛcakṣase endrasya jaṭhare viśa
verses.en: Flow on, O Soma, for the great Viewer of men, for gain of Idne Enter thou into Indra's throat.

verses.sa: महाँ असि सोम ज्येष्ठ उग्राणामिन्द ओजिष्ठः । युध्वा सञ्छश्वज्जिगेथ॥
verses.tr: mahāṃ asi soma jyeṣṭha ugrāṇāminda ojiṣṭhaḥ yudhvā sañchaśvajjigetha
verses.en: Best art thou, Soma, of the great, Strongest of strong ones, Indu: thou As Warrior ever hast prevailed.

verses.sa: य उग्रेभ्यश्चिदोजीयाञ्छूरेभ्यश्चिच्छूरतरः । भूरिदाभ्यश्चिन्मंहीयान्॥
verses.tr: ya ugrebhyaścidojīyāñchūrebhyaścicchūrataraḥ bhūridābhyaścinmaṃhīyān
verses.en: Mightier even than the strong, more valiant even than the brave, More liberal than the bountiful,

verses.sa: त्वं सोम सूर एषस्तोकस्य साता तनूनाम् । वृणीमहे सख्याय वृणीमहे युज्याय॥
verses.tr: tvaṃ soma sūra eṣastokasya sātā tanūnām vṛṇīmahe sakhyāya vṛṇīmahe yujyāya
verses.en: Soma, as Sura, bring us food, win offspring of our bodies: we Elect thee for our friendship, we elect thee for companionship.

verses.sa: अग्न आयूंषि पवस आ सुवोर्जमिषं च नः । आरे बाधस्व दुच्छुनाम्॥
verses.tr: agna āyūṃṣi pavasa ā suvorjamiṣaṃ ca naḥ āre bādhasva ducchunām
verses.en: Agni, thou pourest life; send down upon us food and vigorous strength; Drive thou misfortune far away,

verses.sa: अग्निॠषिः पवमानः पाञ्चजन्यः पुरोहितः । तमीमहे महागयम्॥
verses.tr: agniṝṣiḥ pavamānaḥ pāñcajanyaḥ purohitaḥ tamīmahe mahāgayam
verses.en: Agni is Pavamana, Sage, Chief Priest of all the Races Five: To him whose wealth is great we pray.

verses.sa: अग्ने पवस्व स्वपा अस्मे वर्चः सुवीर्यम् । दधद्रयिं मयि पोषम्॥
verses.tr: agne pavasva svapā asme varcaḥ suvīryam dadhadrayiṃ mayi poṣam
verses.en: Skilled in thy task, O Agni, pour splendour with hero strength on us, Granting me wealth that nourishes.

verses.sa: पवमानो अति स्रिधोऽभ्यर्षति सुष्टुतिम् । सूरो न विश्वदर्शतः॥
verses.tr: pavamāno ati sridho'bhyarṣati suṣṭutim sūro na viśvadarśataḥ
verses.en: Beyond his enemies away to sweet praise Pavamana flows, Like Surya visible to all.

verses.sa: स मर्मृजान आयुभिः प्रयस्वान्प्रयसे हितः । इन्दुरत्यो विचक्षणः॥
verses.tr: sa marmṛjāna āyubhiḥ prayasvānprayase hitaḥ induratyo vicakṣaṇaḥ
verses.en: Adorned by living men, set forth for entertainment, rich in food, Far-sighted Indu is a Steed.

verses.sa: पवमान ऋतं बृहच्छुक्रं ज्योतिरजीजनत् । कृष्णा तमांसि जङ्घनत्॥
verses.tr: pavamāna ṛtaṃ bṛhacchukraṃ jyotirajījanat kṛṣṇā tamāṃsi jaṅghanat
verses.en: He, Pavamana, hath produced the lofty Law, the brilliant light, Destroying darkness black of hue.

verses.sa: पवमानस्य जङ्घ्नतो हरेश्चन्द्रा असृक्षत । जीरा अजिरशोचिषः॥
verses.tr: pavamānasya jaṅghnato hareścandrā asṛkṣata jīrā ajiraśociṣaḥ
verses.en: From tawny Pavamana, the Destroyer, radiant streams have sprung, Quick streams from him whose gleams are swift.

verses.sa: पवमानो रथीतमः शुभ्रेभिः शुभ्रशस्तमः । हरिश्चन्द्रो मरुद्गणः॥
verses.tr: pavamāno rathītamaḥ śubhrebhiḥ śubhraśastamaḥ hariścandro marudgaṇaḥ
verses.en: Best rider of the chariot, praised with fairest praise mid beauteous ones, Gold-gleaming with the Marut host,

verses.sa: पवमानो व्यश्नवद्रश्मिभिर्वाजसातमः । दधत्स्तोत्रे सुवीर्यम्॥
verses.tr: pavamāno vyaśnavadraśmibhirvājasātamaḥ dadhatstotre suvīryam
verses.en: May Pavamana, best to win the booty, penetrate with rays, Giving the singer hero strength.

verses.sa: प्र सुवान इन्दुरक्षाः पवित्रमत्यव्ययम् । पुनान इन्दुरिन्द्रमा॥
verses.tr: pra suvāna indurakṣāḥ pavitramatyavyayam punāna indurindramā
verses.en: Over the fleecy sieve hath flowed the drop effused: to Indra comes Indu while he is purified

verses.sa: एष सोमो अधि त्वचि गवां क्रीळत्यद्रिभिः । इन्द्रं मदाय जोहुवत्॥
verses.tr: eṣa somo adhi tvaci gavāṃ krīḻatyadribhiḥ indraṃ madāya johuvat
verses.en: This Soma, through the pressing-stones, is sporting on the oxhide, and Summoning Indra to the draught.

verses.sa: यस्य ते द्युम्नवत्पयः पवमानाभृतं दिवः । तेन नो मृळ जीवसे॥
verses.tr: yasya te dyumnavatpayaḥ pavamānābhṛtaṃ divaḥ tena no mṛḻa jīvase
verses.en: O Pavamana, bless us, so that we may live, with that bright milk Of thine which hath been brought from heaven.

verses.sa: त्वं सोमासि धारयुर्मन्द्र ओजिष्ठो अध्वरे । पवस्व मंहयद्रयिः॥
verses.tr: tvaṃ somāsi dhārayurmandra ojiṣṭho adhvare pavasva maṃhayadrayiḥ
verses.en: Thou, Soma, hast a running stream, joyous, most strong at sacrifice: Flow bounteously bestowing wealth.

verses.sa: त्वं सुतो नृमादनो दधन्वान्मत्सरिन्तमः । इन्द्राय सूरिरन्धसा॥
verses.tr: tvaṃ suto nṛmādano dadhanvānmatsarintamaḥ indrāya sūrirandhasā
verses.en: Effused as cheerer of the men, flowing best gladdener, thou art A Prince to Indra with thy juice.

verses.sa: त्वं सुष्वाणो अद्रिभिरभ्यर्ष कनिक्रदत् । द्युमन्तं शुष्ममुत्तमम्॥
verses.tr: tvaṃ suṣvāṇo adribhirabhyarṣa kanikradat dyumantaṃ śuṣmamuttamam
verses.en: Poured forth by pressing-stones, do thou with loud roar send us in a stream Most excellent illustrious might.

verses.sa: इन्दुर्हिन्वानो अर्षति तिरो वाराण्यव्यया । हरिर्वाजमचिक्रदत्॥
verses.tr: indurhinvāno arṣati tiro vārāṇyavyayā harirvājamacikradat
verses.en: Indu, urged forward, floweth through the fleecy cloth: the Tawny One With his loud roar hath brought as strength.

verses.sa: इन्दो व्यव्यमर्षसि वि श्रवांसि वि सौभगा । वि वाजान्त्सोम गोमतः॥
verses.tr: indo vyavyamarṣasi vi śravāṃsi vi saubhagā vi vājāntsoma gomataḥ
verses.en: Indu, thou flowest through the fleece, bringing felicities and fame, And, Soma, spoil and wealth in kine.

verses.sa: आ न इन्दो शतग्विनं रयिं गोमन्तमश्विनम् । भरा सोम सहस्रिणम्॥
verses.tr: ā na indo śatagvinaṃ rayiṃ gomantamaśvinam bharā soma sahasriṇam
verses.en: Hither, O Indu, bring us wealth in steeds and cattle hundredfold: Bring wealth, O Soma, thousand fold.

verses.sa: पवमानास इन्दवस्तिरः पवित्रमाशवः । इन्द्रं यामेभिराशत॥
verses.tr: pavamānāsa indavastiraḥ pavitramāśavaḥ indraṃ yāmebhirāśata
verses.en: In purifying, through the sieve the rapid drops of'Soma juice Come nigh to Indra in their course.

verses.sa: ककुहः सोम्यो रस इन्दुरिन्द्राय पूर्व्यः । आयुः पवत आयवे॥
verses.tr: kakuhaḥ somyo rasa indurindrāya pūrvyaḥ āyuḥ pavata āyave
verses.en: For Indra floweth excellent Indu, the noblest Soma juice The Living for the Living One.

verses.sa: हिन्वन्ति सूरमुस्रयः पवमानं मधुश्चुतम् । अभि गिरा समस्वरन्॥
verses.tr: hinvanti sūramusrayaḥ pavamānaṃ madhuścutam abhi girā samasvaran
verses.en: The glittering maids send Sura forth they with their song have sung aloud To Pavamana dropping meath.

verses.sa: अविता नो अजाश्वः पूषा यामनियामनि । आ भक्षत्कन्यासु नः॥
verses.tr: avitā no ajāśvaḥ pūṣā yāmaniyāmani ā bhakṣatkanyāsu naḥ
verses.en: May Pusan, drawn by goats, be our protector, and on all his paths Bestow on us our share of maids.

verses.sa: अयं सोमः कपर्दिने घृतं न पवते मधु । आ भक्षत्कन्यासु नः॥
verses.tr: ayaṃ somaḥ kapardine ghṛtaṃ na pavate madhu ā bhakṣatkanyāsu naḥ
verses.en: This Soma flows like gladdening oil for him who wears the braided locks: He shall give us our share of maids.

verses.sa: अयं त आघृणे सुतो घृतं न पवते शुचि । आ भक्षत्कन्यासु नः॥
verses.tr: ayaṃ ta āghṛṇe suto ghṛtaṃ na pavate śuci ā bhakṣatkanyāsu naḥ
verses.en: This Soma juice, O glowing God, flows like pure oil, effused for thee: He shall give us our share of maids.

verses.sa: वाचो जन्तुः कवीनां पवस्व सोम धारया । देवेषु रत्नधा असि॥
verses.tr: vāco jantuḥ kavīnāṃ pavasva soma dhārayā deveṣu ratnadhā asi
verses.en: Flow onward, Soma, in thy stream, begetter of the sages' speech: Wealth-giver among Gods art thou.

verses.sa: आ कलशेषु धावति श्येनो वर्म वि गाहते । अभि द्रोणा कनिक्रदत्॥
verses.tr: ā kalaśeṣu dhāvati śyeno varma vi gāhate abhi droṇā kanikradat
verses.en: The Falcon dips within the jars: he wrap him in his robe and goes Loud roaring to the vats of wood.

verses.sa: परि प्र सोम ते रसोऽसर्जि कलशे सुतः । श्येनो न तक्तो अर्षति॥
verses.tr: pari pra soma te raso'sarji kalaśe sutaḥ śyeno na takto arṣati
verses.en: Soma, thy juice hath been effused and poured into the pitcher: like A rapid hawk it rushes on.

verses.sa: पवस्व सोम मन्दयन्निन्द्राय मधुमत्तमः॥
verses.tr: pavasva soma mandayannindrāya madhumattamaḥ
verses.en: For Indra flow most rich in sweets, O Soma, bringing him delight.

verses.sa: असृग्रन्देववीतये वाजयन्तो रथा इव॥
verses.tr: asṛgrandevavītaye vājayanto rathā iva
verses.en: They were sent forth to feast the Gods, like chariots that display their strength.

verses.sa: ते सुतासो मदिन्तमाः शुक्रा वायुमसृक्षत॥
verses.tr: te sutāso madintamāḥ śukrā vāyumasṛkṣata
verses.en: Brilliant, best givers of delight, these juices have sent Vayu forth.

verses.sa: ग्राव्णा तुन्नो अभिष्टुतः पवित्रं सोम गच्छसि । दधत्स्तोत्रे सुवीर्यम्॥
verses.tr: grāvṇā tunno abhiṣṭutaḥ pavitraṃ soma gacchasi dadhatstotre suvīryam
verses.en: Bruised by the press-stones and extolled, Soma, thou goest to the sieve, Giving the worshipper hero strength.

verses.sa: एष तुन्नो अभिष्टुतः पवित्रमति गाहते । रक्षोहा वारमव्ययम्॥
verses.tr: eṣa tunno abhiṣṭutaḥ pavitramati gāhate rakṣohā vāramavyayam
verses.en: This juice bruised by the pressing-stones and lauded passes through the sieve, Slayer of demons, through the fleece.

verses.sa: यदन्ति यच्च दूरके भयं विन्दति मामिह । पवमान वि तज्जहि॥
verses.tr: yadanti yacca dūrake bhayaṃ vindati māmiha pavamāna vi tajjahi
verses.en: O Pavamana, drive away the danger, whether near at hand Or far remote, that finds me here.

verses.sa: पवमानः सो अद्य नः पवित्रेण विचर्षणिः । यः पोता स पुनातु नः॥
verses.tr: pavamānaḥ so adya naḥ pavitreṇa vicarṣaṇiḥ yaḥ potā sa punātu naḥ
verses.en: This day may Pavamana cleanse us with his purifying power, Most active purifying Priest.

verses.sa: यत्ते पवित्रमर्चिष्यग्ने विततमन्तरा । ब्रह्म तेन पुनीहि नः॥
verses.tr: yatte pavitramarciṣyagne vitatamantarā brahma tena punīhi naḥ
verses.en: O Agni, with the cleansing light diffused through all thy fiery glow, Purify thou this prayer of ours.

verses.sa: यत्ते पवित्रमर्चिवदग्ने तेन पुनीहि नः । ब्रह्मसवैः पुनीहि नः॥
verses.tr: yatte pavitramarcivadagne tena punīhi naḥ brahmasavaiḥ punīhi naḥ
verses.en: Cleanse us with thine own cleansing power, O Agni, that is bright with flame, And by libations poured to thee.

verses.sa: उभाभ्यां देव सवितः पवित्रेण सवेन च । मां पुनीहि विश्वतः॥
verses.tr: ubhābhyāṃ deva savitaḥ pavitreṇa savena ca māṃ punīhi viśvataḥ
verses.en: Savitar, God, by both of these, libation, purifying power, Purify me on every side.

verses.sa: त्रिभिष्ट्वं देव सवितर्वर्षिष्ठैः सोम धामभिः । अग्ने दक्षैः पुनीहि नः॥
verses.tr: tribhiṣṭvaṃ deva savitarvarṣiṣṭhaiḥ soma dhāmabhiḥ agne dakṣaiḥ punīhi naḥ
verses.en: Cleanse us, God Savitar, with Three, O Soma, with sublimest forms, Agni, with forms of power and might.

verses.sa: पुनन्तु मां देवजनाः पुनन्तु वसवो धिया । विश्वे देवाः पुनीत मा जातवेदः पुनीहि मा॥
verses.tr: punantu māṃ devajanāḥ punantu vasavo dhiyā viśve devāḥ punīta mā jātavedaḥ punīhi mā
verses.en: May the Gods' company make me clean, and Vasus make rue pure by song. Purify me, ye General Gods; O Jatavedas, make me pure.

verses.sa: प्र प्यायस्व प्र स्यन्दस्व सोम विश्वेभिरंशुभिः । देवेभ्य उत्तमं हविः॥
verses.tr: pra pyāyasva pra syandasva soma viśvebhiraṃśubhiḥ devebhya uttamaṃ haviḥ
verses.en: Fill thyself full of juice, flow forth, O Soma, thou with all thy stalks, The best oblation to the Gods.

verses.sa: उप प्रियं पनिप्नतं युवानमाहुतीवृधम् । अगन्म बिभ्रतो नमः॥
verses.tr: upa priyaṃ panipnataṃ yuvānamāhutīvṛdham aganma bibhrato namaḥ
verses.en: We with our homage have approached the Friend who seeks our wondering praise, Young, strengthener of the solemn rite.

verses.sa: अलाय्यस्य परशुर्ननाश तमा पवस्व देव सोम । आखुं चिदेव देव सोम॥
verses.tr: alāyyasya paraśurnanāśa tamā pavasva deva soma ākhuṃ cideva deva soma
verses.en: Lost is Alayya's axe. O Soma, God do thou send it back hither in thy flow Even, Soma, God, if 'twere a mole.

verses.sa: यः पावमानीरध्येत्यृषिभिः सम्भृतं रसम् । सर्वं स पूतमश्नाति स्वदितं मातरिश्वना॥
verses.tr: yaḥ pāvamānīradhyetyṛṣibhiḥ sambhṛtaṃ rasam sarvaṃ sa pūtamaśnāti svaditaṃ mātariśvanā
verses.en: The man who reads the essence stored by saints, the Pavamani hymns, Tastes food completely purified, made sweet by Matarisvan's touch.

verses.sa: पावमानीर्यो अध्येत्यृषिभिः सम्भृतं रसम् । तस्मै सरस्वती दुहे क्षीरं सर्पिर्मधूदकम्॥
verses.tr: pāvamānīryo adhyetyṛṣibhiḥ sambhṛtaṃ rasam tasmai sarasvatī duhe kṣīraṃ sarpirmadhūdakam
verses.en: Whoever reads the essence stored by saints, the Pavamani hymns, Sarasvati draws forth for him water and butter, milk and meath.

verses.sa:
प्र देवमच्छा मधुमन्त इन्दवोऽसिष्यदन्त गाव आ न धेनवः ।
बर्हिषदो वचनावन्त ऊधभिः परिस्रुतमुस्रिया निर्णिजं धिरे॥
verses.tr: pra devamacchā madhumanta indavo'siṣyadanta gāva ā na dhenavaḥ barhiṣado vacanāvanta ūdhabhiḥ parisrutamusriyā nirṇijaṃ dhire
verses.en: The drops of Soma juice like cows who yield their milk have flowed forth, rich in meath, unto the Shining One, And, seated on the grass, raising their voice, assumed the milk, the covering robe wherewith the udders stream.

verses.sa:
स रोरुवदभि पूर्वा अचिक्रददुपारुहः श्रथयन्त्स्वादते हरिः ।
तिरः पवित्रं परियन्नुरु ज्रयो नि शर्याणि दधते देव आ वरम्॥
verses.tr: sa roruvadabhi pūrvā acikradadupāruhaḥ śrathayantsvādate hariḥ tiraḥ pavitraṃ pariyannuru jrayo ni śaryāṇi dadhate deva ā varam
verses.en: He bellows with a roar around the highest twigs: the Tawny One is sweetened as he breaks them up. Then passing through the sieve into the ample room, the God throws off the dregs according to his wish.

verses.sa:
वि यो ममे यम्या संयती मदः साकंवृधा पयसा पिन्वदक्षिता ।
मही अपारे रजसी विवेविददभिव्रजन्नक्षितं पाज आ ददे॥
verses.tr: vi yo mame yamyā saṃyatī madaḥ sākaṃvṛdhā payasā pinvadakṣitā mahī apāre rajasī vivevidadabhivrajannakṣitaṃ pāja ā dade
verses.en: The gladdening drink that measured out the meeting Twins fills full with milk the Eternal Ever-waxing Pair. Bringing to light the Two great Regions limitless, moving above them he gained sheen that never fades.

verses.sa:
स मातरा विचरन्वाजयन्नपः प्र मेधिरः स्वधया पिन्वते पदम् ।
अंशुर्यवेन पिपिशे यतो नृभिः सं जामिभिर्नसते रक्षते शिरः॥
verses.tr: sa mātarā vicaranvājayannapaḥ pra medhiraḥ svadhayā pinvate padam aṃśuryavena pipiśe yato nṛbhiḥ saṃ jāmibhirnasate rakṣate śiraḥ
