verses.en: Wandering through, the Parents, strengthening the floods, the Sage makes his place swell with his own native might. The stalk is mixed with grain: he comes led by the men together with the sisters, and preserves the Head.

verses.sa:
सं दक्षेण मनसा जायते कविॠतस्य गर्भो निहितो यमा परः ।
यूना ह सन्ता प्रथमं वि जज्ञतुर्गुहा हितं जनिम नेममुद्यतम्॥
verses.tr: saṃ dakṣeṇa manasā jāyate kaviṝtasya garbho nihito yamā paraḥ yūnā ha santā prathamaṃ vi jajñaturguhā hitaṃ janima nemamudyatam
verses.en: With energetic intellect the Sage is born, deposited as germ of Law, far from the Twins. They being young at first showed visibly distinct the Creature that is half-concealed and half-exposed.

verses.sa:
मन्द्रस्य रूपं विविदुर्मनीषिणः श्येनो यदन्धो अभरत्परावतः ।
तं मर्जयन्त सुवृधं नदीष्वाँ उशन्तमंशुं परियन्तमृग्मियम्॥
verses.tr: mandrasya rūpaṃ vividurmanīṣiṇaḥ śyeno yadandho abharatparāvataḥ taṃ marjayanta suvṛdhaṃ nadīṣvāṃ uśantamaṃśuṃ pariyantamṛgmiyam
verses.en: The sages knew the form of him the Gladdener, what time the Falcon brought the plant from far away. Him who assures success they beautified in streams, the stalk who yearned therefor, mighty and meet for praise.

verses.sa:
त्वां मृजन्ति दश योषणः सुतं सोम ऋषिभिर्मतिभिर्धीतिभिर्हितम् ।
अव्यो वारेभिरुत देवहूतिभिर्नृभिर्यतो वाजमा दर्षि सातये॥
verses.tr: tvāṃ mṛjanti daśa yoṣaṇaḥ sutaṃ soma ṛṣibhirmatibhirdhītibhirhitam avyo vārebhiruta devahūtibhirnṛbhiryato vājamā darṣi sātaye
verses.en: Together with the Rsis, with their prayers and hymns ten women deck thee, Soma, friendly when effused. Led by the men, with invocations of the Gods, through the fleece, thou hast given us strength to win the spoil.

verses.sa:
परिप्रयन्तं वय्यं सुषंसदं सोमं मनीषा अभ्यनूषत स्तुभः ।
यो धारया मधुमाँ ऊर्मिणा दिव इयर्ति वाचं रयिषाळमर्त्यः॥
verses.tr: pariprayantaṃ vayyaṃ suṣaṃsadaṃ somaṃ manīṣā abhyanūṣata stubhaḥ yo dhārayā madhumāṃ ūrmiṇā diva iyarti vācaṃ rayiṣāḻamartyaḥ
verses.en: Songs resonant with praise have celebrated him. Soma, Friend, springing forth with his fair company. Even him who rich in meath, with undulating stream, Winnner of Wealth, Immortal, sends his voice from heaven,

verses.sa:
अयं दिव इयर्ति विश्वमा रजः सोमः पुनानः कलशेषु सीदति ।
अद्भिर्गोभिर्मृज्यते अद्रिभिः सुतः पुनान इन्दुर्वरिवो विदत्प्रियम्॥
verses.tr: ayaṃ diva iyarti viśvamā rajaḥ somaḥ punānaḥ kalaśeṣu sīdati adbhirgobhirmṛjyate adribhiḥ sutaḥ punāna indurvarivo vidatpriyam
verses.en: He sends it into all the region forth from heaven. Soma, while he is filtered, settles in the jars. With milk and waters is he decked when pressed with stones: Indu, when purified, shall find sweet rest and room.

verses.sa:
एवा नः सोम परिषिच्यमानो वयो दधच्चित्रतमं पवस्व ।
अद्वेषे द्यावापृथिवी हुवेम देवा धत्त रयिमस्मे सुवीरम्॥
verses.tr: evā naḥ soma pariṣicyamāno vayo dadhaccitratamaṃ pavasva adveṣe dyāvāpṛthivī huvema devā dhatta rayimasme suvīram
verses.en: Even thus poured forth How on thy way, O Soma, vouchsafing us most manifold lively vigour. We will invoke benevolent Earth and Heaven. Give us, ye Gods, riches with noble heroes.

verses.sa:
इषुर्न धन्वन्प्रति धीयते मतिर्वत्सो न मातुरुप सर्ज्यूधनि ।
उरुधारेव दुहे अग्र आयत्यस्य व्रतेष्वपि सोम इष्यते॥
verses.tr: iṣurna dhanvanprati dhīyate matirvatso na māturupa sarjyūdhani urudhāreva duhe agra āyatyasya vrateṣvapi soma iṣyate
verses.en: Laid like an arrow on the bow the hymn hath been loosed like a young calf to the udder of its dam. As one who cometh first with full stream she is milked the Soma is impelled to this man's holy rites.

verses.sa:
उपो मतिः पृच्यते सिच्यते मधु मन्द्राजनी चोदते अन्तरासनि ।
पवमानः संतनिः प्रघ्नतामिव मधुमान्द्रप्सः परि वारमर्षति॥
verses.tr: upo matiḥ pṛcyate sicyate madhu mandrājanī codate antarāsani pavamānaḥ saṃtaniḥ praghnatāmiva madhumāndrapsaḥ pari vāramarṣati
verses.en: The thought is deeply fixed; the savoury juice is shed; the tongue with joyous sound is stirring in the mouth; And Pavamana, like the shout of combatants, the drop rising in sweet juice, is flowing through the fleece.

verses.sa:
अव्ये वधूयुः पवते परि त्वचि श्रथ्नीते नप्तीरदितेॠतं यते ।
हरिरक्रान्यजतः संयतो मदो नृम्णा शिशानो महिषो न शोभते॥
verses.tr: avye vadhūyuḥ pavate pari tvaci śrathnīte naptīraditeṝtaṃ yate harirakrānyajataḥ saṃyato mado nṛmṇā śiśāno mahiṣo na śobhate
verses.en: He flows about the sheep-skin, longing for a bride: he looses Aditi's Daughters for the worshipper. The sacred drink hath come, gold-tinted, well-restrained: like a strong Bull he shines, whetting his manly might.

verses.sa:
उक्षा मिमाति प्रति यन्ति धेनवो देवस्य देवीरुप यन्ति निष्कृतम् ।
अत्यक्रमीदर्जुनं वारमव्ययमत्कं न निक्तं परि सोमो अव्यत॥
verses.tr: ukṣā mimāti prati yanti dhenavo devasya devīrupa yanti niṣkṛtam atyakramīdarjunaṃ vāramavyayamatkaṃ na niktaṃ pari somo avyata
verses.en: The Bull is bellowing; the Cows are coming nigh: the Goddesses approach the God's own resting-place. Onward hath Soma passed through the sheep's fair bright fleece, and hath, as 'twere, endued a garment newly washed.

verses.sa:
अमृक्तेन रुशता वाससा हरिरमर्त्यो निर्णिजानः परि व्यत ।
दिवस्पृष्ठं बर्हणा निर्णिजे कृतोपस्तरणं चम्वोर्नभस्मयम्॥
verses.tr: amṛktena ruśatā vāsasā hariramartyo nirṇijānaḥ pari vyata divaspṛṣṭhaṃ barhaṇā nirṇije kṛtopastaraṇaṃ camvornabhasmayam
verses.en: The golden-hued, Immortal, newly bathed, puts on a brightly shining vesture that is never harmed. He made the ridge of heaven to be his radiant robe, by sprinkling of the bowls from moisture of the sky.

verses.sa:
सूर्यस्येव रश्मयो द्रावयित्नवो मत्सरासः प्रसुपः साकमीरते ।
तन्तुं ततं परि सर्गास आशवो नेन्द्रादृते पवते धाम किं चन॥
verses.tr: sūryasyeva raśmayo drāvayitnavo matsarāsaḥ prasupaḥ sākamīrate tantuṃ tataṃ pari sargāsa āśavo nendrādṛte pavate dhāma kiṃ cana
verses.en: Even as the beams of Surya, urging men to speed, that cheer and send to sleep, together rush they forth, These swift outpourings in long course of holy rites: no form save only Indra shows itself so pure.

verses.sa:
सिन्धोरिव प्रवणे निम्न आशवो वृषच्युता मदासो गातुमाशत ।
शं नो निवेशे द्विपदे चतुष्पदेऽस्मे वाजाः सोम तिष्ठन्तु कृष्टयः॥
verses.tr: sindhoriva pravaṇe nimna āśavo vṛṣacyutā madāso gātumāśata śaṃ no niveśe dvipade catuṣpade'sme vājāḥ soma tiṣṭhantu kṛṣṭayaḥ
verses.en: As down the steep slope of a river to the vale, drawn from the Steer the swift strong draughts have found a way. Well be it with the men and cattle in our home. May powers, O Soma, may the people stay with us.

verses.sa:
आ नः पवस्व वसुमद्धिरण्यवदश्वावद्गोमद्यवमत्सुवीर्यम् ।
यूयं हि सोम पितरो मम स्थन दिवो मूर्धानः प्रस्थिता वयस्कृतः॥
verses.tr: ā naḥ pavasva vasumaddhiraṇyavadaśvāvadgomadyavamatsuvīryam yūyaṃ hi soma pitaro mama sthana divo mūrdhānaḥ prasthitā vayaskṛtaḥ
verses.en: Pour out upon us wealth in goods, in gold, in steeds, in cattle and in corn, and great heroic strength. Ye, Soma, are my Fathers, lifted up on high as heads of heaven and makers of the strength of life.

verses.sa:
एते सोमाः पवमानास इन्द्रं रथा इव प्र ययुः सातिमच्छ ।
सुताः पवित्रमति यन्त्यव्यं हित्वी वव्रिं हरितो वृष्टिमच्छ॥
verses.tr: ete somāḥ pavamānāsa indraṃ rathā iva pra yayuḥ sātimaccha sutāḥ pavitramati yantyavyaṃ hitvī vavriṃ harito vṛṣṭimaccha
verses.en: These Pavamanas here, these drops of Soma, to Indra have sped forth like cars to booty. Effused, they pass the cleansing fleece, while, gold-hued, they cast their covering off to pour the rain down.

verses.sa:
इन्दविन्द्राय बृहते पवस्व सुमृळीको अनवद्यो रिशादाः ।
भरा चन्द्राणि गृणते वसूनि देवैर्द्यावापृथिवी प्रावतं नः॥
verses.tr: indavindrāya bṛhate pavasva sumṛḻīko anavadyo riśādāḥ bharā candrāṇi gṛṇate vasūni devairdyāvāpṛthivī prāvataṃ naḥ
verses.en: O Indu, flow thou on for lofty Indra, flow blameless, very gracious, foe-destroyer. Bring splendid treasures to the man who lauds thee. O Heaven and Earth, with all the Gods protect us.

verses.sa:
त्रिरस्मै सप्त धेनवो दुदुह्रे सत्यामाशिरं पूर्व्ये व्योमनि ।
चत्वार्यन्या भुवनानि निर्णिजे चारूणि चक्रे यदृतैरवर्धत॥
verses.tr: trirasmai sapta dhenavo duduhre satyāmāśiraṃ pūrvye vyomani catvāryanyā bhuvanāni nirṇije cārūṇi cakre yadṛtairavardhata
verses.en: The three times seven Milch-kine in the eastern heaven have for this Soma poured the genuine milky draught. Four other beauteous Creatures hath he made for his adornment, when he waxed in strength through holy rites.

verses.sa:
स भिक्षमाणो अमृतस्य चारुण उभे द्यावा काव्येना वि शश्रथे ।
तेजिष्ठा अपो मंहना परि व्यत यदी देवस्य श्रवसा सदो विदुः॥
verses.tr: sa bhikṣamāṇo amṛtasya cāruṇa ubhe dyāvā kāvyenā vi śaśrathe tejiṣṭhā apo maṃhanā pari vyata yadī devasya śravasā sado viduḥ
verses.en: Longing for lovely Amrta, by his wisdom he divided, each apart from other, earth and heaven. He gladly wrapped himself in the most lucid floods, when through their glory they found the God's resting-place.

verses.sa:
ते अस्य सन्तु केतवोऽमृत्यवोऽदाभ्यासो जनुषी उभे अनु ।
येभिर्नृम्णा च देव्या च पुनत आदिद्राजानं मनना अगृभ्णत॥
verses.tr: te asya santu ketavo'mṛtyavo'dābhyāso januṣī ubhe anu yebhirnṛmṇā ca devyā ca punata ādidrājānaṃ mananā agṛbhṇata
verses.en: May those his brilliant rays he ever free from death, inviolate, for both classes of created things,- Rays wherewith powers of men and Gods are purified. Yea, even for this have sages welcomed him as King.

verses.sa:
स मृज्यमानो दशभिः सुकर्मभिः प्र मध्यमासु मातृषु प्रमे सचा ।
व्रतानि पानो अमृतस्य चारुण उभे नृचक्षा अनु पश्यते विशौ॥
verses.tr: sa mṛjyamāno daśabhiḥ sukarmabhiḥ pra madhyamāsu mātṛṣu prame sacā vratāni pāno amṛtasya cāruṇa ubhe nṛcakṣā anu paśyate viśau
verses.en: He, while he is adorned by the ten skillful ones, that he too in the Midmost Mothers may create, While he is watching o'er the lovely Amrta's ways, looks on both races as Beholder of mankind.

verses.sa:
स मर्मृजान इन्द्रियाय धायस ओभे अन्ता रोदसी हर्षते हितः ।
वृषा शुष्मेण बाधते वि दुर्मतीरादेदिशानः शर्यहेव शुरुधः॥
verses.tr: sa marmṛjāna indriyāya dhāyasa obhe antā rodasī harṣate hitaḥ vṛṣā śuṣmeṇa bādhate vi durmatīrādediśānaḥ śaryaheva śurudhaḥ
verses.en: He, while he is adorned to stream forth mighty strength, rejoices in his place between the earth and heaven. The Steer dispels the evil-hearted with his might, aiming at offerings as an archer at the game.

verses.sa:
स मातरा न ददृशान उस्रियो नानददेति मरुतामिव स्वनः ।
जानन्नृतं प्रथमं यत्स्वर्णरं प्रशस्तये कमवृणीत सुक्रतुः॥
verses.tr: sa mātarā na dadṛśāna usriyo nānadadeti marutāmiva svanaḥ jānannṛtaṃ prathamaṃ yatsvarṇaraṃ praśastaye kamavṛṇīta sukratuḥ
verses.en: Beholding, as it were, Two Mother Cows, the Steer goes roaring on his way even as the Maruts roar. Knowing Eternal Law, the earliest light of heaven, he, passing wise, was chosen out to tell it forth.

verses.sa:
रुवति भीमो वृषभस्तविष्यया शृङ्गे शिशानो हरिणी विचक्षणः ।
आ योनिं सोमः सुकृतं नि षीदति गव्ययी त्वग्भवति निर्णिगव्ययी॥
verses.tr: ruvati bhīmo vṛṣabhastaviṣyayā śṛṅge śiśāno hariṇī vicakṣaṇaḥ ā yoniṃ somaḥ sukṛtaṃ ni ṣīdati gavyayī tvagbhavati nirṇigavyayī
verses.en: The fearful Bull is bellowing with violent might, far-sighted, sharpening his yellow coloured horns. Soma assumes his seat in the well-fashioned place: the cowhide and the sheepskin are his ornament.

verses.sa:
शुचिः पुनानस्तन्वमरेपसमव्ये हरिर्न्यधाविष्ट सानवि ।
जुष्टो मित्राय वरुणाय वायवे त्रिधातु मधु क्रियते सुकर्मभिः॥
verses.tr: śuciḥ punānastanvamarepasamavye harirnyadhāviṣṭa sānavi juṣṭo mitrāya varuṇāya vāyave tridhātu madhu kriyate sukarmabhiḥ
verses.en: Bright, making pure his body free from spot and stain, on the sheep's back the Golden-coloured hath flowed down. Acceptable to Mitra, Vayu, Varuna, he is prepared as threefold meal by skillful men.

verses.sa:
पवस्व सोम देववीतये वृषेन्द्रस्य हार्दि सोमधानमा विश ।
पुरा नो बाधाद्दुरिताति पारय क्षेत्रविद्धि दिश आहा विपृच्छते॥
verses.tr: pavasva soma devavītaye vṛṣendrasya hārdi somadhānamā viśa purā no bādhādduritāti pāraya kṣetraviddhi diśa āhā vipṛcchate
verses.en: Flow on for the God's banquet, Soma, as a Steer, and enter Indra's heart, the Soma's reservoir. Bear us beyond misfortune ere we be oppressed. the man who knows the land directs the man who asks.

verses.sa:
हितो न सप्तिरभि वाजमर्षेन्द्रस्येन्दो जठरमा पवस्व ।
नावा न सिन्धुमति पर्षि विद्वाञ्छूरो न युध्यन्नव नो निदः स्पः॥
verses.tr: hito na saptirabhi vājamarṣendrasyendo jaṭharamā pavasva nāvā na sindhumati parṣi vidvāñchūro na yudhyannava no nidaḥ spaḥ
verses.en: Urged like a car-steed flow to strength, O Soma: Indu, flow onward to the throat of Indra. Skilled, bear us past, as in a boat o'er water: as battling Hero save us from the foeman.

verses.sa:
आ दक्षिणा सृज्यते शुष्म्या३सदं वेति द्रुहो रक्षसः पाति जागृविः ।
हरिरोपशं कृणुते नभस्पय उपस्तिरे चम्वो३र्ब्रह्म निर्णिजे॥
verses.tr: ā dakṣiṇā sṛjyate śuṣmyā3sadaṃ veti druho rakṣasaḥ pāti jāgṛviḥ hariropaśaṃ kṛṇute nabhaspaya upastire camvo3rbrahma nirṇije
verses.en: The guerdon is bestowed: the Mighty takes his Seat, and, ever-Watchful, guards from fiend and evil sprite. Gold-hued, he makes the cloud his diadem, the milk his carpet in both worlds, and prayer his robe of state.

verses.sa:
प्र कृष्टिहेव शूष एति रोरुवदसुर्यं१ वर्णं नि रिणीते अस्य तम् ।
जहाति वव्रिं पितुरेति निष्कृतमुपप्रुतं कृणुते निर्णिजं तना॥
verses.tr: pra kṛṣṭiheva śūṣa eti roruvadasuryaṃ1 varṇaṃ ni riṇīte asya tam jahāti vavriṃ pitureti niṣkṛtamupaprutaṃ kṛṇute nirṇijaṃ tanā
verses.en: Strong, bellowing, he goes, like one who slays the folk; he lets this hue of Asuras flow off from him, Throws off his covering, seeks his father's meeting-place, and thus makes for himself the bright robe he assumes.

verses.sa:
अद्रिभिः सुतः पवते गभस्त्योर्वृषायते नभसा वेपते मती ।
स मोदते नसते साधते गिरा नेनिक्ते अप्सु यजते परीमणि॥
verses.tr: adribhiḥ sutaḥ pavate gabhastyorvṛṣāyate nabhasā vepate matī sa modate nasate sādhate girā nenikte apsu yajate parīmaṇi
verses.en: Onward he flows, from both the hands, pressed out with stones: excited by the prayer, the water makes him wild. He frolics and draws near, completes his work with song, and bathes in streams to satisfy the worshipper.

verses.sa:
परि द्युक्षं सहसः पर्वतावृधं मध्वः सिञ्चन्ति हर्म्यस्य सक्षणिम् ।
आ यस्मिन्गावः सुहुताद ऊधनि मूर्धञ्छ्रीणन्त्यग्रियं वरीमभिः॥
verses.tr: pari dyukṣaṃ sahasaḥ parvatāvṛdhaṃ madhvaḥ siñcanti harmyasya sakṣaṇim ā yasmingāvaḥ suhutāda ūdhani mūrdhañchrīṇantyagriyaṃ varīmabhiḥ
verses.en: They pour out meath around the Master of the house, Celestial Strengthener of the mountain that gives might; In whom, through his great powers, oblation-eating cows in their uplifted udder mix their choicest milk.

verses.sa:
समी रथं न भुरिजोरहेषत दश स्वसारो अदितेरुपस्थ आ ।
जिगादुप ज्रयति गोरपीच्यं पदं यदस्य मतुथा अजीजनन्॥
verses.tr: samī rathaṃ na bhurijoraheṣata daśa svasāro aditerupastha ā jigādupa jrayati gorapīcyaṃ padaṃ yadasya matuthā ajījanan
verses.en: They, the ten sisters, on the lap of Aditi, have sent him forward like a car from both the arms. He wanders and comes near the Cow's mysterious place, even the place which his inventions have produced.

verses.sa:
श्येनो न योनिं सदनं धिया कृतं हिरण्ययमासदं देव एषति ।
ए रिणन्ति बर्हिषि प्रियं गिराऽश्वो न देवाँ अप्येति यज्ञियः॥
verses.tr: śyeno na yoniṃ sadanaṃ dhiyā kṛtaṃ hiraṇyayamāsadaṃ deva eṣati e riṇanti barhiṣi priyaṃ girā'śvo na devāṃ apyeti yajñiyaḥ
verses.en: Like as a falcon to his home, so speeds the God to his own golden wisely-fashioned place to rest. With song they urge the darling to the sacred grass: the Holy One goes like a courser to the Gods.

verses.sa:
परा व्यक्तो अरुषो दिवः कविर्वृषा त्रिपृष्ठो अनविष्ट गा अभि ।
सहस्रणीतिर्यतिः परायती रेभो न पूर्वीरुषसो वि राजति॥
verses.tr: parā vyakto aruṣo divaḥ kavirvṛṣā tripṛṣṭho anaviṣṭa gā abhi sahasraṇītiryatiḥ parāyatī rebho na pūrvīruṣaso vi rājati
verses.en: From far away, from heaven, the red hued noted Sage, Steer of the triple height, hath sung unto the kine. With thousand guidings he, leading this way and that, shines, as a singer, splendidly through many a morn.

verses.sa:
त्वेषं रूपं कृणुते वर्णो अस्य स यत्राशयत्समृता सेधति स्रिधः ।
अप्सा याति स्वधया दैव्यं जनं सं सुष्टुती नसते सं गोअग्रया॥
verses.tr: tveṣaṃ rūpaṃ kṛṇute varṇo asya sa yatrāśayatsamṛtā sedhati sridhaḥ apsā yāti svadhayā daivyaṃ janaṃ saṃ suṣṭutī nasate saṃ goagrayā
verses.en: His covering assumes a radiant hue; where'er he comes into the fight he drives the foe afar. The Winner of the Floods, with food he seeks the host of heaven, he comes to praises glorified with milk.

verses.sa:
उक्षेव यूथा परियन्नरावीदधि त्विषीरधित सूर्यस्य ।
दिव्यः सुपर्णोऽव चक्षत क्षां सोमः परि क्रतुना पश्यते जाः॥
verses.tr: ukṣeva yūthā pariyannarāvīdadhi tviṣīradhita sūryasya divyaḥ suparṇo'va cakṣata kṣāṃ somaḥ pari kratunā paśyate jāḥ
verses.en: Like a bull roaming round the herds he bellows: he hath assumed the brilliancy of Surya. Down to the earth hath looked the heavenly Falcon: Soma with wisdom views all living creatures.

verses.sa:
हरिं मृजन्त्यरुषो न युज्यते सं धेनुभिः कलशे सोमो अज्यते ।
उद्वाचमीरयति हिन्वते मती पुरुष्टुतस्य कति चित्परिप्रियः॥
verses.tr: hariṃ mṛjantyaruṣo na yujyate saṃ dhenubhiḥ kalaśe somo ajyate udvācamīrayati hinvate matī puruṣṭutasya kati citparipriyaḥ
verses.en: They cleanse the Gold-hued: like a red Steed is he yoked, and Soma in the jar is mingled with the milk. He sendeth out his voice, and many loving friends of him the highly lauded hasten with their songs.

verses.sa:
साकं वदन्ति बहवो मनीषिण इन्द्रस्य सोमं जठरे यदादुहुः ।
यदी मृजन्ति सुगभस्तयो नरः सनीळाभिर्दशभिः काम्यं मधु॥
verses.tr: sākaṃ vadanti bahavo manīṣiṇa indrasya somaṃ jaṭhare yadāduhuḥ yadī mṛjanti sugabhastayo naraḥ sanīḻābhirdaśabhiḥ kāmyaṃ madhu
verses.en: The many sages utter words in unison, while into Indra's throat they pour the Soma juice, When, with the ten that dwell together closely joined, the men whose hands are skillful cleanse the lovely meath.

verses.sa:
अरममाणो अत्येति गा अभि सूर्यस्य प्रियं दुहितुस्तिरो रवम् ।
अन्वस्मै जोषमभरद्विनंगृसः सं द्वयीभिः स्वसृभिः क्षेति जामिभिः॥
verses.tr: aramamāṇo atyeti gā abhi sūryasya priyaṃ duhitustiro ravam anvasmai joṣamabharadvinaṃgṛsaḥ saṃ dvayībhiḥ svasṛbhiḥ kṣeti jāmibhiḥ
verses.en: He goes upon his way, unresting, to the cows, over the roaring sound which Sarya's Daughter loves. The Falcon brought it to him for his own delight: now with the twofold kindred sisters is his home.

verses.sa:
नृधूतो अद्रिषुतो बर्हिषि प्रियः पतिर्गवां प्रदिव इन्दुॠत्वियः ।
पुरंधिवान्मनुषो यज्ञसाधनः शुचिर्धिया पवते सोम इन्द्र ते॥
verses.tr: nṛdhūto adriṣuto barhiṣi priyaḥ patirgavāṃ pradiva induṝtviyaḥ puraṃdhivānmanuṣo yajñasādhanaḥ śucirdhiyā pavate soma indra te
verses.en: Washed by the men, stone-pressed, dear on the holy grass, faithful to seasons, Lord of cattle from of old, Most liberal, completing sacrifice for men, O Indra, pure bright Soma, Indu, flows for thee.

verses.sa:
नृबाहुभ्यां चोदितो धारया सुतोऽनुष्वधं पवते सोम इन्द्र ते ।
आप्राः क्रतून्त्समजैरध्वरे मतीर्वेर्न द्रुषच्चम्वो३रासदद्धरिः॥
verses.tr: nṛbāhubhyāṃ codito dhārayā suto'nuṣvadhaṃ pavate soma indra te āprāḥ kratūntsamajairadhvare matīrverna druṣaccamvo3rāsadaddhariḥ
verses.en: O Indra, urged by arms of men and poured in streams, Soma flows on for thee after his Godlike kind. Plans thou fulfillest, gatherest thoughts for sacrifice: in the bowls sits the Gold-hued like a roosting bird.

verses.sa:
अंशुं दुहन्ति स्तनयन्तमक्षितं कविं कवयोऽपसो मनीषिणः ।
समी गावो मतयो यन्ति संयत ऋतस्य योना सदने पुनर्भुवः॥
verses.tr: aṃśuṃ duhanti stanayantamakṣitaṃ kaviṃ kavayo'paso manīṣiṇaḥ samī gāvo matayo yanti saṃyata ṛtasya yonā sadane punarbhuvaḥ
verses.en: Sages well-skilled in work, intelligent, drain out the stalk that roars, the Sage, the Everlasting One. The milk, the hymns unite them with him in the place of sacrifice, his seat who is produced anew.

verses.sa:
नाभा पृथिव्या धरुणो महो दिवो३ऽपामूर्मौ सिन्धुष्वन्तरुक्षितः ।
इन्द्रस्य वज्रो वृषभो विभूवसुः सोमो हृदे पवते चारु मत्सरः॥
verses.tr: nābhā pṛthivyā dharuṇo maho divo3'pāmūrmau sindhuṣvantarukṣitaḥ indrasya vajro vṛṣabho vibhūvasuḥ somo hṛde pavate cāru matsaraḥ
verses.en: Earth's central point, sustainer of the mighty heavens, distilled into the streams, into the waters' wave, As Indra's thunderbolt, Steer with far spreading wealth, Soma is flowing on to make the heart rejoice.

verses.sa:
स तू पवस्व परि पार्थिवं रजः स्तोत्रे शिक्षन्नाधून्वते च सुक्रतो ।
मा नो निर्भाग्वसुनः सादनस्पृशो रयिं पिशङ्गं बहुलं वसीमहि॥
verses.tr: sa tū pavasva pari pārthivaṃ rajaḥ stotre śikṣannādhūnvate ca sukrato mā no nirbhāgvasunaḥ sādanaspṛśo rayiṃ piśaṅgaṃ bahulaṃ vasīmahi
verses.en: Over the earthly region flow thou on thy way, helping the praiser and the pourer, thou Most Wise. Let us not lack rich treasure reaching to our home, and may we clothe ourselves in manifold bright wealth.

verses.sa:
आ तू न इन्दो शतदात्वश्व्यं सहस्रदातु पशुमद्धिरण्यवत् ।
उप मास्व बृहती रेवतीरिषोऽधि स्तोत्रस्य पवमान नो गहि॥
verses.tr: ā tū na indo śatadātvaśvyaṃ sahasradātu paśumaddhiraṇyavat upa māsva bṛhatī revatīriṣo'dhi stotrasya pavamāna no gahi
verses.en: Hither, O Indu, unto us a hundred gifts of steeds, a thousand gifts of cattle and of gold, Measure thou forth, yea, splendid ample strengthening food do thou, O Pavamana, heed this laud of ours.

verses.sa:
स्रक्वे द्रप्सस्य धमतः समस्वरन्नृतस्य योना समरन्त नाभयः ।
त्रीन्त्स मूर्ध्नो असुरश्चक्र आरभे सत्यस्य नावः सुकृतमपीपरन्॥
verses.tr: srakve drapsasya dhamataḥ samasvarannṛtasya yonā samaranta nābhayaḥ trīntsa mūrdhno asuraścakra ārabhe satyasya nāvaḥ sukṛtamapīparan
verses.en: They from the spouting drop have sounded at the rim: naves speed together to the place of sacrifice. That Asura hath formed, to seize, three lofty heights. The ships of truth have borne the pious man across.

verses.sa:
सम्यक्सम्यञ्चो महिषा अहेषत सिन्धोरूर्मावधि वेना अवीविपन् ।
मधोर्धाराभिर्जनयन्तो अर्कमित्प्रियामिन्द्रस्य तन्वमवीवृधन्॥
verses.tr: samyaksamyañco mahiṣā aheṣata sindhorūrmāvadhi venā avīvipan madhordhārābhirjanayanto arkamitpriyāmindrasya tanvamavīvṛdhan
verses.en: The strong Steers, gathering, have duly stirred themselves, and over the stream's wave the friends sent forth the song. Engendering the hymn, with flowing streams of meath, Indra's dear body have they caused to wax in strength.

verses.sa:
पवित्रवन्तः परि वाचमासते पितैषां प्रत्नो अभि रक्षति व्रतम् ।
महः समुद्रं वरुणस्तिरो दधे धीरा इच्छेकुर्धरुणेष्वारभम्॥
verses.tr: pavitravantaḥ pari vācamāsate pitaiṣāṃ pratno abhi rakṣati vratam mahaḥ samudraṃ varuṇastiro dadhe dhīrā icchekurdharuṇeṣvārabham
verses.en: With sanctifying gear they sit around the song: their ancient Father guards their holy work from harm. Varuna hath o'erspread the mighty sea of air. Sages had power to hold him in sustaining floods.

verses.sa:
सहस्रधारेऽव ते समस्वरन्दिवो नाके मधुजिह्वा असश्चतः ।
अस्य स्पशो न नि मिषन्ति भूर्णयः पदेपदे पाशिनः सन्ति सेतवः॥
verses.tr: sahasradhāre'va te samasvarandivo nāke madhujihvā asaścataḥ asya spaśo na ni miṣanti bhūrṇayaḥ padepade pāśinaḥ santi setavaḥ
verses.en: Sweet-tongued, exhaustless, they have sent their voices down together, in heaven's vault that pours a thousand streams. His wildly-restless warders never close an eye: in every place are found the bonds that bind man last.

verses.sa:
पितुर्मातुरध्या ये समस्वरन्नृचा शोचन्तः संदहन्तो अव्रतान् ।
इन्द्रद्विष्टामप धमन्ति मायया त्वचमसिक्नीं भूमनो दिवस्परि॥
verses.tr: piturmāturadhyā ye samasvarannṛcā śocantaḥ saṃdahanto avratān indradviṣṭāmapa dhamanti māyayā tvacamasiknīṃ bhūmano divaspari
verses.en: O'er Sire and Mother they have roared in unison bright with the verse of praise, burning up riteless men, Blowing away with supernatural might from earth and from the heavens the swarthy skin which Indra hates.

verses.sa:
प्रत्नान्मानादध्या ये समस्वरञ्छ्लोकयन्त्रासो रभसस्य मन्तवः ।
अपानक्षासो बधिरा अहासत ऋतस्य पन्थां न तरन्ति दुष्कृतः॥
verses.tr: pratnānmānādadhyā ye samasvarañchlokayantrāso rabhasasya mantavaḥ apānakṣāso badhirā ahāsata ṛtasya panthāṃ na taranti duṣkṛtaḥ
verses.en: Those which, as guides of song and counsellors of speed, were manifested from their ancient dwelling place,- From these the eyeless and the deaf have turned aside: the wicked travel not the pathway of the Law.

verses.sa:
सहस्रधारे वितते पवित्र आ वाचं पुनन्ति कवयो मनीषिणः ।
रुद्रास एषामिषिरासो अद्रुहः स्पशः स्वञ्चः सुदृशो नृचक्षसः॥
verses.tr: sahasradhāre vitate pavitra ā vācaṃ punanti kavayo manīṣiṇaḥ rudrāsa eṣāmiṣirāso adruhaḥ spaśaḥ svañcaḥ sudṛśo nṛcakṣasaḥ
verses.en: What time the filter with a thousand streams is stretched, the thoughtful sages purify their song therein. Bright-coloured are their spies, vigorous, void of guile, excellent, fair to see, beholders of mankind.

verses.sa:
ऋतस्य गोपा न दभाय सुक्रतुस्त्री ष पवित्रा हृद्य१न्तरा दधे ।
विद्वान्त्स विश्वा भुवनाभि पश्यत्यवाजुष्टान्विध्यति कर्ते अव्रतान्॥
verses.tr: ṛtasya gopā na dabhāya sukratustrī ṣa pavitrā hṛdya1ntarā dadhe vidvāntsa viśvā bhuvanābhi paśyatyavājuṣṭānvidhyati karte avratān
verses.en: Guardian of Law, most wise, he may not be deceived: three Purifiers hath he set within his heart. With wisdom he beholds all creatures that exist: he drives into the pit the hated riteless ones.

verses.sa:
ऋतस्य तन्तुर्विततः पवित्र आ जिह्वाया अग्रे वरुणस्य मायया ।
धीराश्चित्तत्समिनक्षन्त आशताऽत्रा कर्तमव पदात्यप्रभुः॥
verses.tr: ṛtasya tanturvitataḥ pavitra ā jihvāyā agre varuṇasya māyayā dhīrāścittatsaminakṣanta āśatā'trā kartamava padātyaprabhuḥ
verses.en: The thread of sacrifice spun in the cleansing sieve, on Varuna's tongue-tip, by supernatural might,- This, by their striving, have the prudent ones attained: he who hath not this power shall sink into the pit.

verses.sa:
शिशुर्न जातोऽव चक्रदद्वने स्व१र्यद्वाज्यरुषः सिषासति ।
दिवो रेतसा सचते पयोवृधा तमीमहे सुमती शर्म सप्रथः॥
verses.tr: śiśurna jāto'va cakradadvane sva1ryadvājyaruṣaḥ siṣāsati divo retasā sacate payovṛdhā tamīmahe sumatī śarma saprathaḥ
verses.en: Born like a youngling he hath clamoured in the wood, when he, the Red, the Strong, would win the light of heaven. He comes with heavenly seed that makes the water swell: him for wide-spreading shelter we implore with prayer.

verses.sa:
दिवो यः स्कम्भो धरुणः स्वातत आपूर्णो अंशुः पर्येति विश्वतः ।
सेमे मही रोदसी यक्षदावृता समीचीने दाधार समिषः कविः॥
verses.tr: divo yaḥ skambho dharuṇaḥ svātata āpūrṇo aṃśuḥ paryeti viśvataḥ seme mahī rodasī yakṣadāvṛtā samīcīne dādhāra samiṣaḥ kaviḥ
verses.en: A far-extended pillar that supports the sky the Soma-stalk, filled full, moves itself every way. He shall bring both these great worlds while the rite proceeds: the Sage holds these who move! together and all food.

verses.sa:
महि प्सरः सुकृतं सोम्यं मधूर्वी गव्यूतिरदितेॠतं यते ।
ईशे यो वृष्टेरित उस्रियो वृषाऽपां नेता य इतऊतिॠग्मियः॥
verses.tr: mahi psaraḥ sukṛtaṃ somyaṃ madhūrvī gavyūtiraditeṝtaṃ yate īśe yo vṛṣṭerita usriyo vṛṣā'pāṃ netā ya itaūtiṝgmiyaḥ
verses.en: Wide space hath he who follows Aditi's right path, and mighty, well-made food, meath blent with Soma juice; He who from hence commands the rain, Steer of the kine, Leader of floods, who helps us hence, who claims our laud.

verses.sa:
आत्मन्वन्नभो दुह्यते घृतं पय ऋतस्य नाभिरमृतं वि जायते ।
समीचीनाः सुदानवः प्रीणन्ति तं नरो हितमव मेहन्ति पेरवः॥
verses.tr: ātmanvannabho duhyate ghṛtaṃ paya ṛtasya nābhiramṛtaṃ vi jāyate samīcīnāḥ sudānavaḥ prīṇanti taṃ naro hitamava mehanti peravaḥ
verses.en: Butter and milk are drawn from animated cloud; thence Amrta is produced, centre of sacrifice. Him the Most Bounteous Ones, ever united, love; him as our Friend the Men who make all swell rain down.

verses.sa:
अरावीदंशुः सचमान ऊर्मिणा देवाव्यं१ मनुषे पिन्वति त्वचम् ।
दधाति गर्भमदितेरुपस्थ आ येन तोकं च तनयं च धामहे॥
verses.tr: arāvīdaṃśuḥ sacamāna ūrmiṇā devāvyaṃ1 manuṣe pinvati tvacam dadhāti garbhamaditerupastha ā yena tokaṃ ca tanayaṃ ca dhāmahe
verses.en: The Soma-stalk hath roared, following with the wave: he swells with sap for man the skin which Gods enjoy. Upon the lap of Aditi he lays the germ, by means whereof we gain children and progeny.

verses.sa:
सहस्रधारेऽव ता असश्चतस्तृतीये सन्तु रजसि प्रजावतीः ।
चतस्रो नाभो निहिता अवो दिवो हविर्भरन्त्यमृतं घृतश्चुतः॥
verses.tr: sahasradhāre'va tā asaścatastṛtīye santu rajasi prajāvatīḥ catasro nābho nihitā avo divo havirbharantyamṛtaṃ ghṛtaścutaḥ
verses.en: In the third region which distils a thousand streams, may the Exhaustless Ones descend with procreant power. The kindred Four have been sent downward from the heavens: dropping with oil they bring Amrta and sacred gifts.

verses.sa:
श्वेतं रूपं कृणुते यत्सिषासति सोमो मीढ्वाँ असुरो वेद भूमनः ।
धिया शमी सचते सेमभि प्रवद्दिवस्कवन्धमव दर्षदुद्रिणम्॥
verses.tr: śvetaṃ rūpaṃ kṛṇute yatsiṣāsati somo mīḍhvāṃ asuro veda bhūmanaḥ dhiyā śamī sacate semabhi pravaddivaskavandhamava darṣadudriṇam
verses.en: Soma assumes white colour when he strives to gain: the bounteous Asura knows full many a precious boon. Down the steep slope, through song, he comes to sacrifice, and he will burst the water-holding cask of heaven,

verses.sa:
अध श्वेतं कलशं गोभिरक्तं कार्ष्मन्ना वाज्यक्रमीत्ससवान् ।
आ हिन्विरे मनसा देवयन्तः कक्षीवते शतहिमाय गोनाम्॥
verses.tr: adha śvetaṃ kalaśaṃ gobhiraktaṃ kārṣmannā vājyakramītsasavān ā hinvire manasā devayantaḥ kakṣīvate śatahimāya gonām
verses.en: Yea, to the shining milk-anointed beaker, as to his goal, hath stepped the conquering Courser. Pious-souled men have sent their gift of cattle unto Kaksivan of the hundred winters.

verses.sa:
अद्भिः सोम पपृचानस्य ते रसोऽव्यो वारं वि पवमान धावति ।
स मृज्यमानः कविभिर्मदिन्तम स्वदस्वेन्द्राय पवमान पीतये॥
verses.tr: adbhiḥ soma papṛcānasya te raso'vyo vāraṃ vi pavamāna dhāvati sa mṛjyamānaḥ kavibhirmadintama svadasvendrāya pavamāna pītaye
verses.en: Soma, thy juice when thou art blended with the streams, flows, Pavamana, through the long wool of the sheep. So, cleansed by sages. O best giver of delight, grow sweet for Indra, Pavamana! for his drink.

verses.sa:
अभि प्रियाणि पवते चनोहितो नामानि यह्वो अधि येषु वर्धते ।
आ सूर्यस्य बृहतो बृहन्नधि रथं विष्वञ्चमरुहद्विचक्षणः॥
verses.tr: abhi priyāṇi pavate canohito nāmāni yahvo adhi yeṣu vardhate ā sūryasya bṛhato bṛhannadhi rathaṃ viṣvañcamaruhadvicakṣaṇaḥ
verses.en: Graciously-MINDED he is flowing on his way to win dear names o'er which the Youthful One grows great. The Mighty and Far-seeing One hath mounted now the mighty Surya's car which moves to every side.

verses.sa:
ऋतस्य जिह्वा पवते मधु प्रियं वक्ता पतिर्धियो अस्या अदाभ्यः ।
दधाति पुत्रः पित्रोरपीच्यं१ नाम तृतीयमधि रोचने दिवः॥
verses.tr: ṛtasya jihvā pavate madhu priyaṃ vaktā patirdhiyo asyā adābhyaḥ dadhāti putraḥ pitrorapīcyaṃ1 nāma tṛtīyamadhi rocane divaḥ
verses.en: The Speaker, unassailable Master of this hymn, the Tongue of sacrifice pours forth the pleasant meath. Within the lustrous region of the heavens the Son makes the third secret name of Mother and of Sire.

verses.sa:
अव द्युतानः कलशाँ अचिक्रदन्नृभिर्येमानः कोश आ हिरण्यये ।
अभीमृतस्य दोहना अनूषताऽधि त्रिपृष्ठ उषसो वि राजति॥
verses.tr: ava dyutānaḥ kalaśāṃ acikradannṛbhiryemānaḥ kośa ā hiraṇyaye abhīmṛtasya dohanā anūṣatā'dhi tripṛṣṭha uṣaso vi rājati
verses.en: Sending forth flashes he hath bellowed to the jars, led by the men into the golden reservoir. The milky streams of sacrifice have sung to him: he of the triple height shines brightly through the morns.

verses.sa:
अद्रिभिः सुतो मतिभिश्चनोहितः प्ररोचयन्रोदसी मातरा शुचिः ।
रोमाण्यव्या समया वि धावति मधोर्धारा पिन्वमाना दिवेदिवे॥
verses.tr: adribhiḥ suto matibhiścanohitaḥ prarocayanrodasī mātarā śuciḥ romāṇyavyā samayā vi dhāvati madhordhārā pinvamānā divedive
verses.en: Pressed by the stones, with hymns, and graciously inclined, illuminating both the Parents, Heaven and Earth, He flows in ordered season onward through the flee, a current of sweet juice still swelling day by day.

verses.sa:
परि सोम प्र धन्वा स्वस्तये नृभिः पुनानो अभि वासयाशिरम् ।
ये ते मदा आहनसो विहायसस्तेभिरिन्द्रं चोदय दातवे मघम्॥
verses.tr: pari soma pra dhanvā svastaye nṛbhiḥ punāno abhi vāsayāśiram ye te madā āhanaso vihāyasastebhirindraṃ codaya dātave magham
verses.en: Flow onward, Soma, flow to bring prosperity: cleansed by the men, invest thee with the milky draught. What gladdening drinks thou hast, foaming, exceeding strong, even with these incite Indra to give us wealth.

verses.sa:
धर्ता दिवः पवते कृत्व्यो रसो दक्षो देवानामनुमाद्यो नृभिः ।
हरिः सृजानो अत्यो न सत्वभिर्वृथा पाजांसि कृणुते नदीष्वा॥
verses.tr: dhartā divaḥ pavate kṛtvyo raso dakṣo devānāmanumādyo nṛbhiḥ hariḥ sṛjāno atyo na satvabhirvṛthā pājāṃsi kṛṇute nadīṣvā
verses.en: On flows the potent juice, sustainer of the heavens, the strength of Gods, whom men must hail with shouts of joy. The Gold-hued, started like a courser by brave men, impetuously winneth splendour in the streams.

verses.sa:
शूरो न धत्त आयुधा गभस्त्योः स्व१ः सिषासन्रथिरो गविष्टिषु ।
इन्द्रस्य शुष्ममीरयन्नपस्युभिरिन्दुर्हिन्वानो अज्यते मनीषिभिः॥
verses.tr: śūro na dhatta āyudhā gabhastyoḥ sva1ḥ siṣāsanrathiro gaviṣṭiṣu indrasya śuṣmamīrayannapasyubhirindurhinvāno ajyate manīṣibhiḥ
verses.en: He takes his weapons, like a hero, in his hands, fain to win light, car-borne, in forays for the kine. Indu, while stimulating India's might, is urged forward and balmed by sages skillful in their task.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रस्य सोम पवमान ऊर्मिणा तविष्यमाणो जठरेष्वा विश ।
प्र णः पिन्व विद्युदभ्रेव रोदसी धिया न वाजाँ उप मासि शश्वतः॥
verses.tr: indrasya soma pavamāna ūrmiṇā taviṣyamāṇo jaṭhareṣvā viśa pra ṇaḥ pinva vidyudabhreva rodasī dhiyā na vājāṃ upa māsi śaśvataḥ
verses.en: Soma, as thou art purified with flowing wave, exhibiting thy strength enter thou Indra's throat. Make both worlds stream for us, as lightning doth the clouds: mete out exhaustless powers for us, as 'twere through song.

verses.sa:
विश्वस्य राजा पवते स्वर्दृश ऋतस्य धीतिमृषिषाळवीवशत् ।
यः सूर्यस्यासिरेण मृज्यते पिता मतीनामसमष्टकाव्यः॥
verses.tr: viśvasya rājā pavate svardṛśa ṛtasya dhītimṛṣiṣāḻavīvaśat yaḥ sūryasyāsireṇa mṛjyate pitā matīnāmasamaṣṭakāvyaḥ
verses.en: Onward he flows, the King of all that sees the light: the Rsis' Lord hath raised the song of sacrifice; Even he who is adorned with Surya's arrowy beam, Father of hymns, whose wisdom is beyond our reach.

verses.sa:
वृषेव यूथा परि कोशमर्षस्यपामुपस्थे वृषभः कनिक्रदत् ।
स इन्द्राय पवसे मत्सरिन्तमो यथा जेषाम समिथे त्वोतयः॥
verses.tr: vṛṣeva yūthā pari kośamarṣasyapāmupasthe vṛṣabhaḥ kanikradat sa indrāya pavase matsarintamo yathā jeṣāma samithe tvotayaḥ
verses.en: Like as a bull to herds, thou flowest to the pail, bellowing as a steer upon the water's lap. So, best of Cheerers, thou for Indra flowest on that we, with thy protection, may o'ercome in fight.

verses.sa:
एष प्र कोशे मधुमाँ अचिक्रददिन्द्रस्य वज्रो वपुषो वपुष्टरः ।
अभीमृतस्य सुदुघा घृतश्चुतो वाश्रा अर्षन्ति पयसेव धेनवः॥
verses.tr: eṣa pra kośe madhumāṃ acikradadindrasya vajro vapuṣo vapuṣṭaraḥ abhīmṛtasya sudughā ghṛtaścuto vāśrā arṣanti payaseva dhenavaḥ
verses.en: More beauteous than the beautiful, as Indra's bolt, this Soma, rich in sweets, hath clamoured in the vat. Dropping with oil, abundant, streams of sacrifice flow unto him like milch-kine, lowing, with their milk.

verses.sa:
स पूर्व्यः पवते यं दिवस्परि श्येनो मथायदिषितस्तिरो रजः ।
स मध्व आ युवते वेविजान इत्कृशानोरस्तुर्मनसाह बिभ्युषा॥
verses.tr: sa pūrvyaḥ pavate yaṃ divaspari śyeno mathāyadiṣitastiro rajaḥ sa madhva ā yuvate vevijāna itkṛśānorasturmanasāha bibhyuṣā
verses.en: On flows that Ancient One whom, hitherward, from heaven, sped through the region of the air, the Falcon snatched. He, quivering with alarm and terrified in heart before bow-armed Krsanu, holdeth fast the sweet.

verses.sa:
ते नः पूर्वास उपरास इन्दवो महे वाजाय धन्वन्तु गोमते ।
ईक्षेण्यासो अह्यो३ न चारवो ब्रह्मब्रह्म ये जुजुषुर्हविर्हविः॥
verses.tr: te naḥ pūrvāsa uparāsa indavo mahe vājāya dhanvantu gomate īkṣeṇyāso ahyo3 na cāravo brahmabrahma ye jujuṣurhavirhaviḥ
verses.en: May those first freshest drops of Soma juice effused flow on, their way to bring us mighty strength in kine. Beauteous as serpents, worthy to be looked upon, they whom each sacred gift and all our prayers have pleased.

verses.sa:
अयं नो विद्वान्वनवद्वनुष्यत इन्दुः सत्राचा मनसा पुरुष्टुतः ।
इनस्य यः सदने गर्भमादधे गवामुरुब्जमभ्यर्षति व्रजम्॥
verses.tr: ayaṃ no vidvānvanavadvanuṣyata induḥ satrācā manasā puruṣṭutaḥ inasya yaḥ sadane garbhamādadhe gavāmurubjamabhyarṣati vrajam
verses.en: May that much-lauded Indu, with a heart inclined to us, well-knowing, fight against our enemies. He who hath brought the germ beside the Strong One's seat moves onward to the widely-opened stall of kine.

verses.sa:
चक्रिर्दिवः पवते कृत्व्यो रसो महाँ अदब्धो वरुणो हुरुग्यते ।
असावि मित्रो वृजनेषु यज्ञियोऽत्यो न यूथे वृषयुः कनिक्रदत्॥
verses.tr: cakrirdivaḥ pavate kṛtvyo raso mahāṃ adabdho varuṇo hurugyate asāvi mitro vṛjaneṣu yajñiyo'tyo na yūthe vṛṣayuḥ kanikradat
verses.en: The active potent juice of heaven is flowing on, great Varuna whom the forward man can ne'er deceive. Mitra, the Holy, hath been pressed for troubled times, neighing like an impatient horse amid the herd.

verses.sa:
प्र राजा वाचं जनयन्नसिष्यददपो वसानो अभि गा इयक्षति ।
गृभ्णाति रिप्रमविरस्य तान्वा शुद्धो देवानामुप याति निष्कृतम्॥
verses.tr: pra rājā vācaṃ janayannasiṣyadadapo vasāno abhi gā iyakṣati gṛbhṇāti ripramavirasya tānvā śuddho devānāmupa yāti niṣkṛtam
verses.en: Raising his voice the King hath flowed upon his way: invested with the waters he would win the kine. The fleece retains his solid parts as though impure, and bright and cleansed he seeks the special place of Gods.

verses.sa:
इन्द्राय सोम परि षिच्यसे नृभिर्नृचक्षा ऊर्मिः कविरज्यसे वने ।
पूर्वीर्हि ते स्रुतयः सन्ति यातवे सहस्रमश्वा हरयश्चमूषदः॥
verses.tr: indrāya soma pari ṣicyase nṛbhirnṛcakṣā ūrmiḥ kavirajyase vane pūrvīrhi te srutayaḥ santi yātave sahasramaśvā harayaścamūṣadaḥ
verses.en: Thou, Soma, art effused for Indra by the men, balmed in the wood as wave, Sage, Viewer of mankind. Full many are the paths whereon thou mayest go: a thousand bay steeds hast thou resting in the bowls.

verses.sa:
समुद्रिया अप्सरसो मनीषिणमासीना अन्तरभि सोममक्षरन् ।
ता ईं हिन्वन्ति हर्म्यस्य सक्षणिं याचन्ते सुम्नं पवमानमक्षितम्॥
verses.tr: samudriyā apsaraso manīṣiṇamāsīnā antarabhi somamakṣaran tā īṃ hinvanti harmyasya sakṣaṇiṃ yācante sumnaṃ pavamānamakṣitam
verses.en: Apsarases who dwell in waters of the sea, sitting within, have flowed to Soma wise of heart. They urge the Master of the house upon his way, and to the Eternal Pavamana pray for bliss.

verses.sa:
गोजिन्नः  सोमो रथजिद्धिरण्यजित्स्वर्जिदब्जित्पवते सहस्रजित् ।
यं देवासश्चक्रिरे पीतये मदं स्वादिष्ठं द्रप्समरुणं मयोभुवम्॥
verses.tr: gojinnaḥ somo rathajiddhiraṇyajitsvarjidabjitpavate sahasrajit yaṃ devāsaścakrire pītaye madaṃ svādiṣṭhaṃ drapsamaruṇaṃ mayobhuvam
verses.en: Soma flows on for u's as winner of the kine, winner of thousands, cars, water, and light, and gold; He whom the Gods have made a gladdening draught to drink, the drop most sweet to taste, weal-bringing, red of hue.

verses.sa:
एतानि सोम पवमानो अस्मयुः सत्यानि कृण्वन्द्रविणान्यर्षसि ।
जहि शत्रुमन्तिके दूरके च य उर्वीं गव्यूतिमभयं च नस्कृधि॥
verses.tr: etāni soma pavamāno asmayuḥ satyāni kṛṇvandraviṇānyarṣasi jahi śatrumantike dūrake ca ya urvīṃ gavyūtimabhayaṃ ca naskṛdhi
verses.en: Soma, as Pavamana thou, our faithful Friend, making for us these real treasures, flowest on. Slay thou the enemy both near and far away: grant us security and ample pasturage.

verses.sa:
अचोदसो नो धन्वन्त्विन्दवः प्र सुवानासो बृहद्दिवेषु हरयः ।
वि च नशन्न इषो अरातयोऽर्यो नशन्त सनिषन्त नो धियः॥
verses.tr: acodaso no dhanvantvindavaḥ pra suvānāso bṛhaddiveṣu harayaḥ vi ca naśanna iṣo arātayo'ryo naśanta saniṣanta no dhiyaḥ
verses.en: Spontaneous let our drops of Soma juice flow on, pressed, golden-hued, among the Gods of lofty heaven. Perish among us they who give no gifts of food! perish the godless! May our prayers obtain success.

verses.sa:
प्र णो धन्वन्त्विन्दवो मदच्युतो धना वा येभिरर्वतो जुनीमसि ।
तिरो मर्तस्य कस्य चित्परिह्वृतिं वयं धनानि विश्वधा भरेमहि॥
verses.tr: pra ṇo dhanvantvindavo madacyuto dhanā vā yebhirarvato junīmasi tiro martasya kasya citparihvṛtiṃ vayaṃ dhanāni viśvadhā bharemahi
verses.en: Forward to us the drops, distilling meath, shall flow, like riches for whose sake we urge the horses on. Beyond the crafty hindering of all mortal men may we continually bear precious wealth away.

verses.sa:
उत स्वस्या अरात्या अरिर्हि ष उतान्यस्या अरात्या वृको हि षः ।
धन्वन्न तृष्णा समरीत ताँ अभि सोम जहि पवमान दुराध्यः॥
verses.tr: uta svasyā arātyā arirhi ṣa utānyasyā arātyā vṛko hi ṣaḥ dhanvanna tṛṣṇā samarīta tāṃ abhi soma jahi pavamāna durādhyaḥ
verses.en: Yea, verily, foe of hate shown to himself is he, yea, verity, destroyer too of other hate. As thirst subdueth in the desert, conquer thou, O Soma Pavarnana, men of evil thoughts.

verses.sa:
दिवि ते नाभा परमो य आददे पृथिव्यास्ते रुरुहुः सानवि क्षिपः ।
अद्रयस्त्वा बप्सति गोरधि त्वच्य१प्सु त्वा हस्तैर्दुदुहुर्मनीषिणः॥
verses.tr: divi te nābhā paramo ya ādade pṛthivyāste ruruhuḥ sānavi kṣipaḥ adrayastvā bapsati goradhi tvacya1psu tvā hastairduduhurmanīṣiṇaḥ
verses.en: Near kin to thee is he, raised loftiest in the heavens: upon the earth's high ridge thy scions have grown forth. The press-stones chew and crunch thee on the ox's hide: sages have milked thee with their hands into the streams.

verses.sa:
एवा त इन्दो सुभ्वं सुपेशसं रसं तुञ्जन्ति प्रथमा अभिश्रियः ।
निदंनिदं पवमान नि तारिष आविस्ते शुष्मो भवतु प्रियो मदः॥
verses.tr: evā ta indo subhvaṃ supeśasaṃ rasaṃ tuñjanti prathamā abhiśriyaḥ nidaṃnidaṃ pavamāna ni tāriṣa āviste śuṣmo bhavatu priyo madaḥ
verses.en: So do they hurry on thy strong and beauteous juice, O Indu, as the first ingredient of the draught. Bring low, thou Pavamana, every single foe, and be thy might shown forth as sweet and gladdening drink.

verses.sa:
सोमस्य धारा पवते नृचक्षस ऋतेन देवान्हवते दिवस्परि ।
बृहस्पते रवथेना वि दिद्युते समुद्रासो न सवनानि विव्यचुः॥
verses.tr: somasya dhārā pavate nṛcakṣasa ṛtena devānhavate divaspari bṛhaspate ravathenā vi didyute samudrāso na savanāni vivyacuḥ
verses.en: On flows the stream of Soma who beholds mankind: by everlasting Law he calls the Gods from heaven. He lightens with the roaring of Br aspati: h the lakes have not contained the pourings of juice.

verses.sa:
यं त्वा वाजिन्नघ्न्या अभ्यनूषताऽयोहतं योनिमा रोहसि द्युमान् ।
मघोनामायुः प्रतिरन्महि श्रव इन्द्राय सोम पवसे वृषा मदः॥
verses.tr: yaṃ tvā vājinnaghnyā abhyanūṣatā'yohataṃ yonimā rohasi dyumān maghonāmāyuḥ pratiranmahi śrava indrāya soma pavase vṛṣā madaḥ
verses.en: Thou, powerful Soma, thou to whom the cows have -lowed, ascendest bright with sheen, thine iron-fashioned home. Thou, lengthening our princes' life and high renown, flowest for Indra as his might to gladdening drink.

verses.sa:
एन्द्रस्य कुक्षा पवते मदिन्तम ऊर्जं वसानः श्रवसे सुमङ्गलः ।
प्रत्यङ्स विश्वा भुवनाभि पप्रथे क्रीळन्हरिरत्यः स्यन्दते वृषा॥
verses.tr: endrasya kukṣā pavate madintama ūrjaṃ vasānaḥ śravase sumaṅgalaḥ pratyaṅsa viśvā bhuvanābhi paprathe krīḻanhariratyaḥ syandate vṛṣā
verses.en: Best giver of delight, he flows to Indra's throat, robing himself in might, Auspicious One, for fame. He spreads himself abroad to meet all things that be: the vigorous Tawny Steed flows sporting on his way.

verses.sa:
तं त्वा देवेभ्यो मधुमत्तमं नरः सहस्रधारं दुहते दश क्षिपः ।
नृभिः सोम प्रच्युतो ग्रावभिः सुतो विश्वान्देवाँ आ पवस्वा सहस्रजित्॥
verses.tr: taṃ tvā devebhyo madhumattamaṃ naraḥ sahasradhāraṃ duhate daśa kṣipaḥ nṛbhiḥ soma pracyuto grāvabhiḥ suto viśvāndevāṃ ā pavasvā sahasrajit
verses.en: The men, the ten swift fingers, milk thee out for Gods, even thee most rich in meath, with thousand flowing streams. Soma who winnest thousands, driven by the men, expressed with stones, bring, as thou flowest, all the Gods.

verses.sa:
तं त्वा हस्तिनो मधुमन्तमद्रिभिर्दुहन्त्यप्सु वृषभं दश क्षिपः ।
इन्द्रं सोम मादयन्दैव्यं जनं सिन्धोरिवोर्मिः पवमानो अर्षसि॥
verses.tr: taṃ tvā hastino madhumantamadribhirduhantyapsu vṛṣabhaṃ daśa kṣipaḥ indraṃ soma mādayandaivyaṃ janaṃ sindhorivormiḥ pavamāno arṣasi
verses.en: Deft-handed men with stones, the ten swift fingers, drain thee into waters, thee, the Steer enriched with sweets. Thou, Soma, gladdening Indra, and the Heavenly Host, flowest as Pavamana like a river's wave.

verses.sa:
प्र सोमस्य पवमानस्योर्मय इन्द्रस्य यन्ति जठरं सुपेशसः ।
दध्ना यदीमुन्नीता यशसा गवां दानाय शूरमुदमन्दिषुः सुताः॥
verses.tr: pra somasya pavamānasyormaya indrasya yanti jaṭharaṃ supeśasaḥ dadhnā yadīmunnītā yaśasā gavāṃ dānāya śūramudamandiṣuḥ sutāḥ
verses.en: Onward to Indra's throat move, beauteously adorned, the waves of Soma as he purifies himself, When they, brought forward with the lovely curd of kine, effused, have cheered the Hero to bestow his gifts.

verses.sa:
अच्छा हि सोमः कलशाँ असिष्यददत्यो न वोळ्हा रघुवर्तनिर्वृषा ।
अथा देवानामुभयस्य जन्मनो विद्वाँ अश्नोत्यमुत इतश्च यत्॥
verses.tr: acchā hi somaḥ kalaśāṃ asiṣyadadatyo na voḻhā raghuvartanirvṛṣā athā devānāmubhayasya janmano vidvāṃ aśnotyamuta itaśca yat
verses.en: Hither hath Soma flowed unto the beakers, like a chariot-horse, a stallion swift upon his way. Thus, knowing both the generations, he obtains the rights and dues of Gods from yonder and from hence.

verses.sa:
आ नः सोम पवमानः किरा वस्विन्दो भव मघवा राधसो महः ।
शिक्षा वयोधो वसवे सु चेतुना मा नो गयमारे अस्मत्परा सिचः॥
verses.tr: ā naḥ soma pavamānaḥ kirā vasvindo bhava maghavā rādhaso mahaḥ śikṣā vayodho vasave su cetunā mā no gayamāre asmatparā sicaḥ
verses.en: While thou art cleansed, O Soma, scatter wealth on us; Indu, bestow great bounty as a liberal Prince. Giver of life, with wisdom help to opulence; strew not our home possessions far away from us.

verses.sa:
आ नः पूषा पवमानः सुरातयो मित्रो गच्छन्तु वरुणः सजोषसः ।
बृहस्पतिर्मरुतो वायुरश्विना त्वष्टा सविता सुयमा सरस्वती॥
verses.tr: ā naḥ pūṣā pavamānaḥ surātayo mitro gacchantu varuṇaḥ sajoṣasaḥ bṛhaspatirmaruto vāyuraśvinā tvaṣṭā savitā suyamā sarasvatī
verses.en: Hither let Pusan Pavamana come to us, Varuna, Mitra, bountiful, of one accord, The Maruts, Asvins, Vayu, and Brhaspati, Savitar, Tvastar, tractable Sarasvati.

verses.sa:
उभे द्यावापृथिवी विश्वमिन्वे अर्यमा देवो अदितिर्विधाता ।
भगो नृशंस उर्व१न्तरिक्षं विश्वे देवाः पवमानं जुषन्त॥
verses.tr: ubhe dyāvāpṛthivī viśvaminve aryamā devo aditirvidhātā bhago nṛśaṃsa urva1ntarikṣaṃ viśve devāḥ pavamānaṃ juṣanta
verses.en: Both Heaven and Earth, the all-invigorating Pair, Vidhatar, Aditi, and Aryaman the God, Bhaga who blesses men, the spacious Firmament,-let all the Gods in Pavamana take delight.

verses.sa:
असावि सोमो अरुषो वृषा हरी राजेव दस्मो अभि गा अचिक्रदत् ।
पुनानो वारं पर्येत्यव्ययं श्येनो न योनिं घृतवन्तमासदम्॥
verses.tr: asāvi somo aruṣo vṛṣā harī rājeva dasmo abhi gā acikradat punāno vāraṃ paryetyavyayaṃ śyeno na yoniṃ ghṛtavantamāsadam
verses.en: Even as a King hath Soma, red and tawny Bull, been pressed: the Wondrous One hath bellowed to the kine. While purified he passes through the filtering fleece to seat him hawk-like on the place that drops with oil.

verses.sa:
कविर्वेधस्या पर्येषि माहिनमत्यो न मृष्टो अभि वाजमर्षसि ।
अपसेधन्दुरिता सोम मृळय घृतं वसानः परि यासि निर्णिजम्॥
verses.tr: kavirvedhasyā paryeṣi māhinamatyo na mṛṣṭo abhi vājamarṣasi apasedhanduritā soma mṛḻaya ghṛtaṃ vasānaḥ pari yāsi nirṇijam
verses.en: To glory goest thou, Sage with disposing skill, like a groomed steed thou rushest forward to the prize. O Soma, be thou gracious, driving off distress: thou goest, clothed in butter, to a robe of state.

verses.sa:
पर्जन्यः पिता महिषस्य पर्णिनो नाभा पृथिव्या गिरिषु क्षयं दधे ।
स्वसार आपो अभि गा उतासरन्त्सं ग्रावभिर्नसते वीते अध्वरे॥
verses.tr: parjanyaḥ pitā mahiṣasya parṇino nābhā pṛthivyā giriṣu kṣayaṃ dadhe svasāra āpo abhi gā utāsarantsaṃ grāvabhirnasate vīte adhvare
verses.en: Parjanya is the Father of the Mighty Bird: on mountains, in earth's centre hath he made his home. The waters too have flowed, the Sisters, to the kine: he meets the pressing-stones at the beloved rite.

verses.sa:
जायेव पत्यावधि शेव मंहसे पज्राया गर्भ शृणुहि ब्रवीमि ते ।
अन्तर्वाणीषु प्र चरा सु जीवसेऽनिन्द्यो वृजने सोम जागृहि॥
verses.tr: jāyeva patyāvadhi śeva maṃhase pajrāyā garbha śṛṇuhi bravīmi te antarvāṇīṣu pra carā su jīvase'nindyo vṛjane soma jāgṛhi
verses.en: Thou givest pleasure as a wife delights her lord. Listen, O Child of Pajri, for to thee I speak. Amid the holy songs go on that we may live: in time of trouble, Soma, watch thou free from blame.

verses.sa:
यथा पूर्वेभ्यः शतसा अमृध्रः सहस्रसाः पर्यया वाजमिन्दो ।
एवा पवस्व सुविताय नव्यसे तव व्रतमन्वापः सचन्ते॥
verses.tr: yathā pūrvebhyaḥ śatasā amṛdhraḥ sahasrasāḥ paryayā vājamindo evā pavasva suvitāya navyase tava vratamanvāpaḥ sacante
verses.en: As to the men of old thou camest, Indu unharmed, to strengthen, winning hundreds, thousands, So now for new felicity flow onward: the waters follow as thy law ordaineth.

verses.sa:
पवित्रं ते विततं ब्रह्मणस्पते प्रभुर्गात्राणि पर्येषि विश्वतः ।
अतप्ततनूर्न तदामो अश्नुते शृतास इद्वहन्तस्तत्समाशत॥
verses.tr: pavitraṃ te vitataṃ brahmaṇaspate prabhurgātrāṇi paryeṣi viśvataḥ ataptatanūrna tadāmo aśnute śṛtāsa idvahantastatsamāśata
verses.en: Spread is thy cleansing filter, Brahmanaspati: as Prince, thou enterest its limbs from every side. The raw, whose mass hath not been heated gains not this: they only which are dressed, which bear, attain to it.

verses.sa:
तपोष्पवित्रं विततं दिवस्पदे शोचन्तो अस्य तन्तवो व्यस्थिरन् ।
अवन्त्यस्य पवीतारमाशवो दिवस्पृष्ठमधि तिष्ठन्ति चेतसा॥
verses.tr: tapoṣpavitraṃ vitataṃ divaspade śocanto asya tantavo vyasthiran avantyasya pavītāramāśavo divaspṛṣṭhamadhi tiṣṭhanti cetasā
verses.en: High in the seat of heaven is spread the Scorcher's sieve: its threads are standing separate, glittering with light. The Swift Ones favour him who purifieth this: with consciousness they stand upon the height of heaven.

verses.sa:
अरूरुचदुषसः पृश्निरग्रिय उक्षा बिभर्ति भुवनानि वाजयुः ।
मायाविनो ममिरे अस्य मायया नृचक्षसः पितरो गर्भमा दधुः॥
verses.tr: arūrucaduṣasaḥ pṛśniragriya ukṣā bibharti bhuvanāni vājayuḥ māyāvino mamire asya māyayā nṛcakṣasaḥ pitaro garbhamā dadhuḥ
verses.en: The foremost spotted Steer hath made the Mornings shine, and yearning after strength sustains all things that be. By his high wisdom have the mighty Sages wrought: the Fathers who behold mankind laid down the germ,

verses.sa:
गन्धर्व इत्था पदमस्य रक्षति पाति देवानां जनिमान्यद्भुतः ।
गृभ्णाति रिपुं निधया निधापतिः सुकृत्तमा मधुनो भक्षमाशत॥
verses.tr: gandharva itthā padamasya rakṣati pāti devānāṃ janimānyadbhutaḥ gṛbhṇāti ripuṃ nidhayā nidhāpatiḥ sukṛttamā madhuno bhakṣamāśata
verses.en: Gandharva verily protects his dwelling place; Wondrous, he guards the generations of the Gods. Lord of the snare, he takes the foeman with the snare: those who are most devout have gained a share of meath.

verses.sa:
हविर्हविष्मो महि सद्म दैव्यं नभो वसानः परि यास्यध्वरम् ।
राजा पवित्ररथो वाजमारुहः सहस्रभृष्टिर्जयसि श्रवो बृहत्॥
verses.tr: havirhaviṣmo mahi sadma daivyaṃ nabho vasānaḥ pari yāsyadhvaram rājā pavitraratho vājamāruhaḥ sahasrabhṛṣṭirjayasi śravo bṛhat
verses.en: Rich in oblations! robed in cloud, thou compassest oblation, sacrifice, the mighty seat of Gods. King, on thy chariot-sieve thou goest up to war, and with a thousand weapons winnest lofty fame.

verses.sa:
पवस्व देवमादनो विचर्षणिरप्सा इन्द्राय वरुणाय वायवे ।
कृधी नो अद्य वरिवः स्वस्तिमदुरुक्षितौ गृणीहि दैव्यं जनम्॥
verses.tr: pavasva devamādano vicarṣaṇirapsā indrāya varuṇāya vāyave kṛdhī no adya varivaḥ svastimadurukṣitau gṛṇīhi daivyaṃ janam
verses.en: Flow, cheering Gods, most active, winner of the flood, for Indra, and for Vayu, and for Varuna. Bestow on us to-day wide room with happiness, and in thine ample dwelling laud the Host of Heaven.

verses.sa:
आ यस्तस्थौ भुवनान्यमर्त्यो विश्वानि सोमः परि तान्यर्षति ।
कृण्वन्त्संचृतं विचृतमभिष्टय इन्दुः सिषक्त्युषसं न सूर्यः॥
verses.tr: ā yastasthau bhuvanānyamartyo viśvāni somaḥ pari tānyarṣati kṛṇvantsaṃcṛtaṃ vicṛtamabhiṣṭaya induḥ siṣaktyuṣasaṃ na sūryaḥ
verses.en: He who hath come anear to creatures that have life, Immortal Soma flows onward to all of them. Effecting, for our aid, both union and release, Indu, like Surya, follows closely after Dawn.

verses.sa:
आ यो गोभिः सृज्यत ओषधीष्वा देवानां सुम्न इषयन्नुपावसुः ।
आ विद्युता पवते धारया सुत इन्द्रं सोमो मादयन्दैव्यं जनम्॥
verses.tr: ā yo gobhiḥ sṛjyata oṣadhīṣvā devānāṃ sumna iṣayannupāvasuḥ ā vidyutā pavate dhārayā suta indraṃ somo mādayandaivyaṃ janam
verses.en: He who is poured with milk, he who within the plants hastes bringing treasure for the happiness of Gods, He, poured forth in a stream flows with the lightning's flash, Soma who gladdens Indra and the Host of Heaven.

verses.sa:
एष स्य सोमः पवते सहस्रजिद्धिन्वानो वाचमिषिरामुषर्बुधम् ।
इन्दुः समुद्रमुदियर्ति वायुभिरेन्द्रस्य हार्दि कलशेषु सीदति॥
verses.tr: eṣa sya somaḥ pavate sahasrajiddhinvāno vācamiṣirāmuṣarbudham induḥ samudramudiyarti vāyubhirendrasya hārdi kalaśeṣu sīdati
verses.en: Winner of thousands, he, this Soma, flows along, raising a vigorous voice that wakens with the dawn. Indu with winds drives on the ocean of the air, he sinks within the jars, he rests in Indra's heart.

verses.sa:
अभि त्यं गावः पयसा पयोवृधं सोमं श्रीणन्ति मतिभिः स्वर्विदम् ।
धनंजयः पवते कृत्व्यो रसो विप्रः कविः काव्येना स्वर्चनाः॥
verses.tr: abhi tyaṃ gāvaḥ payasā payovṛdhaṃ somaṃ śrīṇanti matibhiḥ svarvidam dhanaṃjayaḥ pavate kṛtvyo raso vipraḥ kaviḥ kāvyenā svarcanāḥ
verses.en: The kine with milk dress him who makes the milk increase, Soma, amid the songs, who finds the light of heaven. Winner of wealth, the effectual juice is flowing on, Singer and Sage by wisdom, dear as heaven itself.

verses.sa:
इन्द्राय सोम सुषुतः परि स्रवाऽपामीवा भवतु रक्षसा सह ।
मा ते रसस्य मत्सत द्वयाविनो द्रविणस्वन्त इह सन्त्विन्दवः॥
verses.tr: indrāya soma suṣutaḥ pari sravā'pāmīvā bhavatu rakṣasā saha mā te rasasya matsata dvayāvino draviṇasvanta iha santvindavaḥ
verses.en: Flow on to Indra, Soma, carefully effused: let sickness stay afar together with the fiends. Let not the double-tongued delight them with thy juice. here be thy flowing drops laden with opulence.

verses.sa:
अस्मान्त्समर्ये पवमान चोदय दक्षो देवानामसि हि प्रियो मदः ।
जहि शत्रूँरभ्या भन्दनायतः पिबेन्द्र सोममव नो मृधो जहि॥
verses.tr: asmāntsamarye pavamāna codaya dakṣo devānāmasi hi priyo madaḥ jahi śatrūṃrabhyā bhandanāyataḥ pibendra somamava no mṛdho jahi
verses.en: O Pavamana, urge us forward in the fight thou art the vigour of the Gods, the well-loved drink. Smite thou our enemies who raise the shout of joy: Indra, drink Soma juice, and drive away our foes.

verses.sa:
अदब्ध इन्दो पवसे मदिन्तम आत्मेन्द्रस्य भवसि धासिरुत्तमः ।
अभि स्वरन्ति बहवो मनीषिणो राजानमस्य भुवनस्य निंसते॥
verses.tr: adabdha indo pavase madintama ātmendrasya bhavasi dhāsiruttamaḥ abhi svaranti bahavo manīṣiṇo rājānamasya bhuvanasya niṃsate
verses.en: Unharmed, best Cheerer, thou, O Indu, flowest on: thou, even thou thyself, art Indra's noblest food. Full many a wise man lifts to thee the song of praise, and hails thee with a kiss as Sovran of this world.

verses.sa:
सहस्रणीथः शतधारो अद्भुत इन्द्रायेन्दुः पवते काम्यं मधु ।
जयन्क्षेत्रमभ्यर्षा जयन्नप उरुं नो गातुं कृणु सोम मीढ्वः॥
verses.tr: sahasraṇīthaḥ śatadhāro adbhuta indrāyenduḥ pavate kāmyaṃ madhu jayankṣetramabhyarṣā jayannapa uruṃ no gātuṃ kṛṇu soma mīḍhvaḥ
verses.en: Wondrous, with hundred streams, hymned in a thousand songs, Indu pours out for Indra his delightful meath. Winning us land and waters, flow thou hitherward: Rainer of bounties, Soma, make broad way for us.

verses.sa:
कनिक्रदत्कलशे गोभिरज्यसे व्य१व्ययं समया वारमर्षसि ।
मर्मृज्यमानो अत्यो न सानसिरिन्द्रस्य सोम जठरे समक्षरः॥
verses.tr: kanikradatkalaśe gobhirajyase vya1vyayaṃ samayā vāramarṣasi marmṛjyamāno atyo na sānasirindrasya soma jaṭhare samakṣaraḥ
verses.en: Roaring within the beaker thou art balmed with milk: thou passest through the fleecy filter all at once. Carefully cleansed and decked like a prizewinning steed, O Soma, thou hast flowed down within Indra's throat.

verses.sa:
स्वादुः पवस्व दिव्याय जन्मने स्वादुरिन्द्राय सुहवीतुनाम्ने ।
स्वादुर्मित्राय वरुणाय वायवे बृहस्पतये मधुमाँ अदाभ्यः॥
verses.tr: svāduḥ pavasva divyāya janmane svādurindrāya suhavītunāmne svādurmitrāya varuṇāya vāyave bṛhaspataye madhumāṃ adābhyaḥ
verses.en: Flow onward sweet of flavour for the Heavenly Race, for Indra sweet, whose name is easily invoked: Flow sweet for Mitra, Varuna, and Vayu, rich in meath, inviolable for Brhaspati.

verses.sa:
अत्यं मृजन्ति कलशे दश क्षिपः प्र विप्राणां मतयो वाच ईरते ।
पवमाना अभ्यर्षन्ति सुष्टुतिमेन्द्रं विशन्ति मदिरास इन्दवः॥
verses.tr: atyaṃ mṛjanti kalaśe daśa kṣipaḥ pra viprāṇāṃ matayo vāca īrate pavamānā abhyarṣanti suṣṭutimendraṃ viśanti madirāsa indavaḥ
verses.en: Ten rapid fingers deck the Courser in the jar: with hymns the holy singers send their voices forth. The filtering juices hasten to their eulogy, the drops that gladden find their way to Indra's heart.

verses.sa:
पवमानो अभ्यर्षा सुवीर्यमुर्वीं गव्यूतिं महि शर्म सप्रथः ।
माकिर्नो अस्य परिषूतिरीशतेन्दो जयेम त्वया धनंधनम्॥
verses.tr: pavamāno abhyarṣā suvīryamurvīṃ gavyūtiṃ mahi śarma saprathaḥ mākirno asya pariṣūtirīśatendo jayema tvayā dhanaṃdhanam
verses.en: While thou art purified pour on us hero strength, great, far-extended shelter, spacious pasturage. Let no oppression master this our holy work: may we, O Indu, gain all opulence through thee.

verses.sa:
अधि द्यामस्थाद्वृषभो विचक्षणोऽरूरुचद्वि दिवो रोचना कविः ।
राजा पवित्रमत्येति रोरुवद्दिवः पीयूषं दुहते नृचक्षसः॥
verses.tr: adhi dyāmasthādvṛṣabho vicakṣaṇo'rūrucadvi divo rocanā kaviḥ rājā pavitramatyeti roruvaddivaḥ pīyūṣaṃ duhate nṛcakṣasaḥ
verses.en: The Steer who sees afar hath risen above the sky: the Sage hath caused the lights of heaven to give their shine. The. King is passing through the filter with a roar: they drain the milk of heaven from him who looks on men.

verses.sa:
दिवो नाके मधुजिह्वा असश्चतो वेना दुहन्त्युक्षणं गिरिष्ठाम् ।
अप्सु द्रप्सं वावृधानं समुद्र आ सिन्धोरूर्मा मधुमन्तं पवित्र आ॥
verses.tr: divo nāke madhujihvā asaścato venā duhantyukṣaṇaṃ giriṣṭhām apsu drapsaṃ vāvṛdhānaṃ samudra ā sindhorūrmā madhumantaṃ pavitra ā
verses.en: High in the vault of heaven, unceasing, honey-tongued, the Loving Ones drain out the mountain-haunting Steer,- The drop that hath grown great in waters, in the lake meath-rich, in the stream's wave and in the cleansing sieve.

verses.sa:
नाके सुपर्णमुपपप्तिवांसं गिरो वेनानामकृपन्त पूर्वीः ।
शिशुं रिहन्ति मतयः पनिप्नतं हिरण्ययं शकुनं क्षामणि स्थाम्॥
verses.tr: nāke suparṇamupapaptivāṃsaṃ giro venānāmakṛpanta pūrvīḥ śiśuṃ rihanti matayaḥ panipnataṃ hiraṇyayaṃ śakunaṃ kṣāmaṇi sthām
verses.en: The Loving Ones besought with many voices the Eagle who had flown away to heaven. Hymns kiss the Youngling worthy of laudation, resting on earth, the Bird of golden colour.

verses.sa:
ऊर्ध्वो गन्धर्वो अधि नाके अस्थाद्विश्वा रूपा प्रतिचक्षाणो अस्य ।
भानुः शुक्रेण शोचिषा व्यद्यौत्प्रारूरुचद्रोदसी मातरा शुचिः॥
verses.tr: ūrdhvo gandharvo adhi nāke asthādviśvā rūpā praticakṣāṇo asya bhānuḥ śukreṇa śociṣā vyadyautprārūrucadrodasī mātarā śuciḥ
verses.en: High to heaven's vault hath the Gandharva risen, beholding all his varied forms and figures. His ray hath shone abroad with gleaming splendour: pure, he hath lighted both the worlds, the Parents.

verses.sa:
प्र त आशवः पवमान धीजवो मदा अर्षन्ति रघुजा इव त्मना ।
दिव्याः सुपर्णा मधुमन्त इन्दवो मदिन्तमासः परि कोशमासते॥
verses.tr: pra ta āśavaḥ pavamāna dhījavo madā arṣanti raghujā iva tmanā divyāḥ suparṇā madhumanta indavo madintamāsaḥ pari kośamāsate
verses.en: Thy gladdening draughts, O Pavamana, urged by song flow swiftly of themselves like sons of fleet-foot mares. The drops of Soma juice, those eagles of the heavens, most cheering, rich in meath, rest in the reservoir.

verses.sa:
प्र ते मदासो मदिरास आशवोऽसृक्षत रथ्यासो यथा पृथक् ।
धेनुर्न वत्सं पयसाभि वज्रिणमिन्द्रमिन्दवो मधुमन्त ऊर्मयः॥
verses.tr: pra te madāso madirāsa āśavo'sṛkṣata rathyāso yathā pṛthak dhenurna vatsaṃ payasābhi vajriṇamindramindavo madhumanta ūrmayaḥ
verses.en: As rapid chariot-steeds, so turned in several ways have thine exhilarating juices darted forth, Soma-drops rich in meath, waves, to the Thunder-armed, to Indra, like milch-kine who seek their calf with milk.

verses.sa:
अत्यो न हियानो अभि वाजमर्ष स्वर्वित्कोशं दिवो अद्रिमातरम् ।
वृषा पवित्रे अधि सानो अव्यये सोमः पुनान इन्द्रियाय धायसे॥
verses.tr: atyo na hiyāno abhi vājamarṣa svarvitkośaṃ divo adrimātaram vṛṣā pavitre adhi sāno avyaye somaḥ punāna indriyāya dhāyase
verses.en: Like a steed urged to battle, finder of the light; speed onward to the cloud-born reservoir of heaven, A Steer that o'er the woolly surface seeks the sieve, Soma while purified for Indra's nourishment.

verses.sa:
प्र त आश्विनीः पवमान धीजुवो दिव्या असृग्रन्पयसा धरीमणि ।
प्रान्तॠषयः स्थाविरीरसृक्षत ये त्वा मृजन्त्यृषिषाण वेधसः॥
verses.tr: pra ta āśvinīḥ pavamāna dhījuvo divyā asṛgranpayasā dharīmaṇi prāntaṝṣayaḥ sthāvirīrasṛkṣata ye tvā mṛjantyṛṣiṣāṇa vedhasaḥ
verses.en: Fleet as swift steeds, thy drops, divine, thought-swift, have been, O Pavamana, poured with milk into the vat. The Rsis have poured in continuous Soma drops, ordainers who adorn thee, Friend whom Rsis love.

verses.sa:
विश्वा धामानि विश्वचक्ष ऋभ्वसः प्रभोस्ते सतः परि यन्ति केतवः ।
व्यानशिः पवसे सोम धर्मभिः पतिर्विश्वस्य भुवनस्य राजसि॥
verses.tr: viśvā dhāmāni viśvacakṣa ṛbhvasaḥ prabhoste sataḥ pari yanti ketavaḥ vyānaśiḥ pavase soma dharmabhiḥ patirviśvasya bhuvanasya rājasi
verses.en: O thou who seest all things, Sovran as thou art and passing strong, thy rays encompass all abodes. Pervading with thy natural powers thou flowest on, and as the whole world's Lord, O Soma, thou art King.

verses.sa:
उभयतः पवमानस्य रश्मयो ध्रुवस्य सतः परि यन्ति केतवः ।
यदी पवित्रे अधि मृज्यते हरिः सत्ता नि योना कलशेषु सीदति॥
verses.tr: ubhayataḥ pavamānasya raśmayo dhruvasya sataḥ pari yanti ketavaḥ yadī pavitre adhi mṛjyate hariḥ sattā ni yonā kalaśeṣu sīdati
verses.en: The beams of Pavamana, sent from earth and heaven, his ensigns who is ever steadfast, travel round. When on the sieve the Golden-hued is cleansed, he rests within the vats as one who seats him in his place.

verses.sa:
यज्ञस्य केतुः पवते स्वध्वरः सोमो देवानामुप याति निष्कृतम् ।
सहस्रधारः परि कोशमर्षति वृषा पवित्रमत्येति रोरुवत्॥
verses.tr: yajñasya ketuḥ pavate svadhvaraḥ somo devānāmupa yāti niṣkṛtam sahasradhāraḥ pari kośamarṣati vṛṣā pavitramatyeti roruvat
verses.en: Served with fair rites he flows, ensign of sacrifice: Soma advances to the special place of Gods. He speeds with thousand currents to the reservoir, and passes through the filter bellowing as a bull.

verses.sa:
राजा समुद्रं नद्यो३ वि गाहतेऽपामूर्मिं सचते सिन्धुषु श्रितः ।
अध्यस्थात्सानु पवमानो अव्ययं नाभा पृथिव्या धरुणो महो दिवः॥
verses.tr: rājā samudraṃ nadyo3 vi gāhate'pāmūrmiṃ sacate sindhuṣu śritaḥ adhyasthātsānu pavamāno avyayaṃ nābhā pṛthivyā dharuṇo maho divaḥ
verses.en: The Sovran dips him in the sea in and the streams, and set in rivers with the waters' wave moves on. High heaven's Sustainer at the central point of earth, raised on the fleecy surface Pavamana stands.

verses.sa:
दिवो न सानु स्तनयन्नचिक्रदद्द्यौश्च यस्य पृथिवी च धर्मभिः ।
इन्द्रस्य सख्यं पवते विवेविदत्सोमः पुनानः कलशेषु सीदति॥
verses.tr: divo na sānu stanayannacikradaddyauśca yasya pṛthivī ca dharmabhiḥ indrasya sakhyaṃ pavate vivevidatsomaḥ punānaḥ kalaśeṣu sīdati
verses.en: He on whose high decree the heavens and earth depend hath roared and thundered like the summit of the sky. Soma flows on obtaining Indra's friendly love, and, as they purify him, settles in the jars.

verses.sa:
ज्योतिर्यज्ञस्य पवते मधु प्रियं पिता देवानां जनिता विभूवसुः ।
दधाति रत्नं स्वधयोरपीच्यं मदिन्तमो मत्सर इन्द्रियो रसः॥
verses.tr: jyotiryajñasya pavate madhu priyaṃ pitā devānāṃ janitā vibhūvasuḥ dadhāti ratnaṃ svadhayorapīcyaṃ madintamo matsara indriyo rasaḥ
verses.en: He, light of sacrifice distils delicious meath, most wealthy, Father and begetter of the Gods. He, gladdening, best of Cheerers, juice hat Indra loves, enriches with mysterious treasure earth and heaven.

verses.sa:
अभिक्रन्दन्कलशं वाज्यर्षति पतिर्दिवः शतधारो विचक्षणः ।
हरिर्मित्रस्य सदनेषु सीदति मर्मृजानोऽविभिः सिन्धुभिर्वृषा॥
verses.tr: abhikrandankalaśaṃ vājyarṣati patirdivaḥ śatadhāro vicakṣaṇaḥ harirmitrasya sadaneṣu sīdati marmṛjāno'vibhiḥ sindhubhirvṛṣā
verses.en: The vigorous and far-seeing one, the Lord of heaven, flows, shouting to the beaker, with his thousand streams. Coloured like gold he rests in seats where Mitra dwells, the Steer made beautiful by rivers and by sheep.

verses.sa:
अग्रे सिन्धूनां पवमानो अर्षत्यग्रे वाचो अग्रियो गोषु गच्छति ।
अग्रे वाजस्य भजते महाधनं स्वायुधः सोतृभिः पूयते वृषा॥
verses.tr: agre sindhūnāṃ pavamāno arṣatyagre vāco agriyo goṣu gacchati agre vājasya bhajate mahādhanaṃ svāyudhaḥ sotṛbhiḥ pūyate vṛṣā
verses.en: In forefront of the rivers Pavamana speeds, in forefront of the hymn, foremost among the kine. He shares the mighty booty in the van of war: the well-armed Steer is purified by worshippers.

verses.sa:
अयं मतवाञ्छकुनो यथा हितोऽव्ये ससार पवमान ऊर्मिणा ।
तव क्रत्वा रोदसी अन्तरा कवे शुचिर्धिया पवते सोम इन्द्र ते॥
verses.tr: ayaṃ matavāñchakuno yathā hito'vye sasāra pavamāna ūrmiṇā tava kratvā rodasī antarā kave śucirdhiyā pavate soma indra te
verses.en: This heedful Pavamana, like a bird sent forth, hath with his wave flowed onward to the fleecy sieve. O Indra, through thy wisdom, b thy thought, O Sage, Soma flows bright and pure between the earth and heaven.

verses.sa:
द्रापिं वसानो यजतो दिविस्पृशमन्तरिक्षप्रा भुवनेष्वर्पितः ।
स्वर्जज्ञानो नभसाभ्यक्रमीत्प्रत्नमस्य पितरमा विवासति॥
verses.tr: drāpiṃ vasāno yajato divispṛśamantarikṣaprā bhuvaneṣvarpitaḥ svarjajñāno nabhasābhyakramītpratnamasya pitaramā vivāsati
verses.en: He, clad in mail that reaches heaven, the Holy One, filling the firmament stationed amid the worlds, Knowing. the realm of light, hath come to us in rain: he summons to himself his own primeval Sire.

verses.sa:
सो अस्य विशे महि शर्म यच्छति यो अस्य धाम प्रथमं व्यानशे ।
पदं यदस्य परमे व्योमन्यतो विश्वा अभि सं याति संयतः॥
verses.tr: so asya viśe mahi śarma yacchati yo asya dhāma prathamaṃ vyānaśe padaṃ yadasya parame vyomanyato viśvā abhi saṃ yāti saṃyataḥ
verses.en: He who was first of all to penetrate his form bestowed upon his race wide shelter and defense. From that high station which he hath in loftiest heaven he comes victorious to all encounters here.

verses.sa:
प्रो अयासीदिन्दुरिन्द्रस्य निष्कृतं सखा सख्युर्न प्र मिनाति संगिरम् ।
मर्य इव युवतिभिः समर्षति सोमः कलशे शतयाम्ना पथा॥
verses.tr: pro ayāsīdindurindrasya niṣkṛtaṃ sakhā sakhyurna pra mināti saṃgiram marya iva yuvatibhiḥ samarṣati somaḥ kalaśe śatayāmnā pathā
verses.en: Indu hath started for Indra's special place and slights not as a Friend the promise of his Friend. Soma speeds onward like a youth to youthful maids, and gains the beaker by a course of hundred paths.

verses.sa:
प्र वो धियो मन्द्रयुवो विपन्युवः पनस्युवः संवसनेष्वक्रमुः ।
सोमं मनीषा अभ्यनूषत स्तुभोऽभि धेनवः पयसेमशिश्रयुः॥
verses.tr: pra vo dhiyo mandrayuvo vipanyuvaḥ panasyuvaḥ saṃvasaneṣvakramuḥ somaṃ manīṣā abhyanūṣata stubho'bhi dhenavaḥ payasemaśiśrayuḥ
verses.en: Your songs, exhilarating, tuneful, uttering praise, are come into the plains where the people meet. Worshippers have exalted Soma with their hymns, and milch kine have come near to meet him with their milk.

verses.sa:
आ नः सोम संयतं पिप्युषीमिषमिन्दो पवस्व पवमानो अस्रिधम् ।
या नो दोहते त्रिरहन्नसश्चुषी क्षुमद्वाजवन्मधुमत्सुवीर्यम्॥
verses.tr: ā naḥ soma saṃyataṃ pipyuṣīmiṣamindo pavasva pavamāno asridham yā no dohate trirahannasaścuṣī kṣumadvājavanmadhumatsuvīryam
verses.en: O Soma, Indu, while they cleanse thee, pour on us accumulateds Plentiful, nutritious food, Which, ceaseless, thrice a day shall yield us hero power enriched with store of nourishment, and strength, and Meath.

verses.sa:
वृषा मतीनां पवते विचक्षणः सोमो अह्नः प्रतरीतोषसो दिवः ।
क्राणा सिन्धूनां कलशाँ अवीवशदिन्द्रस्य हार्द्याविशन्मनीषिभिः॥
verses.tr: vṛṣā matīnāṃ pavate vicakṣaṇaḥ somo ahnaḥ pratarītoṣaso divaḥ krāṇā sindhūnāṃ kalaśāṃ avīvaśadindrasya hārdyāviśanmanīṣibhiḥ
verses.en: Far-seeing Soma flows, the Steer, the Lord of hymns, the Furtherer of day, of morning, and of heaven. Mixt with the streams he caused the beakers to resound, and with the singers' aid they entered Indra's heart.

verses.sa:
मनीषिभिः पवते पूर्व्यः कविर्नृभिर्यतः परि कोशाँ अचिक्रदत् ।
त्रितस्य नाम जनयन्मधु क्षरदिन्द्रस्य वायोः सख्याय कर्तवे॥
verses.tr: manīṣibhiḥ pavate pūrvyaḥ kavirnṛbhiryataḥ pari kośāṃ acikradat tritasya nāma janayanmadhu kṣaradindrasya vāyoḥ sakhyāya kartave
verses.en: On, with the prudent singers, flows the ancient Sage and guided by the men hath roared about the vats. Producing Trita's name, may he pour forth the meath, that Vayu and that Indra may become his Friends.

verses.sa:
अयं पुनान उषसो वि रोचयदयं सिन्धुभ्यो अभवदु लोककृत् ।
अयं त्रिः सप्त दुदुहान आशिरं सोमो हृदे पवते चारु मत्सरः॥
verses.tr: ayaṃ punāna uṣaso vi rocayadayaṃ sindhubhyo abhavadu lokakṛt ayaṃ triḥ sapta duduhāna āśiraṃ somo hṛde pavate cāru matsaraḥ
verses.en: He, being purified, hath made the Mornings shine: this, even this is he who gave the rivers room. He made the Three Times Seven pour out the milky flow: Soma, the Cheerer, yields whate'er the heart finds sweet.

verses.sa:
पवस्व सोम दिव्येषु धामसु सृजान इन्दो कलशे पवित्र आ ।
सीदन्निन्द्रस्य जठरे कनिक्रदन्नृभिर्यतः सूर्यमारोहयो दिवि॥
verses.tr: pavasva soma divyeṣu dhāmasu sṛjāna indo kalaśe pavitra ā sīdannindrasya jaṭhare kanikradannṛbhiryataḥ sūryamārohayo divi
verses.en: Flow, onward, Soma, in thine own celestial forms, flow, Indu, poured within the beaker and the sieve. Sinking into the throat of Indra with a roar, led by the men thou madest Surya mount to heaven.

verses.sa:
अद्रिभिः सुतः पवसे पवित्र आँ इन्दविन्द्रस्य जठरेष्वाविशन् ।
त्वं नृचक्षा अभवो विचक्षण सोम गोत्रमङ्गिरोभ्योऽवृणोरप॥
verses.tr: adribhiḥ sutaḥ pavase pavitra āṃ indavindrasya jaṭhareṣvāviśan tvaṃ nṛcakṣā abhavo vicakṣaṇa soma gotramaṅgirobhyo'vṛṇorapa
verses.en: Pressed out with stones thou flowest onward to the sieve, O Indu, entering the depths of Indra's throat. Far-sighted Soma, now thou lookest on mankind: thou didst unbar the cowstall for the Angirases.

verses.sa:
त्वां सोम पवमानं स्वाध्योऽनु विप्रासो अमदन्नवस्यवः ।
त्वां सुपर्ण आभरद्दिवस्परीन्दो विश्वाभिर्मतिभिः परिष्कृतम्॥
verses.tr: tvāṃ soma pavamānaṃ svādhyo'nu viprāso amadannavasyavaḥ tvāṃ suparṇa ābharaddivasparīndo viśvābhirmatibhiḥ pariṣkṛtam
verses.en: In thee, O Soma, while thou purifitedst thee, high-thoughted sages, seeking favour, have rejoiced. Down from the heavens the Falcon brought thee hitherward, even thee, O Indu, thee whom all our hymns adorn.

verses.sa:
अव्ये पुनानं परि वार ऊर्मिणा हरिं नवन्ते अभि सप्त धेनवः ।
अपामुपस्थे अध्यायवः कविमृतस्य योना महिषा अहेषत॥
verses.tr: avye punānaṃ pari vāra ūrmiṇā hariṃ navante abhi sapta dhenavaḥ apāmupasthe adhyāyavaḥ kavimṛtasya yonā mahiṣā aheṣata
verses.en: Seven Milch-kine glorify the Tawny-coloured One while with his wave in wool he purifies himself. The living men, the mighty, have impelled the Sage into the waters' lap, the place of sacrifice.

verses.sa:
इन्दुः पुनानो अति गाहते मृधो विश्वानि कृण्वन्त्सुपथानि यज्यवे ।
गाः कृण्वानो निर्णिजं हर्यतः कविरत्यो न क्रीळन्परि वारमर्षति॥
verses.tr: induḥ punāno ati gāhate mṛdho viśvāni kṛṇvantsupathāni yajyave gāḥ kṛṇvāno nirṇijaṃ haryataḥ kaviratyo na krīḻanpari vāramarṣati
verses.en: Indu, attaining purity, plunges through the foe, making his ways all easy for the pious man. Making the kine his mantle, he, the lovely Sage, runs like a sporting courser onward through the fleece.

verses.sa:
असश्चतः शतधारा अभिश्रियो हरिं नवन्तेऽव ता उदन्युवः ।
क्षिपो मृजन्ति परि गोभिरावृतं तृतीये पृष्ठे अधि रोचने दिवः॥
verses.tr: asaścataḥ śatadhārā abhiśriyo hariṃ navante'va tā udanyuvaḥ kṣipo mṛjanti pari gobhirāvṛtaṃ tṛtīye pṛṣṭhe adhi rocane divaḥ
verses.en: The ceaseless watery fountains with their hundred streams sing, as they hasten near, to him the Golden-hued Him, clad in robes of milk, swift fingers beautify on the third height and in the luminous realm of heaven.

verses.sa:
तवेमाः प्रजा दिव्यस्य रेतसस्त्वं विश्वस्य भुवनस्य राजसि ।
अथेदं विश्वं पवमान ते वशे त्वमिन्दो प्रथमो धामधा असि॥
verses.tr: tavemāḥ prajā divyasya retasastvaṃ viśvasya bhuvanasya rājasi athedaṃ viśvaṃ pavamāna te vaśe tvamindo prathamo dhāmadhā asi
verses.en: These are thy generations of celestial seed thou art the Sovran Lord of all the world of life. This universe, O Pavamana, owns thy sway; thou, Indu, art the first establisher of Law.

verses.sa:
त्वं समुद्रो असि विश्ववित्कवे तवेमाः पञ्च प्रदिशो विधर्मणि ।
त्वं द्यां च पृथिवीं चाति जभ्रिषे तव ज्योतींषि पवमान सूर्यः॥
verses.tr: tvaṃ samudro asi viśvavitkave tavemāḥ pañca pradiśo vidharmaṇi tvaṃ dyāṃ ca pṛthivīṃ cāti jabhriṣe tava jyotīṃṣi pavamāna sūryaḥ
verses.en: Thou art the sea, O Sage who bringest all to light: under thy Law are these five regions of the world. Tlou reachest out beyond the earth, beyond the heavens: thine are the lights, O Pavamana, thine the Sun.

verses.sa:
त्वं पवित्रे रजसो विधर्मणि देवेभ्यः सोम पवमान पूयसे ।
त्वामुशिजः प्रथमा अगृभ्णत तुभ्येमा विश्वा भुवनानि येमिरे॥
verses.tr: tvaṃ pavitre rajaso vidharmaṇi devebhyaḥ soma pavamāna pūyase tvāmuśijaḥ prathamā agṛbhṇata tubhyemā viśvā bhuvanāni yemire
verses.en: Thou in the filter, Soma Pavamana, art purified to support the region for the Gods. The chief, the longing ones have sought to hold thee fast, and all these living creatures have been turned to thee.

verses.sa:
प्र रेभ एत्यति वारमव्ययं वृषा वनेष्वव चक्रदद्धरिः ।
सं धीतयो वावशाना अनूषत शिशुं रिहन्ति मतयः पनिप्नतम्॥
verses.tr: pra rebha etyati vāramavyayaṃ vṛṣā vaneṣvava cakradaddhariḥ saṃ dhītayo vāvaśānā anūṣata śiśuṃ rihanti matayaḥ panipnatam
verses.en: Onward the Singer travels o'er the fleecy sieve. the Tawny Steer hath bellowed in the wooden vats. Hymns have been sung aloud in resonant harmony, and holy songs kiss him, the Child who claims our praise.

verses.sa:
स सूर्यस्य रश्मिभिः परि व्यत तन्तुं तन्वानस्त्रिवृतं यथा विदे ।
नयन्नृतस्य प्रशिषो नवीयसीः पतिर्जनीनामुप याति निष्कृतम्॥
verses.tr: sa sūryasya raśmibhiḥ pari vyata tantuṃ tanvānastrivṛtaṃ yathā vide nayannṛtasya praśiṣo navīyasīḥ patirjanīnāmupa yāti niṣkṛtam
verses.en: He hath assumed the rays of Surya for his robe, spinning, as he knows bow, the triply-twisted thread. He, guiding to the newest rules of Holy Law, comes as the Women's Consort to the special place.

verses.sa:
राजा सिन्धूनां पवते पतिर्दिव ऋतस्य याति पथिभिः कनिक्रदत् ।
सहस्रधारः परि षिच्यते हरिः पुनानो वाचं जनयन्नुपावसुः॥
verses.tr: rājā sindhūnāṃ pavate patirdiva ṛtasya yāti pathibhiḥ kanikradat sahasradhāraḥ pari ṣicyate hariḥ punāno vācaṃ janayannupāvasuḥ
verses.en: On flows the King of rivers and the Lord of heaven: he follows with a shout the paths of Holy Law. The Golden-hued is poured forth, with his hundred streams, Wealth-bringer, lifting up his voice while purified.

verses.sa:
पवमान मह्यर्णो वि धावसि सूरो न चित्रो अव्ययानि पव्यया ।
गभस्तिपूतो नृभिरद्रिभिः सुतो महे वाजाय धन्याय धन्वसि॥
verses.tr: pavamāna mahyarṇo vi dhāvasi sūro na citro avyayāni pavyayā gabhastipūto nṛbhiradribhiḥ suto mahe vājāya dhanyāya dhanvasi
verses.en: Fain to be cleansed, thou, Pavamana, pourest out, like wondrous Surya, through the fleece, an ample sea. Purified with the hands, pressed by the men with stones, thou speedest on to mighty booty-bringing war.

verses.sa:
इषमूर्जं पवमानाभ्यर्षसि श्येनो न वंसु कलशेषु सीदसि ।
इन्द्राय मद्वा मद्यो मदः सुतो दिवो विष्टम्भ उपमो विचक्षणः॥
verses.tr: iṣamūrjaṃ pavamānābhyarṣasi śyeno na vaṃsu kalaśeṣu sīdasi indrāya madvā madyo madaḥ suto divo viṣṭambha upamo vicakṣaṇaḥ
verses.en: Thou, Pavamana, sendest food and power in streams. thou sittest in the beakers as a hawk on trees, For Indra poured as cheering juice to make him glad, as nearest and farseeing bearer-up of heaven.

verses.sa:
सप्त स्वसारो अभि मातरः शिशुं नवं जज्ञानं जेन्यं विपश्चितम् ।
अपां गन्धर्वं दिव्यं नृचक्षसं सोमं विश्वस्य भुवनस्य राजसे॥
verses.tr: sapta svasāro abhi mātaraḥ śiśuṃ navaṃ jajñānaṃ jenyaṃ vipaścitam apāṃ gandharvaṃ divyaṃ nṛcakṣasaṃ somaṃ viśvasya bhuvanasya rājase
verses.en: The Sisters Seven, the Mothers, stand around the Babe, the noble, new-born Infant, skilled in holy song, Gandharva of the floods, divine, beholding men, Soma, that he may reign as King of all the world.

verses.sa:
ईशान इमा भुवनानि वीयसे युजान इन्दो हरितः सुपर्ण्यः ।
तास्ते क्षरन्तु मधुमद्घृतं पयस्तव व्रते सोम तिष्ठन्तु कृष्टयः॥
verses.tr: īśāna imā bhuvanāni vīyase yujāna indo haritaḥ suparṇyaḥ tāste kṣarantu madhumadghṛtaṃ payastava vrate soma tiṣṭhantu kṛṣṭayaḥ
verses.en: As Sovran Lord thereof thou Passest through these worlds, O Indu, harnessing thy tawny well-winged Mares. May they pour forth for thee milk and oil rich in sweets: O Soma, let the folk abide in thy decree.

verses.sa:
त्वं नृचक्षा असि सोम विश्वतः पवमान वृषभ ता वि धावसि ।
स नः पवस्व वसुमद्धिरण्यवद्वयं स्याम भुवनेषु जीवसे॥
verses.tr: tvaṃ nṛcakṣā asi soma viśvataḥ pavamāna vṛṣabha tā vi dhāvasi sa naḥ pavasva vasumaddhiraṇyavadvayaṃ syāma bhuvaneṣu jīvase
verses.en: O Soma, thou beholdest men from every side: O Pavamana, Steer, thou wanderest through these. Pour out upon us wealth in treasure and in gold: may we have strength to live among the things that be.

verses.sa:
गोवित्पवस्व वसुविद्धिरण्यविद्रेतोधा इन्दो भुवनेष्वर्पितः ।
त्वं सुवीरो असि सोम विश्ववित्तं त्वा विप्रा उप गिरेम आसते॥
verses.tr: govitpavasva vasuviddhiraṇyavidretodhā indo bhuvaneṣvarpitaḥ tvaṃ suvīro asi soma viśvavittaṃ tvā viprā upa girema āsate
verses.en: Winner of gold and goods and cattle flow thou on, set as impregner, Indu, mid the worlds of life. Rich in brave men art thou, Soma, who winnest all: these holy singers wait upon thee with the song.

verses.sa:
उन्मध्व ऊर्मिर्वनना अतिष्ठिपदपो वसानो महिषो वि गाहते ।
राजा पवित्ररथो वाजमारुहत्सहस्रभृष्टिर्जयति श्रवो बृहत्॥
verses.tr: unmadhva ūrmirvananā atiṣṭhipadapo vasāno mahiṣo vi gāhate rājā pavitraratho vājamāruhatsahasrabhṛṣṭirjayati śravo bṛhat
verses.en: The wave of flowing meath hath wakened up desires: the Steer enrobed in milk plunges into the streams. Borne on his chariot-sieve the King hath risen to war, and with a thousand rays hath won him high renown.

verses.sa:
स भन्दना उदियर्ति प्रजावतीर्विश्वायुर्विश्वाः सुभरा अहर्दिवि ।
ब्रह्म प्रजावद्रयिमश्वपस्त्यं पीत इन्दविन्द्रमस्मभ्यं याचतात्॥
verses.tr: sa bhandanā udiyarti prajāvatīrviśvāyurviśvāḥ subharā ahardivi brahma prajāvadrayimaśvapastyaṃ pīta indavindramasmabhyaṃ yācatāt
verses.en: Dear to all life, he sends triumphant praises forth, abundant, bringing offspring, each succeeding day. From Indra crave for us, Indu, when thou art quaffed, the blessing that gives children, wealth that harbours steeds.

verses.sa:
सो अग्रे अह्नां हरिर्हर्यतो मदः प्र चेतसा चेतयतत अनु द्युभिः ।
द्वा जना यातयन्नन्तरीयते नरा च शंसं दैव्यं च धर्तरि॥
verses.tr: so agre ahnāṃ harirharyato madaḥ pra cetasā cetayatata anu dyubhiḥ dvā janā yātayannantarīyate narā ca śaṃsaṃ daivyaṃ ca dhartari
verses.en: When days begin, the strong juice, lovely, golden-hued, is recognized by wisdom more and more each day, He, stirring both the Races, goes between the two, the bearer of the word of men and word of Gods.

verses.sa:
अञ्जते व्यञ्जते समञ्जते क्रतुं रिहन्ति मधुनाभ्यञ्जते ।
सिन्धोरुच्छ्वासे पतयन्तमुक्षणं हिरण्यपावाः पशुमासु गृभ्णते॥
verses.tr: añjate vyañjate samañjate kratuṃ rihanti madhunābhyañjate sindhorucchvāse patayantamukṣaṇaṃ hiraṇyapāvāḥ paśumāsu gṛbhṇate
verses.en: They balm him, balm him over balm him thoroughly, caress the mighty strength and balm it with the meath. They seize the flying Steer at the stream's breathing-place: cleansing with gold they grasp the Animal herein.

verses.sa:
विपश्चिते पवमानाय गायत मही न धारात्यन्धो अर्षति ।
