अहिर्न जूर्णामति सर्पति त्वचमत्यो न क्रीळन्नसरद्वृषा हरिः॥
verses.tr: vipaścite pavamānāya gāyata mahī na dhārātyandho arṣati ahirna jūrṇāmati sarpati tvacamatyo na krīḻannasaradvṛṣā hariḥ
verses.en: Sing forth to Pavamana skilled in holy song: the juice is flowing onward like a mighty stream. He glideth like a serpent from his ancient skin, and like a playful horse the Tawny Steer hath run.

verses.sa:
अग्रेगो राजाप्यस्तविष्यते विमानो अह्नां भुवनेष्वर्पितः ।
हरिर्घृतस्नुः सुदृशीको अर्णवो ज्योतीरथः पवते राय ओक्यः॥
verses.tr: agrego rājāpyastaviṣyate vimāno ahnāṃ bhuvaneṣvarpitaḥ harirghṛtasnuḥ sudṛśīko arṇavo jyotīrathaḥ pavate rāya okyaḥ
verses.en: Dweller in floods, King, foremost, he displays his might, set among living things as measurer of days. Distilling oil he flows, fair, billowy, golden-hued, borne on a car of light, sharing one home with wealth.

verses.sa:
असर्जि स्कम्भो दिव उद्यतो मदः परि त्रिधातुर्भुवनान्यर्षति ।
अंशुं रिहन्ति मतयः पनिप्नतं गिरा यदि निर्णिजमृग्मिणो ययुः॥
verses.tr: asarji skambho diva udyato madaḥ pari tridhāturbhuvanānyarṣati aṃśuṃ rihanti matayaḥ panipnataṃ girā yadi nirṇijamṛgmiṇo yayuḥ
verses.en: Loosed is the heavens! support, the uplifted cheering juice: the triply-mingled draught flows round into the worlds. The holy hymns caress the stalk that claims our praise, when singers have approached his beauteous robe with song.

verses.sa:
प्र ते धारा अत्यण्वानि मेष्यः पुनानस्य संयतो यन्ति रंहयः ।
यद्गोभिरिन्दो चम्वोः समज्यस आ सुवानः सोम कलशेषु सीदसि॥
verses.tr: pra te dhārā atyaṇvāni meṣyaḥ punānasya saṃyato yanti raṃhayaḥ yadgobhirindo camvoḥ samajyasa ā suvānaḥ soma kalaśeṣu sīdasi
verses.en: Thy streams that flow forth rapidly collected run over the fine fleece of the sheep as thou art cleansed. When, Indu, thou art balmed with milk within the bowl, thou sinkest in the jars, O Soma, when expressed.

verses.sa:
पवस्व सोम क्रतुविन्न उक्थ्योऽव्यो वारे परि धाव मधु प्रियम् ।
जहि विश्वान्रक्षस इन्दो अत्रिणो बृहद्वदेम विदथे सुवीराः॥
verses.tr: pavasva soma kratuvinna ukthyo'vyo vāre pari dhāva madhu priyam jahi viśvānrakṣasa indo atriṇo bṛhadvadema vidathe suvīrāḥ
verses.en: Winner of' power, flow, Soma, worthy of our laud: run onward to the fleece as well-beloved meath. Destroy, O Indu, all voracious Raksasas. With brave sons in the assembly let our speech be bold.

verses.sa:
प्र तु द्रव परि कोशं नि षीद नृभिः पुनानो अभि वाजमर्ष ।
अश्वं न त्वा वाजिनं मर्जयन्तोऽच्छा बर्ही रशनाभिर्नयन्ति॥
verses.tr: pra tu drava pari kośaṃ ni ṣīda nṛbhiḥ punāno abhi vājamarṣa aśvaṃ na tvā vājinaṃ marjayanto'cchā barhī raśanābhirnayanti
verses.en: Run onward to the reservoir and seat thee: cleansed by the men speed forward to the battle. Making thee beauteous like an able courser, forth to the sacred grass with reins they lead thee.

verses.sa:
स्वायुधः पवते देव इन्दुरशस्तिहा वृजनं रक्षमाणः ।
पिता देवानां जनिता सुदक्षो विष्टम्भो दिवो धरुणः पृथिव्याः॥
verses.tr: svāyudhaḥ pavate deva induraśastihā vṛjanaṃ rakṣamāṇaḥ pitā devānāṃ janitā sudakṣo viṣṭambho divo dharuṇaḥ pṛthivyāḥ
verses.en: Indu, the well-armed God, is flowing onward, who quells the curse and guards from treacherous onslaught, Father, begetter of the Gods, most skillful, the buttress of the heavens and earth's supporter.

verses.sa:
ऋषिर्विप्रः पुरएता जनानामृभुर्धीर उशना काव्येन ।
स चिद्विवेद निहितं यदासामपीच्यं१ गुह्यं नाम गोनाम्॥
verses.tr: ṛṣirvipraḥ puraetā janānāmṛbhurdhīra uśanā kāvyena sa cidviveda nihitaṃ yadāsāmapīcyaṃ1 guhyaṃ nāma gonām
verses.en: Rsi and Sage, the Champion of the people, cleft and sagacious, Usana in wisdom, He hath discovered even their hidden nature, the Cows' concealed and most mysterious title.

verses.sa:
एष स्य ते मधुमाँ इन्द्र सोमो वृषा वृष्णे परि पवित्रे अक्षाः ।
सहस्रसाः शतसा भूरिदावा शश्वत्तमं बर्हिरा वाज्यस्थात्॥
verses.tr: eṣa sya te madhumāṃ indra somo vṛṣā vṛṣṇe pari pavitre akṣāḥ sahasrasāḥ śatasā bhūridāvā śaśvattamaṃ barhirā vājyasthāt
verses.en: This thine own Soma rich in meath, O Indra, Steer for the Steer, hath flowed into the filter. The strong Free-giver, winning hundreds, thousands, hath reached the holy grass that never fails him.

verses.sa:
एते सोमा अभि गव्या सहस्रा महे वाजायामृताय श्रवांसि ।
पवित्रेभिः पवमाना असृग्रञ्छ्रवस्यवो न पृतनाजो अत्याः॥
verses.tr: ete somā abhi gavyā sahasrā mahe vājāyāmṛtāya śravāṃsi pavitrebhiḥ pavamānā asṛgrañchravasyavo na pṛtanājo atyāḥ
verses.en: These Somas are for wealth of countless cattle, renown therefor, and mighty strength immortal. These have been sent forth, purified by strainers, like steeds who rush to battle fain for glory.

verses.sa:
परि हि ष्मा पुरुहूतो जनानां विश्वासरद्भोजना पूयमानः ।
अथा भर श्येनभृत प्रयांसि रयिं तुञ्जानो अभि वाजमर्ष॥
verses.tr: pari hi ṣmā puruhūto janānāṃ viśvāsaradbhojanā pūyamānaḥ athā bhara śyenabhṛta prayāṃsi rayiṃ tuñjāno abhi vājamarṣa
verses.en: He, while he cleanses him, invoked of many, hath flowed to give the people all enjoyment. Thou whom the Falcon brought, bring, dainty viands, bestir thyself and send us wealth and booty.

verses.sa:
एष सुवानः परि सोमः पवित्रे सर्गो न सृष्टो अदधावदर्वा ।
तिग्मे शिशानो महिषो न शृङ्गे गा गव्यन्नभि शूरो न सत्वा॥
verses.tr: eṣa suvānaḥ pari somaḥ pavitre sargo na sṛṣṭo adadhāvadarvā tigme śiśāno mahiṣo na śṛṅge gā gavyannabhi śūro na satvā
verses.en: This Soma, pressed into the cleansing filter, hath run as 'twere a host let loose, the Courser; Like a strong bull who whets his horns pen-pointed, like a brave warrior in the fray for cattle.

verses.sa:
एषा ययौ परमादन्तरद्रेः कूचित्सतीरूर्वे गा विवेद ।
दिवो न विद्युत्स्तनयन्त्यभ्रैः सोमस्य ते पवत इन्द्र धारा॥
verses.tr: eṣā yayau paramādantaradreḥ kūcitsatīrūrve gā viveda divo na vidyutstanayantyabhraiḥ somasya te pavata indra dhārā
verses.en: He issued forth from out the loftiest mountain, and found kine hidden somewhere in a stable. Soma's stream clears itself for thee, O Indra, like lightning thundering through the clouds of heaven,

verses.sa:
उत स्म राशिं परि यासि गोनामिन्द्रेण सोम सरथं पुनानः ।
पूर्वीरिषो बृहतीर्जीरदानो शिक्षा शचीवस्तव ता उपष्टुत्॥
verses.tr: uta sma rāśiṃ pari yāsi gonāmindreṇa soma sarathaṃ punānaḥ pūrvīriṣo bṛhatīrjīradāno śikṣā śacīvastava tā upaṣṭut
verses.en: Cleansing thyself, and borne along with Indra, Soma, thou goest round the herd of cattle. May thy praise help us, Mighty One, prompt Giver, to the full ample food which thou bestowest.

verses.sa:
अयं सोम इन्द्र तुभ्यं सुन्वे तुभ्यं पवते त्वमस्य पाहि ।
त्वं ह यं चकृषे त्वं ववृष इन्दुं मदाय युज्याय सोमम्॥
verses.tr: ayaṃ soma indra tubhyaṃ sunve tubhyaṃ pavate tvamasya pāhi tvaṃ ha yaṃ cakṛṣe tvaṃ vavṛṣa induṃ madāya yujyāya somam
verses.en: For thee this Soma is effused, O Indra: drink of this juice; for thee the stream is flowing- Soma, which thou thyself hast made and chosen, even Indu, for thy special drink to cheer thee.

verses.sa:
स ईं रथो न भुरिषाळयोजि महः पुरूणि सातये वसूनि ।
आदीं विश्वा नहुष्याणि जाता स्वर्षाता वन ऊर्ध्वा नवन्त॥
verses.tr: sa īṃ ratho na bhuriṣāḻayoji mahaḥ purūṇi sātaye vasūni ādīṃ viśvā nahuṣyāṇi jātā svarṣātā vana ūrdhvā navanta
verses.en: Like a capacious car hath it been harnessed, the Mighty; to acquire abundant treasures. Then in the sacrifice they celebrated all triumphs won by Nahusa in the battle.

verses.sa:
वायुर्न यो नियुत्वाँ इष्टयामा नासत्येव हव आ शम्भविष्ठः ।
विश्ववारो द्रविणोदा इव त्मन्पूषेव धीजवनोऽसि सोम॥
verses.tr: vāyurna yo niyutvāṃ iṣṭayāmā nāsatyeva hava ā śambhaviṣṭhaḥ viśvavāro draviṇodā iva tmanpūṣeva dhījavano'si soma
verses.en: Like Vayu with his team, moving at pleasure, most gracious when invoked like both Nasatyas, Thou art thyself like the Wealth-Giver, Soma! who grants all boons, like song-inspiring Pusan.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रो न यो महा कर्माणि चक्रिर्हन्ता वृत्राणामसि सोम पूर्भित् ।
पैद्वो न हि त्वमहिनाम्नां हन्ता विश्वस्यासि सोम दस्योः॥
verses.tr: indro na yo mahā karmāṇi cakrirhantā vṛtrāṇāmasi soma pūrbhit paidvo na hi tvamahināmnāṃ hantā viśvasyāsi soma dasyoḥ
verses.en: Like Indra who hath done great deeds, thou, Soma, art slayer of the Vrtras, Fort-destroyer. Like Pedu's horse who killed the brood of serpents, thus thou, O Soma, slayest every Dasyu.

verses.sa:
अग्निर्न यो वन आ सृज्यमानो वृथा पाजांसि कृणुते नदीषु ।
जनो न युध्वा महत उपब्दिरियर्ति सोमः पवमान ऊर्मिम्॥
verses.tr: agnirna yo vana ā sṛjyamāno vṛthā pājāṃsi kṛṇute nadīṣu jano na yudhvā mahata upabdiriyarti somaḥ pavamāna ūrmim
verses.en: Like Agni loosed amid the forest, fiercely he winneth splendour in the running waters. Like one who fights, the roaring of the mighty, thus Soma Pavamana sends his current.

verses.sa:
एते सोमा अति वाराण्यव्या दिव्या न कोशासो अभ्रवर्षाः ।
वृथा समुद्रं सिन्धवो न नीचीः सुतासो अभि कलशाँ असृग्रन्॥
verses.tr: ete somā ati vārāṇyavyā divyā na kośāso abhravarṣāḥ vṛthā samudraṃ sindhavo na nīcīḥ sutāso abhi kalaśāṃ asṛgran
verses.en: These Somas passing through the fleecy filter, like rain descending from the clouds of heaven, Have been effused and poured into the beakers, swiftly like rivers running lowly seaward.

verses.sa:
शुष्मी शर्धो न मारुतं पवस्वानभिशस्ता दिव्या यथा विट् ।
आपो न मक्षू सुमतिर्भवा नः सहस्राप्साः पृतनाषाण्न यज्ञः॥
verses.tr: śuṣmī śardho na mārutaṃ pavasvānabhiśastā divyā yathā viṭ āpo na makṣū sumatirbhavā naḥ sahasrāpsāḥ pṛtanāṣāṇna yajñaḥ
verses.en: Flow onward like the potent band of Maruts, like that Celestial Host whom none revileth. Quickly be gracious unto us like waters, like sacrifice victorious, thousand-fashioned.

verses.sa:
राज्ञो नु ते वरुणस्य व्रतानि बृहद्गभीरं तव सोम धाम ।
शुचिष्ट्वमसि प्रियो न मित्रो दक्षाय्यो अर्यमेवासि सोम॥
verses.tr: rājño nu te varuṇasya vratāni bṛhadgabhīraṃ tava soma dhāma śuciṣṭvamasi priyo na mitro dakṣāyyo aryamevāsi soma
verses.en: Thine are King Varuna's eternal statutes, lofty and deep, O Soma, is thy glory. All-pure art thou like Mitra the beloved, adorable, like Aryaman, O Soma.

verses.sa:
प्रो स्य वह्निः पथ्याभिरस्यान्दिवो न वृष्टिः पवमानो अक्षाः ।
सहस्रधारो असदन्न्य१स्मे मातुरुपस्थे वन आ च सोमः॥
verses.tr: pro sya vahniḥ pathyābhirasyāndivo na vṛṣṭiḥ pavamāno akṣāḥ sahasradhāro asadannya1sme māturupasthe vana ā ca somaḥ
verses.en: This Chariot-horse hath moved along the pathways, and Pavamana flowed like rain from heaven. With us hath Soma with a thousand currents sunk in the wood, upon his Mother's bosom.

verses.sa:
राजा सिन्धूनामवसिष्ट वास ऋतस्य नावमारुहद्रजिष्ठाम् ।
अप्सु द्रप्सो वावृधे श्येनजूतो दुह ईं पिता दुह ईं पितुर्जाम्॥
verses.tr: rājā sindhūnāmavasiṣṭa vāsa ṛtasya nāvamāruhadrajiṣṭhām apsu drapso vāvṛdhe śyenajūto duha īṃ pitā duha īṃ piturjām
verses.en: King, he hath clothed him in the robe of rivers, mounted the straightest-going ship of Order. Sped by the Hawk the drop hath waxed in waters: the father drains it, drains the Father's offspring.

verses.sa:
सिंहं नसन्त मध्वो अयासं हरिमरुषं दिवो अस्य पतिम् ।
शूरो युत्सु प्रथमः पृच्छते गा अस्य चक्षसा परि पात्युक्षा॥
verses.tr: siṃhaṃ nasanta madhvo ayāsaṃ harimaruṣaṃ divo asya patim śūro yutsu prathamaḥ pṛcchate gā asya cakṣasā pari pātyukṣā
verses.en: They come to him, red, tawny, Lord of Heaven, the watchful Guardian of the meath, the Lion. First, Hero in the fight, he seeks the cattle, and with his eye the Steer is our protector.

verses.sa:
मधुपृष्ठं घोरमयासमश्वं रथे युञ्जन्त्युरुचक्र ऋष्वम् ।
स्वसार ईं जामयो मर्जयन्ति सनाभयो वाजिनमूर्जयन्ति॥
verses.tr: madhupṛṣṭhaṃ ghoramayāsamaśvaṃ rathe yuñjantyurucakra ṛṣvam svasāra īṃ jāmayo marjayanti sanābhayo vājinamūrjayanti
verses.en: They harness to the broad-wheeled car the mighty Courser whose back bears meath, unwearied, awful. The twins, the sisters brighten him, and strengthen-these children of one dame the vigorous Racer.

verses.sa:
चतस्र ईं घृतदुहः सचन्ते समाने अन्तर्धरुणे निषत्ताः ।
ता ईमर्षन्ति नमसा पुनानास्ता ईं विश्वतः परि षन्ति पूर्वीः॥
verses.tr: catasra īṃ ghṛtaduhaḥ sacante samāne antardharuṇe niṣattāḥ tā īmarṣanti namasā punānāstā īṃ viśvataḥ pari ṣanti pūrvīḥ
verses.en: Four pouring out the holy oil attend him, sitting together in the same container. To him they flow, when purified, with homage, and still, from every side, are first about him.

verses.sa:
विष्टम्भो दिवो धरुणः पृथिव्या विश्वा उत क्षितयो हस्ते अस्य ।
असत्त उत्सो गृणते नियुत्वान्मध्वो अंशुः पवत इन्द्रियाय॥
verses.tr: viṣṭambho divo dharuṇaḥ pṛthivyā viśvā uta kṣitayo haste asya asatta utso gṛṇate niyutvānmadhvo aṃśuḥ pavata indriyāya
verses.en: He is the buttress of the heavens, supporter of earth, and in his hand are all the people. Be the team's Lord a well to thee the singer: cleansed is the sweet plant's stalk for deed of glory.

verses.sa:
वन्वन्नवातो अभि देववीतिमिन्द्राय सोम वृत्रहा पवस्व ।
शग्धि महः पुरुश्चन्द्रस्य रायः सुवीर्यस्य पतयः स्याम॥
verses.tr: vanvannavāto abhi devavītimindrāya soma vṛtrahā pavasva śagdhi mahaḥ puruścandrasya rāyaḥ suvīryasya patayaḥ syāma
verses.en: Fighting, uninjured come where Gods are feasted; Soma, as Vitra-slayer flow for Indra. Vouchsafe us ample riches very splendid may we be masters of heroic vigour.

verses.sa:
प्र हिन्वानो जनिता रोदस्यो रथो न वाजं सनिष्यन्नयासीत् ।
इन्द्रं गच्छन्नायुधा संशिशानो विश्वा वसु हस्तयोरादधानः॥
verses.tr: pra hinvāno janitā rodasyo ratho na vājaṃ saniṣyannayāsīt indraṃ gacchannāyudhā saṃśiśāno viśvā vasu hastayorādadhānaḥ
verses.en: Urged On, the Father of the Earth and Heaven hath gone forth like a car to gather booty, Going to Indra, sharpening his weapons, and in his hand containing every treasure.

verses.sa:
अभि त्रिपृष्ठं वृषणं वयोधामाङ्गूषाणामवावशन्त वाणीः ।
वना वसानो वरुणो न सिन्धून्वि रत्नधा दयते वार्याणि॥
verses.tr: abhi tripṛṣṭhaṃ vṛṣaṇaṃ vayodhāmāṅgūṣāṇāmavāvaśanta vāṇīḥ vanā vasāno varuṇo na sindhūnvi ratnadhā dayate vāryāṇi
verses.en: To him the tones of sacred song have sounded, Steer of the triple height, the Life-bestower. Dwelling in wood as Varuna in rivers, lavishing treasure he distributes blessings

verses.sa:
शूरग्रामः सर्ववीरः सहावाञ्जेता पवस्व सनिता धनानि ।
तिग्मायुधः क्षिप्रधन्वा समत्स्वषाळ्हः साह्वान्पृतनासु शत्रून्॥
verses.tr: śūragrāmaḥ sarvavīraḥ sahāvāñjetā pavasva sanitā dhanāni tigmāyudhaḥ kṣipradhanvā samatsvaṣāḻhaḥ sāhvānpṛtanāsu śatrūn
verses.en: Great Conqueror, warrior-girt, Lord of all heroes, flow on thy way as he who winneth riches; With sharpened. arms, with swift bow, never vanquished in battle, vanquishing in fight the foemen.

verses.sa:
उरुगव्यूतिरभयानि कृण्वन्त्समीचीने आ पवस्वा पुरंधी ।
अपः सिषासन्नुषसः स्व१र्गाः सं चिक्रदो महो अस्मभ्यं वाजान्॥
verses.tr: urugavyūtirabhayāni kṛṇvantsamīcīne ā pavasvā puraṃdhī apaḥ siṣāsannuṣasaḥ sva1rgāḥ saṃ cikrado maho asmabhyaṃ vājān
verses.en: Giving security, Lord of wide dominion, send us both earth and heaven with all their fulness. Striving to win the Dawns, the light, the waters, and cattle, call to us abundant vigour.

verses.sa:
मत्सि सोम वरुणं मत्सि मित्रं मत्सीन्द्रमिन्दो पवमान विष्णुम् ।
मत्सि शर्धो मारुतं मत्सि देवान्मत्सि महामिन्द्रमिन्दो मदाय॥
verses.tr: matsi soma varuṇaṃ matsi mitraṃ matsīndramindo pavamāna viṣṇum matsi śardho mārutaṃ matsi devānmatsi mahāmindramindo madāya
verses.en: O Soma, gladden Varuna and Mitra; cheer, Indu Pavamana! Indra, Visnu. Cheer thou the Gods, the Company of Maruts: Indu, cheer mighty Indra to rejoicing.

verses.sa:
एवा राजेव क्रतुमाँ अमेन विश्वा घनिघ्नद्दुरिता पवस्व ।
इन्दो सूक्ताय वचसे वयो धा यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः॥
verses.tr: evā rājeva kratumāṃ amena viśvā ghanighnadduritā pavasva indo sūktāya vacase vayo dhā yūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ
verses.en: Thus like a wise and potent King flow onward, destroying with thy vigour all misfortunes. For our well-spoken hymn give life, O Indu. Do ye preserve us evermore with blessings.

verses.sa:
असर्जि वक्वा रथ्ये यथाजौ धिया मनोता प्रथमो मनीषी ।
दश स्वसारो अधि सानो अव्येऽजन्ति वह्निं सदनान्यच्छ॥
verses.tr: asarji vakvā rathye yathājau dhiyā manotā prathamo manīṣī daśa svasāro adhi sāno avye'janti vahniṃ sadanānyaccha
verses.en: As for a chariot-race, the skillful Speaker, Chief, Sage, Inventor, hath, with song, been started. The sisters ten upon the fleecy summit drive on the Car-horse to the resting places.

verses.sa:
वीती जनस्य दिव्यस्य कव्यैरधि सुवानो नहुष्येभिरिन्दुः ।
प्र यो नृभिरमृतो मर्त्येभिर्मर्मृजानोऽविभिर्गोभिरद्भिः॥
verses.tr: vītī janasya divyasya kavyairadhi suvāno nahuṣyebhirinduḥ pra yo nṛbhiramṛto martyebhirmarmṛjāno'vibhirgobhiradbhiḥ
verses.en: The drop of Soma, pressed by wise Nahusyas, becomes the banquet of the Heavenly People- Indu, by hands of mortal men made beauteous, immortal, with the sheep and cows and waters.

verses.sa:
वृषा वृष्णे रोरुवदंशुरस्मै पवमानो रुशदीर्ते पयो गोः ।
सहस्रमृक्वा पथिभिर्वचोविदध्वस्मभिः सूरो अण्वं वि याति॥
verses.tr: vṛṣā vṛṣṇe roruvadaṃśurasmai pavamāno ruśadīrte payo goḥ sahasramṛkvā pathibhirvacovidadhvasmabhiḥ sūro aṇvaṃ vi yāti
verses.en: Steer roaring unto Steer, this Pavamana, this juice runs to the white milk of the milch-cow. Through thousand fine hairs goes the tuneful Singer, like Sura by his fair and open pathways.

verses.sa:
रुजा दृळ्हा चिद्रक्षसः सदांसि पुनान इन्द ऊर्णुहि वि वाजान् ।
वृश्चोपरिष्टात्तुजता वधेन ये अन्ति दूरादुपनायमेषाम्॥
verses.tr: rujā dṛḻhā cidrakṣasaḥ sadāṃsi punāna inda ūrṇuhi vi vājān vṛścopariṣṭāttujatā vadhena ye anti dūrādupanāyameṣām
verses.en: Break down the, strong seats even of the demons: cleansing thee, Indu, robe thyself in vigour. Rend with thy swift bolt, coming from above them, those who are near and those who yet are distant.

verses.sa:
स प्रत्नवन्नव्यसे विश्ववार सूक्ताय पथः कृणुहि प्राचः ।
ये दुःषहासो वनुषा बृहन्तस्ताँस्ते अश्याम पुरुकृत्पुरुक्षो॥
verses.tr: sa pratnavannavyase viśvavāra sūktāya pathaḥ kṛṇuhi prācaḥ ye duḥṣahāso vanuṣā bṛhantastāṃste aśyāma purukṛtpurukṣo
verses.en: Prepare the forward paths in ancient manner for the new hymn, thou Giver of all bounties. Those which are high and hard for foes to conquer may we gain from thee, Active! Food-bestower!

verses.sa:
एवा पुनानो अपः स्व१र्गा अस्मभ्यं तोका तनयानि भूरि ।
शं नः क्षेत्रमुरु ज्योतींषि सोम ज्योङ्नः सूर्यं दृशये रिरीहि॥
verses.tr: evā punāno apaḥ sva1rgā asmabhyaṃ tokā tanayāni bhūri śaṃ naḥ kṣetramuru jyotīṃṣi soma jyoṅnaḥ sūryaṃ dṛśaye rirīhi
verses.en: So purifying thee vouchsafe us waters, heaven's light, and cows, offspring and many children. Give us health, ample land, and lights, O Soma, and grant us long to look upon the sunshine.

verses.sa:
परि सुवानो हरिरंशुः पवित्रे रथो न सर्जि सनये हियानः ।
आपच्छ्लोकमिन्द्रियं पूयमानः प्रति देवाँ अजुषत प्रयोभिः॥
verses.tr: pari suvāno hariraṃśuḥ pavitre ratho na sarji sanaye hiyānaḥ āpacchlokamindriyaṃ pūyamānaḥ prati devāṃ ajuṣata prayobhiḥ
verses.en: The gold-hued juice, poured out upon the filter, is started like a car sent forth to conquer. He hath gained song and vigour while they cleansed him, and hath rejoiced the Gods with entertainments.

verses.sa:
अच्छा नृचक्षा असरत्पवित्रे नाम दधानः कविरस्य योनौ ।
सीदन्होतेव सदने चमूषूपेमग्मन्नृषयः सप्त विप्राः॥
verses.tr: acchā nṛcakṣā asaratpavitre nāma dadhānaḥ kavirasya yonau sīdanhoteva sadane camūṣūpemagmannṛṣayaḥ sapta viprāḥ
verses.en: He who beholdeth man hath reached the filter: bearing his name, the Sage hath sought his dwelling. The Rsis came to him, seven holy singers, when in the bowls he settled as Invoker.

verses.sa:
प्र सुमेधा गातुविद्विश्वदेवः सोमः पुनानः सद एति नित्यम् ।
भुवद्विश्वेषु काव्येषु रन्ताऽनु जनान्यतते पञ्च धीरः॥
verses.tr: pra sumedhā gātuvidviśvadevaḥ somaḥ punānaḥ sada eti nityam bhuvadviśveṣu kāvyeṣu rantā'nu janānyatate pañca dhīraḥ
verses.en: Shared by all Gods, most wise, propitious, Soma goes, while they cleanse him, to his constant station. Let him rejoice in all his lofty wisdom to the Five Tribes the Sage attains with labour.

verses.sa:
तव त्ये सोम पवमान निण्ये विश्वे देवास्त्रय एकादशासः ।
दश स्वधाभिरधि सानो अव्ये मृजन्ति त्वा नद्यः सप्त यह्वीः॥
verses.tr: tava tye soma pavamāna niṇye viśve devāstraya ekādaśāsaḥ daśa svadhābhiradhi sāno avye mṛjanti tvā nadyaḥ sapta yahvīḥ
verses.en: In thy mysterious place, O Pavamana Soma, are all the Gods, the Thrice-Eleven. Ten on the fleecy height, themselves, self-prompted, and seven fresh rivers, brighten and adorn thee.

verses.sa:
तन्नु सत्यं पवमानस्यास्तु यत्र विश्वे कारवः संनसन्त ।
ज्योतिर्यदह्ने अकृणोदु लोकं प्रावन्मनुं दस्यवे करभीकम्॥
verses.tr: tannu satyaṃ pavamānasyāstu yatra viśve kāravaḥ saṃnasanta jyotiryadahne akṛṇodu lokaṃ prāvanmanuṃ dasyave karabhīkam
verses.en: Now let this be the truth of Pavamana, there where all singers gather them together, That he hath given us room and made the daylight, hath holpen Manu and repelled the Dasyu.

verses.sa:
परि सद्मेव पशुमान्ति होता राजा न सत्यः समितीरियानः ।
सोमः पुनानः कलशाँ अयासीत्सीदन्मृगो न महिषो वनेषु॥
verses.tr: pari sadmeva paśumānti hotā rājā na satyaḥ samitīriyānaḥ somaḥ punānaḥ kalaśāṃ ayāsītsīdanmṛgo na mahiṣo vaneṣu
verses.en: As the priest seeks the station rich in cattle, like a true King who goes to great assemblies, Soma hath sought the beakers while they cleansed him, and like a wild bull, in the wood hath settled.

verses.sa:
साकमुक्षो मर्जयन्त स्वसारो दश धीरस्य धीतयो धनुत्रीः ।
हरिः पर्यद्रवज्जाः सूर्यस्य द्रोणं ननक्षे अत्यो न वाजी॥
verses.tr: sākamukṣo marjayanta svasāro daśa dhīrasya dhītayo dhanutrīḥ hariḥ paryadravajjāḥ sūryasya droṇaṃ nanakṣe atyo na vājī
verses.en: Ten sisters, pouring out the rain together, swift-moving thinkers of the sage, adorn him. Hither hath run the gold-hued Child of Surya and reached the vat like a fleet vigorous courser.

verses.sa:
सं मातृभिर्न शिशुर्वावशानो वृषा दधन्वे पुरुवारो अद्भिः ।
मर्यो न योषामभि निष्कृतं यन्त्सं गच्छते कलश उस्रियाभिः॥
verses.tr: saṃ mātṛbhirna śiśurvāvaśāno vṛṣā dadhanve puruvāro adbhiḥ maryo na yoṣāmabhi niṣkṛtaṃ yantsaṃ gacchate kalaśa usriyābhiḥ
verses.en: Even as a youngling crying to his mothers, the bounteous Steer hath flowed along to waters. As youth to damsel, so with milk he hastens on to the. chose meeting-place, the beaker.

verses.sa:
उत प्र पिप्य ऊधरघ्न्याया इन्दुर्धाराभिः सचते सुमेधाः ।
मूर्धानं गावः पयसा चमूष्वभि श्रीणन्ति वसुभिर्न निक्तैः॥
verses.tr: uta pra pipya ūdharaghnyāyā indurdhārābhiḥ sacate sumedhāḥ mūrdhānaṃ gāvaḥ payasā camūṣvabhi śrīṇanti vasubhirna niktaiḥ
verses.en: Yea, swollen is the udder of the milch-cow: thither in streams goes very sapient Indu. The kine make ready, as with new-washed treasures, the Head and Chief with milk within the vessels.

verses.sa:
स नो देवेभिः पवमान रदेन्दो रयिमश्विनं वावशानः ।
रथिरायतामुशती पुरंधिरस्मद्र्य१गा दावने वसूनाम्॥
verses.tr: sa no devebhiḥ pavamāna radendo rayimaśvinaṃ vāvaśānaḥ rathirāyatāmuśatī puraṃdhirasmadrya1gā dāvane vasūnām
verses.en: With all the Gods, O Indu Pavamana, while thou art roaring send us wealth in horses. Hither upon her car come willing Plenty, inclined to us, to give us of her treasures.

verses.sa:
नू नो रयिमुप मास्व नृवन्तं पुनानो वाताप्यं विश्वश्चन्द्रम् ।
प्र वन्दितुरिन्दो तार्यायुः प्रातर्मक्षू धियावसुर्जगम्यात्॥
verses.tr: nū no rayimupa māsva nṛvantaṃ punāno vātāpyaṃ viśvaścandram pra vanditurindo tāryāyuḥ prātarmakṣū dhiyāvasurjagamyāt
verses.en: Now unto us mete riches, while they cleanse thee, all-glorious, swelling wealth, with store of heroes. Long be his life who worships, thee, O Indu. May he, enriched with prayer, come soon and early.

verses.sa:
अधि यदस्मिन्वाजिनीव शुभः स्पर्धन्ते धियः सूर्ये न विशः ।
अपो वृणानः पवते कवीयन्व्रजं न पशुवर्धनाय मन्म॥
verses.tr: adhi yadasminvājinīva śubhaḥ spardhante dhiyaḥ sūrye na viśaḥ apo vṛṇānaḥ pavate kavīyanvrajaṃ na paśuvardhanāya manma
verses.en: When beauties strive for him as for a charger, then strive the songs like soldiers for the sunlight. Acting the Sage, he flows enrobed in waters and song as 'twere a stall that kine may prosper.

verses.sa:
द्विता व्यूर्ण्वन्नमृतस्य धाम स्वर्विदे भुवनानि प्रथन्त ।
धियः पिन्वानाः स्वसरे न गाव ऋतायन्तीरभि वावश्र इन्दुम्॥
verses.tr: dvitā vyūrṇvannamṛtasya dhāma svarvide bhuvanāni prathanta dhiyaḥ pinvānāḥ svasare na gāva ṛtāyantīrabhi vāvaśra indum
verses.en: The worlds expand to him who from aforetime found light to spread the law of life eternal. The swelling songs, like kine within the stable, in deep devotion call aloud on Indu.

verses.sa:
परि यत्कविः काव्या भरते शूरो न रथो भुवनानि विश्वा ।
देवेषु यशो मर्ताय भूषन्दक्षाय रायः पुरुभूषु नव्यः॥
verses.tr: pari yatkaviḥ kāvyā bharate śūro na ratho bhuvanāni viśvā deveṣu yaśo martāya bhūṣandakṣāya rāyaḥ purubhūṣu navyaḥ
verses.en: When the sage bears his holy wisdom round him, like a car visiting all worlds, the Hero, Becoming fame, mid Gods, unto the mortal, wealth to the skilled, worth praise mid the Ever-present,

verses.sa:
श्रिये जातः श्रिय आ निरियाय श्रियं वयो जरितृभ्यो दधाति ।
श्रियं वसाना अमृतत्वमायन्भवन्ति सत्या समिथा मितद्रौ॥
verses.tr: śriye jātaḥ śriya ā niriyāya śriyaṃ vayo jaritṛbhyo dadhāti śriyaṃ vasānā amṛtatvamāyanbhavanti satyā samithā mitadrau
verses.en: For glory born be hath come forth to glory: he giveth life and glory to the singers. They, clothed in glory, have become immortal. He, measured in his course, makes frays successful.

verses.sa:
इषमूर्जमभ्य१र्षाश्वं गामुरु ज्योतिः कृणुहि मत्सि देवान् ।
विश्वानि हि सुषहा तानि तुभ्यं पवमान बाधसे सोम शत्रून्॥
verses.tr: iṣamūrjamabhya1rṣāśvaṃ gāmuru jyotiḥ kṛṇuhi matsi devān viśvāni hi suṣahā tāni tubhyaṃ pavamāna bādhase soma śatrūn
verses.en: Stream to us food and vigour, kine and horses: give us broad lights and fill the Gods with rapture. All there are easy things for thee to master thou, Pavamana Soma, quellest foemen.

verses.sa:
कनिक्रन्ति हरिरा सृज्यमानः सीदन्वनस्य जठरे पुनानः ।
नृभिर्यतः कृणुते निर्णिजं गा अतो मतीर्जनयत स्वधाभिः॥
verses.tr: kanikranti harirā sṛjyamānaḥ sīdanvanasya jaṭhare punānaḥ nṛbhiryataḥ kṛṇute nirṇijaṃ gā ato matīrjanayata svadhābhiḥ
verses.en: Loud neighs the Tawny Steed when started, settling deep in the wooden vessel while they cleanse him. Led by the men he takes the milk for raiment: then shall he, through his powers, engender praise-songs.

verses.sa:
हरिः सृजानः पथ्यामृतस्येयर्ति वाचमरितेव नावम् ।
देवो देवानां गुह्यानि नामाऽऽविष्कृणोति बर्हिषि प्रवाचे॥
verses.tr: hariḥ sṛjānaḥ pathyāmṛtasyeyarti vācamariteva nāvam devo devānāṃ guhyāni nāmā''viṣkṛṇoti barhiṣi pravāce
verses.en: As one who rows drives on his boat, he, Gold-hued, sends forth his voice, loosed on the path of Order. As God, the secret names of Gods he utters, to be declared on sacred grass more widely.

verses.sa:
अपामिवेदूर्मयस्तर्तुराणाः प्र मनीषा ईरते सोममच्छ ।
नमस्यन्तीरुप च यन्ति सं चा ऽऽच विशन्त्युशतीरुशन्तम्॥
verses.tr: apāmivedūrmayastarturāṇāḥ pra manīṣā īrate somamaccha namasyantīrupa ca yanti saṃ cā ''ca viśantyuśatīruśantam
verses.en: Hastening onward like the waves of waters, our holy hymns are pressing nigh to Soma. To him they come with lowly adoration, and, longing, enter him who longs to meet them.

verses.sa:
तं मर्मृजानं महिषं न सानावंशुं दुहन्त्युक्षणं गिरिष्ठाम् ।
तं वावशानं मतयः सचन्ते त्रितो बिभर्ति वरुणं समुद्रे॥
verses.tr: taṃ marmṛjānaṃ mahiṣaṃ na sānāvaṃśuṃ duhantyukṣaṇaṃ giriṣṭhām taṃ vāvaśānaṃ matayaḥ sacante trito bibharti varuṇaṃ samudre
verses.en: They drain the stalk, the Steer who dwells on mountains, even as a Bull who decks him on the upland. Hymns follow and attend him as he bellows: Trita bears Varuna aloft in ocean.

verses.sa:
इष्यन्वाचमुपवक्तेव होतुः पुनान इन्दो वि ष्या मनीषाम् ।
इन्द्रश्च यत्क्षयथः सौभगाय सुवीर्यस्य पतयः स्याम॥
verses.tr: iṣyanvācamupavakteva hotuḥ punāna indo vi ṣyā manīṣām indraśca yatkṣayathaḥ saubhagāya suvīryasya patayaḥ syāma
verses.en: Sending thy voice out as Director, loosen the Invoker's thought, O Indu, as they cleanse thee. While thou and Indra rule for our advantage, may we be masters of heroic vigour.

verses.sa:
प्र सेनानीः शूरो अग्रे रथानां गव्यन्नेति हर्षते अस्य सेना ।
भद्रान्कृण्वन्निन्द्रहवान्त्सखिभ्य आ सोमो वस्त्रा रभसानि दत्ते॥
verses.tr: pra senānīḥ śūro agre rathānāṃ gavyanneti harṣate asya senā bhadrānkṛṇvannindrahavāntsakhibhya ā somo vastrā rabhasāni datte
verses.en: In forefront of the cars forth goes the Hero, the Leader, winning spoil: his host rejoices. Soma endues his robes of lasting colours, and blesses, for his friends, their calls on Indra.

verses.sa:
समस्य हरिं हरयो मृजन्त्यश्वहयैरनिशितं नमोभिः ।
आ तिष्ठति रथमिन्द्रस्य सखा विद्वाँ एना सुमतिं यात्यच्छ॥
verses.tr: samasya hariṃ harayo mṛjantyaśvahayairaniśitaṃ namobhiḥ ā tiṣṭhati rathamindrasya sakhā vidvāṃ enā sumatiṃ yātyaccha
verses.en: Men decked with gold adorn his golden tendril, incessantly with steed-impelling homage. The Friend of Indra mounts his car well-knowing, he comes thereon to meet the prayer we offer.

verses.sa:
स नो देव देवताते पवस्व महे सोम प्सरस इन्द्रपानः ।
कृण्वन्नपो वर्षयन्द्यामुतेमामुरोरा नो वरिवस्या पुनानः॥
verses.tr: sa no deva devatāte pavasva mahe soma psarasa indrapānaḥ kṛṇvannapo varṣayandyāmutemāmurorā no varivasyā punānaḥ
verses.en: O God, for service of the Gods flow onward, for food sublime, as Indra's drink, O Soma. Making the floods, bedewing earth and heaven, come from the vast, comfort us while we cleanse thee

verses.sa:
अजीतयेऽहतये पवस्व स्वस्तये सर्वतातये बृहते ।
तदुशन्ति विश्व इमे सखायस्तदहं वश्मि पवमान सोम॥
verses.tr: ajītaye'hataye pavasva svastaye sarvatātaye bṛhate taduśanti viśva ime sakhāyastadahaṃ vaśmi pavamāna soma
verses.en: Flow for prosperity and constant Vigour, flow on for happiness and high perfection. This is the wish of these friends assembled: this is my wish, O Soma Pavamana.

verses.sa:
सोमः पवते जनिता मतीनां जनिता दिवो जनिता पृथिव्याः ।
जनिताग्नेर्जनिता सूर्यस्य जनितेन्द्रस्य जनितोत विष्णोः॥
verses.tr: somaḥ pavate janitā matīnāṃ janitā divo janitā pṛthivyāḥ janitāgnerjanitā sūryasya janitendrasya janitota viṣṇoḥ
verses.en: Father of holy hymns, Soma flows onward the Father of the earth, Father of heaven: Father of Agni, Surya's generator, the Father who begat Indra and Visnu.

verses.sa:
ब्रह्मा देवानां पदवीः कवीनामृषिर्विप्राणां महिषो मृगाणाम् ।
श्येनो गृध्राणां स्वधितिर्वनानां सोमः पवित्रमत्येति रेभन्॥
verses.tr: brahmā devānāṃ padavīḥ kavīnāmṛṣirviprāṇāṃ mahiṣo mṛgāṇām śyeno gṛdhrāṇāṃ svadhitirvanānāṃ somaḥ pavitramatyeti rebhan
verses.en: Brahman of Gods, the Leader of the poets, Rsi of sages, Bull of savage creatures, Falcon amid the vultures, Axe of forests, over the cleansing sieve goes Soma singing.

verses.sa:
प्रावीविपद्वाच ऊर्मिं न सिन्धुर्गिरः सोमः पवमानो मनीषाः ।
अन्तः पश्यन्वृजनेमावराण्या तिष्ठति वृषभो गोषु जानन्॥
verses.tr: prāvīvipadvāca ūrmiṃ na sindhurgiraḥ somaḥ pavamāno manīṣāḥ antaḥ paśyanvṛjanemāvarāṇyā tiṣṭhati vṛṣabho goṣu jānan
verses.en: He, Soma Pavamana, like a river, hath stirred the wave of voice, our songs and praises. Beholding these inferior powers in cattle, he rests among them as a Steer well-knowing.

verses.sa:
स मत्सरः पृत्सु वन्वन्नवातः सहस्ररेता अभि वाजमर्ष ।
इन्द्रायेन्दो पवमानो मनीष्यं१शोरूर्मिमीरय गा इषण्यन्॥
verses.tr: sa matsaraḥ pṛtsu vanvannavātaḥ sahasraretā abhi vājamarṣa indrāyendo pavamāno manīṣyaṃ1śorūrmimīraya gā iṣaṇyan
verses.en: As Gladdener, Warrior never harmed in battle, with thousand genial streams, pour strength and vigour. As thoughtful Pavamana, urge O Indu, speeding the kine, the plant's wave on to Indra.

verses.sa:
परि प्रियः कलशे देववात इन्द्राय सोमो रण्यो मदाय ।
सहस्रधारः शतवाज इन्दुर्वाजी न सप्तिः समना जिगाति॥
verses.tr: pari priyaḥ kalaśe devavāta indrāya somo raṇyo madāya sahasradhāraḥ śatavāja indurvājī na saptiḥ samanā jigāti
verses.en: Dear, grateful to the Gods, on to the beaker moves Soma, sweet to Indra, to delight him. With hundred powers, with thousand currents, Indu, like a strong car-horse, goes to the assembly.

verses.sa:
स पूर्व्यो वसुविज्जायमानो मृजानो अप्सु दुदुहानो अद्रौ ।
अभिशस्तिपा भुवनस्य राजा विदद्गातुं ब्रह्मणे पूयमानः॥
verses.tr: sa pūrvyo vasuvijjāyamāno mṛjāno apsu duduhāno adrau abhiśastipā bhuvanasya rājā vidadgātuṃ brahmaṇe pūyamānaḥ
verses.en: Born in old time as finder-out of treasures, drained with the stone, decking himself in waters, Warding off curses, King of all existence, he shall find way for prayer the while they cleanse him.

verses.sa:
त्वया हि नः पितरः सोम पूर्वे कर्माणि चक्रुः पवमान धीराः ।
वन्वन्नवातः परिधीँरपोर्णु वीरेभिरश्वैर्मघवा भवा नः॥
verses.tr: tvayā hi naḥ pitaraḥ soma pūrve karmāṇi cakruḥ pavamāna dhīrāḥ vanvannavātaḥ paridhīṃraporṇu vīrebhiraśvairmaghavā bhavā naḥ
verses.en: For our sage fathers, Soma Pavamana, of old performed, by thee, their sacred duties. Fighting unvanquished, open the enclosures: enrich us with large gifts of steeds and heroes.

verses.sa:
यथापवथा मनवे वयोधा अमित्रहा वरिवोविद्धविष्मान् ।
एवा पवस्व द्रविणं दधान इन्द्रे सं तिष्ठ जनयायुधानि॥
verses.tr: yathāpavathā manave vayodhā amitrahā varivoviddhaviṣmān evā pavasva draviṇaṃ dadhāna indre saṃ tiṣṭha janayāyudhāni
verses.en: As thou didst flow for Manu Life-bestowing, Foe-queller, Comforter, rich in oblations, Even thus flow onward now conferring riches: combine with Indra, and bring forth thy weapons.

verses.sa:
पवस्व सोम मधुमाँ ऋतावाऽपो वसानो अधि सानो अव्ये ।
अव द्रोणानि घृतवान्ति सीद मदिन्तमो मत्सर इन्द्रपानः॥
verses.tr: pavasva soma madhumāṃ ṛtāvā'po vasāno adhi sāno avye ava droṇāni ghṛtavānti sīda madintamo matsara indrapānaḥ
verses.en: Flow onward, Soma, rich in sweets and holy,. enrobed in waters on the fleecy summit. Settle in vessels that are full of fatness, as cheering and most gladdening drink for Indra.

verses.sa:
वृष्टिं दिवः शतधारः पवस्व सहस्रसा वाजयुर्देववीतौ ।
सं सिन्धुभिः कलशे वावशानः समुस्रियाभिः प्रतिरन्न आयुः॥
verses.tr: vṛṣṭiṃ divaḥ śatadhāraḥ pavasva sahasrasā vājayurdevavītau saṃ sindhubhiḥ kalaśe vāvaśānaḥ samusriyābhiḥ pratiranna āyuḥ
verses.en: Pour, hundred-streamed, winner of thousands, mighty at the Gods' banquet, Pour the rain of heaven, While thou with rivers roarest in the beaker, and blent with milk prolongest our existence.

verses.sa:
एष स्य सोमो मतिभिः पुनानोऽत्यो न वाजी तरतीदरातीः ।
पयो न दुग्धमदितेरिषिरमुर्विव गातुः सुयमो न वोळ्हा॥
verses.tr: eṣa sya somo matibhiḥ punāno'tyo na vājī taratīdarātīḥ payo na dugdhamaditeriṣiramurviva gātuḥ suyamo na voḻhā
verses.en: Purified with our holy hymns, this Soma o'ertakes malignities like some strong charger, Like fresh milk poured by Aditi, like passage in ample room, or like a docile car-horse.

verses.sa:
स्वायुधः सोतृभिः पूयमानोऽभ्यर्ष गुह्यं चारु नाम ।
अभि वाजं सप्तिरिव श्रवस्याऽभि वायुमभि गा देव सोम॥
verses.tr: svāyudhaḥ sotṛbhiḥ pūyamāno'bhyarṣa guhyaṃ cāru nāma abhi vājaṃ saptiriva śravasyā'bhi vāyumabhi gā deva soma
verses.en: Cleansed by the pressers, armed with noble weapons, stream to us the fair secret name thou bearest. Pour booty, like a horse, for love of glory God, Soma, send us kine, and send us Vayu.

verses.sa:
शिशुं जज्ञानं हर्यतं मृजन्ति शुम्भन्ति वह्निं मरुतो गणेन ।
कविर्गीर्भिः काव्येना कविः सन्त्सोमः पवित्रमत्येति रेभन्॥
verses.tr: śiśuṃ jajñānaṃ haryataṃ mṛjanti śumbhanti vahniṃ maruto gaṇena kavirgīrbhiḥ kāvyenā kaviḥ santsomaḥ pavitramatyeti rebhan
verses.en: They deck him at his birth, the lovely Infant, the Maruts with their troop adorn the Car-horse. By songs a Poet and a Sage by wisdom, Soma joes singing through the cleansing filter.

verses.sa:
ऋषिमना य ऋषिकृत्स्वर्षाः सहस्रणीथः पदवीः कवीनाम् ।
तृतीयं धाम महिषः सिषासन्त्सोमो विराजमनु राजति ष्टुप्॥
verses.tr: ṛṣimanā ya ṛṣikṛtsvarṣāḥ sahasraṇīthaḥ padavīḥ kavīnām tṛtīyaṃ dhāma mahiṣaḥ siṣāsantsomo virājamanu rājati ṣṭup
verses.en: Light-winner, Rsi-minded, Rsi-maker, hymned in a thousand hymns, Leader of sages, A Steer who strives to gain his third form, Soma is, like Viraj, resplendent as a Singer.

verses.sa:
चमूषच्छ्येनः शकुनो विभृत्वा गोविन्दुर्द्रप्स आयुधानि बिभ्रत् ।
अपामूर्मिं सचमानः समुद्रं तुरीयं धाम महिषो विवक्ति॥
verses.tr: camūṣacchyenaḥ śakuno vibhṛtvā govindurdrapsa āyudhāni bibhrat apāmūrmiṃ sacamānaḥ samudraṃ turīyaṃ dhāma mahiṣo vivakti
verses.en: Hawk seated in the bowls, Bird wide-extended, the Banner seeking kine and wielding weapons, Following close the sea, the wave of waters, the great Bull tells his fourth form and declares it.

verses.sa:
मर्यो न शुभ्रस्तन्वं मृजानोऽत्यो न सृत्वा सनये धनानाम् ।
वृषेव यूथा परि कोशमर्षन्कनिक्रदच्चम्वो३रा विवेश॥
verses.tr: maryo na śubhrastanvaṃ mṛjāno'tyo na sṛtvā sanaye dhanānām vṛṣeva yūthā pari kośamarṣankanikradaccamvo3rā viveśa
verses.en: Like a fair youth who decorates his body, a courser rushing to the gain of riches, A steer to herds, so, flowing to the pitcher, he with a roar hath passed into the beakers.

verses.sa:
पवस्वेन्दो पवमानो महोभिः कनिक्रदत्परि वाराण्यर्ष ।
क्रीळञ्चम्वो३रा विश पूयमान इन्द्रं ते रसो मदिरो ममत्तु॥
verses.tr: pavasvendo pavamāno mahobhiḥ kanikradatpari vārāṇyarṣa krīḻañcamvo3rā viśa pūyamāna indraṃ te raso madiro mamattu
verses.en: Flow on with might as Pavamana, Indu flow loudly roaring through the fleecy filter. Enter the beakers sporting, as they cleanse thee, and let thy gladdening juice make Indra joyful.

verses.sa:
प्रास्य धारा बृहतीरसृग्रन्नक्तो गोभिः कलशाँ आ
विवेश । साम कृण्वन्त्सामन्यो विपश्चित्क्रन्दन्नेत्यभि सख्युर्न जामिम्॥
verses.tr: prāsya dhārā bṛhatīrasṛgrannakto gobhiḥ kalaśāṃ ā viveśa sāma kṛṇvantsāmanyo vipaścitkrandannetyabhi sakhyurna jāmim
verses.en: His streams have been effused in all their fulness, and he hath entered, balmed with milk, the goblets. Singing his psalm, well-skilled in song, a Chanter, be comes as 'twere to his friend's sister roaring.

verses.sa:
अपघ्नन्नेषि पवमान शत्रून्प्रियां न जारो अभिगीत इन्दुः ।
सीदन्वनेषु शकुनो न पत्वा सोमः पुनानः कलशेषु सत्ता॥
verses.tr: apaghnanneṣi pavamāna śatrūnpriyāṃ na jāro abhigīta induḥ sīdanvaneṣu śakuno na patvā somaḥ punānaḥ kalaśeṣu sattā
verses.en: Chasing our foes thou comest, Pavamana Indu, besting, as lover to his darling. As a bird flies and settles in the forest, thus Soma settles, purified, in goblets.

verses.sa:
आ ते रुचः पवमानस्य सोम योषेव यन्ति सुदुघाः सुधाराः ।
हरिरानीतः पुरुवारो अप्स्वचिक्रदत्कलशे देवयूनाम्॥
verses.tr: ā te rucaḥ pavamānasya soma yoṣeva yanti sudughāḥ sudhārāḥ harirānītaḥ puruvāro apsvacikradatkalaśe devayūnām
verses.en: With full stream and abundant milk, O Soma, thy beams come, like a woman, as they cleanse thee. He, gold-hued, rich in boons, brought to the waters, hath roared within the goblet of the pious.

verses.sa:
अस्य प्रेषा हेमना पूयमानो देवो देवेभिः समपृक्त रसम् ।
सुतः पवित्रं पर्येति रेभन्मितेव सद्म पशुमान्ति होता॥
verses.tr: asya preṣā hemanā pūyamāno devo devebhiḥ samapṛkta rasam sutaḥ pavitraṃ paryeti rebhanmiteva sadma paśumānti hotā
verses.en: Made pure by this man's urgent zeal and impulse the God hath to the Gods his juice imparted. He goes, effused and singing, to the filter, like priest to measured seats supplied with cattle.

verses.sa:
भद्रा वस्त्रा समन्या३ वसानो महान्कविर्निवचनानि शंसन् ।
आ वच्यस्व चम्वोः पूयमानो विचक्षणो जागृविर्देववीतौ॥
verses.tr: bhadrā vastrā samanyā3 vasāno mahānkavirnivacanāni śaṃsan ā vacyasva camvoḥ pūyamāno vicakṣaṇo jāgṛvirdevavītau
verses.en: Robed in fair raiment meet to wear in battle, a mighty Sage pronouncing invocations. Roll onward to the beakers as they cleanse thee, far-seeing at the feast of Gods, and watchful.

verses.sa:
समु प्रियो मृज्यते सानो अव्ये यशस्तरो यशसां क्षैतो अस्मे ।
अभि स्वर धन्वा पूयमानो यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः॥
verses.tr: samu priyo mṛjyate sāno avye yaśastaro yaśasāṃ kṣaito asme abhi svara dhanvā pūyamāno yūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ
verses.en: Dear, he is brightened on the fleecy summit, a Prince among us, nobler than the noble. Roar out as thou art purified, run forward. Do ye preserve us evermore with blessings.

verses.sa:
प्र गायताभ्यर्चाम देवान्त्सोमं हिनोत महते धनाय ।
स्वादुः पवाते अति वारमव्यमा सीदाति कलशं देवयुर्नः॥
verses.tr: pra gāyatābhyarcāma devāntsomaṃ hinota mahate dhanāya svāduḥ pavāte ati vāramavyamā sīdāti kalaśaṃ devayurnaḥ
verses.en: Let us sing praises to the Gods: sing loudly, send ye the Soma forth for mighty riches. Let him flow, sweetly-flavoured, through the filter, and let our pious one rest in the pitcher.

verses.sa:
इन्दुर्देवानामुप सख्यमायन्त्सहस्रधारः पवते मदाय ।
नृभिः स्तवानो अनु धाम पूर्वमगन्निन्द्रं महते सौभगाय॥
verses.tr: indurdevānāmupa sakhyamāyantsahasradhāraḥ pavate madāya nṛbhiḥ stavāno anu dhāma pūrvamagannindraṃ mahate saubhagāya
verses.en: Winning the friendship of the Deities, Indu flows in a thousand streams to make them joyful. Praised by the men after the ancient statute, he hath come nigh, for our great bliss, to Indra.

verses.sa:
स्तोत्रे राये हरिरर्षा पुनान इन्द्रं मदो गच्छतु ते भराय ।
देवैर्याहि सरथं राधो अच्छा यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः॥
verses.tr: stotre rāye harirarṣā punāna indraṃ mado gacchatu te bharāya devairyāhi sarathaṃ rādho acchā yūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ
verses.en: Flow, Gold-hued, cleansing thee, to enrich the singer: let thy juice go to Indra to support him. Come nigh, together with the Gods, for bounty. Do ye preserve us evermore with blessings.

verses.sa:
प्र काव्यमुशनेव ब्रुवाणो देवो देवानां जनिमा विवक्ति ।
महिव्रतः शुचिबन्धुः पावकः पदा वराहो अभ्येति रेभन्॥
verses.tr: pra kāvyamuśaneva bruvāṇo devo devānāṃ janimā vivakti mahivrataḥ śucibandhuḥ pāvakaḥ padā varāho abhyeti rebhan
verses.en: The God declares the Deities' generations, like Usana, proclaiming lofty wisdom. With brilliant kin, far-ruling, sanctifying, the Boar advances, singing, to the places.

verses.sa:
प्र हंसासस्तृपलं मन्युमच्छामादस्तं वृषगणा अयासुः ।
आङ्गूष्यं१ पवमानं सखायो दुर्मर्षं साकं प्र वदन्ति वाणम्॥
verses.tr: pra haṃsāsastṛpalaṃ manyumacchāmādastaṃ vṛṣagaṇā ayāsuḥ āṅgūṣyaṃ1 pavamānaṃ sakhāyo durmarṣaṃ sākaṃ pra vadanti vāṇam
verses.en: The Swans, the Vrsaganas from anear us have brought their restless spirit to our dwelling. Friends come to Pavamana meet for praises, and sound in concert their resistless music.

verses.sa:
स रंहत उरुगायस्य जूतिं वृथा क्रीळन्तं मिमते न गावः ।
परीणसं कृणुते तिग्मशृङ्गो दिवा हरिर्ददृशे नक्तमृज्रः॥
verses.tr: sa raṃhata urugāyasya jūtiṃ vṛthā krīḻantaṃ mimate na gāvaḥ parīṇasaṃ kṛṇute tigmaśṛṅgo divā harirdadṛśe naktamṛjraḥ
verses.en: He follows the Wide-strider's rapid movement: cows low, as 'twere, to him who sports at pleasure. He with the sharpened horns brings forth abundance: the Silvery shines by night, by day the Golden.

verses.sa:
इन्दुर्वाजी पवते गोन्योघा इन्द्रे सोमः सह इन्वन्मदाय ।
हन्ति रक्षो बाधते पर्यरातीर्वरिवः कृण्वन्वृजनस्य राजा॥
verses.tr: indurvājī pavate gonyoghā indre somaḥ saha invanmadāya hanti rakṣo bādhate paryarātīrvarivaḥ kṛṇvanvṛjanasya rājā
verses.en: Strong Indu, bathed in milk, flows on for Indra, Soma exciting strength, to make him joyful. He quells malignities and slays the demons, the King of mighty power who brings us comfort.

verses.sa:
अध धारया मध्वा पृचानस्तिरो रोम पवते अद्रिदुग्धः ।
इन्दुरिन्द्रस्य सख्यं जुषाणो देवो देवस्य मत्सरो मदाय॥
verses.tr: adha dhārayā madhvā pṛcānastiro roma pavate adridugdhaḥ indurindrasya sakhyaṃ juṣāṇo devo devasya matsaro madāya
verses.en: Then in a stream he flows, milked out with press-stones, mingled with sweetness, through the fleecy filter- Indu rejoicing in the love of Indra, the God who gladdens, for the God's enjoyment.

verses.sa:
अभि प्रियाणि पवते पुनानो देवो देवान्त्स्वेन रसेन पृञ्चन् ।
इन्दुर्धर्माण्यृतुथा वसानो दश क्षिपो अव्यत सानो अव्ये॥
verses.tr: abhi priyāṇi pavate punāno devo devāntsvena rasena pṛñcan indurdharmāṇyṛtuthā vasāno daśa kṣipo avyata sāno avye
verses.en: As he is purified he pours out treasures, a God bedewing Gods with his own juices. Indu hath, wearing qualities by seasons, on the raised fleece engaged, the ten swift fingers.

verses.sa:
वृषा शोणो अभिकनिक्रदद्गा नदयन्नेति पृथिवीमुत द्याम् ।
इन्द्रस्येव वग्नुरा शृण्व आजौ प्रचेतयन्नर्षति वाचमेमाम्॥
verses.tr: vṛṣā śoṇo abhikanikradadgā nadayanneti pṛthivīmuta dyām indrasyeva vagnurā śṛṇva ājau pracetayannarṣati vācamemām
verses.en: The Red Bull bellowing to the kine advances, causing the heavens and earth to roar and thunder. Well is he beard like Indra's shout in battle: letting this voice be known he hastens hither.

verses.sa:
रसाय्यः पयसा पिन्वमान ईरयन्नेषि मधुमन्तमंशुम् ।
पवमानः संतनिमेषि कृण्वन्निन्द्राय सोम परिषिच्यमानः॥
verses.tr: rasāyyaḥ payasā pinvamāna īrayanneṣi madhumantamaṃśum pavamānaḥ saṃtanimeṣi kṛṇvannindrāya soma pariṣicyamānaḥ
verses.en: Swelling with milk, abounding in sweet flavours, urging the meath-rich plant thou goest onward. Raising a shout thou flowest as they cleanse thee, when thou, O Soma, art effused for Indra.

verses.sa:
एवा पवस्व मदिरो मदायोदग्राभस्य नमयन्वधस्नैः ।
परि वर्णं भरमाणो रुशन्तं गव्युर्नो अर्ष परि सोम सिक्तः॥
verses.tr: evā pavasva madiro madāyodagrābhasya namayanvadhasnaiḥ pari varṇaṃ bharamāṇo ruśantaṃ gavyurno arṣa pari soma siktaḥ
verses.en: So flow thou on inspiriting, for rapture, aiming death-shafts at him who stays the waters, Flow to us wearing thy resplendent colour, effused and eager for the kine, O Soma.

verses.sa:
जुष्ट्वी न इन्दो सुपथा सुगान्युरौ पवस्व वरिवांसि कृण्वन् ।
घनेव विष्वग्दुरितानि विघ्नन्नधि ष्णुना धन्व सानो अव्ये॥
verses.tr: juṣṭvī na indo supathā sugānyurau pavasva varivāṃsi kṛṇvan ghaneva viṣvagduritāni vighnannadhi ṣṇunā dhanva sāno avye
verses.en: Pleased with us, Indu, send us as thou flowest good easy paths in ample space and comforts. Dispelling, as 'twere with a club, misfortunes, run o'er the height, run o'er the fleecy summit.

verses.sa:
वृष्टिं नो अर्ष दिव्यां जिगत्नुमिळावतीं शंगयीं जीरदानुम् ।
स्तुकेव वीता धन्वा विचिन्वन्बन्धूँरिमाँ अवराँ इन्दो वायून्॥
verses.tr: vṛṣṭiṃ no arṣa divyāṃ jigatnumiḻāvatīṃ śaṃgayīṃ jīradānum stukeva vītā dhanvā vicinvanbandhūṃrimāṃ avarāṃ indo vāyūn
verses.en: Pour on us rain celestial, quickly streaming, refreshing, fraught with health and ready bounty. Flow, Indu, send these Winds thy lower kinsmen, setting them free like locks of hair unbraided.

verses.sa:
ग्रन्थिं न वि ष्य ग्रथितं पुनान ऋजुं च गातुं वृजिनं च सोम ।
अत्यो न क्रदो हरिरा सृजानो मर्यो देव धन्व पस्त्यावान्॥
verses.tr: granthiṃ na vi ṣya grathitaṃ punāna ṛjuṃ ca gātuṃ vṛjinaṃ ca soma atyo na krado harirā sṛjāno maryo deva dhanva pastyāvān
verses.en: Part, like a knotted tangle, while they cleanse thee, O Soma, righteous and unrighteous conduct. Neigh like a tawny courser who is loosened, come like a youth, O God, a house-possessor.

verses.sa:
जुष्टो मदाय देवतात इन्दो परि ष्णुना धन्व सानो अव्ये ।
सहस्रधारः सुरभिरदब्धः परि स्रव वाजसातौ नृषह्ये॥
verses.tr: juṣṭo madāya devatāta indo pari ṣṇunā dhanva sāno avye sahasradhāraḥ surabhiradabdhaḥ pari srava vājasātau nṛṣahye
verses.en: For the God's service, for delight, O Indu, run o'er the height, run o'ver the fleecy summit. With thousand streams, inviolate, sweet-scented, flow on for gain of strength that conquers heroes.

verses.sa:
अरश्मानो येऽरथा अयुक्ता अत्यासो न ससृजानास आजौ ।
एते शुक्रासो धन्वन्ति सोमा देवासस्ताँ उप याता पिबध्यै॥
verses.tr: araśmāno ye'rathā ayuktā atyāso na sasṛjānāsa ājau ete śukrāso dhanvanti somā devāsastāṃ upa yātā pibadhyai
verses.en: Without a car, without a rein to guide them, unyoked, like coursers started in the contest, These brilliant drops of Soma juice run forward. Do ye, O Deities, come nigh to drink them.

verses.sa:
एवा न इन्दो अभि देववीतिं परि स्रव नभो अर्णश्चमूषु ।
सोमो अस्मभ्यं काम्यं बृहन्तं रयिं ददातु वीरवन्तमुग्रम्॥
verses.tr: evā na indo abhi devavītiṃ pari srava nabho arṇaścamūṣu somo asmabhyaṃ kāmyaṃ bṛhantaṃ rayiṃ dadātu vīravantamugram
verses.en: So for our banquet of the Gods, O Indu, pour down the rain of heaven into the vessels. May Soma grant us riches sought with longing, mighty, exceeding strong, with store of heroes.

verses.sa:
तक्षद्यदी मनसो वेनतो वाग्ज्येष्ठस्य वा धर्मणि क्षोरनीके ।
आदीमायन्वरमा वावशाना जुष्टं पतिं कलशे गाव इन्दुम्॥
verses.tr: takṣadyadī manaso venato vāgjyeṣṭhasya vā dharmaṇi kṣoranīke ādīmāyanvaramā vāvaśānā juṣṭaṃ patiṃ kalaśe gāva indum
verses.en: What time the loving spirit's word had formed him Chief of all food, by statute of the Highest, Then loudly lowing came the cows to Indu, the chosen, well-loved Master in the beaker.

verses.sa:
प्र दानुदो दिव्यो दानुपिन्व ऋतमृताय पवते सुमेधाः ।
धर्मा भुवद्वृजन्यस्य राजा प्र रश्मिभिर्दशभिर्भारि भूम॥
verses.tr: pra dānudo divyo dānupinva ṛtamṛtāya pavate sumedhāḥ dharmā bhuvadvṛjanyasya rājā pra raśmibhirdaśabhirbhāri bhūma
verses.en: The Sage, Celestial, liberal, raining bounties, pours as he flows the Genuine for the Truthful. The King shall be effectual strength's upholder: he by the ten bright reins is mostly guided.

verses.sa:
पवित्रेभिः पवमानो नृचक्षा राजा देवानामुत मर्त्यानाम् ।
द्विता भुवद्रयिपती रयीणामृतं भरत्सुभृतं चार्विन्दुः॥
verses.tr: pavitrebhiḥ pavamāno nṛcakṣā rājā devānāmuta martyānām dvitā bhuvadrayipatī rayīṇāmṛtaṃ bharatsubhṛtaṃ cārvinduḥ
verses.en: He who beholds mankind, made pure with filters, the King supreme of Deities and mortals, From days of old is Treasure-Lord of riches: he, Indu, cherishes fair well-kept Order.

verses.sa:
अर्वाँ इव श्रवसे सातिमच्छेन्द्रस्य वायोरभि वीतिमर्ष ।
स नः सहस्रा बृहतीरिषो दा भवा सोम द्रविणोवित्पुनानः॥
verses.tr: arvāṃ iva śravase sātimacchendrasya vāyorabhi vītimarṣa sa naḥ sahasrā bṛhatīriṣo dā bhavā soma draviṇovitpunānaḥ
verses.en: Haste, like a steed, to victory for glory, to Indra's and to Vayu's entertainment. Give us food ample, thousandfold: be, Soma, the finder-out of riches when they cleanse thee.

verses.sa:
देवाव्यो नः परिषिच्यमानाः क्षयं सुवीरं धन्वन्त  सोमाः ।
आयज्यवः सुमतिं विश्ववारा होतारो न दिवियजो मन्द्रतमाः॥
verses.tr: devāvyo naḥ pariṣicyamānāḥ kṣayaṃ suvīraṃ dhanvanta somāḥ āyajyavaḥ sumatiṃ viśvavārā hotāro na diviyajo mandratamāḥ
verses.en: Effused by us let God-delighting Somas bring as they flow a home with noble heroes. Rich in all boons like priests acquiring favour, the worshippers of heaven, the best of Cheerers.

verses.sa:
एवा देव देवताते पवस्व महे सोम प्सरसे देवपानः ।
महश्चिद्धि ष्मसि हिताः समर्ये कृधि सुष्ठाने रोदसी पुनानः॥
verses.tr: evā deva devatāte pavasva mahe soma psarase devapānaḥ mahaściddhi ṣmasi hitāḥ samarye kṛdhi suṣṭhāne rodasī punānaḥ
verses.en: So, God, for service of the Gods flow onward, flow, drink of Gods, for ample food, O Soma. For we go forth to war against the mighty make heaven and earth well stablished by thy cleansing.

verses.sa:
अश्वो नो क्रदो वृषभिर्युजानः सिंहो न भीमो मनसो जवीयान् ।
अर्वाचीनैः पथिभिर्ये रजिष्ठा आ पवस्व सौमनसं न इन्दो॥
verses.tr: aśvo no krado vṛṣabhiryujānaḥ siṃho na bhīmo manaso javīyān arvācīnaiḥ pathibhirye rajiṣṭhā ā pavasva saumanasaṃ na indo
verses.en: Thou, yoked by strong men, neighest like a courser, swifter than thought is, like an awful lion. By paths directed hitherward, the straightest, send thou us happiness, Indu, while they cleanse thee.

verses.sa:
शतं धारा देवजाता असृग्रन्त्सहस्रमेनाः कवयो मृजन्ति ।
इन्दो सनित्रं दिव आ पवस्व पुरएतासि महतो धनस्य॥
verses.tr: śataṃ dhārā devajātā asṛgrantsahasramenāḥ kavayo mṛjanti indo sanitraṃ diva ā pavasva puraetāsi mahato dhanasya
verses.en: Sprung from the Gods, a hundred streams, a thousand, have been effused: sages prepare and purge them. Bring us from heaven the means of winning, Indu; thou art-forerunnner of abundant riches.

verses.sa:
दिवो न सर्गा अससृग्रमह्नां राजा न मित्रं प्र मिनाति धीरः ।
पितुर्न पुत्रः क्रतुभिर्यतान आ पवस्व विशे अस्या अजीतिम्॥
verses.tr: divo na sargā asasṛgramahnāṃ rājā na mitraṃ pra mināti dhīraḥ piturna putraḥ kratubhiryatāna ā pavasva viśe asyā ajītim
verses.en: The streams of days, were poured as 'twere from heaven: the wise King doth not treat his friend unkindly. Like a son following his father's wishes, grant to this family success and safety.

verses.sa:
प्र ते धारा मधुमतीरसृग्रन्वारान्यत्पूतो अत्येष्यव्यान् ।
पवमान पवसे धाम गोनां जज्ञानः सूर्यमपिन्वो अर्कैः॥
verses.tr: pra te dhārā madhumatīrasṛgranvārānyatpūto atyeṣyavyān pavamāna pavase dhāma gonāṃ jajñānaḥ sūryamapinvo arkaiḥ
verses.en: Now are thy streams poured forth with all their sweetness, when, purified. thou goest through the filter. The race of kine is thy gift, Pavarridna: when born thou madest Surya rich with brightness.

verses.sa:
कनिक्रददनु पन्थामृतस्य शुक्रो वि भास्यमृतस्य धाम ।
स इन्द्राय पवसे मत्सरवान्हिन्वानो वाचं मतिभिः कवीनाम्॥
verses.tr: kanikradadanu panthāmṛtasya śukro vi bhāsyamṛtasya dhāma sa indrāya pavase matsaravānhinvāno vācaṃ matibhiḥ kavīnām
verses.en: Bright, bellowing aiong the path of Order, thou shinest as the form of life eternal. Thou flowest on as gladdening drink for Indra, sending thy voice out with the hymns of sages.

verses.sa:
दिव्यः सुपर्णोऽव चक्षि सोम पिन्वन्धाराः कर्मणा देववीतौ ।
एन्दो विश कलशं सोमधानं क्रन्दन्निहि सूर्यस्योप रश्मिम्॥
verses.tr: divyaḥ suparṇo'va cakṣi soma pinvandhārāḥ karmaṇā devavītau endo viśa kalaśaṃ somadhānaṃ krandannihi sūryasyopa raśmim
verses.en: Pouring out streams at the Gods' feast with service, thou, Soma, lookest down, a heavenly Eagle. Enter the Soma-holding beaker, Indu, and with a roar approach the ray of Sarya.

verses.sa:
तिस्रो वाच ईरयति प्र वह्निॠतस्य धीतिं ब्रह्मणो मनीषाम् ।
गावो यन्ति गोपतिं पृच्छमानाः सोमं यन्ति मतयो वावशानाः॥
verses.tr: tisro vāca īrayati pra vahniṝtasya dhītiṃ brahmaṇo manīṣām gāvo yanti gopatiṃ pṛcchamānāḥ somaṃ yanti matayo vāvaśānāḥ
verses.en: Three are the voices that the Courser utters: he speaks the thought of prayer, the law of Order. To the Cow's Master come the Cows inquiring: the hymns with eager longing come to Soma.

verses.sa:
सोमं गावो धेनवो वावशानाः सोमं विप्रा मतिभिः पृच्छमानाः ।
सोमः सुतः पूयते अज्यमानः सोमे अर्कास्त्रिष्टुभः सं नवन्ते॥
verses.tr: somaṃ gāvo dhenavo vāvaśānāḥ somaṃ viprā matibhiḥ pṛcchamānāḥ somaḥ sutaḥ pūyate ajyamānaḥ some arkāstriṣṭubhaḥ saṃ navante
verses.en: To Soma come the Cows, the Milch-kine longing, to Soma sages with their hymns inquiring. Soma, effused, is purified and blended our hymns and Trstup songs unite in Soma.

verses.sa:
एवा नः सोम परिषिच्यमान आ पवस्व पूयमानः स्वस्ति ।
इन्द्रमा विश बृहता रवेण वर्धया वाचं जनया पुरंधिम्॥
verses.tr: evā naḥ soma pariṣicyamāna ā pavasva pūyamānaḥ svasti indramā viśa bṛhatā raveṇa vardhayā vācaṃ janayā puraṃdhim
verses.en: Thus, Soma, as we pour thee into vessels, while thou art purified flow for our welfare. Pass into Indra with a mighty roaring make the voice swell, and generate abundance.

verses.sa:
आ जागृविर्विप्र ऋता मतीनां सोमः पुनानो असदच्चमूषु ।
सपन्ति यं मिथुनासो निकामा अध्वर्यवो रथिरासः सुहस्ताः॥
verses.tr: ā jāgṛvirvipra ṛtā matīnāṃ somaḥ punāno asadaccamūṣu sapanti yaṃ mithunāso nikāmā adhvaryavo rathirāsaḥ suhastāḥ
verses.en: Singer of true songs, ever-watchful, Soma hath settled in the ladles when they cleanse him. Him the Adhvaryus, paired and eager, follow, leaders of sacrifice and skilful-handed.

verses.sa:
स पुनान उप सूरे न धातोभे अप्रा रोदसी वि ष आवः ।
प्रिया चिद्यस्य प्रियसास ऊती स तू धनं कारिणे न प्र यंसत्॥
verses.tr: sa punāna upa sūre na dhātobhe aprā rodasī vi ṣa āvaḥ priyā cidyasya priyasāsa ūtī sa tū dhanaṃ kāriṇe na pra yaṃsat
verses.en: Cleansed near the Sun as 'twere he as Creator hath filled full heaven and earth, and hath disclosed them. He by whose dear help men gain all their wishes shall yield the precious meed as to a victor.

verses.sa:
स वर्धिता वर्धनः पूयमानः सोमो मीढ्वाँ अभि नो ज्योतिषावीत् ।
येना नः पूर्वे पितरः पदज्ञाः स्वर्विदो अभि गा अद्रिमुष्णन्॥
verses.tr: sa vardhitā vardhanaḥ pūyamānaḥ somo mīḍhvāṃ abhi no jyotiṣāvīt yenā naḥ pūrve pitaraḥ padajñāḥ svarvido abhi gā adrimuṣṇan
verses.en: He, being cleansed, the Strengthener and Increaser, Soma the Bounteous, helped us with his lustre, Wherewith our sires of old who knew the footsteps found light and stole the cattle from the mountain.

verses.sa:
अक्रान्त्समुद्रः प्रथमे विधर्मञ्जनयन्प्रजा भुवनस्य राजा ।
वृषा पवित्रे अधि सानो अव्ये बृहत्सोमो वावृधे सुवान इन्दुः॥
verses.tr: akrāntsamudraḥ prathame vidharmañjanayanprajā bhuvanasya rājā vṛṣā pavitre adhi sāno avye bṛhatsomo vāvṛdhe suvāna induḥ
verses.en: In the first vault of heaven loud roared the Ocean, King of all being, generating creatures. Steer, in the filter, on the fleecy summit, Soma, the Drop effused, hath waxen mighty.

verses.sa:
महत्तत्सोमो महिषश्चकाराऽपां यद्गर्भोऽवृणीत देवान् ।
अदधादिन्द्रे पवमान ओजोऽजनयत्सूर्ये ज्योतिरिन्दुः॥
verses.tr: mahattatsomo mahiṣaścakārā'pāṃ yadgarbho'vṛṇīta devān adadhādindre pavamāna ojo'janayatsūrye jyotirinduḥ
verses.en: Soma the Steer, in that as Child of Waters he chose the Gods, performed that great achievement. He, Pavamana, granted strength to Indra; he, Indu, generated light in Surya.

verses.sa:
मत्सि वायुमिष्टये राधसे च मत्सि मित्रावरुणा पूयमानः ।
मत्सि शर्धो मारुतं मत्सि देवान्मत्सि द्यावापृथिवी देव सोम॥
verses.tr: matsi vāyumiṣṭaye rādhase ca matsi mitrāvaruṇā pūyamānaḥ matsi śardho mārutaṃ matsi devānmatsi dyāvāpṛthivī deva soma
verses.en: Make Vayu glad,, for furtherance and bounty: cheer Varuna and Mitra, as they cleanse thee. Gladden the Gods, gladden the host of Maruts: make Heaven and Earth rejoice, O God, O Soma.

verses.sa:
ऋजुः पवस्व वृजिनस्य हन्ताऽपामीवां बाधमानो मृधश्च ।
अभिश्रीणन्पयः पयसाभि गोनामिन्द्रस्य त्वं तव वयं सखायः॥
verses.tr: ṛjuḥ pavasva vṛjinasya hantā'pāmīvāṃ bādhamāno mṛdhaśca abhiśrīṇanpayaḥ payasābhi gonāmindrasya tvaṃ tava vayaṃ sakhāyaḥ
verses.en: Flow onward righteous slayer of the wicked, driving away our enemies and sickness, Blending thy milk with milk which cows afford us. We are thy friends, thou art the Friend of Indra.

verses.sa:
मध्वः सूदं पवस्व वस्व उत्सं वीरं च न आ पवस्वा भगं च ।
स्वदस्वेन्द्राय पवमान इन्दो रयिं च न आ पवस्वा समुद्रात्॥
verses.tr: madhvaḥ sūdaṃ pavasva vasva utsaṃ vīraṃ ca na ā pavasvā bhagaṃ ca svadasvendrāya pavamāna indo rayiṃ ca na ā pavasvā samudrāt
verses.en: Pour us a fount of meath, a spring of treasure; send us a hero son and happy fortune. Be sweet to India when they cleanse thee, Indu, and pour down riches on us from the ocean.

verses.sa:
सोमः सुतो धारयात्यो न हित्वा सिन्धुर्न निम्नमभि वाज्यक्षाः ।
आ योनिं वन्यमसदत्पुनानः समिन्दुर्गोभिरसरत्समद्भिः॥
verses.tr: somaḥ suto dhārayātyo na hitvā sindhurna nimnamabhi vājyakṣāḥ ā yoniṃ vanyamasadatpunānaḥ samindurgobhirasaratsamadbhiḥ
verses.en: Strong Soma, pressed, like an impetuous courser, hath flowed in stream as a flood speeding downward. Cleansed, he hath settled in his wooden dwelling: Indu hath flowed with milk and with the waters.

verses.sa:
एष स्य ते पवत इन्द्र सोमश्चमूषु धीर उशते तवस्वान् ।
स्वर्चक्षा रथिरः सत्यशुष्मः कामो न यो देवयतामसर्जि॥
verses.tr: eṣa sya te pavata indra somaścamūṣu dhīra uśate tavasvān svarcakṣā rathiraḥ satyaśuṣmaḥ kāmo na yo devayatāmasarji
verses.en: Strong, wise, for thee who longest for his coming this Soma here flows to the bowls, O Indra. He, chariot-borne, sun-bright, and truly potent, was poured forth like the longing of the pious.

verses.sa:
एष प्रत्नेन वयसा पुनानस्तिरो वर्पांसि दुहितुर्दधानः ।
वसानः शर्म त्रिवरूथमप्सु होतेव याति समनेषु रेभन्॥
verses.tr: eṣa pratnena vayasā punānastiro varpāṃsi duhiturdadhānaḥ vasānaḥ śarma trivarūthamapsu hoteva yāti samaneṣu rebhan
verses.en: He, purified with ancient vital vigour, pervading all his Daughter's forms and figures, Finding his threefold refuge in the waters, goes singing, as a priest, to the assemblies.

verses.sa:
नू नस्त्वं रथिरो देव सोम परि स्रव चम्वोः पूयमानः ।
अप्सु स्वादिष्ठो मधुमाँ ऋतावा देवो न यः सविता सत्यमन्मा॥
verses.tr: nū nastvaṃ rathiro deva soma pari srava camvoḥ pūyamānaḥ apsu svādiṣṭho madhumāṃ ṛtāvā devo na yaḥ savitā satyamanmā
verses.en: Now, chariot-borne, flow unto us, God Soma, as thou art purified flow to the saucers, Sweetest in waters, rich in meath, and holy, as Savitar the God is, truthful minded.

verses.sa:
अभि वायुं वीत्यर्षा गृणानो३ऽभि मित्रावरुणा पूयमानः ।
अभी नरं धीजवनं रथेष्ठामभीन्द्रं वृषणं वज्रबाहुम्॥
verses.tr: abhi vāyuṃ vītyarṣā gṛṇāno3'bhi mitrāvaruṇā pūyamānaḥ abhī naraṃ dhījavanaṃ ratheṣṭhāmabhīndraṃ vṛṣaṇaṃ vajrabāhum
verses.en: To feast him, flow mid song and hymn, to Vayu, flow purified to Varuna and Mitra. Flow to the song-inspiring car-borne Hero, to mighty Indra, him who wields the thunder.

verses.sa:
अभि वस्त्रा सुवसनान्यर्षाऽभि धेनूः सुदुघाः पूयमानः ।
अभि चन्द्रा भर्तवे नो हिरण्याऽभ्यश्वान्रथिनो देव सोम॥
verses.tr: abhi vastrā suvasanānyarṣā'bhi dhenūḥ sudughāḥ pūyamānaḥ abhi candrā bhartave no hiraṇyā'bhyaśvānrathino deva soma
verses.en: Pour on us garments that shall clothe us meetly, send, purified, milch-kine, abundant yielders. God Soma, send us chariot-drawing horses that they may bring us treasures bright and golden.

verses.sa:
अभी नो अर्ष दिव्या वसून्यभि विश्वा पार्थिवा पूयमानः ।
अभि येन द्रविणमश्नवामाऽभ्यार्षेयं जमदग्निवन्नः॥
verses.tr: abhī no arṣa divyā vasūnyabhi viśvā pārthivā pūyamānaḥ abhi yena draviṇamaśnavāmā'bhyārṣeyaṃ jamadagnivannaḥ
verses.en: Send to us in a stream celestial riches, send us, when thou art cleansed, what earth containeth, So that thereby we may acquire possessions and Rsihood in Jamadagni's manner.

verses.sa:
अया पवा पवस्वैना वसूनि माँश्चत्व इन्दो सरसि प्र धन्व ।
ब्रध्नश्चिदत्र वातो न जूतः पुरुमेधश्चित्तकवे नरं दात्॥
verses.tr: ayā pavā pavasvainā vasūni māṃścatva indo sarasi pra dhanva bradhnaścidatra vāto na jūtaḥ purumedhaścittakave naraṃ dāt
verses.en: Pour forth this wealth with this purification: flow onward to the yellow lake, O Indu. Here, too, the Ruddy, wind-swift, full of wisdom, Shall give a son to him who cometh quickly.

verses.sa:
उत न एना पवया पवस्वाऽधि श्रुते श्रवाय्यस्य तीर्थे ।
षष्टिं सहस्रा नैगुतो वसूनि वृक्षं न पक्वं धूनवद्रणाय॥
verses.tr: uta na enā pavayā pavasvā'dhi śrute śravāyyasya tīrthe ṣaṣṭiṃ sahasrā naiguto vasūni vṛkṣaṃ na pakvaṃ dhūnavadraṇāya
verses.en: Flow on for us with this purification to the famed ford of thee whose due is glory. May the Foe-queller shake us down, for triumph, like a tree's ripe fruit, sixty thousand treasures.

verses.sa:
महीमे अस्य वृषनाम शूषे माँश्चत्वे वा पृशने वा वधत्रे ।
अस्वापयन्निगुतः स्नेहयच्चाऽपामित्राँ अपाचितो अचेतः॥
verses.tr: mahīme asya vṛṣanāma śūṣe māṃścatve vā pṛśane vā vadhatre asvāpayannigutaḥ snehayaccā'pāmitrāṃ apācito acetaḥ
verses.en: Eagerly do we pray for those two exploits, at the blue lake and Prsana, wrought in battle. He sent our enemies to sleep and slew them, and turned away the foolish and unfriendly.

verses.sa:
सं त्री पवित्रा विततान्येष्यन्वेकं धावसि पूयमानः ।
असि भगो असि दात्रस्य दाताऽसि मघवा मघवद्भ्य इन्दो॥
verses.tr: saṃ trī pavitrā vitatānyeṣyanvekaṃ dhāvasi pūyamānaḥ asi bhago asi dātrasya dātā'si maghavā maghavadbhya indo
verses.en: Thou comest unto three extended filters, and hasteriest through each one as they cleanse thee. Thou art the giver of the gift, a Bhaga, a Maghavan for liberal lords, O Indu.

verses.sa:
एष विश्ववित्पवते मनीषी सोमो विश्वस्य भुवनस्य राजा ।
द्रप्साँ ईरयन्विदथेष्विन्दुर्वि वारमव्यं समयाति याति॥
verses.tr: eṣa viśvavitpavate manīṣī somo viśvasya bhuvanasya rājā drapsāṃ īrayanvidatheṣvindurvi vāramavyaṃ samayāti yāti
verses.en: This Soma here, the Wise, the All-obtainer, flows on his way as King of all existence. Driving the drops at our assemblies, Indu completely traverses the fleecy filter.

verses.sa:
इन्दुं रिहन्ति महिषा अदब्धाः पदे रेभन्ति कवयो न गृध्राः ।
हिन्वन्ति धीरा दशभिः क्षिपाभिः समञ्जते रूपमपां रसेन॥
verses.tr: induṃ rihanti mahiṣā adabdhāḥ pade rebhanti kavayo na gṛdhrāḥ hinvanti dhīrā daśabhiḥ kṣipābhiḥ samañjate rūpamapāṃ rasena
verses.en: The Great Inviolate are kissing Indu, and singing in his place like eager sages. The wise men send him forth with ten swift fingers, and balm his form with essence of the waters.

verses.sa:
त्वया वयं पवमानेन सोम भरे कृतं वि चिनुयाम शश्वत् ।
तन्नो मित्रो वरुणो मामहन्तामदितिः सिन्धुः पृथिवी उत द्यौः॥
verses.tr: tvayā vayaṃ pavamānena soma bhare kṛtaṃ vi cinuyāma śaśvat tanno mitro varuṇo māmahantāmaditiḥ sindhuḥ pṛthivī uta dyauḥ
verses.en: Soma, may we, with thee as Pavamana, pile up together all our spoil in battle. This boon vouchsafe us Varuna and Mitra, and Aditi and Sindhu, Earth and Heaven.

verses.sa: अभि नो वाजसातमं रयिमर्ष पुरुस्पृहम् । इन्दो सहस्रभर्णसं तुविद्युम्नं विभ्वासहम्॥
verses.tr: abhi no vājasātamaṃ rayimarṣa puruspṛham indo sahasrabharṇasaṃ tuvidyumnaṃ vibhvāsaham
verses.en: Stream on us riches that are sought by many, best at winning strength Riches, O Indu, thousand fold, glorious, conquering the great.

verses.sa: परि ष्य सुवानो अव्ययं रथे न वर्माव्यत । इन्दुरभि द्रुणा हितो हियानो धाराभिरक्षाः॥
verses.tr: pari ṣya suvāno avyayaṃ rathe na varmāvyata indurabhi druṇā hito hiyāno dhārābhirakṣāḥ
verses.en: Effused, he hath, as on a car, invested him in fleecy mail: Onward hath Indu flowed in streams, impelled, surrounded by the wood.

verses.sa: परि ष्य सुवानो अक्षा इन्दुरव्ये मदच्युतः । धारा य ऊर्ध्वो अध्वरे भ्राजा नैति गव्ययुः॥
verses.tr: pari ṣya suvāno akṣā induravye madacyutaḥ dhārā ya ūrdhvo adhvare bhrājā naiti gavyayuḥ
verses.en: Effused, this Indu hath flowed on, distilling rapture, to the fleece: He goes erect, as seeking kine in stream, with light, to sacrifice.

verses.sa: स हि त्वं देव शश्वते वसु मर्ताय दाशुषे । इन्दो सहस्रिणं रयिं शतात्मानं विवाससि॥
verses.tr: sa hi tvaṃ deva śaśvate vasu martāya dāśuṣe indo sahasriṇaṃ rayiṃ śatātmānaṃ vivāsasi
verses.en: For thou thyself, O Indu, God, to every mortal worshipper Attractest riches thousand fold, made manifest in hundred forms.

verses.sa: वयं ते अस्य वृत्रहन्वसो वस्वः पुरुस्पृहः । नि नेदिष्ठतमा इषः स्याम सुम्नस्याध्रिगो॥
verses.tr: vayaṃ te asya vṛtrahanvaso vasvaḥ puruspṛhaḥ ni nediṣṭhatamā iṣaḥ syāma sumnasyādhrigo
verses.en: Good Vrtra-slayer, may we be still nearest to this wealth of thine Which many crave, nearest to food and happiness, Resistless One!

verses.sa: द्विर्यं पञ्च स्वयशसं स्वसारो अद्रिसंहतम् । प्रियमिन्द्रस्य काम्यं प्रस्नापयन्त्यूर्मिणम्॥
verses.tr: dviryaṃ pañca svayaśasaṃ svasāro adrisaṃhatam priyamindrasya kāmyaṃ prasnāpayantyūrmiṇam
verses.en: Whom, bright with native splendour, crushed between the pair of pressing stones The wavy Friend whom Indra loves-the twice-five sisters dip and bathe,

verses.sa: परि त्यं हर्यतं हरिं बभ्रुं पुनन्ति वारेण । यो देवान्विश्वाँ इत्परि मदेन सह गच्छति॥
verses.tr: pari tyaṃ haryataṃ hariṃ babhruṃ punanti vāreṇa yo devānviśvāṃ itpari madena saha gacchati
verses.en: Him with the fleece they purify, brown, golden-hued, beloved of all, Who with exhilarating juice goes forth to all the Deities.

verses.sa: अस्य वो ह्यवसा पान्तो दक्षसाधनम् । यः सूरिषु श्रवो बृहद्दधे स्व१र्ण हर्यतः॥
verses.tr: asya vo hyavasā pānto dakṣasādhanam yaḥ sūriṣu śravo bṛhaddadhe sva1rṇa haryataḥ
verses.en: Through longing for this sap of yours ye drink what brings ability, Even him who, dear as heaven's own light, gives to our princes high renown.

verses.sa: स वां यज्ञेषु मानवी इन्दुर्जनिष्ट रोदसी । देवो देवी गिरिष्ठा अस्रेधन्तं तुविष्वणि॥
verses.tr: sa vāṃ yajñeṣu mānavī indurjaniṣṭa rodasī devo devī giriṣṭhā asredhantaṃ tuviṣvaṇi
verses.en: Indu at holy rites produced you, Heaven and Earth, the Friends of men, Hill-haunting God the Goddesses. They bruised him where the roar was loud.

verses.sa: इन्द्राय सोम पातवे वृत्रघ्ने परि षिच्यसे । नरे च दक्षिणावते देवाय सदनासदे॥
verses.tr: indrāya soma pātave vṛtraghne pari ṣicyase nare ca dakṣiṇāvate devāya sadanāsade
verses.en: For Vrtra-slaying Indra, thou, Soma, art poured that he may drink, Poured for the guerdon-giving man, poured for the God who sitteth there.

verses.sa:
ते प्रत्नासो व्युष्टिषु सोमाः पवित्रे अक्षरन् ।
अपप्रोथन्तः सनुतर्हुरश्चितः प्रातस्ताँ अप्रचेतसः॥
verses.tr: te pratnāso vyuṣṭiṣu somāḥ pavitre akṣaran apaprothantaḥ sanutarhuraścitaḥ prātastāṃ apracetasaḥ
verses.en: These ancient Somas, at the break of day, have flowed into the sieve, Snorting away at early morn these foolish evil-hearted ones.

verses.sa: तं सखायः पुरोरुचं यूयं वयं च सूरयः । अश्याम वाजगन्ध्यं सनेम वाजपस्त्यम्॥
verses.tr: taṃ sakhāyaḥ purorucaṃ yūyaṃ vayaṃ ca sūrayaḥ aśyāma vājagandhyaṃ sanema vājapastyam
verses.en: Friends, may the princes, ye and we, obtain this Most Resplendent One. Gain him who hath the smell of strength, win him whose home is very strength.

verses.sa:
आ हर्यताय धृष्णवे धनुस्तन्वन्ति पौंस्यम् ।
शुक्रां वयन्त्यसुराय निर्णिजं विपामग्रे महीयुवः॥
verses.tr: ā haryatāya dhṛṣṇave dhanustanvanti pauṃsyam śukrāṃ vayantyasurāya nirṇijaṃ vipāmagre mahīyuvaḥ
verses.en: They for the Bold and Lovely One ply manly vigour like a bow: joyous, in front of songs they weave bright raiment for the Lord Divine.

verses.sa: अध क्षपा परिष्कृतो वाजाँ अभि प्र गाहते । यदी विवस्वतो धियो हरिं हिन्वन्ति यातवे॥
verses.tr: adha kṣapā pariṣkṛto vājāṃ abhi pra gāhate yadī vivasvato dhiyo hariṃ hinvanti yātave
verses.en: And he, made beautiful by night, dips forward into strengthening food', What time the sacrificer's thoughts speed on his way the Golden-hued.

verses.sa: तमस्य मर्जयामसि मदो य इन्द्रपातमः । यं गाव आसभिर्दधुः पुरा नूनं च सूरयः॥
verses.tr: tamasya marjayāmasi mado ya indrapātamaḥ yaṃ gāva āsabhirdadhuḥ purā nūnaṃ ca sūrayaḥ
verses.en: We cleanse this gladdening drink of his the juice which Indra chiefly drinks--- That which kine took into their mouths, of old, and princes take it now.

verses.sa: तं गाथया पुराण्या पुनानमभ्यनूषत । उतो कृपन्त धीतयो देवानां नाम बिभ्रतीः॥
verses.tr: taṃ gāthayā purāṇyā punānamabhyanūṣata uto kṛpanta dhītayo devānāṃ nāma bibhratīḥ
verses.en: To him, while purifying, they have raised the ancient psalm of praise: And sacred songs which bear the names of Gods have supplicated him.

verses.sa: तमुक्षमाणमव्यये वारे पुनन्ति धर्णसिम् । दूतं न पूर्वचित्तय आ शासते मनीषिणः॥
verses.tr: tamukṣamāṇamavyaye vāre punanti dharṇasim dūtaṃ na pūrvacittaya ā śāsate manīṣiṇaḥ
verses.en: They purify him as he drops, courageous, in the fleecy sieve. Him they instruct as messenger to bear the sage's morning prayer.

verses.sa: स पुनानो मदिन्तमः सोमश्चमूषु सीदति । पशौ न रेत आदधत्पतिर्वचस्यते धियः॥
verses.tr: sa punāno madintamaḥ somaścamūṣu sīdati paśau na reta ādadhatpatirvacasyate dhiyaḥ
verses.en: Soma, best Cheerer, takes his seat, the while they cleanse him in the bowls. He as it were impregns the cow, and babbles on, the Lord of Song.

verses.sa: स मृज्यते सुकर्मभिर्देवो देवेभ्यः सुतः । विदे यदासु संददिर्महीरपो वि गाहते॥
verses.tr: sa mṛjyate sukarmabhirdevo devebhyaḥ sutaḥ vide yadāsu saṃdadirmahīrapo vi gāhate
verses.en: He is effused and beautified, a God for Gods, by skillful men. He penetrates the mighty floods collecting all he knows therein.

verses.sa: सुत इन्दो पवित्र आ नृभिर्यतो वि नीयसे । इन्द्राय मत्सरिन्तमश्चमूष्वा नि षीदसि॥
verses.tr: suta indo pavitra ā nṛbhiryato vi nīyase indrāya matsarintamaścamūṣvā ni ṣīdasi
verses.en: Pressed, Indu, guided by the men, thou art led to the cleaning sieve. Thou, yielding Indra highest joy, takest thy seat within the bowls.

verses.sa: अभी नवन्ते अद्रुहः प्रियमिन्द्रस्य काम्यम् । वत्सं न पूर्व आयुनि जातं रिहन्ति मातरः॥
verses.tr: abhī navante adruhaḥ priyamindrasya kāmyam vatsaṃ na pūrva āyuni jātaṃ rihanti mātaraḥ
verses.en: The Guileless Ones are singing praise to Indra's well beloved Friend, As, in the morning of its life, the mothers lick the new-born calf.

verses.sa: पुनान इन्दवा भर सोम द्विबर्हसं रयिम् । त्वं वसूनि पुष्यसि विश्वानि दाशुषो गृहे॥
verses.tr: punāna indavā bhara soma dvibarhasaṃ rayim tvaṃ vasūni puṣyasi viśvāni dāśuṣo gṛhe
verses.en: O Indu, while they cleanse thee bring, O Soma, doubly-waxing wealth Thou in the worshipper's abode causest all treasures to increase.

verses.sa: त्वं धियं मनोयुजं सृजा वृष्टिं न तन्यतुः । त्वं वसूनि पार्थिवा दिव्या च सोम पुष्यसि॥
verses.tr: tvaṃ dhiyaṃ manoyujaṃ sṛjā vṛṣṭiṃ na tanyatuḥ tvaṃ vasūni pārthivā divyā ca soma puṣyasi
verses.en: Set free the. song which mind hath yoked, even as thunder frees the rain: All treasures of the earth and heaven, O Soma, thou dost multiply.

verses.sa: परि ते जिग्युषो यथा धारा सुतस्य धावति । रंहमाणा व्य१व्ययं वारं वाजीव सानसिः॥
verses.tr: pari te jigyuṣo yathā dhārā sutasya dhāvati raṃhamāṇā vya1vyayaṃ vāraṃ vājīva sānasiḥ
verses.en: Thy stream when thou art pressed runs on like some victorious warrior's steed Hastening onward through the fleece like a fierce horse who wins the prize.

verses.sa: क्रत्वे दक्षाय नः कवे पवस्व सोम धारया । इन्द्राय पातवे सुतो मित्राय वरुणाय च॥
verses.tr: kratve dakṣāya naḥ kave pavasva soma dhārayā indrāya pātave suto mitrāya varuṇāya ca
verses.en: Flow on, Sage Soma, with thy stream to give us mental power and strength, Effused for Indra, for his drink, for Mitra and for Varuna.

verses.sa: पवस्व वाजसातमः पवित्रे धारया सुतः । इन्द्राय सोम विष्णवे देवेभ्यो मधुमत्तमः॥
verses.tr: pavasva vājasātamaḥ pavitre dhārayā sutaḥ indrāya soma viṣṇave devebhyo madhumattamaḥ
verses.en: Flow to the filter with thy stream, effused, best winner, thou, of spoil, O Soma, as most rich in sweets for Indra, Visnu, and the Gods.

verses.sa: त्वां रिहन्ति मातरो हरिं पवित्रे अद्रुहः । वत्सं जातं न धेनवः पवमान विधर्मणि॥
verses.tr: tvāṃ rihanti mātaro hariṃ pavitre adruhaḥ vatsaṃ jātaṃ na dhenavaḥ pavamāna vidharmaṇi
verses.en: The mothers, void of guiles, caress thee Golden-coloured, in the sieve, As cows, O Pavamana, lick the new-born calf, as Law commands.

verses.sa: पवमान महि श्रवश्चित्रेभिर्यासि रश्मिभिः । शर्धन्तमांसि जिघ्नसे विश्वानि दाशुषो गृहे॥
verses.tr: pavamāna mahi śravaścitrebhiryāsi raśmibhiḥ śardhantamāṃsi jighnase viśvāni dāśuṣo gṛhe
verses.en: Thou, Pavamana, movest on with wondrous rays to great renown. Striving within the votary's house thou drivest all the glooms away.

verses.sa: त्वं द्यां च महिव्रत पृथिवीं चाति जभ्रिषे । प्रति द्रापिममुञ्चथाः पवमान महित्वना॥
verses.tr: tvaṃ dyāṃ ca mahivrata pṛthivīṃ cāti jabhriṣe prati drāpimamuñcathāḥ pavamāna mahitvanā
verses.en: Lord of great sway, thou liftest thee above the heavens, above the earth. Thou, Pavamana hast assumed thy coat of mail in majesty.

verses.sa: पुरोजिती वो अन्धसः सुताय मादयित्नवे । अप श्वानं श्नथिष्टन सखायो दीर्घजिह्व्यम्॥
verses.tr: purojitī vo andhasaḥ sutāya mādayitnave apa śvānaṃ śnathiṣṭana sakhāyo dīrghajihvyam
verses.en: For first possession of your juice, for the exhilarating drink, Drive ye away the dog, my friends, drive ye the long-tongued dog away.

verses.sa: यो धारया पावकया परिप्रस्यन्दते सुतः । इन्दुरश्वो न कृत्व्यः॥
verses.tr: yo dhārayā pāvakayā pariprasyandate sutaḥ induraśvo na kṛtvyaḥ
verses.en: He who with purifying stream, effused, comes flowing hitherward, Indu, is like an able steed.

verses.sa: तं दुरोषमभी नरः सोमं विश्वाच्या धिया । यज्ञं हिन्वन्त्यद्रिभिः॥
verses.tr: taṃ duroṣamabhī naraḥ somaṃ viśvācyā dhiyā yajñaṃ hinvantyadribhiḥ
verses.en: The men with all-pervading song send unassailable Soma forth, By pressing-stones, to sacrifice.

verses.sa: सुतासो मधुमत्तमाः सोमा इन्द्राय मन्दिनः । पवित्रवन्तो अक्षरन्देवान्गच्छन्तु वो मदाः॥
verses.tr: sutāso madhumattamāḥ somā indrāya mandinaḥ pavitravanto akṣarandevāngacchantu vo madāḥ
verses.en: The Somas, very rich in sweets, for which the sieve is destined, flow, Effused, the source of Indra's joy: may your strong juices reach the Gods.

verses.sa: इन्दुरिन्द्राय पवत इति देवासो अब्रुवन् । वाचस्पतिर्मखस्यते विश्वस्येशान ओजसा॥
verses.tr: indurindrāya pavata iti devāso abruvan vācaspatirmakhasyate viśvasyeśāna ojasā
verses.en: Indu flows on for Indra's sake: thus have the Deities declared. The Lord of Speech exerts himself, Ruler of all, because of might.

verses.sa: सहस्रधारः पवते समुद्रो वाचमीङ्खयः । सोमः पती रयीणां सखेन्द्रस्य दिवेदिवे॥
verses.tr: sahasradhāraḥ pavate samudro vācamīṅkhayaḥ somaḥ patī rayīṇāṃ sakhendrasya divedive
verses.en: Inciter of the voice of song, with thousand streams the ocean flows, Even Soma, Lord of opulence, the Friend of Indra, day by day.

verses.sa: अयं पूषा रयिर्भगः सोमः पुनानो अर्षति । पतिर्विश्वस्य भूमनो व्यख्यद्रोदसी उभे॥
verses.tr: ayaṃ pūṣā rayirbhagaḥ somaḥ punāno arṣati patirviśvasya bhūmano vyakhyadrodasī ubhe
verses.en: As Pusan, Fortune, Bhaga, comes this Soma while they make him pure. He, Lord of the multitude, hath looked upon the earth and heaven.

verses.sa: समु प्रिया अनूषत गावो मदाय घृष्वयः । सोमासः कृण्वते पथः पवमानास इन्दवः॥
verses.tr: samu priyā anūṣata gāvo madāya ghṛṣvayaḥ somāsaḥ kṛṇvate pathaḥ pavamānāsa indavaḥ
verses.en: The dear cows lowed in joyful mood together to the gladdening drink. The drops as they were purified, the Soma juices, made then paths.

verses.sa: य ओजिष्ठस्तमा भर पवमान श्रवाय्यम् । यः पञ्च चर्षणीरभि रयिं येन वनामहै॥
verses.tr: ya ojiṣṭhastamā bhara pavamāna śravāyyam yaḥ pañca carṣaṇīrabhi rayiṃ yena vanāmahai
verses.en: O Pavamana, bring the juice, the mightiest, worthy to be famed, Which the Five Tribes have over them, whereby we may win opulence.

verses.sa: सोमाः पवन्त इन्दवोऽस्मभ्यं गातुवित्तमाः । मित्राः सुवाना अरेपसः स्वाध्यः स्वर्विदः॥
verses.tr: somāḥ pavanta indavo'smabhyaṃ gātuvittamāḥ mitrāḥ suvānā arepasaḥ svādhyaḥ svarvidaḥ
verses.en: For us the Soma juices flow, the drops best furtherers of our weal, Effused as friends without a spot, benevolent, finders of the light.

verses.sa: सुष्वाणासो व्यद्रिभिश्चिताना गोरधि त्वचि । इषमस्मभ्यमभितः समस्वरन्वसुविदः॥
verses.tr: suṣvāṇāso vyadribhiścitānā goradhi tvaci iṣamasmabhyamabhitaḥ samasvaranvasuvidaḥ
verses.en: Effused by means of pressing-stones, upon the ox-hide visible, They, treasure-finders, have announced food unto us from every side.

verses.sa: एते पूता विपश्चितः सोमासो दध्याशिरः । सूर्यासो न दर्शतासो जिगत्नवो ध्रुवा घृते॥
verses.tr: ete pūtā vipaścitaḥ somāso dadhyāśiraḥ sūryāso na darśatāso jigatnavo dhruvā ghṛte
verses.en: These Soma juices, skilled in song, purified, blent with milk and curd, When moving and when firmly laid in oil, resemble lovely Suns.

verses.sa: प्र सुन्वानस्यान्धसो मर्तो न वृत तद्वचः । अप श्वानमराधसं हता मखं न भृगवः॥
verses.tr: pra sunvānasyāndhaso marto na vṛta tadvacaḥ apa śvānamarādhasaṃ hatā makhaṃ na bhṛgavaḥ
verses.en: Let not the power of men restrain the voice of the outpouring juice: As Bhrgu's sons chased Makha, so drive ye the greedy hound away.

verses.sa: आ जामिरत्के अव्यत भुजे न पुत्र ओण्योः । सरज्जारो न योषणां वरो न योनिमासदम्॥
verses.tr: ā jāmiratke avyata bhuje na putra oṇyoḥ sarajjāro na yoṣaṇāṃ varo na yonimāsadam
verses.en: The Friend hath wrapped him in his robe, as in his parents arms, a son. He went, as lover to a dame, to take his station suitor-like.

verses.sa: स वीरो दक्षसाधनो वि यस्तस्तम्भ रोदसी । हरिः पवित्रे अव्यत वेधा न योनिमासदम्॥
verses.tr: sa vīro dakṣasādhano vi yastastambha rodasī hariḥ pavitre avyata vedhā na yonimāsadam
verses.en: That Hero who produces strength, he who hath propped both worlds apart, Gold-hued, hath wrapped him in the sieve, to settle, priest-like, in his place.

verses.sa: अव्यो वारेभिः पवते सोमो गव्ये अधि त्वचि । कनिक्रदद्वृषा हरिरिन्द्रस्याभ्येति निष्कृतम्॥
verses.tr: avyo vārebhiḥ pavate somo gavye adhi tvaci kanikradadvṛṣā haririndrasyābhyeti niṣkṛtam
verses.en: Soma upon the ox's skin through the sheep's wool flows purified. Bellowing out, the Tawny Steer goes on to Indra's special place.

verses.sa: क्राणा शिशुर्महीनां हिन्वन्नृतस्य दीधितिम् । विश्वा परि प्रिया भुवदध द्विता॥
verses.tr: krāṇā śiśurmahīnāṃ hinvannṛtasya dīdhitim viśvā pari priyā bhuvadadha dvitā
verses.en: The Child, when blended with the streams, speeding the plan of sacrifice, Surpasses all things that are dear, yea, from of old.

verses.sa: उप त्रितस्य पाष्यो३रभक्त यद्गुहा पदम् । यज्ञस्य सप्त धामभिरध प्रियम्॥
verses.tr: upa tritasya pāṣyo3rabhakta yadguhā padam yajñasya sapta dhāmabhiradha priyam
verses.en: The place, near the two pressing-stones of Trita, hath he occupied, Secret and dear through seven lights of sacrifice.

verses.sa: त्रीणि त्रितस्य धारया पृष्ठेष्वेरया रयिम् । मिमीते अस्य योजना वि सुक्रतुः॥
verses.tr: trīṇi tritasya dhārayā pṛṣṭheṣverayā rayim mimīte asya yojanā vi sukratuḥ
verses.en: Urge to three courses, on the heights of Trita, riches in a stream. He who is passing wise measures his courses out.

verses.sa: जज्ञानं सप्त मातरो वेधामशासत श्रिये । अयं ध्रुवो रयीणां चिकेत यत्॥
verses.tr: jajñānaṃ sapta mātaro vedhāmaśāsata śriye ayaṃ dhruvo rayīṇāṃ ciketa yat
verses.en: Even at his birth the Mothers Seven taught him, for glory, like a sage, So that he, firm and sure, hath set his mind on wealth.

verses.sa: अस्य व्रते सजोषसो विश्वे देवासो अद्रुहः । स्पार्हा भवन्ति रन्तयो जुषन्त यत्॥
