verses.tr: asya vrate sajoṣaso viśve devāso adruhaḥ spārhā bhavanti rantayo juṣanta yat
verses.en: Under his sway, of one accord, are all the guileless Deities: Warriors to be envied, they, when they are pleased.

verses.sa: यमी गर्भमृतावृधो दृशे चारुमजीजनन् । कविं मंहिष्ठमध्वरे पुरुस्पृहम्॥
verses.tr: yamī garbhamṛtāvṛdho dṛśe cārumajījanan kaviṃ maṃhiṣṭhamadhvare puruspṛham
verses.en: The Babe whom they who strengthen Law have generated fair to see, Much longed for at the sacrifice, most liberal Sage,

verses.sa: समीचीने अभि त्मना यह्वी ऋतस्य मातरा । तन्वाना यज्ञमानुषग्यदञ्जते॥
verses.tr: samīcīne abhi tmanā yahvī ṛtasya mātarā tanvānā yajñamānuṣagyadañjate
verses.en: To him, united, of themselves, come the young Parents of the rite, When they adorn him, duly weaving sacrifice.

verses.sa: क्रत्वा शुक्रेभिरक्षभिॠणोरप व्रजं दिवः । हिन्वन्नृतस्य दीधितिं प्राध्वरे॥
verses.tr: kratvā śukrebhirakṣabhiṝṇorapa vrajaṃ divaḥ hinvannṛtasya dīdhitiṃ prādhvare
verses.en: With wisdom and with radiant eyes unbar to us the stall of heaven, Speeding at solemn rite the plan of Holy Law.

verses.sa: प्र पुनानाय वेधसे सोमाय वच उद्यतम् । भृतिं न भरा मतिभिर्जुजोषते॥
verses.tr: pra punānāya vedhase somāya vaca udyatam bhṛtiṃ na bharā matibhirjujoṣate
verses.en: To Soma who is purified as ordering Priest the song is raised: Bring meed, as 'twere, to one who makes thee glad with hymns.

verses.sa: परि वाराण्यव्यया गोभिरञ्जानो अर्षति । त्री षधस्था पुनानः कृणुते हरिः॥
verses.tr: pari vārāṇyavyayā gobhirañjāno arṣati trī ṣadhasthā punānaḥ kṛṇute hariḥ
verses.en: Blended with milk and curds he flows on through the long wool of the sheep. The Gold-hued, purified, makes him three seats for rest.

verses.sa: परि कोशं मधुश्चुतमव्यये वारे अर्षति । अभि वाणीॠषीणां सप्त नूषत॥
verses.tr: pari kośaṃ madhuścutamavyaye vāre arṣati abhi vāṇīṝṣīṇāṃ sapta nūṣata
verses.en: On through the long wool of the sheep to the meath-dropping vat he flows: The Rsis' sevenfold quire hath sung aloud to him.

verses.sa: परि णेता मतीनां विश्वदेवो अदाभ्यः । सोमः पुनानश्चम्वोर्विशद्धरिः॥
verses.tr: pari ṇetā matīnāṃ viśvadevo adābhyaḥ somaḥ punānaścamvorviśaddhariḥ
verses.en: Shared by all Gods, Infallible, the Leader of our holy hymns, Golden-hued Soma, being cleansed, hath reached the bowls.

verses.sa: परि दैवीरनु स्वधा इन्द्रेण याहि सरथम् । पुनानो वाघद्वाघद्भिरमर्त्यः॥
verses.tr: pari daivīranu svadhā indreṇa yāhi saratham punāno vāghadvāghadbhiramartyaḥ
verses.en: After thy Godlike qualities, associate with Indra, go, As a Priest purified by priests, Immortal One.

verses.sa: परि सप्तिर्न वाजयुर्देवो देवेभ्यः सुतः । व्यानशिः पवमानो वि धावति॥
verses.tr: pari saptirna vājayurdevo devebhyaḥ sutaḥ vyānaśiḥ pavamāno vi dhāvati
verses.en: Like a car-horse who shows his strength, a God effused for Deities. The penetrating Pavamana flows along.

verses.sa: सखाय आ नि षीदत पुनानाय प्र गायत । शिशुं न यज्ञैः परि भूषत श्रिये॥
verses.tr: sakhāya ā ni ṣīdata punānāya pra gāyata śiśuṃ na yajñaiḥ pari bhūṣata śriye
verses.en: Sit down, O friends, and sing aloud to him who purifies himself: Deck him for glory, like a child, with holy rites.

verses.sa: समी वत्सं न मातृभिः सृजता गयसाधनम् । देवाव्यं१ मदमभि द्विशवसम्॥
verses.tr: samī vatsaṃ na mātṛbhiḥ sṛjatā gayasādhanam devāvyaṃ1 madamabhi dviśavasam
verses.en: Unite him bringing household wealth, even as a calf, with mother kine, Him who hath double strength, the God, delighting juice.

verses.sa: पुनाता दक्षसाधनं यथा शर्धाय वीतये । यथा मित्राय वरुणाय शंतमः॥
verses.tr: punātā dakṣasādhanaṃ yathā śardhāya vītaye yathā mitrāya varuṇāya śaṃtamaḥ
verses.en: Purify him who gives us power, that he, most Blessed One, may be A banquet for the Troop, Mitra, and Varuna.

verses.sa: अस्मभ्यं त्वा वसुविदमभि वाणीरनूषत । गोभिष्टे वर्णमभि वासयामसि॥
verses.tr: asmabhyaṃ tvā vasuvidamabhi vāṇīranūṣata gobhiṣṭe varṇamabhi vāsayāmasi
verses.en: Voices have sung aloud to thee as finder out of wealth for us: We clothe the hue thou wearest with a robe of milk.

verses.sa: स नो मदानां पत इन्दो देवप्सरा असि । सखेव सख्ये गातुवित्तमो भव॥
verses.tr: sa no madānāṃ pata indo devapsarā asi sakheva sakhye gātuvittamo bhava
verses.en: Thou, Indu, art the food of Gods, O Sovran of all gladdening drinks: As Friend for friend, be thou best finder of success.

verses.sa: सनेमि कृध्य१स्मदा रक्षसं कं चिदत्रिणम् । अपादेवं द्वयुमंहो युयोधि नः॥
verses.tr: sanemi kṛdhya1smadā rakṣasaṃ kaṃ cidatriṇam apādevaṃ dvayumaṃho yuyodhi naḥ
verses.en: Drive utterly away from us each demon, each voracious fiend, The godless and the false: keep sorrow far away.

verses.sa: तं वः सखायो मदाय पुनानमभि गायत । शिशुं न यज्ञैः स्वदयन्त गूर्तिभिः॥
verses.tr: taṃ vaḥ sakhāyo madāya punānamabhi gāyata śiśuṃ na yajñaiḥ svadayanta gūrtibhiḥ
verses.en: Sing; ye aloud, O friends, to him who makes him pure for gladdening drink: They shall make sweet the Child with sacrifice and laud.

verses.sa: सं वत्स इव मातृभिरिन्दुर्हिन्वानो अज्यते । देवावीर्मदो मतिभिः परिष्कृतः॥
verses.tr: saṃ vatsa iva mātṛbhirindurhinvāno ajyate devāvīrmado matibhiḥ pariṣkṛtaḥ
verses.en: Like as a calf with mother cows, so Indu is urged forth and sent, Glorified by our hymns, the God-delighting juice.

verses.sa: अयं दक्षाय साधनोऽयं शर्धाय वीतये । अयं देवेभ्यो मधुमत्तमः सुतः॥
verses.tr: ayaṃ dakṣāya sādhano'yaṃ śardhāya vītaye ayaṃ devebhyo madhumattamaḥ sutaḥ
verses.en: Effectual means of power is he, he is a banquet for the Troop, He who hath been effused, most rich in meath, for Gods.

verses.sa: गोमन्न इन्दो अश्ववत्सुतः सुदक्ष धन्व । शुचिं ते वर्णमधि गोषु दीधरम्॥
verses.tr: gomanna indo aśvavatsutaḥ sudakṣa dhanva śuciṃ te varṇamadhi goṣu dīdharam
verses.en: Flow to us, Indu, passing, strong, effused, with wealth of kine and steeds: I will spread forth above the milk thy radiant hue.

verses.sa: स नो हरीणां पत इन्दो देवप्सरस्तमः । सखेव सख्ये नर्यो रुचे भव॥
verses.tr: sa no harīṇāṃ pata indo devapsarastamaḥ sakheva sakhye naryo ruce bhava
verses.en: Lord of the tawny, Indu thou who art the God's most special food, As Friend to friend, for splendour be thou good to men.

verses.sa: सनेमि त्वमस्मदाँ अदेवं कं चिदत्रिणम् । साह्वाँ इन्दो परि बाधो अप द्वयुम्॥
verses.tr: sanemi tvamasmadāṃ adevaṃ kaṃ cidatriṇam sāhvāṃ indo pari bādho apa dvayum
verses.en: Drive utterly, far away from us each godless, each voracious foe. O Indu, overcome and drive the false afar.

verses.sa: इन्द्रमच्छ सुता इमे वृषणं यन्तु हरयः । श्रुष्टी जातास इन्दवः स्वर्विदः॥
verses.tr: indramaccha sutā ime vṛṣaṇaṃ yantu harayaḥ śruṣṭī jātāsa indavaḥ svarvidaḥ
verses.en: To Indra, to the Mighty Steer, may these gold-coloured juices go, Drops rapidly produced, that find the light of heaven.

verses.sa: अयं भराय सानसिरिन्द्राय पवते सुतः । सोमो जैत्रस्य चेतति यथा विदे॥
verses.tr: ayaṃ bharāya sānasirindrāya pavate sutaḥ somo jaitrasya cetati yathā vide
verses.en: Effused, this juice victorious flows for Indra, for his maintenance. Soma bethinks him of the Conqueror, as he knows.

verses.sa: अस्येदिन्द्रो मदेष्वा ग्राभं गृभ्णीत सानसिम् । वज्रं च वृषणं भरत्समप्सुजित्॥
verses.tr: asyedindro madeṣvā grābhaṃ gṛbhṇīta sānasim vajraṃ ca vṛṣaṇaṃ bharatsamapsujit
verses.en: May Indra in his raptures gain from him the grasp that gathers spoil, And, winning waters, wield the steer strong thunderbolt.

verses.sa: प्र धन्वा सोम जागृविरिन्द्रायेन्दो परि स्रव । द्युमन्तं शुष्ममा भरा स्वर्विदम्॥
verses.tr: pra dhanvā soma jāgṛvirindrāyendo pari srava dyumantaṃ śuṣmamā bharā svarvidam
verses.en: Flow vigilant for Indra, thou Soma, yea, Indu, run thou on: Bring hither splendid strength that finds the light of heaven.

verses.sa: इन्द्राय वृषणं मदं पवस्व विश्वदर्शतः । सहस्रयामा पथिकृद्विचक्षणः॥
verses.tr: indrāya vṛṣaṇaṃ madaṃ pavasva viśvadarśataḥ sahasrayāmā pathikṛdvicakṣaṇaḥ
verses.en: Do thou, all-beautiful, purify for Indra's sake the mighty juice, Path-maker thou, far seeing, with a thousand ways.

verses.sa: अस्मभ्यं गातुवित्तमो देवेभ्यो मधुमत्तमः । सहस्रं याहि पथिभिः कनिक्रदत्॥
verses.tr: asmabhyaṃ gātuvittamo devebhyo madhumattamaḥ sahasraṃ yāhi pathibhiḥ kanikradat
verses.en: Best finder of prosperity for us, most rich in sweets for Gods, Proceed thou loudly roaring on a thousand paths.

verses.sa: पवस्व देववीतय इन्दो धाराभिरोजसा । आ कलशं मधुमान्त्सोम नः सदः॥
verses.tr: pavasva devavītaya indo dhārābhirojasā ā kalaśaṃ madhumāntsoma naḥ sadaḥ
verses.en: O Indu, with thy streams, in might, flow for the banquet of the Gods: Rich in meath, Soma, in our beaker take thy place.

verses.sa: तव द्रप्सा उदप्रुत इन्द्रं मदाय वावृधुः । त्वां देवासो अमृताय कं पपुः॥
verses.tr: tava drapsā udapruta indraṃ madāya vāvṛdhuḥ tvāṃ devāso amṛtāya kaṃ papuḥ
verses.en: Thy drops that swim in water have exalted Indra to delight: The Gods have drunk thee up for immortality.

verses.sa: आ नः सुतास इन्दवः पुनाना धावता रयिम् । वृष्टिद्यावो रीत्यापः स्वर्विदः॥
verses.tr: ā naḥ sutāsa indavaḥ punānā dhāvatā rayim vṛṣṭidyāvo rītyāpaḥ svarvidaḥ
verses.en: Stream opulence to us, ye drops of Soma, pressed and purified, Pouring down rain from heaven in hoods, and finding light.

verses.sa: सोमः पुनान ऊर्मिणाऽव्यो वारं वि धावति । अग्रे वाचः पवमानः कनिक्रदत्॥
verses.tr: somaḥ punāna ūrmiṇā'vyo vāraṃ vi dhāvati agre vācaḥ pavamānaḥ kanikradat
verses.en: Soma, while filtered, with his wave flows through the long wool of the sheep, Shouting while purified before the voice of song.

verses.sa: धीभिर्हिन्वन्ति वाजिनं वने क्रीळन्तमत्यविम् । अभि त्रिपृष्ठं मतयः समस्वरन्॥
verses.tr: dhībhirhinvanti vājinaṃ vane krīḻantamatyavim abhi tripṛṣṭhaṃ matayaḥ samasvaran
verses.en: With songs they send the Mighty forth, sporting in wood, above the fleece: Our psalms have glorified him of the triple height.

verses.sa: असर्जि कलशाँ अभि मीळ्हे सप्तिर्न वाजयुः । पुनानो वाचं जनयन्नसिष्यदत्॥
verses.tr: asarji kalaśāṃ abhi mīḻhe saptirna vājayuḥ punāno vācaṃ janayannasiṣyadat
verses.en: Into the jars hath he been loosed, like an impetuous steed for war, And lifting up his voice, while filtered, glided on.

verses.sa: पवते हर्यतो हरिरति ह्वरांसि रंह्या । अभ्यर्षन्त्स्तोतृभ्यो वीरवद्यशः॥
verses.tr: pavate haryato harirati hvarāṃsi raṃhyā abhyarṣantstotṛbhyo vīravadyaśaḥ
verses.en: Gold-hued and lovely in his course, through tangles of the wool he flows, And pours heroic fame upon the worshippers.

verses.sa: अया पवस्व देवयुर्मधोर्धारा असृक्षत । रेभन्पवित्रं पर्येषि विश्वतः॥
verses.tr: ayā pavasva devayurmadhordhārā asṛkṣata rebhanpavitraṃ paryeṣi viśvataḥ
verses.en: Flow thus, a faithful votary: the streams of meath have been effused. Thou comest to the filter, singing, from each side.

verses.sa:
परीतो षिञ्चता सुतं सोमो य उत्तमं हविः ।
दधन्वाँ यो नर्यो अप्स्व१न्तरा सुषाव सोममद्रिभिः॥
verses.tr: parīto ṣiñcatā sutaṃ somo ya uttamaṃ haviḥ dadhanvāṃ yo naryo apsva1ntarā suṣāva somamadribhiḥ
verses.en: Hence sprinkle forth the juice effused, Soma, the best of sacred gifts, Who, friend of man, hath run amid the water-streams. He hath pressed Soma out with stones.

verses.sa:
नूनं पुनानोऽविभिः परि स्रवाऽदब्धः सुरभिन्तरः ।
सुते चित्त्वाप्सु मदामो अन्धसा श्रीणन्तो गोभिरुत्तरम्॥
verses.tr: nūnaṃ punāno'vibhiḥ pari sravā'dabdhaḥ surabhintaraḥ sute cittvāpsu madāmo andhasā śrīṇanto gobhiruttaram
verses.en: Now, being purified, flow hither through the fleece inviolate and most odorous. We ladden thee in waters when thou art effused, blending thee still with juice and milk.

verses.sa: परि सुवानश्चक्षसे देवमादनः क्रतुरिन्दुर्विचक्षणः॥
verses.tr: pari suvānaścakṣase devamādanaḥ kraturindurvicakṣaṇaḥ
verses.en: Pressed out for all to see, delighting Gods, Indu, Far-sighted One, is mental power.

verses.sa:
पुनानः सोम धारयाऽपो वसानो अर्षसि ।
आ रत्नधा योनिमृतस्य सीदस्युत्सो देव हिरण्ययः॥
verses.tr: punānaḥ soma dhārayā'po vasāno arṣasi ā ratnadhā yonimṛtasya sīdasyutso deva hiraṇyayaḥ
verses.en: Cleansing thee, Soma, in thy stream, thou flowest in a watery robe: Giver of wealth, thou sittest in the place of Law, O God, a fountain made of gold.

verses.sa:
दुहान ऊधर्दिव्यं मधु प्रियं प्रत्नं सधस्थमासदत् ।
आपृच्छ्यं धरुणं वाज्यर्षति नृभिर्धूतो विचक्षणः॥
verses.tr: duhāna ūdhardivyaṃ madhu priyaṃ pratnaṃ sadhasthamāsadat āpṛcchyaṃ dharuṇaṃ vājyarṣati nṛbhirdhūto vicakṣaṇaḥ
verses.en: Milking the heavenly udder for dear meath, he hath sat in the ancient gathering place. Washed by the men, the Strong Farseeing One streams forth nutritious food that all desire.

verses.sa:
पुनानः सोम जागृविरव्यो वारे परि प्रियः ।
त्वं विप्रो अभवोऽङ्गिरस्तमो मध्वा यज्ञं मिमिक्ष नः॥
verses.tr: punānaḥ soma jāgṛviravyo vāre pari priyaḥ tvaṃ vipro abhavo'ṅgirastamo madhvā yajñaṃ mimikṣa naḥ
verses.en: O Soma, while they cleanse thee, dear and watchful in the sheep's long wool, Thou hast become a Singer most like Angiras: thou madest Surya mount to heaven.

verses.sa:
सोमो मीढ्वान्पवते गातुवित्तम ऋषिर्विप्रो विचक्षणः ।
त्वं कविरभवो देववीतम आ सूर्यं रोहयो दिवि॥
verses.tr: somo mīḍhvānpavate gātuvittama ṛṣirvipro vicakṣaṇaḥ tvaṃ kavirabhavo devavītama ā sūryaṃ rohayo divi
verses.en: Bountiful, best of furtherers, Soma floweth on, Rsi and Singer, keen of sight. Thou hast become a Sage most welcome to the Gods: thou madest Surya mount to heaven.

verses.sa:
सोम उ षुवाणः सोतृभिरधि ष्णुभिरवीनाम् ।
अश्वयेव हरिता याति धारया मन्द्रया याति धारया॥
verses.tr: soma u ṣuvāṇaḥ sotṛbhiradhi ṣṇubhiravīnām aśvayeva haritā yāti dhārayā mandrayā yāti dhārayā
verses.en: Pressed out by pressers, Soma goes over the fleecy backs of sheep, Goes, even as with a mare, in tawny coloured stream, goes in exhilarating stream.

verses.sa:
अनूपे गोमान्गोभिरक्षाः सोमो दुग्धाभिरक्षाः ।
समुद्रं न संवरणान्यग्मन्मन्दी मदाय तोशते॥
verses.tr: anūpe gomāngobhirakṣāḥ somo dugdhābhirakṣāḥ samudraṃ na saṃvaraṇānyagmanmandī madāya tośate
verses.en: Down to the water-Soma, rich in kine hath flowed with cows, with cows that have been milked. They have approached the mixing-vessel as a sea: the cheerer streams for the carouse.

verses.sa:
आ सोम सुवानो अद्रिभिस्तिरो वाराण्यव्यया ।
जनो न पुरि चम्वोर्विशद्धरिः सदो वनेषु दधिषे॥
verses.tr: ā soma suvāno adribhistiro vārāṇyavyayā jano na puri camvorviśaddhariḥ sado vaneṣu dadhiṣe
verses.en: Effused by stones, O Soma, and urged through the long wool of the sheep, Thou, entering the saucers as a man the fort, gold-hued hast settled in the wood.

verses.sa:
स मामृजे तिरो अण्वानि मेष्यो मीळ्हे सप्तिर्न वाजयुः ।
अनुमाद्यः पवमानो मनीषिभिः सोमो विप्रेभिॠक्वभिः॥
verses.tr: sa māmṛje tiro aṇvāni meṣyo mīḻhe saptirna vājayuḥ anumādyaḥ pavamāno manīṣibhiḥ somo viprebhiṝkvabhiḥ
verses.en: He beautifies himself through the sheep's long fine wool, like an impetuous steed in war, Even Soma Pavamana who shall be the joy of sages and of holy bards.

verses.sa:
प्र सोम देववीतये सिन्धुर्न पिप्ये अर्णसा ।
अंशोः पयसा मदिरो न जागृविरच्छा कोशं मधुश्चुतम्॥
verses.tr: pra soma devavītaye sindhurna pipye arṇasā aṃśoḥ payasā madiro na jāgṛviracchā kośaṃ madhuścutam
verses.en: O Soma,-for the feast of Gods, river-like he hath swelled with surge, With the stalk's juice, exhilarating, resting not, into the vat that drops with meath.

verses.sa:
आ हर्यतो अर्जुने अत्के अव्यत प्रियः सूनुर्न मर्ज्यः ।
तमीं हिन्वन्त्यपसो यथा रथं नदीष्वा गभस्त्योः॥
verses.tr: ā haryato arjune atke avyata priyaḥ sūnurna marjyaḥ tamīṃ hinvantyapaso yathā rathaṃ nadīṣvā gabhastyoḥ
verses.en: Like a dear son who must be decked, the Lovely One hath clad him in a shining robe. Men skillful at their work drive him forth, like a car, into the rivers from their bands.

verses.sa:
अभि सोमास आयवः पवन्ते मद्यं मदम् ।
समुद्रस्याधि विष्टपि मनीषिणो मत्सरासः स्वर्विदः॥
verses.tr: abhi somāsa āyavaḥ pavante madyaṃ madam samudrasyādhi viṣṭapi manīṣiṇo matsarāsaḥ svarvidaḥ
verses.en: The living drops of Soma juice pour, as they flow, the gladdening drink, Intelligent drops above the basin of the sea, exhilarating, finding light.

verses.sa:
तरत्समुद्रं पवमान ऊर्मिणा राजा देव ऋतं बृहत् ।
अर्षन्मित्रस्य वरुणस्य धर्मणा प्र हिन्वान ऋतं बृहत्॥
verses.tr: taratsamudraṃ pavamāna ūrmiṇā rājā deva ṛtaṃ bṛhat arṣanmitrasya varuṇasya dharmaṇā pra hinvāna ṛtaṃ bṛhat
verses.en: May Pavamana, King and God, speed with his wave over the sea the lofty rite: May he by Mitra's and by Varuna's decree flow furthering the lofty rite.

verses.sa: नृभिर्येमानो हर्यतो विचक्षणो राजा देवः समुद्रियः॥
verses.tr: nṛbhiryemāno haryato vicakṣaṇo rājā devaḥ samudriyaḥ
verses.en: Far-seeing, lovely, guided by the men, the God whose home is in the sea-

verses.sa: इन्द्राय पवते मदः सोमो मरुत्वते सुतः । सहस्रधारो अत्यव्यमर्षति तमी मृजन्त्यायवः॥
verses.tr: indrāya pavate madaḥ somo marutvate sutaḥ sahasradhāro atyavyamarṣati tamī mṛjantyāyavaḥ
verses.en: Soma, the gladdening juice, flows pressed for Indra with his Marut host: He hastens o'er the fleece with all his thousand streams: men make him bright and beautiful.

verses.sa:
पुनानश्चमू जनयन्मतिं कविः सोमो देवेषु रण्यति ।
अपो वसानः परि गोभिरुत्तरः सीदन्वनेष्वव्यत॥
verses.tr: punānaścamū janayanmatiṃ kaviḥ somo deveṣu raṇyati apo vasānaḥ pari gobhiruttaraḥ sīdanvaneṣvavyata
verses.en: Purified in the bowl and gendering the hymn, wise Soma joys among the Gods. Robed in the flood, the Mighty One hath clad himself with milk and settled in the vats.

verses.sa:
तवाहं सोम रारण सख्य इन्दो दिवेदिवे ।
पुरूणि बभ्रो नि चरन्ति मामव परिधीँरति ताँ इहि॥
verses.tr: tavāhaṃ soma rāraṇa sakhya indo divedive purūṇi babhro ni caranti māmava paridhīṃrati tāṃ ihi
verses.en: O Soma, Indu, every day thy friendship hath been my delight. Many fiends follow me; help me, thou Tawny-hued; pass on beyond these barriers.

verses.sa:
उताहं नक्तमुत सोम ते दिवा सख्याय बभ्र ऊधनि ।
घृणा तपन्तमति सूर्यं परः शकुना इव पप्तिम॥
verses.tr: utāhaṃ naktamuta soma te divā sakhyāya babhra ūdhani ghṛṇā tapantamati sūryaṃ paraḥ śakunā iva paptima
verses.en: Close to thy bosom am I, Soma, day and night. O Tawny-hued, for friendship sake. Surya himself refulgent with his glow have we o'ertaken in his course like birds.

verses.sa:
मृज्यमानः सुहस्त्य समुद्रे वाचमिन्वसि ।
रयिं पिशङ्गं बहुलं पुरुस्पृहं पवमानाभ्यर्षसि॥
verses.tr: mṛjyamānaḥ suhastya samudre vācaminvasi rayiṃ piśaṅgaṃ bahulaṃ puruspṛhaṃ pavamānābhyarṣasi
verses.en: Deft-handcd! thou when purified liftest thy voice amid the sea. Thou, Pavamana, makest riches flow to us, yellow, abundant, much-desired.

verses.sa:
मृजानो वारे पवमानो अव्यये वृषाव चक्रदो वने ।
देवानां सोम पवमान निष्कृतं गोभिरञ्जानो अर्षसि॥
verses.tr: mṛjāno vāre pavamāno avyaye vṛṣāva cakrado vane devānāṃ soma pavamāna niṣkṛtaṃ gobhirañjāno arṣasi
verses.en: Making thee pure and bright in the sheep's long wool, tbou hast bellowed, steer like, in the wood. Thou flowest, Soma Pavamana, balmed with milk unto the special place of Gods.

verses.sa:
पवस्व वाजसातयेऽभि विश्वानि काव्या ।
त्वं समुद्रं प्रथमो वि धारयो देवेभ्यः सोम मत्सरः॥
verses.tr: pavasva vājasātaye'bhi viśvāni kāvyā tvaṃ samudraṃ prathamo vi dhārayo devebhyaḥ soma matsaraḥ
verses.en: Flow on to win us strength, flow on to lofty lore of every kind. Thou, Soma, as Exhilarator wast the first to spread the sea abroad for Gods.

verses.sa:
स तू पवस्व परि पार्थिवं रजो दिव्या च सोम धर्मभिः ।
त्वां विप्रासो मतिभिर्विचक्षण शुभ्रं हिन्वन्ति धीतिभिः॥
verses.tr: sa tū pavasva pari pārthivaṃ rajo divyā ca soma dharmabhiḥ tvāṃ viprāso matibhirvicakṣaṇa śubhraṃ hinvanti dhītibhiḥ
verses.en: Flow to the realm of earth, flow to the realm of heaven, O Soma, in thy righteous ways. Fair art thou whom the sages, O Far-seeing One, urge onward with their songs and hymns.

verses.sa:
पवमाना असृक्षत पवित्रमति धारया ।
मरुत्वन्तो मत्सरा इन्द्रिया हया मेधामभि प्रयांसि च॥
verses.tr: pavamānā asṛkṣata pavitramati dhārayā marutvanto matsarā indriyā hayā medhāmabhi prayāṃsi ca
verses.en: Over the cleansing sieve have flowed the Pavamanas in a stream, Girt by the Maruts, gladdening, Steeds with Indra's strength, for wisdom and for dainty food.

verses.sa:
अपो वसानः परि कोशमर्षतीन्दुर्हियानः सोतृभिः ।
जनयञ्ज्योतिर्मन्दना अवीवशद्गाः कृण्वानो न निर्णिजम्॥
verses.tr: apo vasānaḥ pari kośamarṣatīndurhiyānaḥ sotṛbhiḥ janayañjyotirmandanā avīvaśadgāḥ kṛṇvāno na nirṇijam
verses.en: Urged onward by the pressers, clad in watery robes, Indu is speeding to the vat. He gendering light, hath made the glad Cows low, while he takes them as his garb of state.

verses.sa: पवस्व मधुमत्तम इन्द्राय सोम क्रतुवित्तमो मदः । महि द्युक्षतमो मदः॥
verses.tr: pavasva madhumattama indrāya soma kratuvittamo madaḥ mahi dyukṣatamo madaḥ
verses.en: For Indra, flow thou Soma on, as gladdening juice most sweet, intelligent, Great, cheering, dwelling most in heaven.

verses.sa:
यस्य ते पीत्वा वृषभो वृषायतेऽस्य पीता स्वर्विदः ।
स सुप्रकेतो अभ्यक्रमीदिषोऽच्छा वाजं नैतशः॥
verses.tr: yasya te pītvā vṛṣabho vṛṣāyate'sya pītā svarvidaḥ sa supraketo abhyakramīdiṣo'cchā vājaṃ naitaśaḥ
verses.en: Thou, of whom having drunk the Steer acts like a steer. drinking of this that finds the light, He, Excellently Wise, is come to strengthening food, to spoil and wealth like Etasa.

verses.sa: त्वं ह्य१ङ्ग दैव्या पवमान जनिमानि द्युमत्तमः । अमृतत्वाय घोषयः॥
verses.tr: tvaṃ hya1ṅga daivyā pavamāna janimāni dyumattamaḥ amṛtatvāya ghoṣayaḥ
verses.en: For, verily, Pavamana, thou bast, splendidest, called all the generations of The Gods to immortality.

verses.sa:
येना नवग्वो दध्यङ्ङपोर्णुते येन विप्रास आपिरे ।
देवानां सुम्ने अमृतस्य चारुणो येन श्रवांस्यानशुः॥
verses.tr: yenā navagvo dadhyaṅṅaporṇute yena viprāsa āpire devānāṃ sumne amṛtasya cāruṇo yena śravāṃsyānaśuḥ
verses.en: By whom Dadhyac Navagva opens fastened doors, by whom the sages gained their wish, By whom they won the fame of lovely Amrta in the felicity of Gods.

verses.sa: एष स्य धारया सुतोऽव्यो वारेभिः पवते मदिन्तमः । क्रीळन्नूर्मिरपामिव॥
verses.tr: eṣa sya dhārayā suto'vyo vārebhiḥ pavate madintamaḥ krīḻannūrmirapāmiva
verses.en: Effused, he floweth in a stream, best rapture-giver, in the long wool of the sheep, Sporting, as 'twere the waters' wave.

verses.sa:
य उस्रिया अप्या अन्तरश्मनो निर्गा अकृन्तदोजसा ।
अभि व्रजं तत्निषे गव्यमश्व्यं वर्मीव धृष्णवा रुज॥
verses.tr: ya usriyā apyā antaraśmano nirgā akṛntadojasā abhi vrajaṃ tatniṣe gavyamaśvyaṃ varmīva dhṛṣṇavā ruja
verses.en: He who from out the rocky cavern took with might the red refulgent watery Cows, Thou masterest the stable full of kine and steeds: burst it, brave Lord, like one in mail.

verses.sa: आ सोता परि षिञ्चताऽश्वं न स्तोममप्तुरं रजस्तुरम् । वनक्रक्षमुदप्रुतम्॥
verses.tr: ā sotā pari ṣiñcatā'śvaṃ na stomamapturaṃ rajasturam vanakrakṣamudaprutam
verses.en: Press ye and pour him, like a steed, laudworthy, speeding through the region and the flood, Who swims in water, roan in wood;

verses.sa:
सहस्रधारं वृषभं पयोवृधं प्रियं देवाय जन्मने ।
ऋतेन य ऋतजातो विवावृधे राजा देव ऋतं बृहत्॥
verses.tr: sahasradhāraṃ vṛṣabhaṃ payovṛdhaṃ priyaṃ devāya janmane ṛtena ya ṛtajāto vivāvṛdhe rājā deva ṛtaṃ bṛhat
verses.en: Increaser of the water, Steer with thousand streams, dear to the race of Deities; Who born in Law hath waxen mighty by the Law, King, God, and lofty Ordinance.

verses.sa: अभि द्युम्नं बृहद्यश इषस्पते दिदीहि देव देवयुः । वि कोशं मध्यमं युव॥
verses.tr: abhi dyumnaṃ bṛhadyaśa iṣaspate didīhi deva devayuḥ vi kośaṃ madhyamaṃ yuva
verses.en: Make splendid glory shine on us, thou Lord of strengthening food, God, as the Friend of Gods: Unclose the fount of middle air.

verses.sa:
आ वच्यस्व सुदक्ष चम्वोः सुतो विशां वह्निर्न विश्पतिः ।
वृष्टिं दिवः पवस्व रीतिमपां जिन्वा गविष्टये धियः॥
verses.tr: ā vacyasva sudakṣa camvoḥ suto viśāṃ vahnirna viśpatiḥ vṛṣṭiṃ divaḥ pavasva rītimapāṃ jinvā gaviṣṭaye dhiyaḥ
verses.en: Roll onward to the bowls, O Mighty One, effused, as Prince supporter of the tribes. Pour on us rain from heaven, send us the waters' flow: incite our thoughts to win the spoil.

verses.sa: एतमु त्यं मदच्युतं सहस्रधारं वृषभं दिवो दुहुः । विश्वा वसूनि बिभ्रतम्॥
verses.tr: etamu tyaṃ madacyutaṃ sahasradhāraṃ vṛṣabhaṃ divo duhuḥ viśvā vasūni bibhratam
verses.en: They have drained him the Steer of heaven, him with a thousand streams, distilling rapturous joy, Him who brings all things excellent.

verses.sa:
वृषा वि जज्ञे जनयन्नमर्त्यः प्रतपञ्ज्योतिषा तमः ।
स सुष्टुतः कविभिर्निर्णिजं दधे त्रिधात्वस्य दंससा॥
verses.tr: vṛṣā vi jajñe janayannamartyaḥ pratapañjyotiṣā tamaḥ sa suṣṭutaḥ kavibhirnirṇijaṃ dadhe tridhātvasya daṃsasā
verses.en: The Mighty One was born Immortal, giving life, lightening darkness with his shine. Well-praised by. sages he hath. by his wondrous power assumed the Threefold as his robe.

verses.sa: स सुन्वे यो वसूनां यो रायामानेता य इळानाम् । सोमो यः सुक्षितीनाम्॥
verses.tr: sa sunve yo vasūnāṃ yo rāyāmānetā ya iḻānām somo yaḥ sukṣitīnām
verses.en: Effused is he who brings good things, who brings us bounteous gifts and sweet refreshing food, Soma who brings us quiet homes:

verses.sa:
यस्य न इन्द्रः पिबाद्यस्य मरुतो यस्य वार्यमणा भगः ।
आ येन मित्रावरुणा करामह एन्द्रमवसे महे॥
verses.tr: yasya na indraḥ pibādyasya maruto yasya vāryamaṇā bhagaḥ ā yena mitrāvaruṇā karāmaha endramavase mahe
verses.en: He whom our Indra and the Marut host shall drink, Bhaga shall drink with Aryaman, By whom we bring to us Mitra and Varuna and Indra for our great defence.

verses.sa: इन्द्राय सोम पातवे नृभिर्यतः स्वायुधो मदिन्तमः । पवस्व मधुमत्तमः॥
verses.tr: indrāya soma pātave nṛbhiryataḥ svāyudho madintamaḥ pavasva madhumattamaḥ
verses.en: Soma, for Indra's drink do thou, led by the men, well-weaponed and most gladdening, Flow on with greatest store of sweets.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रस्य हार्दि सोमधानमा विश समुद्रमिव सिन्धवः ।
जुष्टो मित्राय वरुणाय वायवे दिवो विष्टम्भ उत्तमः॥
verses.tr: indrasya hārdi somadhānamā viśa samudramiva sindhavaḥ juṣṭo mitrāya varuṇāya vāyave divo viṣṭambha uttamaḥ
verses.en: Enter the Soma-holder, even Indra's heart, as rivers pass into the sea, Acceptable to Mitra, Vayu, Varuna, the noblest Pillar of the heavens.

verses.sa: परि प्र धन्वेन्द्राय सोम स्वादुर्मित्राय पूष्णे भगाय॥
verses.tr: pari pra dhanvendrāya soma svādurmitrāya pūṣṇe bhagāya
verses.en: Pleasant to Indra's Mitra's, Pusan's Bhaga's taste, sped onward, Soma, with thy flowing stream.

verses.sa: इन्द्रस्ते सोम सुतस्य पेयाः क्रत्वे दक्षाय विश्वे च देवाः ॥१॥
verses.tr: indraste soma sutasya peyāḥ kratve dakṣāya viśve ca devāḥ 1
verses.en: Let Indra drink, O Soma, of thy juice for wisdom, and all Deities for strength.

verses.sa: एवामृताय महे क्षयाय स शुक्रो अर्ष दिव्यः पीयूषः॥
verses.tr: evāmṛtāya mahe kṣayāya sa śukro arṣa divyaḥ pīyūṣaḥ
verses.en: So flow thou on as bright celestial juice, flow to the vast, immortal dwelling-place.

verses.sa: पवस्व सोम महान्त्समुद्रः पिता देवानां विश्वाभि धाम ॥२॥
verses.tr: pavasva soma mahāntsamudraḥ pitā devānāṃ viśvābhi dhāma 2
verses.en: Flow onward, Soma, as a mighty sea, as Father of the Gods to every form.

verses.sa: शुक्रः पवस्व देवेभ्यः सोम दिवे पृथिव्यै शं च प्रजायै॥
verses.tr: śukraḥ pavasva devebhyaḥ soma dive pṛthivyai śaṃ ca prajāyai
verses.en: Flow on, O Soma, radiant for the Gods and Heaven and Earth and bless our progeny.

verses.sa: दिवो धर्तासि शुक्रः पीयूषः सत्ये विधर्मन्वाजी पवस्व ॥३॥
verses.tr: divo dhartāsi śukraḥ pīyūṣaḥ satye vidharmanvājī pavasva 3
verses.en: Thou, bright Juice, art Sustainer of the sky: flow, mighty, in accordance with true Law.

verses.sa: पवस्व सोम द्युम्नी सुधारो महामवीनामनु पूर्व्यः॥
verses.tr: pavasva soma dyumnī sudhāro mahāmavīnāmanu pūrvyaḥ
verses.en: Soma, flow splendid with thy copious stream through the great fleece as in the olden time.

verses.sa: नृभिर्येमानो जज्ञानः पूतः क्षरद्विश्वानि मन्द्रः स्वर्वित् ॥४॥
verses.tr: nṛbhiryemāno jajñānaḥ pūtaḥ kṣaradviśvāni mandraḥ svarvit 4
verses.en: Bom, led by men, joyous, and purified, let the Light-finder make all blessings flow:

verses.sa: इन्दुः पुनानः प्रजामुराणः करद्विश्वानि द्रविणानि नः॥
verses.tr: induḥ punānaḥ prajāmurāṇaḥ karadviśvāni draviṇāni naḥ
verses.en: Indu, while cleansed, keeping the people safe, shall give us all possessions for our own.

verses.sa: पवस्व सोम क्रत्वे दक्षायाऽश्वो न निक्तो वाजी धनाय ॥५॥
verses.tr: pavasva soma kratve dakṣāyā'śvo na nikto vājī dhanāya 5
verses.en: Flow on for wisdom, Soma, and for power, as a strong courser bathed, to win the prize.

verses.sa: तं ते सोतारो रसं मदाय पुनन्ति सोमं महे द्युम्नाय ॥
verses.tr: taṃ te sotāro rasaṃ madāya punanti somaṃ mahe dyumnāya
verses.en: The pressers purify this juice of thine, the Soma, for delight, and lofty fame

verses.sa: शिशुं जज्ञानं हरिं मृजन्ति पवित्रे सोमं देवेभ्य इन्दुम् ॥६॥
verses.tr: śiśuṃ jajñānaṃ hariṃ mṛjanti pavitre somaṃ devebhya indum 6
verses.en: They deck the Gold-hued Infant, newly born, even Soma, Indu, in the sieve for Gods.

verses.sa: इन्दुः पविष्ट चारुर्मदायाऽपामुपस्थे कविर्भगाय॥
verses.tr: induḥ paviṣṭa cārurmadāyā'pāmupasthe kavirbhagāya
verses.en: Fair Indu hath flowed on for rapturous joy, Sage for good fortune in the waters' lap.

verses.sa: बिभर्ति चार्विन्द्रस्य नाम येन विश्वानि वृत्रा जघान ॥७॥
verses.tr: bibharti cārvindrasya nāma yena viśvāni vṛtrā jaghāna 7
verses.en: He bears the beauteous name of Indra, that wherewith he overcame all demon foes.

verses.sa: पिबन्त्यस्य विश्वे देवासो गोभिः श्रीतस्य नृभिः सुतस्य ॥
verses.tr: pibantyasya viśve devāso gobhiḥ śrītasya nṛbhiḥ sutasya
verses.en: All Deities are wont to drink of him, pressed by the men and blent with milk and curds.

verses.sa: प्र सुवानो अक्षाः सहस्रधारस्तिरः पवित्रं वि वारमव्यम् ॥८॥
verses.tr: pra suvāno akṣāḥ sahasradhārastiraḥ pavitraṃ vi vāramavyam 8
verses.en: He hath flowed forth with thousand streams effused, flowed through the filter and the sheep's long wool.

verses.sa: स वाज्यक्षाः सहस्ररेता अद्भिर्मृजानो गोभिः श्रीणानः ॥
verses.tr: sa vājyakṣāḥ sahasraretā adbhirmṛjāno gobhiḥ śrīṇānaḥ
verses.en: With endless genial flow the Strong hath run, purified by the waters, blent with milk.

verses.sa: प्र सोम याहीन्द्रस्य कुक्षा नृभिर्येमानो अद्रिभिः सुतः ॥९॥
verses.tr: pra soma yāhīndrasya kukṣā nṛbhiryemāno adribhiḥ sutaḥ 9
verses.en: Pressed out with stones, directed by the men, go forth, O Soma, into Indra's throat.

verses.sa: असर्जि वाजी तिरः पवित्रमिन्द्राय सोमः सहस्रधारः ॥
verses.tr: asarji vājī tiraḥ pavitramindrāya somaḥ sahasradhāraḥ
verses.en: The mighty Soma with a thousand streams is poured to Indra through the cleansing sieve.

verses.sa: अञ्जन्त्येनं मध्वो रसेनेन्द्राय वृष्ण इन्दुं मदाय ॥१०॥
verses.tr: añjantyenaṃ madhvo rasenendrāya vṛṣṇa induṃ madāya 10
verses.en: Indu they balm with pleasant milky juice for Indra, for the Steer, for his delight.

verses.sa: देवेभ्यस्त्वा वृथा पाजसेऽपो वसानं हरिं मृजन्ति ॥
verses.tr: devebhyastvā vṛthā pājase'po vasānaṃ hariṃ mṛjanti
verses.en: Lightly, for sheen, they cleanse thee for the Gods, gold-coloured, wearing water as thy robe.

verses.sa: इन्दुरिन्द्राय तोशते नि तोशते श्रीणन्नुग्रो रिणन्नपः ॥११॥
verses.tr: indurindrāya tośate ni tośate śrīṇannugro riṇannapaḥ 11
verses.en: Indu to Indra streams, yea, downward streams, Strong, flowing to the floods, and mingling -there.

verses.sa: पर्यू षु प्र धन्व वाजसातये परि वृत्राणि सक्षणिः । द्विषस्तरध्या ऋणया न ईयसे॥
verses.tr: paryū ṣu pra dhanva vājasātaye pari vṛtrāṇi sakṣaṇiḥ dviṣastaradhyā ṛṇayā na īyase
verses.en: O'ERPOWERING Vrtras, forward run to win great strength: Thou speedest to subdue like one exacting debts.

verses.sa: अनु हि त्वा सुतं सोम मदामसि महे समर्यराज्ये । वाजाँ अभि पवमान प्र गाहसे॥
verses.tr: anu hi tvā sutaṃ soma madāmasi mahe samaryarājye vājāṃ abhi pavamāna pra gāhase
verses.en: In thee, effused, O Soma, we rejoice ourselves for great supremacy in fight. Thou, Pavamana, enterest into mighty deeds,

verses.sa: अजीजनो हि पवमान सूर्यं विधारे शक्मना पयः । गोजीरया रंहमाणः पुरंध्या॥
verses.tr: ajījano hi pavamāna sūryaṃ vidhāre śakmanā payaḥ gojīrayā raṃhamāṇaḥ puraṃdhyā
verses.en: O Pavamana, thou didst generate the Sun, and spread the moisture out with power, Hasting to us with plenty vivified with milk.

verses.sa: अजीजनो अमृत मर्त्येष्वाँ ऋतस्य धर्मन्नमृतस्य चारुणः । सदासरो वाजमच्छा सनिष्यदत्॥
verses.tr: ajījano amṛta martyeṣvāṃ ṛtasya dharmannamṛtasya cāruṇaḥ sadāsaro vājamacchā saniṣyadat
verses.en: Thou didst produce him, Deathless God mid mortal men for maintenance of Law and lovely Amrta: Thou evermore hast moved making strength flow to us.

verses.sa: अभ्यभि हि श्रवसा ततर्दिथोत्सं न कं चिज्जनपानमक्षितम् । शर्याभिर्न भरमाणो गभस्त्योः॥
verses.tr: abhyabhi hi śravasā tatardithotsaṃ na kaṃ cijjanapānamakṣitam śaryābhirna bharamāṇo gabhastyoḥ
verses.en: All round about hast thou with glory pierced for us as 'twere a never-failing well for men to drink, Borne on thy way in fragments from the presser's arms.

verses.sa: आदीं के चित्पश्यमानास आप्यं वसुरुचो दिव्या अभ्यनूषत । वारं न देवः सविता व्यूर्णुते॥
verses.tr: ādīṃ ke citpaśyamānāsa āpyaṃ vasuruco divyā abhyanūṣata vāraṃ na devaḥ savitā vyūrṇute
verses.en: Then, beautifully radiant, certain Heavenly Ones, have sung to him their kinship as they looked thereon, And Savitar the God opens as 'twere a stall.

verses.sa: त्वे सोम प्रथमा वृक्तबर्हिषो महे वाजाय श्रवसे धियं दधुः । स त्वं नो वीर वीर्याय चोदय॥
verses.tr: tve soma prathamā vṛktabarhiṣo mahe vājāya śravase dhiyaṃ dadhuḥ sa tvaṃ no vīra vīryāya codaya
verses.en: Soma, the men of old whose grass was trimmed addressed the hymn to thee for mighty strength and for renown: So, Hero, urge us onward to heroic power.

verses.sa: दिवः पीयूषं पूर्व्यं यदुक्थ्यं महो गाहाद्दिव आ निरधुक्षत । इन्द्रमभि जायमानं समस्वरन्॥
verses.tr: divaḥ pīyūṣaṃ pūrvyaṃ yadukthyaṃ maho gāhāddiva ā niradhukṣata indramabhi jāyamānaṃ samasvaran
verses.en: They have drained forth from out the great depth of the sky the old primeval milk of heaven that claims the laud: They lifted up their voice to Indra at his birth.

verses.sa:
अध यदिमे पवमान रोदसी इमा च विश्वा भुवनाभि मज्मना ।
यूथे न निःष्ठा वृषभो वि तिष्ठसे॥
verses.tr: adha yadime pavamāna rodasī imā ca viśvā bhuvanābhi majmanā yūthe na niḥṣṭhā vṛṣabho vi tiṣṭhase
verses.en: As long as thou, O Pavamana, art above this earth and heaven and all existence in thy might, Thou standest like a Bull the chief amid the herd.

verses.sa: सोमः पुनानो अव्यये वारे शिशुर्न क्रीळन्पवमानो अक्षाः । सहस्रधारः शतवाज इन्दुः॥
verses.tr: somaḥ punāno avyaye vāre śiśurna krīḻanpavamāno akṣāḥ sahasradhāraḥ śatavāja induḥ
verses.en: In the sheep's wool hath Soma Pavamana flowed, while they cleanse him, like a playful infant, Indu with hundred powers and hundred currents.

verses.sa: एष पुनानो मधुमाँ ऋतावेन्द्रायेन्दुः पवते स्वादुरूर्मिः । वाजसनिर्वरिवोविद्वयोधाः॥
verses.tr: eṣa punāno madhumāṃ ṛtāvendrāyenduḥ pavate svādurūrmiḥ vājasanirvarivovidvayodhāḥ
verses.en: Holy and sweet, while purified, this Indu flows on, a wave of pleasant taste, to Indra,- Strength-winner, Treasure-finder, Life. bestower.

verses.sa: स पवस्व सहमानः पृतन्यून्त्सेधन्रक्षांस्यप दुर्गहाणि । स्वायुधः सासह्वान्त्सोम शत्रून्॥
verses.tr: sa pavasva sahamānaḥ pṛtanyūntsedhanrakṣāṃsyapa durgahāṇi svāyudhaḥ sāsahvāntsoma śatrūn
verses.en: So flow thou on, subduing our assailants, chasing the demons hard to been countered, Well-armed and conquering our foes, O Soma.

verses.sa:
अया रुचा हरिण्या पुनानो विश्वा द्वेषांसि तरति स्वयुग्वभिः सूरो न स्वयुग्वभिः ।
धारा सुतस्य रोचते पुनानो अरुषो हरिः । विश्वा यद्रूपा परियात्यृक्वभिः सप्तास्येभिॠक्वभिः॥
verses.tr: ayā rucā hariṇyā punāno viśvā dveṣāṃsi tarati svayugvabhiḥ sūro na svayugvabhiḥ dhārā sutasya rocate punāno aruṣo hariḥ viśvā yadrūpā pariyātyṛkvabhiḥ saptāsyebhiṝkvabhiḥ
verses.en: With this his golden splendour purifying him, he with his own allies subdues all enemies, as Sara with his own allies. Cleansing himself with stream of juice he shines forth yellow-hued and red, when with the praisers he encompasses all forms, with praisers having seven mouths.

verses.sa:
त्वं त्यत्पणीनां विदो वसु सं मातृभिर्मर्जयसि स्व आ दम ऋतस्य धीतिभिर्दमे ।
परावतो न साम तद्यत्रा रणन्ति धीतयः । त्रिधातुभिररुषीभिर्वयो दधे रोचमानो वयो दधे॥
verses.tr: tvaṃ tyatpaṇīnāṃ vido vasu saṃ mātṛbhirmarjayasi sva ā dama ṛtasya dhītibhirdame parāvato na sāma tadyatrā raṇanti dhītayaḥ tridhātubhiraruṣībhirvayo dadhe rocamāno vayo dadhe
verses.en: That treasure of the Panis thou discoveredst; thou with thy mothers deckest thee in thine abode, with songs of worship in thine home. As 'twere from far, the hymn is heard, where holy songs resound in joy. He with the ruddy-hued, threefold hath won life-power, he, glittering, hath won life-power.

verses.sa:
पूर्वामनु प्रदिशं याति चेकितत्सं रश्मिभिर्यतते दर्शतो रथो दैव्यो दर्शतो रथः ।
अग्मन्नुक्थानि पौंस्येन्द्रं जैत्राय हर्षयन् । वज्रश्च यद्भवथो अनपच्युता समत्स्वनपच्युता॥
verses.tr: pūrvāmanu pradiśaṃ yāti cekitatsaṃ raśmibhiryatate darśato ratho daivyo darśato rathaḥ agmannukthāni pauṃsyendraṃ jaitrāya harṣayan vajraśca yadbhavatho anapacyutā samatsvanapacyutā
verses.en: He moves intelligent, directed to the East. The very beauteous car rivals the beams of light, the beautiful celestial car. Hymns, lauding manly valour, came, inciting Indra to success, that ye may be unconquered, both thy bolt and thou, both be unconquered in the war.

verses.sa:
नानानं वा उ नो धियो वि व्रतानि जनानाम् ।
तक्षा रिष्टं रुतं भिषग्ब्रह्मा सुन्वन्तमिच्छतीन्द्रायेन्दो परि स्रव॥
verses.tr: nānānaṃ vā u no dhiyo vi vratāni janānām takṣā riṣṭaṃ rutaṃ bhiṣagbrahmā sunvantamicchatīndrāyendo pari srava
verses.en: We all have various thoughts and plans, and diverse are the ways of men. The Brahman seeks the worshipper, wright seeks the cracked, and leech the maimed. Flow, Indu, flow for Indra's sake.

verses.sa:
जरतीभिरोषधीभिः पर्णेभिः शकुनानाम् ।
कार्मारो अश्मभिर्द्युभिर्हिरण्यवन्तमिच्छतीन्द्रायेन्दो परि स्रव॥
verses.tr: jaratībhiroṣadhībhiḥ parṇebhiḥ śakunānām kārmāro aśmabhirdyubhirhiraṇyavantamicchatīndrāyendo pari srava
verses.en: The smith with ripe and seasoned plants, with feathers of the birds of air, With stones, and with enkindled flames, seeks him who hath a store of gold. Flow, Indu, flow for Indra's sake.

verses.sa:
कारुरहं ततो भिषगुपलप्रक्षिणी नना ।
नानाधियो वसूयवोऽनु गा इव तस्थिमेन्द्रायेन्दो परि स्रव॥
verses.tr: kārurahaṃ tato bhiṣagupalaprakṣiṇī nanā nānādhiyo vasūyavo'nu gā iva tasthimendrāyendo pari srava
verses.en: A bard am I, my dad's a leech, mammy lays corn upon the stones. Striving for wealth, with varied plans, we follow our desires like kine. Flow, Indu, flow for Indra's sake.

verses.sa:
अश्वो वोळ्हा सुखं रथं हसनामुपमन्त्रिणः ।
शेपो रोमण्वन्तौ भेदौ वारिन्मण्डूक इच्छतीन्द्रायेन्दो परि स्रव॥
verses.tr: aśvo voḻhā sukhaṃ rathaṃ hasanāmupamantriṇaḥ śepo romaṇvantau bhedau vārinmaṇḍūka icchatīndrāyendo pari srava
verses.en: The horse would draw an easy car, gay hosts attract the laugh and jest. The male desires his mate's approach, the frog is eager for the flood, Flow, Indu, flow for Indra's sake.

verses.sa:
शर्यणावति सोममिन्द्रः पिबतु वृत्रहा ।
बलं दधान आत्मनि करिष्यन्वीर्यं महदिन्द्रायेन्दो परि स्रव॥
verses.tr: śaryaṇāvati somamindraḥ pibatu vṛtrahā balaṃ dadhāna ātmani kariṣyanvīryaṃ mahadindrāyendo pari srava
verses.en: Let Vrtra-slaying Indra drink Soma by Saryanavan's side, Storing up vigour in his heart, prepared to do heroic deeds. Flow, Indu, flow for Indra's sake.

verses.sa:
आ पवस्व दिशां पत आर्जीकात्सोम मीढ्वः ।
ऋतवाकेन सत्येन श्रद्धया तपसा सुत इन्द्रायेन्दो परि स्रव॥
verses.tr: ā pavasva diśāṃ pata ārjīkātsoma mīḍhvaḥ ṛtavākena satyena śraddhayā tapasā suta indrāyendo pari srava
verses.en: Lord of the Quarters, flow thou on, boon Soma, from Arjika land, Effused with ardour and with faith, and the true hymn of sacrifice. Flow, Indu, flow for Indra's sake.

verses.sa:
पर्जन्यवृद्धं महिषं तं सूर्यस्य दुहिताभरत् ।
तं गन्धर्वाः प्रत्यगृभ्णन्तं सोमे रसमादधुरिन्द्रायेन्दो परि स्रव॥
verses.tr: parjanyavṛddhaṃ mahiṣaṃ taṃ sūryasya duhitābharat taṃ gandharvāḥ pratyagṛbhṇantaṃ some rasamādadhurindrāyendo pari srava
verses.en: Hither hath Surya's Daughter brought the wild Steer whom Parjanya nursed. Gandharvas have seized bold of him, and in the Soma laid the juice. Flow, Indu, flow for Indra's sake.

verses.sa:
ऋतं वदन्नृतद्युम्न सत्यं वदन्त्सत्यकर्मन् ।
श्रद्धां वदन्त्सोम राजन्धात्रा सोम परिष्कृत इन्द्रायेन्दो परि स्रव॥
verses.tr: ṛtaṃ vadannṛtadyumna satyaṃ vadantsatyakarman śraddhāṃ vadantsoma rājandhātrā soma pariṣkṛta indrāyendo pari srava
verses.en: Splendid by Law! declaring Law, truth speaking, truthful in thy works, Enouncing faith, King Soma! thou, O Soma, whom thy maker decks. Flow, Indu, flow for Indra's sake.

verses.sa:
सत्यमुग्रस्य बृहतः सं स्रवन्ति संस्रवाः ।
सं यन्ति रसिनो रसाः पुनानो ब्रह्मणा हर इन्द्रायेन्दो परि स्रव॥
verses.tr: satyamugrasya bṛhataḥ saṃ sravanti saṃsravāḥ saṃ yanti rasino rasāḥ punāno brahmaṇā hara indrāyendo pari srava
verses.en: Together flow the meeting streams of him the Great and truly Strong. The juices of the juicy meet. Made pure by prayer, O Golden-hued, flow, Indu, flow for Indra's sake.

verses.sa:
यत्र ब्रह्मा पवमान छन्दस्यां३ वाचं वदन् ।
ग्राव्णा सोमे महीयते सोमेनानन्दं जनयन्निन्द्रायेन्दो परि स्रव॥
verses.tr: yatra brahmā pavamāna chandasyāṃ3 vācaṃ vadan grāvṇā some mahīyate somenānandaṃ janayannindrāyendo pari srava
verses.en: O Pavamana, where the priest, as he recites the rhythmic prayer, Lords it o'er Soma with the stone, with Soma bringing forth delight, flow, Indu, flow for Indra's sake.

verses.sa:
यत्र ज्योतिरजस्रं यस्मिँल्लोके स्वर्हितम् ।
तस्मिन्मां धेहि पवमानाऽमृते लोके अक्षित इन्द्रायेन्दो परि स्रव॥
verses.tr: yatra jyotirajasraṃ yasmiṃlloke svarhitam tasminmāṃ dhehi pavamānā'mṛte loke akṣita indrāyendo pari srava
verses.en: O Pavarnana, place me in that deathless, undecaying world Wherein the light of heaven is set, and everlasting lustre shines. Flow, Indu, flow for Indra's sake.

verses.sa:
यत्र राजा वैवस्वतो यत्रावरोधनं दिवः ।
यत्रामूर्यह्वतीरापस्तत्र माममृतं कृधीन्द्रायेन्दो परि स्रव॥
verses.tr: yatra rājā vaivasvato yatrāvarodhanaṃ divaḥ yatrāmūryahvatīrāpastatra māmamṛtaṃ kṛdhīndrāyendo pari srava
verses.en: Make me immortal in that realm where dwells the King, Vivasvan's Son, Where is the secret shrine of heaven, where are those waters young and fresh. Flow, Indu, flow for Indra's sake.

verses.sa:
यत्रानुकामं चरणं त्रिनाके त्रिदिवे दिवः ।
लोका यत्र ज्योतिष्मन्तस्तत्र माममृतं कृधीन्द्रायेन्दो परि स्रव॥
verses.tr: yatrānukāmaṃ caraṇaṃ trināke tridive divaḥ lokā yatra jyotiṣmantastatra māmamṛtaṃ kṛdhīndrāyendo pari srava
verses.en: Make me immortal in that realm where they move even as they list, In the third sphere of inmost heaven where lucid worlds are full of light. Flow, Indu, flow for Indra's sake.

verses.sa:
यत्र कामा निकामाश्च यत्र ब्रध्नस्य विष्टपम् ।
स्वधा च यत्र तृप्तिश्च तत्र माममृतं कृधीन्द्रायेन्दो परि स्रव॥
verses.tr: yatra kāmā nikāmāśca yatra bradhnasya viṣṭapam svadhā ca yatra tṛptiśca tatra māmamṛtaṃ kṛdhīndrāyendo pari srava
verses.en: Make me immortal in that realm of eager wish and strong desire, The region of the radiant Moon, where food and full delight are found. Flow, Indu, flow for Indra's sake:

verses.sa:
यत्रानन्दाश्च मोदाश्च मुदः प्रमुद आसते ।
कामस्य यत्राप्ताः कामास्तत्र माममृतं कृधीन्द्रायेन्दो परि स्रव॥
verses.tr: yatrānandāśca modāśca mudaḥ pramuda āsate kāmasya yatrāptāḥ kāmāstatra māmamṛtaṃ kṛdhīndrāyendo pari srava
verses.en: Make me immortal in that realm where happiness and transports, where Joys and felicities combine, and longing wishes are fulfilled. Flow, Indu, flow for Indra's sake.

verses.sa:
य इन्दोः पवमानस्याऽनु धामान्यक्रमीत् ।
तमाहुः सुप्रजा इति यस्ते सोमाविधन्मन इन्द्रायेन्दो परि स्रव॥
verses.tr: ya indoḥ pavamānasyā'nu dhāmānyakramīt tamāhuḥ suprajā iti yaste somāvidhanmana indrāyendo pari srava
verses.en: The man who walketh as the Laws of Indu Pavamana bid, Men call him rich in children, him, O Soma, who hath met thy thought. Flow, Indu, flow for Indra's sake.

verses.sa:
ऋषे मन्त्रकृतां स्तोमैः कश्यपोद्वर्धयन्गिरः ।
सोमं नमस्य राजानं यो जज्ञे वीरुधां पतिरिन्द्रायेन्दो परि स्रव॥
verses.tr: ṛṣe mantrakṛtāṃ stomaiḥ kaśyapodvardhayangiraḥ somaṃ namasya rājānaṃ yo jajñe vīrudhāṃ patirindrāyendo pari srava
verses.en: Kasyapa, Rsi, lifting up thy voice with hymn-composers' lauds, Pav reverence to King Soma born the Sovran Ruler of the plants. Flow, Indu, flow for Indra's sake.

verses.sa:
सप्त दिशो नानासूर्याः सप्त होतार ऋत्विजः ।
देवा आदित्या ये सप्त तेभिः सोमाभि रक्ष न इन्द्रायेन्दो परि स्रव॥
verses.tr: sapta diśo nānāsūryāḥ sapta hotāra ṛtvijaḥ devā ādityā ye sapta tebhiḥ somābhi rakṣa na indrāyendo pari srava
verses.en: Seven regions have their several Suns; the ministering priests are seven; Seven are the Aditya Deities,-with these, O Soma, guard thou us. Flow, Indu, flow for Indra's sake.

verses.sa:
यत्ते राजञ्छृतं हविस्तेन सोमाभि रक्ष नः ।
अरातीवा मा नस्तारीन्मो च नः किं चनाममदिन्द्रायेन्दो परि स्रव॥
verses.tr: yatte rājañchṛtaṃ havistena somābhi rakṣa naḥ arātīvā mā nastārīnmo ca naḥ kiṃ canāmamadindrāyendo pari srava
verses.en: Guard us with this oblation which, King Soma, hath been dressed for thee.
